title: Keynote
gloss: 主題演講
takeaway: 這是 WWDC 2026 的開場主題演講，揭露 Apple 各平台軟體的全新功能與技術方向。

points.text: 揭露最新的 Apple 軟體與技術，是掌握本屆 WWDC 全貌的**開場主題演講**。
涵蓋各平台的**平台改進（Platform improvements）**，預告整年度的開發方向。
說明在**信任與安全（Trust and safety）**方面的進展。
聚焦 **Apple Intelligence 與 Siri** 的新能力。

audience: **所有 Apple 平台的開發者**，想一次掌握本屆 WWDC 重點方向的人。
gloss_en: Keynote
takeaway_en: This is the WWDC 2026 opening keynote, revealing the new features and technical direction across Apple's platform software.

points_en.text: Reveals the latest Apple software and technologies; the **opening keynote** for grasping the full picture of this year's WWDC.
Covers **platform improvements** across every platform, previewing the development direction for the year ahead.
Explains progress on **trust and safety**.
Focuses on the new capabilities of **Apple Intelligence and Siri**.

audience_en: **Developers across all Apple platforms** who want to grasp this year's WWDC priorities in one go.
summary: 這是 **WWDC 2026 Keynote**，Apple 一年一度向全球開發者與使用者揭曉新一代軟體與技術的開場主題演講。內容橫跨各大作業系統平台的更新、信任與安全（Trust and Safety）的強化，以及本屆最受矚目的 **Apple Intelligence** 與全新 **Siri** 體驗。
演講依序帶過幾條主線：首先是各平台（iOS、iPadOS、macOS、watchOS、visionOS 等）的整體**功能與體驗改進**；接著聚焦在使用者**隱私、安全與信任**機制的演進；最後以 **Apple Intelligence** 與更具情境理解能力的 Siri 收尾，描繪裝置端與雲端協作的智慧化方向。
對開發者而言，Keynote 是定調全週方向的指南針：它預告了後續眾多技術場次會深入的 API 與框架。建議把它當成**索引**，記下與自家 App 相關的主題（例如 Apple Intelligence、平台新體驗或安全機制），再到對應的深入場次與 Group Lab 補齊細節。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: **Keynote** 開場，Apple 揭開本屆 WWDC 的序幕，預告接下來將公布的軟體與技術重點。此段為整場定調，鋪陳後續平台、安全與智慧化三大主軸。

deepdive.title: Platform improvements
deepdive.body: 綜覽各大作業系統平台的**功能與體驗更新**，涵蓋系統介面、App 生態與跨裝置協作的整體進化。這些改進通常會在週間的專門場次中逐一展開細節。

deepdive.title: Trust and safety
deepdive.body: 聚焦使用者的**隱私、安全與信任**機制，說明 Apple 在資料保護與平台安全上的最新作法。對開發者而言預示了權限、隱私揭露與安全相關 API 的方向。

deepdive.title: Apple Intelligence and Siri
deepdive.body: 本屆重頭戲：**Apple Intelligence** 與全新 **Siri** 體驗，強調更深的情境理解與裝置端／雲端協作的智慧能力。為後續 App Intents、Foundation Models 等開發場次埋下伏筆。

summary_en: This is the **WWDC 2026 Keynote**, Apple's annual opening address unveiling the next generation of software and technologies to developers and users worldwide. It spans updates across the operating system platforms, advances in Trust and Safety, and the headline topics of this year: **Apple Intelligence** and a reimagined **Siri**.

The talk moves through a few main threads: first the overall **feature and experience improvements** across platforms (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and more); then a focus on user **privacy, security, and trust**; and finally **Apple Intelligence** and a more context-aware Siri, sketching a direction of on-device and cloud collaboration.

For developers, the Keynote is the compass for the whole week: it previews the APIs and frameworks that later technical sessions dive into. Treat it as an **index** — note the themes relevant to your own app (Apple Intelligence, new platform experiences, or security mechanisms) and follow up in the corresponding deep-dive sessions and Group Labs.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: The **Keynote** opens WWDC, with Apple setting the stage for the software and technologies to be announced. This segment frames the three main threads that follow: platforms, safety, and intelligence.

deepdive_en.title: Platform improvements
deepdive_en.body: An overview of **feature and experience updates** across the operating systems, covering system UI, the app ecosystem, and cross-device collaboration. These improvements are typically expanded in dedicated sessions throughout the week.

deepdive_en.title: Trust and safety
deepdive_en.body: A focus on user **privacy, security, and trust**, outlining Apple's latest approaches to data protection and platform security. For developers it foreshadows the direction of permissions, privacy disclosures, and security-related APIs.

deepdive_en.title: Apple Intelligence and Siri
deepdive_en.body: The marquee topic: **Apple Intelligence** and a new **Siri** experience, emphasizing deeper context understanding and on-device/cloud collaboration. It lays groundwork for later sessions on App Intents, Foundation Models, and more.

audience_en: All Apple platform developers, especially those who want to **get a broad overview of this year's technical highlights** before deciding where to dig deeper.
summary: 2026 年的 **Platforms State of the Union** 圍繞三大主軸：**Apple Intelligence**、平台改進，以及開發者生產力。今年的 Apple Foundation Models 與 Google 的 **Gemini** 技術合作打造，並在裝置端與 Private Cloud Compute 上執行。**Foundation Models 框架**大幅擴充：支援多模態 prompt（文字＋影像）、整合 Vision 的 OCR 與 barcode reader 等 on-device 工具，並可呼叫 **Claude、Gemini 等 server model**（任何供應商都能做一個符合 Language Model protocol 的 Swift 套件）。為了降低門檻，首次下載量低於 200 萬的開發者可免費使用跑在 Private Cloud Compute 上的 Apple Foundation Model（無雲端 API 成本）。框架還引入新的 **Dynamic Profiles** 宣告式 API、開源 Swift 工具套件（含 skills 與 context 管理）、Evaluations 框架、升級的 Foundation Models instrument、**fm 命令列工具**、Python SDK、影像 tool calling 與 Core Spotlight 驅動的 RAG 工具——且框架本身今夏將**開源**。

除了在 app 內建構，Apple Intelligence 也能透過 **App Intents** 把你的 app 推到系統各處。**App Schemas**（entity schema 描述內容、intent schema 描述動作）讓整合 Siri 變簡單：把內容貢獻到 **Spotlight 語意索引**即可被語意理解並導回你的 app，而 intent schema 由系統定義、會隨 Siri 語言能力更新自動受惠，使用者不必記特定指令。新的 **View Annotations API** 讓使用者能引用畫面上的內容（「第二則訊息」「這張照片」）並對其採取動作。Demo 以 Origami app 示範用 `@AppEntity`／`@AppIntent` macro conform schema、索引到 Spotlight，再用 Siri 查訊息、傳訊與傳送畫面上的照片。想在裝置上跑自己的模型則有全新的 **Core AI** 框架（memory-safe Swift API、PyTorch 轉換工具、專屬 instruments 與視覺除錯器），研究／訓練則有支援 Metal 4、可跨多台 Mac 訓練的 **MLX**。

平台改進方面，用新 SDK 重新編譯後 app 啟動更快、更靈敏。**Liquid Glass** 持續精修：更有效擴散背後內容、加入暗邊與更亮的鏡面高光、設定中可從 ultra clear 到 fully tinted 調整，且自動適配 reduce transparency 等無障礙設定；macOS 的 sidebar 延伸到邊緣並恢復 accent color、視窗圓角統一、scroll edge effect 自動套用，Icon Composer 可用多層 Liquid Glass 設計圖示。iOS app 現可在 iPhone Mirroring 與 iPad 上**調整大小**（用新 SDK 重編即自動加入，可用 resizable simulator 與 Previews 測試，並有 coding agent 的 skill 協助修常見問題）。**SwiftUI** 帶來可重排序容器（`.reorderable()`／`.reorderContainer()`）、任意容器的 swipe actions、更彈性的文字選取、更快的 layout 與 lazy state、AsyncImage HTTP 快取、toolbar 的 `visibilityPriority`／overflow／`topBarPinnedTrailing`、新文件基礎建設，以及把 Mac app 內容延伸到 Vision Pro 的 Spatial Preview。**Swift 6.4** 則改善可抑制／升級的警告、`anyAppleOS`、defer 中可 await，並大幅減少「無法在合理時間內 type check」的錯誤。

Swift 正成為橫跨整個技術堆疊的語言：Apple 已在 WebKit、QUIC、TrueType 字型引擎、甚至部分 OS kernel 用 Swift 改寫，並支援 Linux、Windows、Android、Web。最後是開發者生產力：去年帶到 Xcode 的 AI 編碼能力今年加快釋出節奏，支援 **Model Context Protocol**（連 Figma、GitHub 等）、內建 Anthropic／OpenAI／Google 的 agent，並新增 **Agent Client Protocol** 支援任何相容 agent（ACP 與 Gemini 整合於今日的 Xcode 26 更新提供）。Xcode 27 體積縮小 30%、僅支援 Apple silicon，載入更快、修了主要當機、debug 更可靠，且設定會自動同步到 iCloud。另外 macOS 完成轉向 Apple silicon（可上架 Apple silicon-only binary），舊版設計選項將被移除——以 Xcode 27 重編後即自動採用 Liquid Glass。
summary_en: The 2026 **Platforms State of the Union** is organized around three themes: **Apple Intelligence**, platform improvements, and developer productivity. This year's Apple Foundation Models were built in collaboration with Google leveraging its **Gemini** technology, running on device and on Private Cloud Compute. The **Foundation Models framework** expands significantly: multimodal prompts (text + images), integration of on-device Vision tools like OCR and a barcode reader, and the ability to call **server models like Claude and Gemini** (any provider can ship a Swift package conforming to the Language Model protocol). To lower the barrier, developers with fewer than 2 million first-time downloads can use the Apple Foundation Model on Private Cloud Compute for free (no cloud API cost). It also introduces the new declarative **Dynamic Profiles** API, an open-source Swift package (with skills and context management), an Evaluations framework, an upgraded Foundation Models instrument, the **fm command line tool**, a Python SDK, image tool calling, and a Core Spotlight-powered RAG tool—and the framework itself will be **open sourced** this summer.

Beyond in-app features, Apple Intelligence can surface your app across the system through **App Intents**. **App Schemas** (entity schemas describe content, intent schemas describe actions) make Siri integration easy: contribute content to the **Spotlight semantic index** for semantic understanding with attribution back to your app, while intent schemas are system-defined and automatically benefit as Siri's language understanding evolves, so users don't have to memorize phrases. The new **View Annotations API** lets users reference onscreen content ('the second message', 'this photo') and act on it. The Origami app demo shows conforming to schemas with the `@AppEntity`/`@AppIntent` macros, indexing into Spotlight, then using Siri to query messages, send a text, and send an onscreen photo. To run your own models on device there's the new **Core AI** framework (memory-safe Swift API, PyTorch conversion tools, dedicated instruments and visual debugger), and for research/training there's **MLX** (Metal 4 support, training across multiple Macs).

On platform improvements, recompiling with the new SDK makes apps launch faster and feel more responsive. **Liquid Glass** is refined: it diffuses complex content behind it more effectively, adds a darkened edge and brighter specular highlights, a Settings slider ranges from ultra clear to fully tinted, and it adapts automatically to accessibility settings like reduce transparency; on macOS, sidebars extend to the edges and regain accent color, window corner radii are unified, the scroll edge effect applies automatically, and Icon Composer can design icons from multiple Liquid Glass layers. iOS apps can now be **resized** in iPhone Mirroring and on iPad (auto opted-in when recompiled, testable with a resizable simulator and Previews, with a coding-agent skill to fix common issues). **SwiftUI** brings reorderable containers (`.reorderable()`/`.reorderContainer()`), swipe actions in any container, more flexible text selection, faster layout and lazy state, AsyncImage HTTP caching, toolbar `visibilityPriority`/overflow/`topBarPinnedTrailing`, new document infrastructure, and Spatial Preview to extend Mac app content to Vision Pro. **Swift 6.4** improves suppressible/promotable warnings, `anyAppleOS`, await in defer, and greatly reduces the 'unable to type check in reasonable time' error.

Swift is becoming the language across the entire stack: Apple has rewritten parts of WebKit, QUIC, the TrueType font engine, and even portions of the OS kernel in Swift, with support for Linux, Windows, Android, and the web. Finally, developer productivity: the AI coding brought to Xcode last year ships faster this year, supporting **Model Context Protocol** (connecting Figma, GitHub, etc.), built-in agents from Anthropic/OpenAI/Google, and the new **Agent Client Protocol** for any compatible agent (ACP and Gemini integration ship in today's Xcode 26 update). Xcode 27 is 30% smaller, Apple silicon-only, loads faster, fixes top crashes, debugs more reliably, and syncs settings to iCloud. macOS has completed its transition to Apple silicon (you can ship Apple silicon-only binaries), and the old design opt-out will be removed—recompiling with Xcode 27 automatically adopts Liquid Glass.

summary: 這是 2026 年的 **Platforms State of the Union**，Apple 從三大主軸介紹開發者今年最該關注的更新：**Apple Intelligence**、**平台改進**，以及**開發者生產力**。今年兩大貫穿全場的主題是去年起的 **Liquid Glass** 新設計與 Apple Intelligence，許多方向都受開發者回饋影響。Apple Intelligence 的核心是 **Apple Foundation Models**——今年 Apple 與 Google 合作、運用 Gemini 系列背後技術打造最新的 Foundation Models 來驅動 Apple Intelligence，並透過 **Foundation Models 框架**開放給 app 使用。

Foundation Models 框架今年大幅進化：新增**多模態提示**（文字＋圖片，並整合 Vision 框架提供 OCR 與條碼讀取等 on-device 工具），可呼叫 **server models**（Claude、Gemini 等，任何 provider 可做符合 Language Model protocol 的 Swift package），並讓首次 App Store 下載少於 200 萬的開發者**免雲端 API 費用**使用跑在 Private Cloud Compute 上的 Apple Foundation Model。新的開源 Swift package 提供 skills 與 context 管理等預建工具，建立在全新宣告式 API **Dynamic Profiles** 之上——可在同一個 `LanguageModelSession` 中持續切換 profile（換模型、指令、工具），共享同一份 transcript。配套還有 **Evaluations 框架**、升級的 Foundation Models instrument、FM 命令列工具、Python SDK，且框架今夏將**開源**。要在裝置上跑自有模型則用全新的 **Core AI** 框架（memory-safe Swift API、可轉換最佳化 PyTorch 模型、深度整合工具鏈）；研究與微調則有開源的 **MLX**（支援 Metal 4、可跨多台 Mac 訓練）。

系統智慧方面，**App Intents 框架**把 app 接上 Apple Intelligence：用 **entity schemas** 把內容貢獻到 Spotlight 語意索引以供 Siri 推理、用 **intent schemas** 讓使用者以自然語言觸發系統定義的常見動作（自動受惠於未來語言更新），並用新的 **View Annotations API** 讓使用者指涉並操作螢幕上的內容（如「這張照片」「第二則訊息」）。平台改進涵蓋：Liquid Glass 的可讀性調校、可調透明度滑桿、macOS 邊到邊側邊欄與帶色圖示、Icon Composer 多層設計；**iOS app 可調整大小**（iPhone Mirroring 與 iPad，以最新 SDK 重編譯即自動加入，附測試用 resizable simulator 與 coding agent skill）。**SwiftUI** 帶來 reorderable 容器、任意容器的 swipe actions、更強文字選取、佈局加速最多兩倍、lazy state、AsyncImage HTTP 快取、toolbar 的 visibilityPriority 與 overflow、新文件基礎架構，以及 Spatial Preview 框架。**Swift 6.4** 則改善警告抑制、`anyAppleOS`、defer 中 await，以及惡名昭彰的型別檢查逾時。

Apple 也宣布 macOS 全面轉向 **Apple silicon**（可上架 Apple silicon-only 二進位），並將移除舊設計選項——以 Xcode 27 重編譯後自動採用 Liquid Glass。開發者生產力方面，**Xcode** 有兩大故事：日常體驗（載入更快、修掉當機、體積縮小 30%、iCloud 同步設定、免設定即建專案、可自訂工具列與全 app 主題、Xcode Cloud 一鍵設定且快兩倍、Previews 可對任意屬性展開變體、全新 **Device Hub** 取代 Simulator 並整合實機）；以及**智慧**——agentic coding 深入每一層，新增渲染 Previews 變體、操作 simulator、在地化、除錯等工具，所有回答都以 Swift／SwiftUI／Apple 框架為基礎。示範了從 `/plan` 規劃、實作、用 agent 操作 simulator 測試、在地化（French）、到從 Organizer 抓 top crash 並修復的端到端流程。Xcode 27 內建 Apple 工程師與設計師的 skills、文件與 MCP 工具（如同各領域專家），並透過 plugins 支援 **Agent Client Protocol**、Anthropic／OpenAI／Google 的 agent，以及 Figma、GitHub 整合。其他工具更新還有 Reality Composer Pro 3 與加入 AI skills 的 Game Porting Toolkit。
summary_en: This is the 2026 **Platforms State of the Union**, where Apple frames the year's most important developer updates around three areas: **Apple Intelligence**, **platform improvements**, and **developer productivity**. The two themes running throughout are last year's **Liquid Glass** design and Apple Intelligence, with much shaped by developer feedback. At the heart of Apple Intelligence are **Apple Foundation Models**—this year built in collaboration with Google using the technology behind the Gemini family of models to power Apple Intelligence, and exposed to apps through the **Foundation Models framework**.

The Foundation Models framework evolves significantly: new **multimodal prompts** (text plus images, with the Vision framework integrated for on-device OCR and barcode reading), the ability to call **server models** (Claude, Gemini, and more—any provider can ship a Swift package conforming to the Language Model protocol), and **no cloud API cost** for developers with fewer than 2 million first-time App Store downloads using the Apple Foundation Model on Private Cloud Compute. A new open-source Swift package provides pre-built tools like skills and context management, built on the new declarative **Dynamic Profiles** API—you can continuously switch profiles within one `LanguageModelSession` (swapping models, instructions, and tools) while sharing the same transcript. Supporting tools include the **Evaluations framework**, an upgraded Foundation Models instrument, an FM command-line tool, and a Python SDK, and the framework will be **open-sourced** this summer. To run your own models on device there's the new **Core AI** framework (a memory-safe Swift API, PyTorch conversion and optimization, deep toolchain integration); for research and fine-tuning there's open-source **MLX** (Metal 4, multi-Mac training).

For system intelligence, the **App Intents framework** connects apps to Apple Intelligence: use **entity schemas** to contribute content to the Spotlight semantic index for Siri to reason over, **intent schemas** to let users trigger system-defined common actions via natural language (benefiting from future language updates automatically), and the new **View Annotations API** to let users reference and act on on-screen content ('this photo', 'the second message'). Platform improvements span Liquid Glass readability tuning, an adjustable-transparency slider, edge-to-edge sidebars and colored icons on macOS, and multi-layer Icon Composer design; **resizable iOS apps** (in iPhone Mirroring and on iPad, auto-opted-in when recompiled against the latest SDK, with a resizable simulator and a coding-agent skill for testing). **SwiftUI** brings reorderable containers, swipe actions in any container, richer text selection, layouts up to 2x faster, lazy state, AsyncImage HTTP caching, toolbar visibilityPriority and overflow, new document infrastructure, and the Spatial Preview framework. **Swift 6.4** improves warning suppression, `anyAppleOS`, await in defer, and the notorious type-check timeout.

Apple also announces macOS is fully on **Apple silicon** (you can ship Apple silicon-only binaries) and will remove the old-design opt-out—recompiling with Xcode 27 adopts Liquid Glass automatically. For developer productivity, **Xcode** has two stories: the daily experience (faster project loading, fewer crashes, 30% smaller, iCloud settings sync, no-setup project creation, customizable toolbar and full-app themes, one-click Xcode Cloud that's 2x faster, Previews variants for any property, and a new **Device Hub** that replaces Simulator and integrates physical devices); and **intelligence**—agentic coding woven into every layer, with new tools to render Preview variants, drive the simulator, localize, and debug, all grounded in Swift, SwiftUI, and Apple frameworks. It demos an end-to-end flow from `/plan` to implementation, agent-driven simulator testing, French localization, and pulling top crashes from the Organizer to fix them. Xcode 27 ships Apple's engineers' and designers' expertise as skills, docs, and MCP tools (like specialists), and supports the **Agent Client Protocol**, Anthropic/OpenAI/Google agents, and Figma/GitHub integrations via plugins. Other tool updates include Reality Composer Pro 3 and a Game Porting Toolkit with AI skills.

title: Announcing Apple’s next big step for Siri and iPhone
gloss: 宣布 Apple 為 Siri 與 iPhone 邁出的下一大步
takeaway: iOS 27 將帶來全新一代的 **Siri AI** 與生成式影像能力，是本屆 Apple Intelligence 的重大方向預告。

points.text: iOS 27 推出能力更強的全新 **Siri AI**，象徵 Apple 智慧助理的重大躍進。
導入**新一代生成式 AI 影像**技術，可轉換並重新詮釋使用者的相片。
強調能產生**逼真影像（photorealistic imagery）**的生成式模型。
屬於簡短的公告影片，後續可關注更深入的開發者技術場次。

audience: **關注 Apple Intelligence 與 Siri 未來方向**的開發者與決策者。
gloss_en: Announcing Apple's next big step for Siri and iPhone
takeaway_en: iOS 27 brings a new generation of **Siri AI** and generative imagery, serving as the major directional preview of this year's Apple Intelligence.

points_en.text: iOS 27 introduces a more capable new **Siri AI**, marking a major leap forward for Apple's intelligent assistant.
Brings in **next-generation generative AI imagery** that can transform and reinterpret users' photos.
Highlights generative models capable of producing **photorealistic imagery**.
This is a short announcement video; watch for the more in-depth developer technical sessions to follow.

audience_en: Developers and decision-makers **focused on the future direction of Apple Intelligence and Siri**.
summary: 這是一支電影預告片風格的宣傳短片，正式預告 iOS 27 上的 **Siri AI** 與新一代 **Apple Intelligence**。核心訊息是 Siri 將迎來大幅進化，扮演真正的「個人助理」角色：使用者可以向 Siri AI 詢問任何問題，並透過一個全新的專屬 app 輕鬆回顧過往的對話紀錄。短片以詢問餐點營養資訊、協助安排足球觀賽派對等生活情境，凸顯 Siri 更貼近個人脈絡的能力。

影像處理是另一大重點：新一代 Apple Intelligence 能 **extend（延伸）**、**reframe（重新構圖）** 與 **clean up（清理）** 你的相片，並在全新的 **Image Playground** 中產生擬真（photorealistic）影像，應用範圍從 Contact Posters 到自訂桌布。Safari 也以 topics 整理內容、以 **Notify Me** 在適當時機提醒；密碼若外洩可一鍵自動更新。
短片同時強調 **隱私保護** 是整套體驗的基礎——Apple Intelligence 如同守門人般守護你的私人資訊，讓資料在提供智慧功能的同時仍受到保護。由於這是預告性質的內容、沒有技術章節，開發者應將其視為 iOS 27 AI 方向的高層次預覽，後續再從各場專門 session 取得實作細節。
summary_en: This is a cinematic, trailer-style promo formally announcing **Siri AI** and next-generation **Apple Intelligence** on iOS 27. The core message is that Siri is getting a major glow-up to become a true "personal assistant": users can ask Siri AI anything and revisit past conversations through a new dedicated app. The clip uses everyday scenarios—asking for the nutritional details of a meal, handling a soccer watch party—to highlight Siri's more personal, context-aware capabilities.

Image processing is another major theme: next-generation Apple Intelligence can **extend**, **reframe**, and **clean up** your photos, and create photorealistic imagery in the all-new **Image Playground**, spanning everything from Contact Posters to custom wallpapers. Safari is more organized with topics and more timely with **Notify Me**, and compromised passwords can be automatically updated with a single tap.

The clip also stresses that **privacy** underpins the whole experience—Apple Intelligence acts as a faithful sentinel guarding your private information so your data stays protected while still delivering intelligent features. Since this is a teaser with no technical chapters, developers should treat it as a high-level preview of iOS 27's AI direction and look to the dedicated technical sessions for implementation details.

title: WWDC26 Platforms State of the Union Recap
gloss: WWDC26 平台現況演講重點回顧
takeaway: 用五分鐘快速掌握 WWDC26 為 App 與遊戲帶來的最新平台進展。

points.text: 這是 **Platforms State of the Union** 的濃縮回顧，一次掃過今年所有重大平台更新。
內容同時涵蓋 **App 與遊戲**，協助開發者快速判斷哪些新技術值得深入。
全片僅約 **五分鐘**，適合作為當週議程的導覽起點。
看完後可依興趣再前往對應的深入議程取得實作細節。

audience: 想要**快速綜覽今年平台更新**、再決定深入方向的所有 Apple 平台開發者。
gloss_en: WWDC26 Platforms State of the Union recap
takeaway_en: Get up to speed in five minutes on the latest platform advances WWDC26 brings to apps and games.

points_en.text: A condensed recap of the **Platforms State of the Union**, sweeping through all of this year's major platform updates at once.
Covers both **apps and games**, helping developers quickly judge which new technologies are worth digging into.
The whole thing runs only about **five minutes**, making it a great starting point for navigating the week's sessions.
Afterward, you can head to the corresponding deep-dive sessions based on your interests for implementation details.

audience_en: All Apple platform developers who want a **quick overview of this year's platform updates** before deciding where to dive deeper.
summary: 這是 WWDC26 **Platforms State of the Union** 的五分鐘濃縮回顧，串起今年三大主軸：智慧、平台、工具。最大的變化是 **Apple Intelligence** 從頭重建——Apple 與 Google 合作，借助 Gemini 系列模型背後的技術打造新一代 **Apple Foundation Models**。Foundation Models framework 同時擴充到支援**圖片輸入**與**雲端模型**，當任務複雜、需要更強的前沿模型時，API 可串接你選擇的雲端模型供應商；新增的 **dynamic profiles** 則讓你用更少的程式碼建構 AI agent 與 skill，能即時抽換工具、動態更新指令。

底層方面，全新的 **Core AI** framework 內建於 OS、充分發揮 Apple Silicon 效能，成為在 app 中執行裝置端模型的最佳途徑；而 **App Intents** 把 app 接上 Apple Intelligence，讓內容可被探索、動作可透過自然語言在 **Siri** 中觸發，新的 **View Annotations API** 更讓使用者只要開口就能操作螢幕上的內容。設計上，**Liquid Glass** 變得更一致、更可個人化也更耐讀；macOS 每個視窗共用更緊緻的圓角，App 圖示自動以更銳利的方式呈現，並可在 **Icon Composer** 加上折射效果。iOS app 現在可調整大小，在 iPad 或透過 iPhone 鏡像在 Mac 上都能善用更大的螢幕，新的可調整大小 iOS 模擬器與預覽讓跨尺寸測試更輕鬆。

**SwiftUI** 帶來更快的速度與更豐富的互動：拖曳重新排序與滑動操作現在可用於任何容器，巢狀版面 resize 速度最高快兩倍，async image 會自動快取，toolbar 對空間縮小時哪些元素保留有更細的控制；在 Apple Vision Pro 上，新的 **Spatial Preview Framework** 能把 3D 模型從 Mac 串流到你周遭的空間。**Xcode** 今年有兩條主線：日常體驗與 agentic coding。Xcode 27 因為僅支援 Apple Silicon 而體積縮小 30%、載入更快，設定透過 iCloud 同步、toolbar 完全可自訂、並可用主題（Emerald、Neon Noir、Coral Reef）讓色彩貫穿全 app；**Xcode Cloud** 更易設定、建置最高快兩倍並支援 Apple Vision Pro 與 Metal；全新的 **Device Hub** 取代 Simulator，把虛擬與實體裝置整合在一處。

在 agentic coding 上，Apple 與領先的模型供應商合作把 agent 帶進 Xcode——**Anthropic**、**OpenAI**，今年再加上 **Google**。與 agent 的對話現在像一般檔案，可開啟、分割、堆疊在 Navigator 中；agent 會先擬定計畫讓你維持架構主導權，能執行測試、在 playground 試做、自訂預覽以驗證明暗模式、方向、文字大小與在地化的 UI，甚至能驅動執行中的 app（點擊、捲動、滑動、輸入）做端對端測試。Xcode 27 內建 Apple 工程師與設計師的專業（SwiftUI、無障礙、尺寸、測試、效能等 specialist），agent 可隨時取用；你也能透過 **plugin** 擴充——帶入 skill、MCP 工具與任何遵循 agent-client protocol 的 agent，Figma 與 GitHub 都提供一鍵安裝的版本。一句話總結：智慧重建、平台精修、工具脫胎換骨。
summary_en: This is the five-minute condensed recap of the WWDC26 **Platforms State of the Union**, tying together the year's three themes: intelligence, platforms, and tools. The biggest change is that **Apple Intelligence** has been rebuilt from the ground up — Apple worked with Google, leveraging the technologies behind the Gemini family of models, to create the new **Apple Foundation Models**. The Foundation Models framework expands to support **image input** and **cloud models**: when a task is complex and needs a more advanced frontier model, the API can now integrate with the cloud model provider of your choice. New **dynamic profiles** let you build AI agents and skills with far less code, swapping tools in and out and updating instructions on the fly.

Under the hood, the all-new **Core AI** framework is built into the OS and takes full advantage of Apple Silicon, making it the best way to run on-device models in your apps; **App Intents** connect your app to Apple Intelligence so content becomes discoverable and actions are available through natural language in **Siri**, and the new **View Annotations API** lets people act on what's on screen just by asking. On design, **Liquid Glass** is more consistent, more personalizable, and better tuned for readability; every macOS window shares a tighter corner radius, app icons render more sharply automatically, and you can add refraction effects in **Icon Composer**. iOS apps are now resizable, so users can take advantage of larger displays on iPads or on Macs via iPhone mirroring, and the new resizable iOS simulator and previews make cross-size testing easy.

**SwiftUI** brings more speed and richer interactions: drag-to-reorder and swipe actions now work in any container, nested layouts resize up to twice as fast, async images cache automatically, and toolbars get finer control over what stays visible as space shrinks; on Apple Vision Pro, the new **Spatial Preview Framework** streams 3D models from your Mac into the space around you. **Xcode** has two big stories this year: the daily experience and agentic coding. Xcode 27 is 30% smaller because it's Apple Silicon only, so projects load faster; settings sync via iCloud, the toolbar is fully customizable, and color flows through the whole app via themes (Emerald, Neon Noir, Coral Reef). **Xcode Cloud** is easier to set up with builds up to twice as fast and support for Apple Vision Pro and Metal, and the all-new **Device Hub** replaces Simulator, uniting virtual and physical devices in one place.

On agentic coding, Apple is working with leading model providers to bring their agents into Xcode — **Anthropic**, **OpenAI**, and now **Google**. Conversations with agents now behave like any other file: open, split, and stack them in the Navigator; the agent lays out its plan before writing code so you stay the architect, can run your tests, try things in playgrounds, customize previews to validate UI across light/dark mode, orientations, text sizes, and localizations, and can even drive your running app (tap, scroll, swipe, type) for end-to-end testing. Xcode 27 ships with the expertise of Apple's engineers and designers built in (specialists for SwiftUI, accessibility, sizing, testing, and performance) that agents can draw on, and you can extend Xcode with **plugins** that bring skills, MCP tools, and any agent via the agent-client protocol — Figma and GitHub ship their own with one-click setup. In short: intelligence rebuilt, platforms refined, tools transformed.

title: Secure your apps with App Attest
gloss: 運用 App Attest 保護你的 App
takeaway: 透過 App Attest 的金鑰證明與斷言機制，驗證請求確實來自未被竄改的正版 App，藉此抵禦詐欺與偽造攻擊。

points.text: 攻擊者會利用**竄改過的 App**冒充正版來詐騙，**App Attest** 能讓你的伺服器確認請求來自合法且未修改的 App。
先用 **DCAppAttestService** 在 **Secure Enclave** 中產生綁定裝置的金鑰（generateKey），再以 attestKey 取得證明交給伺服器驗證。
後續每個請求用 **generateAssertion** 搭配 clientDataHash 簽署，伺服器即可驗證請求完整性。
介紹常見**陷阱**（common pitfalls）與**詐欺指標**（fraud metric），協助評估保護成效並避免實作錯誤。

audience: **需要在伺服器端抵禦詐欺與 App 竄改**的開發者，特別是涉及金流、帳號或敏感資料的服務。
gloss_en: Protect your app with App Attest
takeaway_en: Use App Attest's key attestation and assertion mechanisms to verify that requests genuinely come from an untampered, legitimate app, defending against fraud and spoofing attacks.

points_en.text: Attackers use **modified apps** to impersonate the genuine app and commit fraud; **App Attest** lets your server confirm that requests come from a legitimate, unmodified app.
First use **DCAppAttestService** to generate a device-bound key in the **Secure Enclave** (generateKey), then call attestKey to obtain an attestation that your server verifies.
Sign each subsequent request with **generateAssertion** plus a clientDataHash so the server can verify request integrity.
Covers **common pitfalls** and **fraud metrics** to help you assess protection effectiveness and avoid implementation mistakes.

audience_en: Developers who **need to defend against fraud and app tampering on the server side**, especially for services involving payments, accounts, or sensitive data.
summary: 這場由 Trust and Safety 團隊主講，核心在於：你把 app 設計成在 Apple 平台的安全環境中運作，但詐騙者會逆向工程、修改並重新簽署你的 app，讓篡改過的副本送出「看起來合法」的請求到你的伺服器。講者用兩個情境點題——作弊者偽造測驗答案、或在遊戲注入作弊選單衝榜——並說明 **App Attest** 能讓伺服器辨識並拒絕來自被修改 client 的請求。它的三大保護是：證明 app 跑在**真正的 Apple 硬體**上、揭露 app 是否被修改（透過 relying party、launch category、bundle version），以及用 assertion 保護從 app 到伺服器的 payload 不被竄改。

整個流程分三步。第一步用 **DCAppAttestService** 的 `generateKey()` 產生一把 **Secure Enclave**-bound 金鑰，私鑰留在 Secure Enclave，app 把回傳的 **key ID** 存進 **Keychain**；最佳實務是帳號型 app 每位使用者一把、或整個 app 一把，且 key 會在重裝、還原或從 iCloud 備份回復時失效。第二步呼叫 `attestKey(keyId:clientDataHash:)` 做 **attestation**，伺服器先發 challenge，attestation 物件含 format、attestation statement（憑證鏈與 receipt）、authenticator data；iOS 27 起 authenticator data 末端新增 **extensions**（launch validation category 與 bundle version），macOS 27 起 leaf 憑證帶有 **ACL Blob OID** 反映 full security mode 與 System Integrity Protection。第三步用 `generateAssertion(keyId:clientDataHash:)` 為後續 payload 簽出 **assertion**，伺服器須驗證其中**嚴格遞增的 counter** 以防重放攻擊。

講者特別提醒幾個常見陷阱：所有驗證都必須在**伺服器端**進行，因為一旦 app 被攻陷就不可信；面對既有使用者的新 key 不要直接拒絕，因為重裝或還原都會造成合法的 key rotation；attestation 應由伺服器控制發動並用 exponential back-off 重試、跑在背景以避開全域 rate limit。最後介紹 **fraud metric**——它回報某裝置在過去 30 天內與你 app 關聯的不重複 attested key 概略數量，可揪出被當成 broker 的受感染裝置，但只應作為**風險評估**的調查訊號，而非直接封鎖使用者的依據。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Trust and Safety 團隊的 Manthan 開場，點出威脅情境：詐騙者會逆向工程你的 app、修改並重新簽署，讓被攻陷的副本送出看似合法的請求竊取敏感資料。以**測驗監考 app 被偽造作答**與**屠龍遊戲被注入作弊選單衝榜**兩個例子說明，並預告本場會涵蓋 App Attest 保護什麼、整合步驟、最佳實務、常見陷阱與 fraud metric。

deepdive.title: Protections
deepdive.body: 說明 **App Attest** 的三大保護：以 attestation 提供 app 跑在**真正 Apple 硬體**上的密碼學證明；揭露 app 是否被修改——透過 **relying party identifier**（Team Identifier 與 bundle identifier 串接）、iOS 27 新增的 **launch validation category**、以及 **bundle version**;以及用 **assertion** 保護從 app 到伺服器的 payload 不被中途竄改。

deepdive.title: Availability
deepdive.body: App Attest 支援所有 Apple 平台，**macOS 27 起也新增支援**。但並非所有 app 類型都能用，因此要先以 **isSupported** API gate 你的使用——例如 Action 與 SSO app extension 支援，其他 extension 則不支援。isSupported 的回應本身也可當 fraud signal：若某使用者突然大量回傳 unsupported，可能代表篡改。

deepdive.title: Key generation
deepdive.body: 流程第一步是產生 **key ID**：App Attest 代為建立 **Secure Enclave**-bound 金鑰對，私鑰留在 Secure Enclave，回傳公鑰的 hash 給 app，app 再把 key ID 存入 **Keychain**。這些 key 是後續 attestation 與 assertion 的基礎。

deepdive.title: Generate a Secure Enclave–bound key
deepdive.body: 示範 `DCAppAttestService.shared.generateKey()` 的呼叫，並列出金鑰最佳實務：帳號型 app **每位使用者一把 key**、或整個 app 在裝置上共用一把，切勿跨使用者族群共享。Key ID 隨 app 安裝存在、可跨 app 更新存活，但**重裝、還原或從 iCloud 備份回復都會使其失效**,且 key 綁定單一裝置、不跨裝置同步。

deepdive.title: Attestation
deepdive.body: 進入 attestation 流程：app 從 Keychain 取出 key ID,向伺服器請求 attestation，伺服器回發 **challenge**;app 帶著 key ID 與 challenge 呼叫 attestation API，App Attest 取出金鑰對與來自 Secure Enclave、無法被修改的裝置硬體快照資料，向 Apple 服務驗證後回傳 attestation 物件給 app，再由 app 送交伺服器**儲存並與使用者關聯**。

deepdive.title: Attestation API
deepdive.body: 示範 `attestKey(keyId:clientDataHash:)`，並強調最佳實務：由**伺服器控制發動** attestation 以維持安全的 requests-per-second 上限;失敗時用 **exponential back-off** 重試、不要在 app 內 hard-code retry 以免衝撞全域 rate limit;將 attestation 操作放在**背景工作**、避開使用者流程;且 attestation **必須由伺服器驗證**,因為被攻陷的 app 不可信。

deepdive.title: Assertion
deepdive.body: 在伺服器已驗證 attestation 並儲存公鑰後，app 可用這把已 attest 的 key 透過 **assertion** 保護後續通訊：伺服器發 challenge，app 取 key ID 呼叫 assertion API 取得 assertion 物件，嵌入 payload 送交伺服器驗證後決定接受或拒絕內容。

deepdive.title: Assertion API
deepdive.body: 示範 `generateAssertion(keyId:clientDataHash:)`,並提醒：assertion **在裝置本地產生、不會 round-trip Apple 伺服器**,應於需要時 on demand 產生;它有 **CPU 成本**,避免短時間大量產生;伺服器須驗證其中嵌入的 **counter** 並確保**嚴格遞增**,以提供 anti-replay 保護——若 counter 持平或下降，可能代表被攻陷的副本不知道伺服器記錄的值。

deepdive.title: Common pitfalls
deepdive.body: 點出常見陷阱：面對既有使用者的**新 key 不要直接拒絕**,因為重裝或裝置還原都會造成合法的 key rotation，也不要立即作廢先前的 key;若伺服器拒絕 attestation 或 assertion，app 應**優雅降級**(限縮 App Attest 相關功能、提高監控)而非直接封鎖;任何懷疑都應走完整的**風險評估**流程，貿然封鎖會侵蝕信任並波及合法使用者。

deepdive.title: Fraud metric
deepdive.body: 介紹 **fraud metric**：受感染裝置可能仍通過 attestation，並當成 **broker** 替其他裝置上的篡改 app 產生合法 attestation。Fraud metric 回報某裝置過去 **30 天**內與你 app 關聯的不重複 attested key 概略數量;伺服器用某筆 attestation 的 **receipt** 向 App Attest data server 發 POST 取得含 metric 的 receipt(其 not before 與 expiration 欄位規範刷新時機)。應將其視為**調查訊號**、建立 baseline 找出 spike，而非直接封鎖使用者。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾的行動建議：先用最新 SDK 重新建置 app 以取得最新 App Attest 功能;找出可受益於 attestation 的區域(如認證流程或付費內容的敏感 payload)並以 assertion 強化;設定伺服器去**驗證 attestation、儲存 receipt、追蹤 assertion counter**;並把 **fraud metric** 納入風險評估管線，藉由 Apple 硬體驗證 app 完整性、保護 app 與伺服器間通訊並偵測詐騙跡象。

summary_en: Presented by the Trust and Safety team, this session centers on a clear threat: you build your app to run in a secure environment on Apple's platforms, but fraudsters reverse-engineer, modify, and re-sign it so tampered copies send legitimate-looking requests to your server. Two examples frame the problem—a cheater submitting falsified quiz answers, and a game with an injected cheat menu climbing the leaderboard—and the takeaway is that **App Attest** lets your server detect and reject requests from modified clients. Its three protections are: cryptographic proof the app runs on **genuine Apple hardware**, visibility into whether the app was modified (via relying party, launch category, and bundle version), and securing app-to-server payloads with assertions.

The flow has three steps. First, call **DCAppAttestService**'s `generateKey()` to create a **Secure Enclave**-bound key—the private key stays in the Secure Enclave and the app stores the returned **key ID** in **Keychain**; best practice is one key per user for account-based apps (or one per app), and keys are invalidated on reinstall, restore, or iCloud-backup restore. Second, call `attestKey(keyId:clientDataHash:)` for an **attestation** against a server-vended challenge; the attestation contains format, an attestation statement (certificate chain and receipt), and authenticator data—on iOS 27 the authenticator data gains an **extensions** structure (launch validation category and bundle version), and on macOS 27 the leaf certificate carries an **ACL Blob OID** reflecting full security mode and System Integrity Protection. Third, call `generateAssertion(keyId:clientDataHash:)` to sign subsequent payloads with an **assertion**, whose **strictly-increasing counter** the server must verify for anti-replay protection.

The talk flags key pitfalls: all validation must happen **server-side**, since a compromised app can't be trusted; don't reject a new key for an existing user outright, because reinstall and restore cause legitimate key rotation; and the server should control when attestations are initiated, use exponential back-off on retry, and run them on background tasks to avoid global rate limits. It closes with the **fraud metric**—an approximate count of unique attested keys tied to your app on a device over the past 30 days, useful for spotting a compromised device acting as a broker, but to be treated only as an investigation signal in your **risk assessment**, never as grounds to block a user directly.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Manthan from the Trust and Safety team opens by framing the threat: fraudsters reverse-engineer, modify, and re-sign your app so compromised copies send legitimate-looking requests that steal sensitive data. He illustrates with a **quiz-proctoring app submitting falsified answers** and a **dragon-slayer game with an injected cheat menu climbing the leaderboard**, then previews the agenda: what App Attest protects, integration steps, best practices, common pitfalls, and the fraud metric.

deepdive_en.title: Protections
deepdive_en.body: Describes App Attest's three protections: an **attestation** provides cryptographic proof the app runs on **genuine Apple hardware**; it surfaces app modifications via the **relying party identifier** (Team Identifier concatenated with bundle identifier), the iOS 27 **launch validation category**, and the **bundle version**; and **assertions** secure app-to-server payloads against tampering in transit.

deepdive_en.title: Availability
deepdive_en.body: App Attest is supported on all Apple platforms, now including **macOS 27**. Not every app type can use it, so gate usage with the **isSupported** API—for example, Action and SSO app extensions are supported while other extensions are not. The isSupported response itself can be a fraud signal: a spike in unsupported responses from a user may indicate tampering.

deepdive_en.title: Key generation
deepdive_en.body: The first step is generating a **key ID**: App Attest creates a **Secure Enclave**-bound key pair on the app's behalf, keeping the private key in the Secure Enclave and returning a hash of the public key, which the app stores in **Keychain**. These keys form the basis for attestations and assertions.

deepdive_en.title: Generate a Secure Enclave–bound key
deepdive_en.body: Shows the `DCAppAttestService.shared.generateKey()` call and lists key best practices: **one key per user** for account-based apps (or one per app on the device), never shared across the user population. Key IDs persist for the app's installation and survive updates, but are **invalidated on reinstall, restore, or iCloud-backup restore**, and are per-device—they don't sync across a user's devices.

deepdive_en.title: Attestation
deepdive_en.body: Walks the attestation flow: the app fetches the key ID from Keychain, requests an attestation from the server, and the server vends a **challenge**; the app calls the attestation API with key ID and challenge, App Attest gathers the key pair plus unmodifiable device data derived from the Secure Enclave, validates it with an Apple service, and returns the attestation object, which the app sends to the server to **validate, store, and associate with the user**.

deepdive_en.title: Attestation API
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates `attestKey(keyId:clientDataHash:)` and stresses best practices: the **server controls initiation** to stay within a safe requests-per-second bound; use **exponential back-off** on failure rather than hard-coded retry logic to avoid global rate limits; perform attestation on a **background task** outside user flows; and the attestation **must be validated by the server**, since a compromised app can't be trusted.

deepdive_en.title: Assertion
deepdive_en.body: Once the server has validated the attestation and stored the public key, the app uses that attested key to secure ongoing communication via **assertions**: the server vends a challenge, the app fetches the key ID and calls the assertion API to get an assertion object, embeds it in the payload, and the server validates it before accepting or rejecting the contents.

deepdive_en.title: Assertion API
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates `generateAssertion(keyId:clientDataHash:)` and notes assertions are **generated locally on the device—they don't round-trip Apple servers**—so generate them on demand; they have **CPU cost**, so avoid generating too many; and the server must verify the embedded **counter** is **strictly increasing** for anti-replay protection—a steady or decreasing counter may indicate a compromised copy unaware of the server's recorded value.

deepdive_en.title: Common pitfalls
deepdive_en.body: Calls out pitfalls: don't reject a **new key for an existing user** outright, since reinstall or device restore cause legitimate key rotation, and don't immediately invalidate prior keys; if the server rejects an attestation or assertion, the app should **gracefully degrade** App Attest-tied functionality with heightened monitoring rather than block directly; and any suspicion should go through a full **risk assessment**, since blocking without proper evaluation erodes trust and can hurt legitimate users.

deepdive_en.title: Fraud metric
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **fraud metric**: a compromised device can still pass attestations and act as a **broker**, generating valid attestations for tampered app instances on other devices. The fraud metric gives an approximate count of unique attested keys tied to your app on a device over the past **30 days**; the server uses an attestation **receipt** to POST to the App Attest data server and receive a receipt carrying the metric (with not-before and expiration fields governing refresh). Treat it as an **investigation signal**—baseline it and watch for spikes—not as grounds to block users.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Closing action items: rebuild against the latest SDKs to access the newest App Attest features; identify areas that benefit from attestation (authentication flows or sensitive payloads for premium content) and strengthen them with assertions; set up the server to **validate attestations, store receipts, and track assertion counters**; and fold the **fraud metric** into your risk-assessment pipeline—verifying app integrity, securing app-to-server communication, and detecting fraud, all backed by Apple hardware.

title: Read between the strokes with PencilKit
gloss: 用 PencilKit 解讀筆跡內容
takeaway: 用 PKStrokeRecognizer 在自家 App 中辨識手寫筆跡、產生可索引與可搜尋的文字，並支援路徑轉換與筆畫切割。

points.text: 用驅動 Freeform、備忘錄等 Apple App 的同一套技術，透過 **PKStrokeRecognizer** 為你的 App 解鎖**手寫辨識**。
呼叫 **updateDrawing** 後即可取得 **recognizedText**，把使用者的手寫筆畫轉成文字字串。
辨識結果可產出 **indexableContent** 供索引，並用 **search** 搜尋關鍵字、回傳可高亮的 bounds。
提供**路徑轉換（path conversion）**與**筆畫切割（stroke slicing）**，並改善模型存取方式。

audience: **開發手寫、筆記或繪圖類 App**、想在 PencilKit 畫布上加入文字辨識與搜尋的開發者。
gloss_en: Read handwriting content with PencilKit
takeaway_en: Use PKStrokeRecognizer to recognize handwritten strokes in your own app, producing indexable and searchable text, with support for path conversion and stroke slicing.

points_en.text: Unlock **handwriting recognition** for your app via **PKStrokeRecognizer**, using the same technology that powers Apple apps like Freeform and Notes.
After calling **updateDrawing**, get **recognizedText** to turn the user's handwritten strokes into a text string.
Recognition results can produce **indexableContent** for indexing, and **search** lets you find keywords and return highlightable bounds.
Provides **path conversion** and **stroke slicing**, along with improved model access.

audience_en: Developers **building handwriting, note-taking, or drawing apps** who want to add text recognition and search on a PencilKit canvas.
summary: 在 iPad 上用 Apple Pencil 書寫如同紙筆般自然，但與紙不同的是手寫內容可以變得**可搜尋、可辨識、可互動**。這場由繪圖功能工程師 Yichen 主講，重點是 **PencilKit** 在 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 27 帶來的全新 API：把手寫筆跡轉成文字的**手寫辨識**、PencilKit 筆畫路徑與標準 Bézier 路徑之間的互轉、對繪圖模型更深入的存取（筆畫身分與選取），以及切割筆畫的 stroke slicing。所有新 API 同樣適用於建立在 PencilKit 之上的 **PaperKit**。

手寫辨識的核心是 **`PKStrokeRecognizer`**，它是一個 Swift `actor`、方法皆為非同步，完全在裝置端離線執行，支援 29 種語言（Simulator 僅支援拉丁字元語言）。它提供三種能力：**recognized text** 回傳最可能的單一辨識結果（可指定 `preferredLanguages` 與 strokeIDs）；**indexable content** 把所有候選結果串接成一個字串，特別適合 Spotlight 索引（持久化時應一併儲存 `recognizerVersion` 以判斷是否需重新索引）；以及 **search()** 給定目標字串回傳比對位置，可搭配 **`UIFindInteraction`** 直接在畫布上獲得系統級尋找與高亮體驗，並能讓 VoiceOver 朗讀手寫內容、提升無障礙性。

**Path conversion** 讓 PencilKit 能用在自家畫布：PencilKit 以 cubic uniform B-spline 表示筆畫，iOS 27 起可與 Bézier path 無損互轉（Bézier 不帶 size、opacity、force，需自行為控制點補上）。把既有 Bézier 筆畫轉成 `PKStrokePath` 後即可組成 `PKDrawing` 餵給辨識器，讓手寫辨識不再侷限於 `PKCanvasView`。模型存取方面，`PKStroke` 與 `PKStrokePath` 現在符合 **`Identifiable`**（穩定 UUID，可跨 transform、編輯、undo 追蹤），並新增 `canvasViewSelectionDidChange` delegate 與可控制的 `renderGroupID`。最後的 stroke slicing 提供兩種切割：用 `PKStrokePath` 當橡皮擦的**程式化抹除**（複雜繪圖較耗效能，建議在背景執行緒處理），以及用 parametric range 的 subscript 做 **substroke 擷取**，可用來精準取出片段並打造如筆順回放的流暢動畫。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由繪圖功能工程師 Yichen 開場，點出手寫在 iPad 上自然如紙筆，但能變得**可搜尋、可辨識、可互動**。**PencilKit** 是 Apple 各平台 freehand 繪圖的核心框架，提供低延遲畫布、表現力豐富的墨水與底層資料模型；iOS 26 的 **PaperKit** 建立其上，而本場所有新 API 同樣適用於 PaperKit。

deepdive.title: Handwriting recognition
deepdive.body: 手寫辨識是 PencilKit 最被期待的能力之一，現於 iOS、iPadOS、macOS、visionOS 27 開放。講者以自製的中英文寫字學習 app 示範：孩子在 flashcard 上書寫「心」，app 能在尚未寫完前就辨識並比對提示字，答對時確認。整段路線圖涵蓋辨識、path conversion、模型存取與 stroke slicing。

deepdive.title: Recognized text
deepdive.body: 核心類別 **`PKStrokeRecognizer`** 是 Swift `actor`（執行緒安全），所有方法皆非同步。**Recognized text** 回傳最可能的單一結果，預設依裝置語言判讀，亦可用 `preferredLanguages` 指定、或只傳入特定 strokeIDs。辨識完全**在裝置端離線**執行，iOS 27 支援 29 種語言（可由 `supportedLanguages` 查詢，Simulator 僅支援拉丁字元）。

deepdive.title: Indexable content
deepdive.body: **Indexable content** 回傳代表整份繪圖內容的單一字串，特別適合 **Spotlight** 搜尋。當手寫模糊（如「1」或小寫「l」、「101」或「lol」）時，它會把所有候選結果串接，確保使用者怎麼搜都找得到。持久化時要一併儲存 **`recognizerVersion`**，載入時與當前版本比對以決定是否重新索引，並建議節流呼叫以省電。

deepdive.title: Find text
deepdive.body: **search()** 給定目標字串，回傳該詞可能出現位置的 SearchResults 陣列（含 bounds），驅動互動式搜尋與高亮。它與系統的 **`UIFindInteraction`** 自然搭配：實作 `UIFindInteractionDelegate` 並以 search() 為底層，即可在畫布直接獲得系統尋找 UI、結果導覽與高亮。這些能力也讓 VoiceOver 能朗讀手寫、輔助功能能定位特定字詞。

deepdive.title: Path conversion
deepdive.body: PencilKit 以 **cubic uniform B-spline** 表示筆畫路徑，但 Bézier path 更通用。iOS 27 起 `PKStrokePath` 支援兩者互轉，PencilKit 處理幾何，但 Bézier 不帶 size、opacity、force，需為每個控制點自行提供。從 `PKStrokePath` 出發來回轉換可得相同控制點位置，達成無損保存；自家 Bézier 畫布也能轉成 `PKStrokePath` 組成 `PKDrawing` 餵給辨識器。

deepdive.title: Improved model access
deepdive.body: `PKStroke` 與 `PKStrokePath` 現在皆符合 **`Identifiable`**，提供穩定 UUID，可跨 transform、編輯、undo 追蹤同一筆畫。有了穩定身分後即可控制 `PKCanvasView` 的選取狀態，並新增 `canvasViewSelectionDidChange` delegate 在選取改變時觸發。當墨水被快速連續繪製時，PencilKit 會以相同 **`renderGroupID`** 合成筆畫，此值在 iOS 27 亦可控制。

deepdive.title: Stroke slicing
deepdive.body: 切割筆畫有兩種方式。**程式化抹除**：提供一個 `PKStrokePath` 當橡皮擦切過繪圖，把單一筆畫切成各自帶 mask 的多個獨立筆畫，效果如使用者用橡皮擦工具；複雜繪圖較耗效能，建議在背景執行緒處理。**Substroke 擷取**：iOS 27 起 `PKStroke` 與 `PKStrokePath` 支援 parametric range 的 subscript，可精準取出任意片段並維持墨水粒子一致性。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 行動建議：採用 **`PKStrokeRecognizer`** 帶入手寫辨識；把既有 Bézier path 轉為 `PKStrokePath`，讓辨識在無 `PKCanvasView` 時也能用；深入模型以穩定身分追蹤筆畫、回應選取變化；並善用 stroke slicing 做程式化抹除與 substroke 動畫（講者用它實作中文筆順回放）。Demo 範例程式碼可在影片資源中取得。

summary_en: Writing on iPad with Apple Pencil feels like pen on paper, but unlike paper your handwriting can become **searchable, recognizable, and interactive**. Presented by drawing-features engineer Yichen, this session covers brand-new **PencilKit** APIs across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS 27: **handwriting recognition** that turns strokes into words, conversion between PencilKit stroke paths and standard Bézier paths, deeper access to the drawing model (stroke identity and selection), and stroke slicing. All of these APIs also work with **PaperKit**, which builds on PencilKit.

Handwriting recognition centers on **`PKStrokeRecognizer`**, a Swift `actor` with async methods that runs entirely on device and offline. It supports 29 languages in iOS 27 (Simulator handles Latin scripts only) and offers three capabilities: **recognized text** returns the single most likely result (configurable via `preferredLanguages` and strokeIDs); **indexable content** concatenates all candidates into one string ideal for Spotlight (store `recognizerVersion` alongside it to decide when to re-index, and throttle calls to save power); and **search()** returns where a target string likely appears, pairing with **`UIFindInteraction`** for a system find-and-highlight experience and enabling VoiceOver to read handwriting for accessibility.

**Path conversion** brings PencilKit to your own canvas: strokes are stored as cubic uniform B-splines, and iOS 27 supports lossless conversion to and from Bézier paths (Bézier paths don't carry size, opacity, or force, so you supply those per control point). Existing Bézier strokes can be converted to `PKStrokePath`, assembled into a `PKDrawing`, and fed to the recognizer, freeing handwriting recognition from `PKCanvasView`. For model access, `PKStroke` and `PKStrokePath` now conform to **`Identifiable`** (stable UUIDs trackable across transforms, edits, and undo), with a new `canvasViewSelectionDidChange` delegate and a controllable `renderGroupID`. Finally, stroke slicing offers programmatic erasing (use a `PKStrokePath` as the eraser; run on a background thread for complex drawings) and substroke extraction via parametric-range subscripts for precise slices and smooth animations like stroke-order replay.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Drawing-features engineer Yichen opens by noting handwriting on iPad feels like pen on paper but can become **searchable, recognizable, and interactive**. **PencilKit** is the core freehand drawing framework on Apple's platforms, offering a low-latency canvas, expressive inks, and access to the underlying data model; iOS 26's **PaperKit** builds on it, and every new API here also works with PaperKit.

deepdive_en.title: Handwriting recognition
deepdive_en.body: Handwriting recognition, one of PencilKit's most requested capabilities, arrives in iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS 27. The presenter demos a Chinese/English writing-practice app for kids: the child writes the character and the app recognizes and checks the work before the word is even finished. The roadmap covers recognition, path conversion, model access, and stroke slicing.

deepdive_en.title: Recognized text
deepdive_en.body: The core class **`PKStrokeRecognizer`** is a thread-safe Swift `actor` with all-async methods. **Recognized text** returns the single most likely result, using device languages by default but configurable via `preferredLanguages` or a subset of strokeIDs. Recognition runs **entirely on device and offline**; iOS 27 supports 29 languages (queryable via `supportedLanguages`; Simulator handles Latin scripts only).

deepdive_en.title: Indexable content
deepdive_en.body: **Indexable content** returns a single string representing the whole drawing, ideal for **Spotlight** search. When handwriting is ambiguous (a '1' vs lowercase 'l', '101' vs 'lol'), it concatenates all candidates so users can find content however they search. Store **`recognizerVersion`** alongside the index to decide whether to re-index when models improve, and throttle calls to conserve power.

deepdive_en.title: Find text
deepdive_en.body: **search()** takes a target string and returns an array of results (with bounds) indicating where the word likely appears, powering interactive search and highlighting. It pairs with the system **`UIFindInteraction`**: implement `UIFindInteractionDelegate` driven by search() to get the system find UI, result navigation, and highlighting in your canvas. These capabilities also let VoiceOver speak handwriting and let assistive features locate specific words.

deepdive_en.title: Path conversion
deepdive_en.body: PencilKit represents stroke paths as **cubic uniform B-splines**, but Bézier paths are more common. iOS 27's `PKStrokePath` supports conversion both ways; PencilKit handles the geometry, but Bézier paths lack size, opacity, and force, so you supply those per control point. Round-tripping from a `PKStrokePath` yields identical control-point locations for lossless storage, and your own Bézier canvas can be converted into a `PKDrawing` for the recognizer.

deepdive_en.title: Improved model access
deepdive_en.body: `PKStroke` and `PKStrokePath` now conform to **`Identifiable`** with stable UUIDs, letting you track a stroke across transforms, edits, and undo. With stable identity you can control selection state on `PKCanvasView`, and a new `canvasViewSelectionDidChange` delegate fires when selection changes. When inks are drawn together quickly, PencilKit composites strokes with an equal **`renderGroupID`**, which is now controllable in iOS 27.

deepdive_en.title: Stroke slicing
deepdive_en.body: Slicing comes in two forms. **Programmatic erasing**: provide a `PKStrokePath` as the eraser to cut through a drawing, slicing one stroke into multiple independent masked strokes just like the eraser tool; slicing is expensive on complex drawings, so consider a background thread. **Substroke extraction**: iOS 27 adds parametric-range subscript access on `PKStroke` and `PKStrokePath` for precise slices that keep ink particles consistent.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recommended actions: adopt **`PKStrokeRecognizer`** to bring handwriting recognition to your app; convert existing Bézier paths to `PKStrokePath` so recognition works even without `PKCanvasView`; dive into the model to track strokes with stable identity and respond to selection changes; and use stroke slicing for programmatic erasing and substroke animations (the presenter built Chinese stroke-order replay this way). Demo sample code is available in the video's resources.

title: What’s new in WebKit for Safari 27
gloss: Safari 27 中 WebKit 的新功能
takeaway: Safari 27 的 WebKit 帶來 CSS Grid Lanes、可自訂 Select、HTML Model 元素與沉浸式網頁環境等新能力，讓網頁體驗更接近原生。

points.text: **CSS Grid Lanes** 提供更靈活的網格排版方式，簡化複雜版面的實作。
**Customizable Select** 讓開發者能完全自訂下拉選單的外觀與內容，不再受原生樣式限制。
新的 **HTML Model element** 可直接在網頁中嵌入並呈現 3D 模型內容。
**Immersive Website Environments** 帶來沉浸式網頁體驗，並持續強化 **Web Extensions** 與 **MapKit JS**。

audience: 適合**網頁開發者與 Safari 平台開發者**，想掌握 Safari 27 最新 Web 標準與能力的人。
gloss_en: What's new in WebKit for Safari 27
takeaway_en: WebKit in Safari 27 brings CSS Grid Lanes, customizable Select, the HTML Model element, and immersive web environments, making web experiences feel closer to native.

points_en.text: **CSS Grid Lanes** offers a more flexible way to lay out grids, simplifying the implementation of complex layouts.
**Customizable Select** lets developers fully customize the appearance and content of dropdown menus, no longer constrained by native styling.
The new **HTML Model element** can embed and render 3D model content directly in web pages.
**Immersive Website Environments** deliver immersive web experiences, with continued enhancements to **Web Extensions** and **MapKit JS**.

audience_en: For **web developers and Safari platform developers** who want to master the latest Web standards and capabilities in Safari 27.
summary: Jen Simmons 帶來 Safari 27 的 **WebKit** 年度更新。今年最大的訊息不是「新功能很多」，而是 WebKit 團隊刻意把重心放在**品質**上：自去年秋天以來累積超過 1100 項功能改善與修復，創下團隊紀錄。品質工作可分為五個主題——**相容性**（例如修正網站用 `.fromCharCode` 處理 emoji 時超過 16-bit 而被截斷成錯字的問題，改由直接把 emoji 當文字送出）、**重建地基**（如從零改寫二十年歷史的 block-in-inline 排版）、**深耕特定領域**（媒體、捲動、SVG、無障礙、WebRTC、HTML 表格，其中 SVG 還重啟並主導了新的標準工作組，做了 75+ 項改善）、**對齊 web 標準**（例如把 CSS `random()` 的命名範圍從 per-instance 改為全域），以及**整合**（補上 `min()`／`max()`／`clamp()` 在 `sizes` 屬性裡缺失的支援）。

在品質之外，這場也介紹了五個值得關注的新功能。**CSS Grid Lanes** 已於 Safari 26.4 推出，能用純 CSS 完成經典的 masonry（瀑布流）版面，無需 JavaScript，並完整保有 CSS Grid 定義軌道的能力。**Customizable Select** 讓開發者用 `appearance: base-select` 接管 `<select>` 與 `::picker` 的外觀，並可在 `<option>` 內放入圖片與描述文字，同時保有原生表單控制項的無障礙與健壯性。**HTML `<model>` element** 把 3D 模型帶進 HTML，今年從 visionOS 擴展到 iOS、iPadOS、macOS，可搭配 `environmentmap`、`stagemode` 等屬性。

在 visionOS 27 上，`<model>` 更進一步支援 **Immersive Website Environments**：使用者可在 Safari 點一下就步入你提供的沉浸場景，搭配仿照 Fullscreen API 設計的新 Immersive API 來操作模型。最後是 **Web Extensions** 的跨瀏覽器化——一套 HTML／CSS／JavaScript 與一份 manifest 即可通用，並推出 **Safari web extension packager**，讓開發者不需 Mac 或 Xcode，也能透過 App Store Connect 從任何瀏覽器打包與發佈。講者也提了一句 **MapKit JS**，可在任何瀏覽器嵌入兼顧隱私的互動地圖。實務建議：在最新的 Safari Technology Preview 或 Safari beta 測試你的專案，並到 bugs.webkit.org 回報問題。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 **WebKit** 與 Safari 的對外代表 Jen Simmons 開場。她點出 Safari 27 第一個 beta 帶來超過 60 項新功能（如 Customizable Select、`img sizes=auto`、`stretch` 關鍵字），但本場真正的主軸是團隊今年投入的**品質**工作，之後才挑五個最值得一看的新功能深入。

deepdive.title: A year of quality improvements
deepdive.body: 說明今年策略性地把資源投在改善既有功能而非狂推新功能，並歸納成五個主題：**相容性**（emoji 因 `.fromCharCode` 截斷成錯字，改由直接送出文字解決）、**重建地基**（重寫二十年的 block-in-inline 排版）、**深耕領域**（SVG 重啟標準工作組、做了 75+ 項改善）、**對齊標準**（CSS `random()` 命名改為全域）與**整合**（補齊 `sizes` 內的 `min()`／`max()`／`clamp()`）。總計超過 **1100 項**改善與修復。

deepdive.title: CSS Grid Lanes
deepdive.body: **CSS Grid Lanes** 已在 Safari 26.4 推出，用純 CSS 即可做出經典 masonry 瀑布流版面，完整保留 CSS Grid 定義軌道的能力且可雙向運作。建議到 gridlanes.webkit.org 的 Field Guide 互動體驗，並用 Web Inspector 開啟 Order Numbers 以調整 tab 順序與 flow tolerance。

deepdive.title: Customizable Select
deepdive.body: Safari 27 用 `appearance: base-select` 讓 `<select>` 開始繼承字型、文字與背景等 CSS，並對 `::picker` 同樣套用以自訂彈出選單；新增 `::checkmark`、`::picker-icon` 等 pseudo-element。還能在 `<option>` 內放入子文字與圖片，並用 Grid／Flexbox 排版，同時保有原生表單控制項的**無障礙**與健壯性。

deepdive.title: HTML Model element
deepdive.body: 去年先在 visionOS 推出的 `` 元素，Safari 27 起擴展到 iOS、iPadOS、macOS，把 3D 模型帶入 HTML，與 ``、`

deepdive.title: Immersive Website Environments
deepdive.body: 在 visionOS 27 上，`<model>` 進一步支援沉浸式網站環境：使用者在 Safari 點一下即可步入你提供的場景（例如預覽劇院座位視野或沉浸式遊戲）。新的 **Immersive API** 運作方式與 Fullscreen API 類似，可參考「Explore immersive website environments in visionOS」深入了解。

deepdive.title: Web Extensions
deepdive.body: 回顧擴充功能跨瀏覽器標準化的歷程，並強調如今可用單一 HTML／CSS／JavaScript 程式碼與一份 manifest 通用於各家瀏覽器。重點是新推出的 **Safari web extension packager**，讓開發者不需 Xcode 甚至不需 Mac，就能透過 App Store Connect 從任何瀏覽器、任何作業系統打包與發佈擴充功能。

deepdive.title: MapKit JS
deepdive.body: 簡短帶到 **MapKit JS**：可在網站或 web app 中嵌入互動地圖，同時保護使用者隱私，且能在所有瀏覽器與任何作業系統上運作。詳情見 developer.apple.com。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結今年 WebKit 在品質與新功能上的投入，邀請開發者用最新的 Safari Technology Preview 或 Safari beta 測試專案，到 bugs.webkit.org 回報問題，並前往 webkit.org 了解每個 Safari 版本的新功能細節。

summary_en: Jen Simmons presents the annual **WebKit** update for Safari 27. The headline this year isn't a flood of new features but a deliberate focus on **quality**: over 1100 feature improvements and fixes since last fall, a team record. The quality work breaks into five themes — **compatibility** (e.g. fixing the bug where sites using `.fromCharCode` truncated emoji code points beyond 16 bits into the wrong character, now solved by delivering the emoji as text instead), **rebuilding foundations** (rewriting the two-decade-old block-in-inline layout from scratch), **going deep in specific areas** (media, scrolling, SVG, accessibility, WebRTC, HTML tables — SVG even meant reviving and leading a new standards effort, with 75+ improvements), **aligning with web standards** (e.g. redefining the scoping of CSS `random()` names from per-instance to global), and **integration** (closing the long-standing gap where `min()`/`max()`/`clamp()` weren't supported inside the `sizes` attribute).

Beyond quality, the session highlights five notable new features. **CSS Grid Lanes** (shipped in Safari 26.4) creates classic masonry layouts in pure CSS — no JavaScript — while keeping all the power of CSS Grid track definition. **Customizable Select** lets you take over the look of `<select>` and `::picker` via `appearance: base-select`, place images and descriptive text inside `<option>`, and lay options out with Grid or Flexbox, all while keeping the accessibility and robustness of a real form control. The HTML **`<model>` element** brings 3D models to HTML, expanding this year from visionOS to iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with attributes like `environmentmap` and `stagemode`.

On visionOS 27, `<model>` goes further with **Immersive Website Environments**: users can tap in Safari to step into a scene you provide, manipulated through a new Immersive API designed to work just like the Fullscreen API. Finally, **Web Extensions** become truly cross-browser — one set of HTML/CSS/JavaScript and one manifest — backed by the new **Safari web extension packager**, which lets developers package and distribute via App Store Connect from any browser on any OS, without Xcode or even a Mac. The talk also briefly mentions **MapKit JS** for embedding privacy-preserving interactive maps in any browser. The practical takeaway: test your projects in the latest Safari Technology Preview or Safari beta and file issues at bugs.webkit.org.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Jen Simmons, WebKit and Safari's public voice, opens. She notes Safari 27's first beta brings over 60 new features (Customizable Select, `img sizes=auto`, the `stretch` keyword), but the real spine of this session is the team's **quality** work this year, followed by a deep look at five standout new features.

deepdive_en.title: A year of quality improvements
deepdive_en.body: Explains the strategic choice to invest in improving existing features rather than shipping many new ones, grouped into five themes: **compatibility** (emoji truncated by `.fromCharCode`, fixed by delivering text directly), **rebuilding foundations** (rewriting two-decade-old block-in-inline layout), **going deep** (reviving an SVG standards group, 75+ improvements), **aligning with standards** (CSS `random()` names made global), and **integration** (closing the `min()`/`max()`/`clamp()` gap inside `sizes`). Over **1100** improvements and fixes total.

deepdive_en.title: CSS Grid Lanes
deepdive_en.body: **CSS Grid Lanes** shipped in Safari 26.4 and creates classic masonry layouts in pure CSS, keeping the full power of CSS Grid track definition and working in both directions. Explore the Field Guide at gridlanes.webkit.org and use Web Inspector's Order Numbers to fine-tune tab order and flow tolerance.

deepdive_en.title: Customizable Select
deepdive_en.body: Safari 27 applies `appearance: base-select` to make `<select>` inherit CSS like font, text color, and background, and applies the same to `::picker` to style the popup; new pseudo-elements include `::checkmark` and `::picker-icon`. You can put subtext and images inside `<option>`, lay them out with Grid or Flexbox, and still keep the **accessibility** and robustness of a real form control.

deepdive_en.title: HTML Model element
deepdive_en.body: The `` element introduced last year on visionOS expands in Safari 27 to iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, bringing 3D models to HTML alongside ``, `

deepdive_en.title: Immersive Website Environments
deepdive_en.body: On visionOS 27, `<model>` supports immersive website environments: users tap in Safari to step into a scene you provide (e.g. previewing theater seats or an immersive game). The new **Immersive API** works just like the Fullscreen API; see "Explore immersive website environments in visionOS" for more.

deepdive_en.title: Web Extensions
deepdive_en.body: Recaps the cross-browser standardization of extensions and stresses that one set of HTML/CSS/JavaScript and a single manifest now work across browsers. The key news is the new **Safari web extension packager**, which lets developers package and distribute through App Store Connect from any browser on any OS — no Xcode and no Mac required.

deepdive_en.title: MapKit JS
deepdive_en.body: A brief mention of **MapKit JS**: embed interactive maps in a website or web app while preserving user privacy, working across all browsers and any operating system. Details at developer.apple.com.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wraps up the year's investment in both quality and new features, inviting developers to test their projects in the latest Safari Technology Preview or Safari beta, file issues at bugs.webkit.org, and visit webkit.org to learn what's new in each Safari release.

title: Enhance your presence on the App Store
gloss: 強化你在 App Store 上的呈現
takeaway: 透過新的素材版位與 Asset Library，把你的圖片與影片運用在 App Store 更多地方，更完整地行銷 App 與遊戲。

points.text: 重新思考如何在 App Store 上行銷 App 與遊戲，把自家**圖片與影片**運用到更多新位置。
介紹**新的素材版位（asset placements）**，讓行銷素材出現在更多場景。
推出 **Asset Library** 集中管理你的行銷素材。
提供後續可採取的**下一步**，協助規劃素材投放。

audience: **負責 App Store 行銷與經營的開發者與行銷人員**，想提升商店頁面表現的人。
gloss_en: Enhance your presence on the App Store
takeaway_en: Use new asset placements and the Asset Library to put your images and videos in more places on the App Store, marketing your apps and games more completely.

points_en.text: Reimagine how you market your apps and games on the App Store by using your own **images and videos** in new places.
Introduces **new asset placements** so your marketing assets appear in more contexts.
Launches the **Asset Library** to manage your marketing assets in one place.
Offers actionable **next steps** to help you plan how you deploy your assets.

audience_en: **Developers and marketers who handle App Store marketing and growth** and want to improve their product page performance.
summary: 使用者在 App Store 上發現你的 App 時，最初幾秒看到的畫面決定了他們是想進一步了解、還是直接滑過。本場次由 App Store Connect 團隊說明全新的視覺呈現方式：除了既有的截圖與預覽影片，**Product Page Header**（產品頁標題區）讓你能放上自由發揮的圖片或影片，成為使用者進入頁面時第一眼看到的視覺元素，用來表達品牌與視覺識別；而 **Search Results**（搜尋結果）也能改用一張有衝擊力的圖片或影片取代預設截圖，讓 App 在搜尋中脫穎而出。

這些新的行銷視覺在 App Store Connect 中稱為 **creative assets**，可以是圖片或影片，並能與 **Custom Product Pages**、**Apple Ads** 搭配運用。講者以健身 App 為例：官網的瑜珈行銷橫幅可連到 Custom Product Page，header 沿用與官網相同的行銷視覺，再以 deep link 把使用者直接導向瑜珈內容，打造從發現到安裝的一致體驗。你也能針對不同搜尋關鍵字顯示不同素材，並透過 **Product Page Optimization** A/B 測試哪種視覺最能打動受眾。這些功能在 iOS 27 與 iPadOS 27 上皆可使用，適用所有類別的 App 與遊戲。

提交審核有兩種方式。第一種是熟悉的版本頁流程：在 version page 上傳素材，用新的 **Preview** 功能預覽 App 在不同 iPhone／iPad、方向與語言下的呈現，確認無誤後如常送審，版本核准上線後 header 與搜尋結果視覺也一併上線。第二種是全新的 **Asset Library**，它是集中管理所有素材的地方，涵蓋截圖、預覽影片、in-app event 媒體與新的 creative assets，你可以獨立上傳並送審素材，不需綁定版本或指定用途。

Asset Library 最大的優勢在於：已核准的素材可直接套用到 Product Page Header 與 Search Results，無需再次審核。講者示範把夏季登山素材即時換成冬季登山素材並直接發佈到 App Store，毋須新的送審。實務上的關鍵收穫是：提前準備並送審素材，就能即時、彈性地更新行銷視覺；同時這些流程都能透過 **App Store Connect API** 與 **Apple Ads Platform API**（含 Swift 開源用戶端函式庫）自動化。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 開場點出 App Store 上**第一印象**的重要性：使用者發現 App 後最初幾秒看到的畫面，決定他們是深入了解還是直接滑過。講者預告今年將透過**圖片與影片**的全新用法來形塑這個關鍵時刻，並快速回顧目前產品頁與搜尋結果預設以截圖與預覽影片呈現的現況。

deepdive.title: New asset placements
deepdive.body: 介紹兩個全新的素材版位。**Product Page Header** 是使用者進入產品頁第一眼看到的視覺，可放截圖／預覽以外的圖片或影片，用來表達品牌識別；**Search Results** 則能以有衝擊力的圖片或影片取代預設截圖。這些素材還能用於 **Apple Ads** 廣告、搭配 **Custom Product Pages** 針對關鍵字客製，並以 **Product Page Optimization** 進行 A/B 測試，於 iOS 27 與 iPadOS 27 適用所有類別。

deepdive.title: Meet Asset Library
deepdive.body: 說明集中式素材管理工具 **Asset Library**，涵蓋截圖、預覽影片、in-app event 媒體與新的 **creative assets**。可獨立上傳並送審素材，不需綁定版本；最大優勢是已核准素材能直接套用到 header 與搜尋結果而免再次審核。講者以夏季登山素材即時替換為冬季素材並直接發佈的示範，凸顯**即時更新**的彈性，並指出可用 App Store Connect API 自動化。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾給出行動清單：先準備要用於展示 App 的圖片與影片，上傳到 **Asset Library** 供 Product Page、Search Results 等版位使用，最後在送審前用 **Preview** 功能確認呈現。整體鼓勵開發者善用這些新視覺，並可結合 **App Store Connect API** 與 **Apple Ads Platform API** 自動化上傳、送審與廣告設定流程。

summary_en: When someone discovers your app on the App Store, what they see in those first few moments decides whether they explore further or scroll past. This App Store Connect session introduces new ways to use images and video beyond your screenshots and previews. The new **Product Page Header** lets you place free-form images or video as the first visual people see when they land on your page, expressing your brand and visual identity, while **Search Results** can now show an impactful image or video instead of default screenshots so your app stands out.

These new marketing visuals are called **creative assets** in App Store Connect, and they pair with **Custom Product Pages** and **Apple Ads**. The speaker walks through a fitness-app example: a website's yoga marketing banner links to a Custom Product Page, the header reuses the same website visuals, and a deep link sends users straight into the yoga offering for a consistent discovery-to-install experience. You can also show tailored assets per search keyword and use **Product Page Optimization** to A/B test which visuals resonate. Everything works on iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 across all app and game categories.

There are two ways to submit for review. First, the familiar version-page flow: upload assets on your version page, use the new **Preview** to see how your app looks across iPhone, iPad, orientations, and languages, then submit as you do today, with the header and search visuals going live when the version is approved. Second, the new **Asset Library**, a centralized place to manage all your assets, including screenshots, preview videos, in-app event media, and the new creative assets, where you can upload and submit assets standalone without tying them to a version.

The big advantage of Asset Library is that approved assets are ready to use across the Product Page Header and Search Results without another review. The speaker demonstrates swapping a summer hiking asset for a winter one and publishing directly to the App Store with no new submission. The practical takeaway: get assets approved ahead of time for real-time, flexible updates, and automate the whole pipeline via the **App Store Connect API** and the **Apple Ads Platform API**, which includes open-source client libraries for Swift.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Frames the importance of the **first impression** on the App Store: the first few moments after discovery decide whether people learn more or scroll past. The speaker previews using **images and video** in new ways to shape that moment, and recaps how product pages and search results today default to screenshots and preview videos.

deepdive_en.title: New asset placements
deepdive_en.body: Introduces two new placements. The **Product Page Header** is the first visual people see and can hold images or video beyond screenshots, used to express brand identity; **Search Results** can show an impactful image or video instead of default screenshots. These assets can also power **Apple Ads**, pair with **Custom Product Pages** for per-keyword tailoring, and be A/B tested with **Product Page Optimization**, available on iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 across all categories.

deepdive_en.title: Meet Asset Library
deepdive_en.body: Explains **Asset Library**, a centralized asset manager covering screenshots, preview videos, in-app event media, and the new **creative assets**. Assets can be uploaded and submitted standalone without tying to a version; the key advantage is that approved assets can be applied directly to the header and search results without another review. A demo swapping a summer hiking asset for a winter one and publishing directly highlights **real-time updates**, and the API can automate the flow.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Closes with an action list: prepare the images and video that showcase your app, upload them to **Asset Library** for use on the Product Page, Search Results, and more, and use **Preview** to confirm presentation before submitting. It encourages adopting these new visuals and automating upload, submission, and ad setup via the **App Store Connect API** and **Apple Ads Platform API**.

title: What’s new in managing Apple devices
gloss: 管理 Apple 裝置的新功能
takeaway: 若你負責企業或教育環境的裝置管理，這場涵蓋宣告式裝置管理、App 派送與身分整合的最新更新。

points.text: 介紹**宣告式裝置管理（declarative device management）**的最新更新，是裝置管理的核心方向。
涵蓋 **Apple Business Manager** 與 **Apple School Manager** 在服務面的進展。
說明 **App management** 派送與管理的改進，便於大規模佈署應用程式。
包含 **Identity Integrations** 身分整合，以及針對**教育（Education）**情境的更新。

audience: 負責 MDM、企業 IT 或教育機構**大規模裝置與 App 佈署**的管理者與開發者。
gloss_en: What's new in managing Apple devices
takeaway_en: If you manage devices in enterprise or education environments, this session covers the latest updates to declarative device management, app distribution, and identity integration.

points_en.text: Introduces the latest updates to **declarative device management**, the core direction for device management.
Covers service-side advancements in **Apple Business Manager** and **Apple School Manager**.
Explains improvements to **App management** distribution and management, making it easier to deploy apps at scale.
Includes **Identity Integrations** as well as updates for **Education** scenarios.

audience_en: Administrators and developers responsible for MDM, enterprise IT, or educational institutions who handle **large-scale device and app deployment**.
summary: 本場次由 Device Management 團隊全面盤點今年管理 Apple 裝置的新功能。在 Apple 服務層面，**Apple Business** 是一套整合大小型組織營運工具的全新平台，已擴展到超過 200 個國家與地區，提供零接觸部署、Managed Apple Accounts 與內建裝置管理功能；並推出新的 API 可建立 Blueprints 與 Configurations、管理使用者與群組、查詢 App 授權與稽核事件。同時 App Store App 訂閱也新增**大量授權（volume licensing）**機制，IT 管理者能像散發 App 一樣，把訂閱指派給群組與組織，稍後將在 Apple Business 與 Apple School Manager 上線。

在裝置管理上，講者重申「裝置管理的標準就是 **declarative management**（宣告式管理）」——它已不是路線圖而是正在生產環境運行。本次新增多項宣告式能力：搭配新 Mac 硬體的**受管理遷移（managed migration）**，在 enrollment 後立即部署一個宣告式設定，讓 IT 控制要遷移哪些帳號、檔案與隱私安全設定；針對 Apple Intelligence、Siri 與鍵盤的細緻控制；以及更有效率的**憑證管理**——因為宣告式模型支援多對多關係，多個設定可引用同一份 credential asset，刷新憑證時伺服器只需更換 asset，裝置便會自動更新所有相依設定。**status channel** 也大幅擴充，新增 enrollment type、Lockdown Mode、**裝置系統健康（device system health）**等狀態項目，並新增 TriggerEnhancedLogCollection 指令與 Content Caching 的宣告式設定與狀態。

App 管理方面，宣告式 App 設定擴展到 macOS 27，支援硬體綁定金鑰與 Managed Device Attestation；package 移除時可一併清除安裝的檔案；新增**整合式隱私同意提示**，App 首次啟動或網站首次出現於 Safari 時一次說明組織與理由，使用者按 Allow 即套用所有預設，避免反覆彈窗；並透過 Endpoint Security 框架推出**二進位執行控管（binary execution）**，依程式碼簽章規則允許或拒絕執行。這些都歸入新的 app.settings 與既有 safari.settings 宣告式設定。

身分整合上，**Platform SSO** 進一步強化：全新登入與解鎖體驗、可要求 Touch ID 作為內建第二因素（涵蓋登入、螢幕解鎖與 FileVault），並導入**以網頁為基礎的驗證**，在 login window 與 screen unlock 中以受系統控管的 secure web view 執行任意現代驗證流程，包含一次性碼、推播與 QR code 無密碼登入；QR 掃描在隔離的系統程序中進行，網頁僅取得解碼資料。**Authenticated Guest Mode** 現可在 FileVault 保護的 Mac 上解鎖磁碟，並將於本版稍後登陸 Shared iPad。教育方面，Classroom App 新增**引導式瀏覽（guided browsing）**，教師可把學生鎖定在指定的一或多個分頁。所有 schema 與文件皆已開源於 GitHub 與 developer.apple.com。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Device Management 團隊工程師 Cyrus Daboo 開場，預告本場涵蓋 **Apple 服務**更新、多項 **declarative management** 新增能力、**App 管理**更新、新的**身分管理**功能，以及教育相關技術的快速更新。整體定調為今年管理 Apple 裝置的全面 what's new。

deepdive.title: Apple services
deepdive.body: 介紹整合式新平台 **Apple Business**，已擴展至超過 200 個國家與地區，提供零接觸部署、Managed Apple Accounts 與內建裝置管理。推出新 API 可建立 Blueprints 與 Configurations、修改使用者與群組、查詢 App 授權與稽核事件，並與既有的伺服器、裝置、庫存與 AppleCare 保固 API 並用。另預告 App Store App 訂閱的**大量授權**機制，IT 可沿用既有散發流程把訂閱指派給群組與組織。

deepdive.title: Device management
deepdive.body: 重申「裝置管理的標準就是 **declarative management**」——已在全球生產環境運行。搭配 MacBook Neo／Air／Pro 等新硬體，推出 enrollment 後立即部署的**受管理遷移**設定（由 Migration Assistant 回報狀態），以及 Apple Intelligence、Siri、鍵盤的細緻控制。**憑證管理**改用宣告式 asset 並利用多對多關係，刷新時只需更換 asset；**status channel** 新增 enrollment type、Lockdown Mode、**device system health**（baseband、相機、Face ID、Touch ID 等硬體）等狀態，並加入 TriggerEnhancedLogCollection 指令與 Content Caching 的宣告式設定與狀態回報。

deepdive.title: App management
deepdive.body: 宣告式 **App 設定**擴展到 macOS 27，支援硬體綁定金鑰與 **Managed Device Attestation**，鼓勵企業 App 採用 ManagedApp 框架；package 移除時可一併清除其安裝的檔案與目錄。推出**整合式隱私同意提示**，App 首次啟動或 Safari 首次載入網站時一次列出組織、理由與各隱私元件，按 Allow（預設按鈕）即套用所有預設、避免反覆彈窗。並以 **Endpoint Security** 框架推出**二進位執行控管**，依程式碼簽章規則允許／拒絕並可關閉相關程序，受管理 App 可自動允許；這些歸入新的 app.settings 與既有 safari.settings 設定。

deepdive.title: Identity Integrations
deepdive.body: 強化 **Platform SSO**：全新登入／解鎖體驗讓使用者清楚是用組織憑證，並可要求 **Touch ID** 作為內建第二因素，涵蓋登入、螢幕解鎖與 FileVault。導入**網頁式驗證**，在 login window 與 screen unlock 以受系統嚴格控管的 secure web view 執行任意現代驗證流程（一次性碼、推播、QR code 無密碼登入），且 QR 掃描在隔離系統程序進行、網頁僅得解碼資料；支援離線驗證。**Authenticated Guest Mode** 現可解鎖 FileVault 保護的 Mac，確保訪客工作階段也有全磁碟加密。

deepdive.title: Education
deepdive.body: 教育更新包含 **Authenticated Guest Mode** 將登陸 **Shared iPad**：iPad 開機進入暫時工作階段並顯示登入畫面，使用者以 Managed Apple Account（支援原生或聯合驗證與 SSO）登入，工作階段與系統共享容量、無硬性配額，登出後本機資料與帳號自動移除。Classroom App 新增**引導式瀏覽**，教師可把學生鎖定在指定的一或多個分頁、限制站內外導覽並控管相機與麥克風存取。最後指出所有 schema 與文件已開源，並建議參考 App Attest 與 Assessment mode 相關場次。

summary_en: The Device Management team gives a full tour of what's new in managing Apple devices this year. On the services side, **Apple Business** is a new all-in-one platform for organizations of any size, now available in over 200 countries and regions, offering zero-touch deployment, Managed Apple Accounts, and built-in device management. New APIs let you create Blueprints and Configurations, modify users and groups, query app license info, and fetch audit events. A new **volume licensing** mechanism for App Store app subscriptions also lets IT administrators assign subscriptions to groups and organizations using existing distribution workflows, coming later to Apple Business and Apple School Manager.

For device management, the speaker reaffirms that "the standard for device management is **declarative management**"—it is shipping in production, not a roadmap item. New declarative capabilities include **managed migration** that pairs with new Mac hardware by deploying a declarative configuration right after enrollment to control which accounts, files, and privacy/security settings migrate; granular controls for Apple Intelligence, Siri, and keyboard settings; and far more efficient **credential management**, since the many-to-many model lets multiple configurations reference one credential asset, so refreshing a credential only requires changing the asset. The **status channel** is greatly expanded with items like enrollment type, Lockdown Mode, and **device system health**, plus a new TriggerEnhancedLogCollection command and declarative Content Caching configuration and status.

For app management, declarative app configuration extends to macOS 27 with hardware-bound keys and Managed Device Attestation; packages can remove the files they installed when removed; a new **consolidated privacy consent prompt** explains the organization and rationale once at first launch (or first website appearance in Safari), so tapping Allow applies all defaults and avoids repeated prompts; and **binary execution control** via the Endpoint Security framework allows or denies execution based on code-signing rules. These live in the new app.settings and existing safari.settings declarative configurations.

On identity, **Platform SSO** is enhanced with a new login and unlock experience, the option to require Touch ID as a built-in second factor (across login, screen unlock, and FileVault), and a new **web-based authentication** option that runs any modern auth flow in a system-controlled secure web view at the login window and screen unlock, including one-time codes, push notifications, and QR-code passwordless sign-in, with QR scanning isolated in a system process so the web page only receives decoded data. **Authenticated Guest Mode** can now unlock FileVault-protected Macs and is coming to Shared iPad later in the release. In education, the Classroom app adds **guided browsing** so teachers can lock students to one or more tabs. All schema and documentation are open source on GitHub and developer.apple.com.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Device Management engineer Cyrus Daboo opens, previewing updates to **Apple services**, several additions to **declarative management**, **app management** changes, new **identity management** features, and a quick education update. The session is framed as a comprehensive what's-new for managing Apple devices this year.

deepdive_en.title: Apple services
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new all-in-one **Apple Business** platform, now available in over 200 countries and regions, with zero-touch deployment, Managed Apple Accounts, and built-in device management. New APIs create Blueprints and Configurations, modify users and groups, query app licenses, and get audit events, joining existing server, device, inventory, and AppleCare APIs. It also previews a **volume licensing** mechanism for App Store app subscriptions, letting IT assign subscriptions to groups and organizations via existing distribution workflows.

deepdive_en.title: Device management
