deepdive_en.body: Reaffirms that "the standard for device management is **declarative management**," already running in production worldwide. Alongside new MacBook Neo/Air/Pro hardware, it adds **managed migration** (a configuration deployed right after enrollment, with status reported by Migration Assistant) and granular Apple Intelligence, Siri, and keyboard controls. **Credential management** moves to declarative assets using the many-to-many model so refreshing only swaps the asset, and the **status channel** gains items like enrollment type, Lockdown Mode, and **device system health** (baseband, camera, Face ID, Touch ID), plus the TriggerEnhancedLogCollection command and declarative Content Caching configuration and status.

deepdive_en.title: App management
deepdive_en.body: Declarative **app configuration** extends to macOS 27 with hardware-bound keys and **Managed Device Attestation**, encouraging adoption of the ManagedApp framework; package removal can now also delete installed files and directories. A new **consolidated privacy consent prompt** lists the organization, justification, and each privacy component once at first launch (or first website appearance in Safari), so tapping Allow (the default button) applies all defaults and avoids repeated prompts. **Binary execution control** via the **Endpoint Security** framework allows or denies execution by code-signing rules and can shut down associated processes, with managed apps auto-allowed; these live in the new app.settings and existing safari.settings configurations.

deepdive_en.title: Identity Integrations
deepdive_en.body: Enhances **Platform SSO** with a new login/unlock experience that makes organizational credentials clear, and the option to require **Touch ID** as a built-in second factor across login, screen unlock, and FileVault. A new **web-based authentication** option runs any modern auth flow in a tightly controlled secure web view at the login window and screen unlock (one-time codes, push, QR-code passwordless sign-in), with QR scanning isolated in a system process so the page only gets decoded data; offline authentication is supported. **Authenticated Guest Mode** can now unlock FileVault-protected Macs so guest sessions still have full-disk encryption.

deepdive_en.title: Education
deepdive_en.body: Education updates include **Authenticated Guest Mode** coming to **Shared iPad**: the iPad boots into a temporary session with a login screen where users sign in with a Managed Apple Account (native or federated auth with SSO), the session shares device capacity with no hard quotas, and signing out automatically removes local data and the account. The Classroom app adds **guided browsing**, letting teachers lock students to one or more tabs, restrict navigation in and out of sites, and control camera and microphone access. It closes by noting all schema and documentation are open source and points to the App Attest and Assessment mode sessions.

title: Deliver workout insights with HealthKit workout zones
gloss: 用 HealthKit 運動區間呈現訓練洞察
takeaway: HealthKit 新增 workout zones,讓你能直接讀取已完成訓練的心率區間、即時接收區間更新,並為使用者建立預設或自訂的區間設定。
chapters: Reading Heart Rate Zones from a completed workout
Check if Preferred Zone has been set

points.text: HealthKit 讓你更容易提供訓練洞察,例如**心率與騎乘功率區間(workout zones)**。
可從已完成的訓練透過 **workout.zoneGroupsByType** 讀取各區間的數量與停留時間(zoneDurations)。
即時訓練可實作 **HKLiveWorkoutBuilder 的 didUpdateWorkoutZone**,在 @MainActor 上更新目前所在區間。
支援 **preferred zones**:先用 zoneConfiguration(for:) 檢查使用者是否已設定。
可用 **HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration** 以心率邊界陣列建立自訂區間,再以 setCustomZoneConfiguration 套用後 beginCollection。

audience: **開發健身、運動或健康類 App,想呈現心率/功率區間訓練數據的開發者。**
gloss_en: Surface workout insights with HealthKit workout zones
takeaway_en: HealthKit adds workout zones, letting you read heart rate zones from completed workouts, receive live zone updates, and set up preferred or custom zone configurations for users.

points_en.text: HealthKit makes it easier to deliver workout insights, such as **heart rate and cycling power zones (workout zones)**.
From a completed workout, read each zone's count and time spent (zoneDurations) via **workout.zoneGroupsByType**.
For live workouts, implement **HKLiveWorkoutBuilder's didUpdateWorkoutZone** to update the current zone on the @MainActor.
Support **preferred zones**: first check whether the user has configured them with zoneConfiguration(for:).
Use **HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration** to build custom zones from an array of heart rate boundaries, then apply with setCustomZoneConfiguration before beginCollection.

audience_en: **Developers building fitness, workout, or health apps who want to surface heart rate / power zone training data.**
summary: 這場由 HealthKit 團隊主講，主題是把 **workout zones**（運動區間）正式整合進 HealthKit。所謂區間，是把心率或騎乘功率這類原始數據，依強度切成數個帶狀範圍——例如典型的 **5 個 heart rate zones**，每筆心率樣本（如 135 bpm）會落在某一區（如 Zone 3）代表當下的努力程度；心率區間依年齡與靜止心率個人化計算，cycling power 區間則以個人化的 FTP（功能性閾值功率）換算瓦數。iOS 27／watchOS 27 起，HealthKit 會自動依運動期間湧入的樣本計算各區間的累計時間，讓 app 不必自行推算。

整場以一個能建立、追蹤並彙整運動的範例 app 貫穿，示範四件事。其一是讀取已完成運動的區間：透過 **`HKWorkout`** 或 **`HKWorkoutActivity`** 上的 **`zoneGroupsByType`** 字典，傳入對應的 `HKQuantityType` 取得 **`HKWorkoutZoneGroup`**，它含一份 **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`**（描述區間集合與來源 source）與一個 `zoneDurations` 陣列（各區間及其停留時間），可直接拿來畫圖表。各區間保證**連續且不重疊**，第一區無下界、最後一區無上界。其二是即時更新：實作 **`HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate`** 的 **`didUpdateWorkoutZone`**，僅在當前區間變動（如 Zone 2 → Zone 3）時觸發，帶入 current／previous 區間、整組 zone group 與最後一筆樣本時戳，可即時高亮當前區間並提醒使用者。

後半談區間設定的來源。預設使用 Health Settings 裡的 **preferred zones**，它會跨裝置透過 HealthKit 同步，並能由系統依使用者指標自動計算或由使用者手動設定，提供跨 app 一致的體驗；開始運動前可先在 `HKHealthStore` 或 `HKWorkoutBuilder` 查詢是否已設定。當 app 有專屬區間模型（如自家訓練平台）時則改用 **custom zones**：建立 `HKQuantity` 邊界陣列、組成 **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`**，並在 `beginCollection` 之前用 `setCustomZoneConfiguration` 餵給 builder。

實務上要留意幾點：區間數須介於 **3 到 9 之間**；custom 設定只存在於該次運動的脈絡，app 需自行負責儲存與同步；不同運動可能有不同的區間數（cycling power 系統預設 6 區，有些 app 用 5、7 或 8 區），因此跨運動比較 time-in-zone 時不能直接對齊區間編號，而要**回到原始樣本、依各自的區間數與邊界重新分桶 normalize**。整體而言，這套 API 讓 post-workout 摘要、即時教練回饋與長期訓練儀表板都能更輕鬆取得可付諸行動的訓練指引。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 HealthKit 工程師 Seth 開場，說明取得授權後 app 即可利用 HealthKit 集中、安全的資料庫與 API。重點介紹 **workout zones** 概念：心率區間依個人**年齡與靜止心率**計算，通常分 **5 區**，每筆樣本落在某區代表強度，可用於跑步、騎乘、HIIT、划船等；cycling power 區間則以個人化 **FTP** 衡量瓦數。並預告本場以心率區間為例，涵蓋讀取已完成運動、live 更新、preferred zones 與 custom zones 四大主題。

deepdive.title: Accessing workout zones
deepdive.body: 說明區間如何把原始數據轉成可付諸行動的訓練指引：耐力訓練要求低於某門檻、間歇訓練則需停在特定強度以上，而長時間落在 Zone 4／5 代表高強度努力，可用來分類運動強度或做負荷平衡。iOS 27／watchOS 27 起區間整合進 HealthKit 後，**time in each zone 由 HealthKit 依湧入樣本自動計算**，並遵循與其他資料型別相同的授權流程——需先為 workouts、heart rate、cycling power 等 quantity type 請求授權。

deepdive.title: Reading Heart Rate Zones from a completed workout
deepdive.body: 示範運動結束後在摘要頁畫出各心率區間的停留時間。作法是存取 `HKWorkout` 或 `HKWorkoutActivity` 上的 **`zoneGroupsByType`** 字典並傳入 `HKQuantityType(.heartRate)`（改傳 cycling power 即取得功率區間），若有資料會回傳 **`HKWorkoutZoneGroup`**。該結構含一份 `HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`（內含 quantity type、表示來源的 **source** enum，以及依邊界排序、保證**連續不重疊**且首尾無界的 zones 陣列）與一個 `zoneDurations` 陣列，範例直接 `map(\.duration)` 餵進圖表。因為區間同時存在於 workout 與 activity 上，多項目運動可整體顯示或依各 activity 拆開。

deepdive.title: Live zone updates
deepdive.body: 處理運動進行中的即時區間變化，讓 app 能顯示當前區間並在改變時提醒使用者調整強度。HealthKit 在 live 運動期間逐筆處理湧入的心率樣本、判定所屬區間，當發生變動（如 Zone 2 → Zone 3）便通知 app。接收更新的協定是 **`HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate`**：HealthKit 追蹤運動，遇到新 activity 或被追蹤資料更新等重要事件時轉交 delegate，app 即可更新 UI。

deepdive.title: Handling Live Zone Updates
deepdive.body: 具體實作 **`didUpdateWorkoutZone`** 方法處理區間變更。每次更新**僅在當前區間真正改變時送出**，帶有 current 與 previous 區間、含完整設定與各區當前累計時間的 zone group，以及最後處理樣本的時戳（可用來顯示停留於當前區間的計時器）。範例取出 `currentZoneDuration?.zone.index`，組成 `ZoneDisplayData` 後在 `@MainActor` 上更新狀態以高亮新的當前區間。

deepdive.title: Preferred zones
deepdive.body: 預設情況下 HealthKit 使用 Health Settings 裡設定的 **preferred zone thresholds**。preferred zones 會透過 HealthKit **跨裝置同步**，提供跨 app 與跨裝置的一致體驗；它可由系統依使用者指標（如心率區間依年齡與靜止心率）**週期性自動計算**，也可由使用者在 Health Settings 中**手動設定**。重點提醒：開始區間運動前，應先確認使用者已有 preferred zone 設定。

deepdive.title: Custom zones
deepdive.body: 當 app 有別於 Health Settings 的專屬區間定義時（例如採用自家專有區間模型的訓練平台），應改用 **custom zones**。本段帶出整體策略：先檢查是否已有 preferred 設定，若無則提供一組自訂區間，串起後續建立邊界、組裝設定、餵給 builder 的流程。

deepdive.title: Check if Preferred Zone has been set
deepdive.body: 示範如何判斷是否需要提供 custom 設定：以 `try await builder.zoneConfiguration(for: HKQuantityType(.heartRate))` 查詢 preferred 心率設定，當回傳 **`nil`** 代表尚未設定，便進入建立自訂區間的分支。此查詢可在 `HKHealthStore` 或 `HKWorkoutBuilder` 上進行。

deepdive.title: Create Zone Boundaries
deepdive.body: 從一組門檻值（範例為 `[91.0, 114.0, 136.0, 158.0]`）與對應的 **`HKUnit`**（心率用 `count()/minute()` 得 bpm）出發，`map` 成一個 **`HKQuantity`** 邊界陣列。強調邊界的單位必須與區間設定的 quantity type **相容且一致**。

deepdive.title: Create Default Workout Zone Configuration
deepdive.body: 用上一步的 boundaries 與 `HKQuantityType(.heartRate)` 建立 **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`**。HealthKit 會依提供的邊界產生區間，**第一區從 0 起、最後一區不設上界**，且區間數必須介於 **3 到 9** 之間。

deepdive.title: Set Custom Zone Configuration
deepdive.body: 透過 `try await builder.setCustomZoneConfiguration(_:for:)` 把自訂設定交給 **`HKWorkoutBuilder`**。關鍵限制：custom zone 設定**必須在呼叫 `beginCollection` 之前加入** builder。

deepdive.title: Begin Data Collection
deepdive.body: 設定就緒後以 `try await builder.beginCollection(at: startDate)` 開始收集資料。本段並總結幾個重要注意事項：custom 設定**只存在於該次運動脈絡**，儲存與同步需由 app 自行負責；不同運動可能有不同區間數（cycling power 預設 6 區，有些用 5、7 或 8），因此跨運動比較 time-in-zone 時**不可直接對齊區間編號**，而要回到原始樣本、依各自區間數與邊界重新 **normalize** 分桶。

summary_en: Presented by the HealthKit team, this session is about bringing **workout zones** fully into HealthKit. A zone slices intensity data such as heart rate or cycling power into contiguous bands — typically **5 heart rate zones** — so each sample (e.g. 135 bpm) lands in a zone (e.g. Zone 3) that signals current effort. Heart rate zones are personalized from age and resting heart rate, while cycling power zones convert watts against a personalized FTP. Starting in iOS 27 / watchOS 27, HealthKit automatically computes time-in-zone from the samples arriving during a workout, so apps no longer have to derive it themselves.

A sample app that creates, tracks, and summarizes workouts runs through the whole talk, demonstrating four things. First, reading zones from a completed workout: via the **`zoneGroupsByType`** dictionary on **`HKWorkout`** or **`HKWorkoutActivity`**, pass the relevant `HKQuantityType` to get an **`HKWorkoutZoneGroup`**, which carries an **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`** (the set of zones plus a source enum) and a `zoneDurations` array (each zone and its dwell time) — ready to chart. Zones are guaranteed **contiguous and non-overlapping**, with no lower bound on the first and no upper bound on the last. Second, live updates: implement **`HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate`**'s **`didUpdateWorkoutZone`**, which fires only when the current zone changes (e.g. Zone 2 → Zone 3) and supplies current/previous zones, the full zone group, and the last sample timestamp — enough to highlight the active zone and nudge the user.

The latter half covers where zone definitions come from. By default HealthKit uses the **preferred zones** configured in Health Settings, which sync across devices via HealthKit and can be either system-calculated from user metrics or manually set, giving a consistent cross-app experience; check for them on `HKHealthStore` or `HKWorkoutBuilder` before starting. When an app has its own zone model (e.g. a proprietary training platform), use **custom zones**: build an array of `HKQuantity` boundaries, assemble an **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`**, and hand it to the builder with `setCustomZoneConfiguration` *before* `beginCollection`.

Practical caveats: a configuration must have between **3 and 9 zones**; custom configurations exist only within that workout's context, so the app is responsible for saving and syncing them; and different workouts can use different zone counts (cycling power defaults to 6, but apps use 5, 7, or 8). Because of that, comparing time-in-zone across workouts can't just align zone indices — you must go back to the raw samples and **re-bucket (normalize)** them to each workout's zone count and boundaries. Overall the API makes post-workout summaries, live coaching, and long-term training dashboards far easier to power with actionable guidance.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: HealthKit engineer Seth opens by noting that, with permission, apps can leverage HealthKit's centralized, secure database and APIs. He introduces **workout zones**: heart rate zones are computed from a person's **age and resting heart rate**, usually split into **5 zones**, with each sample's zone signaling intensity for activities like running, cycling, HIIT, and rowing; cycling power zones measure watts against a personalized **FTP**. He previews the four topics — reading completed workouts, live updates, preferred zones, and custom zones — using heart rate as the example.

deepdive_en.title: Accessing workout zones
deepdive_en.body: Explains how zones turn raw data into actionable guidance: endurance plans want you below a threshold, intervals want you at or above one, and lots of time in Zone 4/5 signals a hard effort useful for classifying intensity and load balancing. With zones integrated in iOS 27 / watchOS 27, **time in each zone is computed automatically by HealthKit** from incoming samples, following the same authorization flow as other types — request access for workouts, heart rate, and cycling power up front.

deepdive_en.title: Reading Heart Rate Zones from a completed workout
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates charting per-zone dwell time on a post-workout summary. Access the **`zoneGroupsByType`** dictionary on `HKWorkout` or `HKWorkoutActivity` with `HKQuantityType(.heartRate)` (swap in cycling power for power zones); if available it returns an **`HKWorkoutZoneGroup`**. That holds an `HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration` (quantity type, a **source** enum, and a boundary-ordered `zones` array that is **contiguous, non-overlapping**, and unbounded at the ends) plus a `zoneDurations` array, which the sample feeds to a chart via `map(\.duration)`. Since zones live on both workout and activity, multi-sport workouts can show totals or break them out per activity.

deepdive_en.title: Live zone updates
deepdive_en.body: Covers handling zone changes during a live workout so the app can show the current zone and alert the user to adjust intensity. HealthKit processes each incoming heart rate sample, identifies its zone, and notifies the app when it changes (e.g. Zone 2 → Zone 3). The protocol for these updates is **`HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate`**: HealthKit tracks the workout and hands important events — a new activity, or an update to a tracked type — to the delegate so the app can update its UI.

deepdive_en.title: Handling Live Zone Updates
deepdive_en.body: Implements the **`didUpdateWorkoutZone`** method. Each update is sent **only when the current zone actually changes** and carries current and previous zones, the zone group with full configuration and current per-zone totals, plus the timestamp of the last processed sample (handy for a running timer in the current zone). The sample reads `currentZoneDuration?.zone.index`, builds a `ZoneDisplayData`, and updates state on the `@MainActor` to highlight the new current zone.

deepdive_en.title: Preferred zones
deepdive_en.body: By default HealthKit uses the **preferred zone thresholds** set in Health Settings. Preferred zones **sync across devices** via HealthKit for a consistent cross-app, cross-device experience; they can be **periodically calculated by the system** from user metrics (heart rate zones from age and resting heart rate) or **manually configured** in Health Settings. The reminder: make sure a preferred zone configuration is set before starting a zone workout.

deepdive_en.title: Custom zones
deepdive_en.body: When an app's zone definitions differ from Health Settings — such as a training platform with a proprietary zone model — use **custom zones**. This section sets up the strategy: check whether preferred zones are set, and if not, supply a custom set, chaining into building boundaries, assembling the configuration, and handing it to the builder.

deepdive_en.title: Check if Preferred Zone has been set
deepdive_en.body: Shows how to decide whether a custom configuration is needed: query the preferred heart rate configuration with `try await builder.zoneConfiguration(for: HKQuantityType(.heartRate))`, and when it returns **`nil`**, branch into building custom zones. This query can be run on either `HKHealthStore` or `HKWorkoutBuilder`.

deepdive_en.title: Create Zone Boundaries
deepdive_en.body: Starting from a set of thresholds (the sample uses `[91.0, 114.0, 136.0, 158.0]`) and the matching **`HKUnit`** (bpm built from `count()/minute()`), `map` them into an array of **`HKQuantity`** boundaries. The boundary units must be **compatible with and match** the configuration's quantity type.

deepdive_en.title: Create Default Workout Zone Configuration
deepdive_en.body: Use the boundaries and `HKQuantityType(.heartRate)` to construct an **`HKWorkoutZoneConfiguration`**. HealthKit creates zones from the boundaries with the **first zone starting at 0 and the last unbounded**, and the count must be between **3 and 9** zones.

deepdive_en.title: Set Custom Zone Configuration
deepdive_en.body: Hand the custom configuration to the **`HKWorkoutBuilder`** via `try await builder.setCustomZoneConfiguration(_:for:)`. The key constraint: a custom zone configuration **must be added before calling `beginCollection`**.

deepdive_en.title: Begin Data Collection
deepdive_en.body: With everything set, start collecting with `try await builder.beginCollection(at: startDate)`. The section also wraps up the caveats: custom configurations exist **only within that workout's context**, so saving and syncing is the app's responsibility; and because workouts can use different zone counts (cycling power defaults to 6, others use 5, 7, or 8), comparing time-in-zone across workouts **must not align zone indices directly** — instead go back to the raw samples and **normalize** by re-bucketing to each workout's zone count and boundaries.

title: What’s new in Wallet
gloss: Apple Wallet 的新功能
takeaway: 用全新的 Poster Generic 樣式、更多條碼類型與 featured actions 翻新你的 Wallet 票券，並用 Pass Designer 與 PassBuilder 加速製作與簽署流程。
chapters: Adopting Poster Generic with Generic fallback
Barcodes: Add new types for iOS 27

points.text: 採用全新的 **Poster Generic** 票券樣式，並可同時保留 `generic` 欄位作為 iOS 26 以前的後備。
新增更多**條碼格式（barcodes）**，例如 `PKBarcodeFormatCodabar`，並可同時提供 QR 等格式以相容舊版系統。
透過 **featured actions** 在票券上加入會員權益、優惠等可點擊動作。
用新的 **Pass Designer** 視覺化設計票券模板，並用 **Pass Builder（PassBuilder）** 套件在伺服器端建立與簽署 `.pkpass`。

audience: **開發 Apple Wallet 票券（會員卡、票券、優惠券）的開發者**，想更新樣式並簡化後端產製流程的人。
gloss_en: What's new in Wallet
takeaway_en: Refresh your Wallet passes with the new Poster Generic style, more barcode types, and featured actions, and speed up authoring and signing with Pass Designer and PassBuilder.

points_en.text: Adopt the new **Poster Generic** pass style, while keeping a `generic` field as a fallback for systems prior to iOS 26.
Add more **barcode formats**, such as `PKBarcodeFormatCodabar`, while still offering formats like QR for compatibility with older systems.
Use **featured actions** to add tappable actions like membership benefits and offers onto a pass.
Design pass templates visually with the new **Pass Designer**, and build and sign `.pkpass` files server-side with the **Pass Builder (PassBuilder)** package.

audience_en: **Developers building Apple Wallet passes (membership cards, tickets, coupons)** who want to update styling and simplify their backend production pipeline.
summary: 這場由 Wallet 團隊主講，回顧 passes 如何讓人更快、更私密、更安全地完成日常——從買咖啡、過閘門到登機。iOS 27 把 passes 往前推了一大步，帶來四項重點：全新的 **Poster Generic** pass 樣式、四種新 barcode 類型、可在 pass face 下方浮現相關動作的 **featured actions**,以及一整套給 Mac 與 server 平台的開發者工具。整體訊息是：設計、個人化與建立 pass 從未如此容易。

在 pass 內容層面，**Poster Generic** 適合會員卡、集點與商店卡，由背景圖、primary logo、header／primary／footer fields 與 barcode 組成,只要在 pass.json 設定 `posterGeneric` top-level style key 即可；它需要 iOS 27 以上，建議同時保留 `generic` key 讓舊系統使用者仍能加入 Wallet。新增的 **EAN-13、Code 39、Codabar、ITF** 四種 barcode 透過既有的 `barcodes` 陣列以 `PKBarcodeFormatCodabar` 等 format 指定;因舊版不支援，務必以優先序提供多個 barcode 做 graceful fallback，無法多型時則把 credential ID 放進 primaryField 並訓練前線人員手動輸入。**featuredActions** 則在 top-level 以 action 物件陣列定義(unique ID、type 如 `membershipBenefits`、URL)，Wallet 會在 pass 下方畫出帶圖示的 call-to-action，每張 pass 最多兩個。

開發者工具是本場重頭戲。全新的 Mac app **Pass Designer** 是所見即所得編輯器，提供 true-to-iOS 的即時預覽，可在 sidebar 設定 identity & signing、style、images、barcodes、fields 與 semantics,並把成果存成 **pkpasstemplate** 範本檔。要把範本轉成個人化、已簽署的 pass，則用全新的 Swift on Server 套件 **Pass Builder**(可在 Mac 與 Linux 執行，提供 Swift API 與 `buildpass` 命令列)。講者以「狗狗日托會員卡」示範:用 **PassPackage** 載入範本、以 `setValue` 填欄位、設定 **PassImage** 背景與 **Pass.Barcode**(PDF417)、加上 **Pass.Action**,再用 **PassCertificate** 與 **PassSigner** 的 `signPass` 自動完成 manifest、簽章與打包。Pass Builder 也能透過 **swift-java** 從 Java 呼叫，或用 protobuf 定義從其他語言驅動 `buildpass`。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Shaun 開場，回顧 passes 如何讓人從買咖啡、過 transit 閘門到登機都更快、更私密、更安全。預告 iOS 27 的四大更新:全新 **Poster Generic** pass 樣式、四種新 barcode 類型、可在 pass face 下方浮現相關動作的新方式,以及給 Mac 與 server 的全新開發者工具套件。

deepdive.title: Poster Generic
deepdive.body: 介紹全新 pass 樣式 **Poster Generic**,適合會員卡、loyalty 計畫、商店卡等想讓**大膽彩色藝術圖**佔據主視覺的場景。pass face 由背景圖、primary logo、header fields、primary fields、單一 footer field 與(若有提供的)barcode 組成,系統會自動把內容排版到整個 pass face 上。

deepdive.title: Adopting Poster Generic
deepdive.body: 說明採用方式:在 pass bundle 的 **pass.json** 指定 `posterGeneric` top-level style key,再用一般的 pass fields 結構放入內容,系統就會處理排版。提醒 pass face **只支援單一 footer field**,若放多個,只會顯示第一個。

deepdive.title: Adopting Poster Generic with Generic fallback
deepdive.body: Poster Generic 需要 **iOS 27 以上**。為了支援 iOS 26 與更早的使用者,建議在 pass.json 中**同時保留既有的 `generic` top-level style key** 與 `posterGeneric`,各自放入對應欄位,讓尚未更新到 iOS 27 的使用者仍能把 pass 加入 Wallet。

deepdive.title: Barcodes
deepdive.body: 宣布 iOS 27 支援**四種新 barcode 類型**:**EAN-13、Code 39、Codabar、ITF**,在出示時提供更大彈性。這些都沿用既有的 barcode 物件與 pass.json 中的 `barcodes` 陣列來指定。

deepdive.title: Barcodes: Add new types for iOS 27
deepdive.body: 示範如何採用新類型:把 barcode 的 `format` 設為對應值(例如 Codabar 用 **PKBarcodeFormatCodabar**),完整 format 定義可在 Wallet Passes 文件查到。範例也包含 `message` 與 `messageEncoding` 欄位。

deepdive.title: Barcodes: Supporting iOS 26 and earlier
deepdive.body: 因舊版 iOS 不支援新格式,**強烈建議以優先序提供一個 barcode 陣列**做 graceful fallback,讓系統有最大機會渲染出硬體可掃描的 barcode。若只提供單一新類型,iOS 26 與更早版本將**完全不顯示 barcode**;若實在無法多型,則應把 **credential ID** 放進醒目的 primaryField 或 headerField 供手動輸入,並訓練前線人員做手動輸入流程,避免顧客被卡住。

deepdive.title: Featured actions
deepdive.body: 回顧 iOS 18 第二代 event ticket 可用 semantic URLs 在 pass 下方提供額外動作(如查看活動時程)。iOS 27 帶來**全新且更彈性的 API**,讓**所有 pass 樣式**都能提供 featured actions。

deepdive.title: Featured actions
deepdive.body: 說明用法:在 pass.json top-level 定義 **featuredActions** key,接收 action 物件陣列,每個 action 由 unique ID、action **type**(如 `membershipBenefits`)與 value(如 URL)組成。Wallet 會在 pass 下方畫出帶彩色圖示與在地化 call-to-action 的按鈕,**每張 pass 最多兩個**,建議以優先序只提供最相關的動作。

deepdive.title: Developer tools
deepdive.body: 點出痛點:過去十年 passes 累積大量功能,很難把 pass bundle 的描述對應到裝置上的視覺呈現。因此 Wallet 推出一套全新開發者工具,讓設計、個人化與建立 pass 變得更容易。

deepdive.title: Pass Designer
deepdive.body: 介紹全新 Mac app **Pass Designer**,一個所見即所得編輯器,提供 **true-to-iOS** 的即時預覽:右側即時預覽、左側 sidebar 可設定 identity & signing、style、images、barcodes、fields 與 semantics。講者實地示範替「Stacey 狗狗日托」設計範本:套用 Poster Generic、拖入狗狗照片當背景、加入 header field(DOG_ID)、primary fields(省略第一個 label 取得粗體大標題)、PDF417 barcode、primary logo 與 footer,最後存成 **pkpasstemplate** 範本檔。

deepdive.title: Pass Builder
deepdive.body: 介紹搭配 Pass Designer 的全新 **Swift on Server** 套件 **Pass Builder**,可在 **Mac 與 Linux** 執行,提供 Swift API 與名為 **buildpass** 的命令列執行檔,用來把範本轉成個人化、已簽署、可發佈的 pass。講者要在伺服器上大規模個人化先前做好的範本。

deepdive.title: Package.swift
deepdive.body: 示範第一步:把 **PassBuilder** 加進 Swift package manifest 的 dependencies(以 `.package(path:)` 指向本地路徑)與 server target 的 `.product`,讓伺服器專案能使用 Pass Builder API。

deepdive.title: CreatePass.swift
deepdive.body: 實作 `createPass` 函式:用 **PassPackage** 載入先前的範本(提供 type-safe 存取 pass bundle 與 pass.json),以 `setValue` 設定狗狗名字、會員 ID 與最愛玩具,建立 **PassImage** 設為 background,加入 PDF417 格式的 **Pass.Barcode**,並以 **Pass.Action** 設定 featuredActions 讓客戶查看會員資格。

deepdive.title: CreatePass.swift
deepdive.body: 接續完成簽署:用 **PassCertificate** 載入 pass signing 憑證與 WWDR intermediate 憑證,建立 **PassSigner**,呼叫其 **signPass** 帶入個人化後的 package 與目標 URL。Pass Builder 自動處理產生 manifest、建立 detached signature、壓縮並加上 .pkpass 副檔名等所有步驟,開發者只需提供憑證,最後回傳寫出的 URL。

deepdive.title: Personalizing a pass template
deepdive.body: 說明 Pass Builder 也能在其他語言使用:**swift-java** 專案可為 Swift API 產生原生 Java bindings,讓 Java runtime 呼叫 Pass Builder;同時也提供 pass package 格式的 **protobuf** 定義,可在偏好語言產生 type-safe 模型、產生 customization message,再呼叫 **buildpass** 命令列來個人化並簽署 pass。延伸參考「Explore Swift and Java interoperability」session。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾的行動建議:下載 **Pass Designer** 並實驗 **Poster Generic** 樣式,評估是否適合你的 pass;若打算採用任何新 barcode 類型,先**規劃 graceful fallback**;並花點時間找出對顧客最有意義的動作,用 **featured actions** 實現。講者形容這是建立 Wallet Passes 的新篇章。

summary_en: Presented by the Wallet team, this session recaps how passes let people move through their day faster, more privately, and more securely—from buying coffee to tapping transit gates to boarding a flight. iOS 27 pushes passes further with four highlights: a brand-new **Poster Generic** pass style, four new barcode types, **featured actions** that surface relevant actions below the pass face, and a full suite of developer tools for Mac and server platforms. The overall message is that designing, personalizing, and building passes has never been easier.

At the content level, **Poster Generic** suits membership, loyalty, and store cards—composed of a background image, primary logo, header/primary/footer fields, and a barcode—and is adopted by setting the `posterGeneric` top-level style key in pass.json; it requires iOS 27, so keep the `generic` key alongside it so older-OS customers can still add the pass. The four new barcodes—**EAN-13, Code 39, Codabar, ITF**—are specified via the existing `barcodes` array with formats like `PKBarcodeFormatCodabar`; because older iOS doesn't support them, provide multiple barcodes in priority order for graceful fallback, and where multiple types aren't possible, surface the credential ID in a primaryField and train front-line staff for manual entry. **featuredActions** are defined as a top-level array of action objects (unique ID, type such as `membershipBenefits`, and a URL), drawn by Wallet below the pass with a localized call-to-action, up to two per pass.

The developer tools are the centerpiece. The new Mac app **Pass Designer** is a WYSIWYG editor with a true-to-iOS live preview, letting you configure identity & signing, style, images, barcodes, fields, and semantics in a sidebar and save the result as a **pkpasstemplate** file. To turn a template into a personalized, signed pass, use the new Swift on Server package **Pass Builder** (runs on Mac and Linux, with a Swift API and a `buildpass` command-line tool). The demo builds doggy-daycare membership cards: load the template with **PassPackage**, fill fields via `setValue`, set a **PassImage** background and a **Pass.Barcode** (PDF417), add a **Pass.Action**, then use **PassCertificate** and **PassSigner**'s `signPass` to auto-generate the manifest, signature, and package. Pass Builder can also be driven from Java via **swift-java** or from other languages via protobuf definitions and the `buildpass` executable.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Shaun opens by recapping how passes let people move faster, more privately, and more securely—from buying coffee to tapping transit gates to boarding flights. He previews the four big iOS 27 updates: the new **Poster Generic** pass style, four new barcode types, a new way to surface relevant actions below the pass face, and a brand-new suite of developer tools for Mac and server.

deepdive_en.title: Poster Generic
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new **Poster Generic** pass style, a great fit for membership cards, loyalty programs, and store cards where **bold, colorful artwork** should take center stage. The pass face consists of a background image, a primary logo, header fields, primary fields, a single footer field, and a barcode if supplied, with the system laying everything out across the face.

deepdive_en.title: Adopting Poster Generic
deepdive_en.body: Explains adoption: specify the `posterGeneric` top-level style key in the bundle's **pass.json**, then add content with the usual pass fields structure and the pass handles layout. Notes the pass face supports only a **single footer field**—if more than one is included, only the first is displayed.

deepdive_en.title: Adopting Poster Generic with Generic fallback
deepdive_en.body: Poster Generic requires **iOS 27 or later**. To support iOS 26 and earlier, the recommendation is to include the existing **`generic` top-level style key alongside** `posterGeneric` in pass.json, with relevant fields under each, so customers who haven't updated can still add the pass to Wallet.

deepdive_en.title: Barcodes
deepdive_en.body: Announces **four new barcode types** in iOS 27—**EAN-13, Code 39, Codabar, ITF**—giving more flexibility at the point of presentation. They're specified using the existing barcode object and the `barcodes` array in pass.json.

deepdive_en.title: Barcodes: Add new types for iOS 27
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates adopting a new type by setting a barcode's `format` to the corresponding value (e.g., **PKBarcodeFormatCodabar** for Codabar), with the full list of format definitions in the Wallet Passes documentation. The example also includes `message` and `messageEncoding` fields.

deepdive_en.title: Barcodes: Supporting iOS 26 and earlier
deepdive_en.body: Because older iOS doesn't support the new formats, the strong recommendation is to provide an **array of barcodes in priority order** for graceful fallback so the system can render one the hardware can scan. Providing only a single new type means **no barcode renders on iOS 26 and earlier**; where multiple types aren't possible, surface the **credential ID** in a prominent primaryField or headerField for manual entry and train front-line staff so a customer is never blocked.

deepdive_en.title: Featured actions
deepdive_en.body: Recaps that the iOS 18 second-generation event ticket could provide semantic URLs to expose extra actions below the pass (like viewing the event schedule). iOS 27 brings a **new, flexible API** that allows **all pass styles** to provide featured actions.

deepdive_en.title: Featured actions
deepdive_en.body: Explains usage: define the **featuredActions** key at the top level of pass.json, taking an array of action objects, each with a unique ID, an action **type** (such as `membershipBenefits`), and a value (such as a URL). Wallet draws each below the pass with a colorful icon and localized call-to-action, **up to two per pass**, and the guidance is to provide only the most relevant actions in priority order.

deepdive_en.title: Developer tools
deepdive_en.body: Names the pain point: a decade of accumulated pass features makes it hard to connect what's described in the pass bundle to the visual representation on device. Wallet responds with a brand-new suite of developer tools that make designing, personalizing, and building passes easier.

deepdive_en.title: Pass Designer
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new Mac app **Pass Designer**, a WYSIWYG editor with a **true-to-iOS** live preview: a live pass preview on the right and a sidebar on the left to configure identity & signing, style, images, barcodes, fields, and semantics. The walkthrough designs a 'Stacey's Doggy Day Care' template: apply Poster Generic, drag in a dog photo as background, add a header field (DOG_ID), primary fields (omitting the first label to get the bold title), a PDF417 barcode, a primary logo, and a footer, then save as a **pkpasstemplate** file.

deepdive_en.title: Pass Builder
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the companion **Swift on Server** package **Pass Builder**, which runs on **Mac and Linux** and provides a Swift API plus a command-line executable called **buildpass** to turn a template into a personalized, signed, distributable pass. The plan is to personalize the earlier template at scale on a server.

deepdive_en.title: Package.swift
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates the first step: add **PassBuilder** to the Swift package manifest dependencies (via `.package(path:)` pointing at a local path) and to the server target's `.product`, so the server project can use the Pass Builder API.

deepdive_en.title: CreatePass.swift
deepdive_en.body: Implements the `createPass` function: load the earlier template with **PassPackage** (a type-safe way to access the pass bundle and pass.json), use `setValue` to set the dog's name, member ID, and favorite toy, create a **PassImage** as the background, add a PDF417-format **Pass.Barcode**, and set a **Pass.Action** on featuredActions so clients can view their membership.

deepdive_en.title: CreatePass.swift
deepdive_en.body: Continues to signing: load the pass signing certificate and the WWDR intermediate certificate with **PassCertificate**, create a **PassSigner**, and call its **signPass** with the personalized package and a destination URL. Pass Builder handles generating the manifest, creating a detached signature, compressing, and adding the .pkpass extension—you just provide the certificates—then returns the written URL.

deepdive_en.title: Personalizing a pass template
deepdive_en.body: Notes Pass Builder can also be used from other languages: the **swift-java** project can generate native Java bindings for the Swift API so the Java runtime can invoke Pass Builder, and **protobuf** definitions of the pass package format let you generate type-safe models in your preferred language, produce a customization message, and call the **buildpass** command line. Points to the 'Explore Swift and Java interoperability' session for more.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Closing action items: check out **Pass Designer** and experiment with the **Poster Generic** style to see if it fits your pass; if adopting any new barcode types, make a plan for **graceful fallbacks**; and identify the most meaningful actions for your customers and bring them to life with **featured actions**. Shaun frames this as a new chapter for building Wallet Passes.

title: What’s new in Apple In-App Purchase
gloss: Apple App 內購買的新功能
takeaway: 新增「**附 12 個月承諾的月繳訂閱**」，讓使用者以更實惠的月付方式訂閱，並可用 StoreKit 完整呈現與購買。

points.text: 推出**附 12 個月承諾的月繳訂閱（monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment）**，提供比年繳更易入手的付費選項。
可在 **App Store Connect** 設定此方案，並透過 `SubscriptionStoreView` 的 `preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms` 呈現月價與總承諾金額。
以 `Product.purchase` 搭配 `billingPlanType(.monthly)` 進行購買，並用 `manageSubscriptionsSheet` 依 `subscriptionGroupID` 管理訂閱。
後端可用 **App Store Server API** 監控，解碼後的 `JWSTransaction` 與 `JWSRenewalInfo` 帶有 `commitmentInfo` 承諾資訊。
涵蓋 **Bundles 與 Suites**、優惠代碼兌換（`offerCodeRedemption`）以及更完善的送審體驗。

audience: **販售訂閱制的 App 開發者與商務團隊**，想導入更彈性月繳方案的人。
gloss_en: What's new in Apple In-App Purchase
takeaway_en: Adds **monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment**, giving users a more affordable monthly way to subscribe, with full StoreKit presentation and purchasing.

points_en.text: Introduces the **monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment**, offering a more accessible payment option than an annual plan.
Configure this plan in **App Store Connect** and present the monthly price and total commitment amount via `SubscriptionStoreView`'s `preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms`.
Purchase with `Product.purchase` using `billingPlanType(.monthly)`, and manage subscriptions with `manageSubscriptionsSheet` keyed by `subscriptionGroupID`.
On the backend, monitor with the **App Store Server API**; the decoded `JWSTransaction` and `JWSRenewalInfo` carry `commitmentInfo`.
Covers **Bundles and Suites**, offer code redemption (`offerCodeRedemption`), and a more refined review submission experience.

audience_en: **App developers and business teams selling subscriptions** who want to adopt a more flexible monthly plan.
summary: 這場由 StoreKit 工程師 Sam 主講的 session，圍繞三大主軸介紹 In-App Purchase 的新功能：擴充訂閱定價選項、更新 **offer code** 兌換 API，以及 App Store Connect 強化後的送審體驗。最核心的亮點是 iOS 26.5 推出的「**月繳但綁定 12 個月承諾**」（monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment）訂閱方案，讓使用者可以選擇按月分期付款來購買原本的年訂閱，藉此降低門檻、觸及更廣的客群。此方案可加到新的或既有的一年期自動續訂訂閱上，並在 App Store Connect 中為每種 billing plan 個別設定 offer（例如只給承諾方案的免費試用）。

在 app 端，**SubscriptionInfo** 新增了 **pricingTerms** 屬性，陣列會列出該產品所有可用的 billing plan；每個自動續訂訂閱至少有一個預設 billingPlanType 為 `.upFront` 的方案，若設定了承諾方案則會多回傳一個 `.monthly` 的方案。透過 StoreKit views 的 `.preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms` modifier 可在 **SubscriptionStoreView** 上篩選並行銷月繳方案；自訂 UI 則用 **Product** API 取得 `billingDisplayPrice` 與 `commitmentInfo.price`，並在購買時帶入 `.billingPlanType(.monthly)` purchase option。系統會在首次訂閱承諾方案前自動顯示一次性的揭露 sheet（每個 Apple Account 一次），並提供 `.manageSubscriptionsSheet` 讓使用者管理方案與查看剩餘付款次數。

伺服器端方面，**Transaction** 與 **RenewalInfo** 新增 `commitmentInfo`、`billingPlanType`、`renewalBillingPlanType` 等欄位（自 OS 26.4 起），decoded 的 **JWSTransaction** 與 **JWSRenewalInfo** 也帶有對應的承諾資訊（billingPeriodNumber、totalBillingPeriods、commitmentPrice、commitmentRenewalDate 等）。App Store Server APIs、Server Notifications V2 與 Retention Messaging API 都支援此新方案。開發者可從 Xcode 26.5 起用 StoreKit configuration 檔的 Billing Plan picker 在本機測試，並用 Transaction inspector 驗證 `commitmentInfo`。

此外，Sam 也預告了 **Bundles and Suites**（跨 app 組合訂閱，Xcode 27 可測試）、更新後會回傳 `verificationResult` 的 **OfferCodeRedemption** API，以及強化的送審流程——可將多個 In-App Purchase 與 in-app events、custom product pages 等 review item 合併為單一 App Review submission，並透過擴充的 **reviewSubmissions** API 統一自動化。實務上建議盡早為年訂閱加上月繳方案、更新 offer code 兌換呼叫點，並在 Xcode 27 與 sandbox 中開始測試。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 StoreKit 團隊工程師 **Sam** 開場，說明 App Store 提供安全可信賴的市集，透過 App Store APIs 開發者可販售數位商品與服務，並交由 App Store commerce 平台處理金流與付款。Sam 預告本場三大主題：擴充訂閱定價選項、更新 **offer code** 兌換 API，以及強化的 App Store Connect 送審體驗。

deepdive.title: Overview of monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment
deepdive.body: 介紹 iOS 26.5 推出的「**月繳但綁定 12 個月承諾**」方案，讓使用者可按月分期付款購買年訂閱。此 billing plan 可加到新或既有的一年期自動續訂訂閱，提供「upfront 一次付清」與「monthly 分期」兩種選擇以觸及更廣客群。App 以 26.5 SDK 編譯後，可用市場中執行 iOS、iPadOS、macOS、tvOS 或 visionOS 26.4 的使用者即可訂閱。

deepdive.title: Set up in App Store Connect
deepdive.body: 示範在 App Store Connect 的 Subscriptions 區為 **SKDemo** app 設定方案：選擇一年期產品，在「monthly with a 12-month commitment availability」下選 Set Up Availability 並依步驟設定 billing plan。建立後可為每種 billing plan type 個別設定 offer，例如只針對 12 個月承諾方案提供免費試用。

deepdive.title: Merchandise with StoreKit
deepdive.body: 介紹 **SubscriptionInfo** 上新的 **pricingTerms** 屬性，此陣列列出產品所有可用 billing plan。每個自動續訂訂閱至少有一個預設 billingPlanType 為 `.upFront` 的方案；因為 SKDemo+ 設定了承諾方案，陣列會多回傳一個 billingPlanType 為 `.monthly` 的物件，而 `.monthly` 僅適用於 12 個月承諾的月繳訂閱。

deepdive.title: Merchandise pricing terms with StoreKit views
deepdive.body: 示範用 StoreKit views 行銷定價，新增 SwiftUI view modifier `.preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms` 並附加到既有的 **SubscriptionStoreView**，再篩選出 billingPlanType 為 `.monthly` 的 pricingTerms。StoreKit views 會自動處理產品 metadata 載入與跨平台版面調整，讓 store 在各平台都有原生感。

deepdive.title: Get subscription pricing terms and make a purchase
deepdive.body: 示範在自訂 store UI 中用 **Product** API 取得產品後，篩選 `.monthly` billingPlanType 的 pricingTerms，並取得 `billingDisplayPrice`（月繳價）與 `commitmentInfo.price`（承諾總價）顯示給使用者。需注意 billing plan metadata 僅在客戶 storefront 有供應時才回傳；購買時要帶入 `.billingPlanType(.monthly)` purchase option 並處理結果。

deepdive.title: Sheet to manage subscriptions by subscriptionGroupID
deepdive.body: 說明首次訂閱承諾方案前，App Store 會自動顯示揭露 sheet（每個 Apple Account 僅一次），內含完成承諾所需的付款次數與取消指引。訂閱啟用後系統也提供管理 UI，可查看所有方案、剩餘付款次數與承諾續訂時間；可用 SwiftUI 的 `.manageSubscriptionsSheet` 或 UIKit 的 `showManageSubscriptions` 直接在 app 內呈現。

deepdive.title: Monitor subscriptions with App Store Server APIs
deepdive.body: 說明在 app 內可用 **Transaction** 新欄位取得 billing plan 專屬 metadata：`.upfront` 方案的 `commitmentInfo` 為 nil，`.monthly` 方案則回傳 12 個月承諾的進度、價格與到期資訊，可用來檢查 entitlement 或自建承諾進度指示器。**RenewalInfo** 上的 `renewalBillingPlanType` 與 `commitmentInfo` 則提供整體承諾續訂資訊，這些欄位自 OS 26.4 起可用，並務必使用 latest transaction 取得正確 expirationDate。

deepdive.title: JWSTransaction (decoded) for a monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment
deepdive.body: 展示伺服器回傳的單一帳期購買的 decoded **JWSTransaction** 範例，內含與前述 StoreKit 對應的新欄位，例如 `billingPlanType: MONTHLY` 以及 `commitmentInfo`（billingPeriodNumber、totalBillingPeriods、commitmentExpiresDate、commitmentPrice）。這些欄位可用來偵測帳期購買，並理解其在整體承諾中的位置。

deepdive.title: JWSRenewalInfo (decoded) for a monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment
deepdive.body: 展示 signed renewal info 物件，內含反映承諾結束後客戶續訂偏好的類似欄位（如 `renewalBillingPlanType`、`commitmentRenewalDate`、`commitmentRenewalPrice`、`commitmentRenewalBillingPlanType`），這些欄位僅在訂閱目前處於承諾中時才出現。範例中客戶將訂閱改為承諾完成後續訂進不同的 `BILLED_UPFRONT` 方案。

deepdive.title: Bundles and Suites
deepdive.body: 預告另一項擴充訂閱供應的新功能 **Bundles and Suites**。**Bundle** 是一組可個別購買、但以單次購買組合銷售並提供較優惠價格的訂閱；**Suite** 則是一組只存在於 Suite 情境、無法個別購買、通常為一系列相關 app 提供服務的訂閱。可從 Xcode 27 開始測試其 API，更多細節將於 2026 年稍晚公布。

deepdive.title: Offer code redemption
deepdive.body: 說明 offer code 可加到 consumable、non-consumable、自動續訂或非續訂訂閱產品，提供特定期間的免費或折扣 IAP。更新後的 **OfferCodeRedemption** API 在兌換完成時會像購買一樣回傳 `verificationResult`，並接受一組 **RedeemOption** 值來設定兌換；成功回傳 transaction、失敗則回傳描述原因的 error，UIKit 版本為 `presentOfferCodeRedeemSheet`。

deepdive.title: Sheet to redeem an offer code
deepdive.body: 示範用 `.offerCodeRedemption` SwiftUI modifier 呈現兌換 sheet，並在 closure 中處理 `.success`（再驗證內含的 verificationResult）與 `.failure`（處理 error）。可從 Xcode 27 開始用新的兌換 API 在所有適用產品類型上測試兌換流程。

deepdive.title: Enhanced submission experience
deepdive.body: 介紹 App Store Connect 強化的 IAP 送審體驗：可將多個產品作為 review item 合併成單一 App Review submission，並與 in-app events、custom product pages、product page optimizations 等其他 review item 一起送審，送出後可在集中視圖查看狀態。同時 **reviewSubmissions** API 擴充支援 IAP、subscription 與 subscription group 資源，舊有資源將被棄用，建議盡早遷移。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: Sam 總結下一步：為年訂閱產品加上新 billing plan 以提供月繳彈性同時鎖定長期承諾；更新 app 各處的 offer code 兌換呼叫點以善用擴充的 API；從今天起在 Xcode 27 與 sandbox 測試這些新功能；準備好後用強化的 App Review 體驗送審更新後的 IAP 產品。

summary_en: Presented by StoreKit engineer Sam, this session covers three themes for In-App Purchase: expanded subscription pricing options, an updated **offer code** redemption API, and the enhanced App Store Connect submission experience. The headline feature is **monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment**, introduced in iOS 26.5, which lets customers pay monthly for an annual subscription—lowering the barrier to entry and reaching a wider audience. These billing plans can be added to new or existing one-year auto-renewable subscriptions in App Store Connect, with offers configurable per billing plan type (for example, a free trial only for the 12-month commitment plan).

On the app side, **SubscriptionInfo** gains a new **pricingTerms** property listing all available billing plans for a product; every auto-renewable subscription carries at least one default plan with billingPlanType `.upFront`, and a `.monthly` plan is returned when a commitment plan is configured. StoreKit views' `.preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms` modifier filters and merchandises the monthly plan on a **SubscriptionStoreView**, while custom UI uses the **Product** API to read `billingDisplayPrice` and `commitmentInfo.price`, passing `.billingPlanType(.monthly)` as a purchase option. The App Store automatically presents a one-time disclosure sheet (once per Apple Account) before a first commitment purchase, and `.manageSubscriptionsSheet` lets customers manage plans and check remaining payments.

On the server side, **Transaction** and **RenewalInfo** gain `commitmentInfo`, `billingPlanType`, and `renewalBillingPlanType` fields (starting OS 26.4), and the decoded **JWSTransaction** and **JWSRenewalInfo** carry matching commitment data (billingPeriodNumber, totalBillingPeriods, commitmentPrice, commitmentRenewalDate, etc.). The App Store Server APIs, Server Notifications V2, and Retention Messaging API all support the new plan. Developers can test locally from Xcode 26.5 using the StoreKit configuration file's Billing Plan picker and verify `commitmentInfo` in the Transaction inspector.

Sam also previews **Bundles and Suites** (cross-app grouped subscriptions, testable in Xcode 27), the updated **OfferCodeRedemption** API that now returns a `verificationResult`, and an enhanced submission flow—multiple IAPs can be grouped with in-app events, custom product pages, and other review items into a single App Review submission, automated through the expanded **reviewSubmissions** API. Practical next steps: add monthly plans to annual subscriptions soon, update offer code redemption call sites, and start testing in Xcode 27 and sandbox.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: StoreKit team engineer **Sam** opens by noting the App Store provides a safe, trusted marketplace, and that App Store APIs let developers sell digital goods and services while the App Store commerce platform handles transactions and payment processing. Sam previews the three topics: expanding subscription pricing options, updates to the **offer code** redemption API, and the enhanced App Store Connect submission experience.

deepdive_en.title: Overview of monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the iOS 26.5 capability of **monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment**, letting customers pay monthly for annual subscriptions. The billing plan can be added to new or existing one-year auto-renewable subscriptions, offering both upfront and monthly choices to reach a larger customer base. Once compiled against the 26.5 SDK, customers in available markets running iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, or visionOS 26.4 can subscribe.

deepdive_en.title: Set up in App Store Connect
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates setup in App Store Connect's Subscriptions section for the **SKDemo** app: selecting a one-year product, choosing Set Up Availability under monthly-with-a-12-month-commitment availability, and following the steps to configure the billing plan. Once created, offers can be configured per billing plan type—for example, a free trial added only for customers on the 12-month commitment plan.

deepdive_en.title: Merchandise with StoreKit
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new **pricingTerms** property on **SubscriptionInfo**, an array listing all available billing plans for a product. Every auto-renewable subscription carries at least one plan with a default billingPlanType of `.upFront`; because SKDemo+ has a commitment plan configured, a second object with billingPlanType `.monthly` is returned, which applies only to monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment.

deepdive_en.title: Merchandise pricing terms with StoreKit views
deepdive_en.body: Shows merchandising with StoreKit views by adding the `.preferredSubscriptionPricingTerms` SwiftUI view modifier to an existing **SubscriptionStoreView** and filtering for pricingTerms with a `.monthly` billingPlanType. StoreKit views handle loading product metadata and adjusting layout automatically so the store feels native across all platforms.

deepdive_en.title: Get subscription pricing terms and make a purchase
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates custom store UI using the **Product** API to fetch products, filter pricingTerms for `.monthly` billingPlanType, and read `billingDisplayPrice` (monthly price) and `commitmentInfo.price` (total commitment price) to display to the customer. Billing plan metadata is only returned when available in the customer's storefront; to purchase, pass the `.billingPlanType(.monthly)` purchase option and handle the result.

deepdive_en.title: Sheet to manage subscriptions by subscriptionGroupID
deepdive_en.body: Explains that before a first commitment purchase, the App Store automatically presents a disclosure sheet (once per Apple Account) with the number of payments required and cancellation guidance. Once active, the system also provides UI to view all plans, remaining payments, and commitment renewal timing; this can be presented in-app via SwiftUI's `.manageSubscriptionsSheet` or UIKit's `showManageSubscriptions` API.

deepdive_en.title: Monitor subscriptions with App Store Server APIs
deepdive_en.body: Explains that in-app, new **Transaction** fields provide billing-plan-specific metadata: for `.upfront` plans `commitmentInfo` is nil, while `.monthly` plans return the progress, price, and expiration for the 12-month commitment—usable to check entitlements or build a commitment progress indicator. **RenewalInfo** exposes `renewalBillingPlanType` and `commitmentInfo` for overall commitment renewal; these fields are available starting OS 26.4, and the latest transaction should always be used for an accurate expirationDate.

deepdive_en.title: JWSTransaction (decoded) for a monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment
deepdive_en.body: Shows a server-side decoded **JWSTransaction** payload for a single billing-period purchase, including new fields matching the StoreKit ones—such as `billingPlanType: MONTHLY` and `commitmentInfo` (billingPeriodNumber, totalBillingPeriods, commitmentExpiresDate, commitmentPrice). These fields let you detect billing-period purchases and understand their place within the overall commitment.

deepdive_en.title: JWSRenewalInfo (decoded) for a monthly subscription with a 12-month commitment
deepdive_en.body: Shows the signed renewal info object containing similar fields reflecting the customer's renewal preferences after the commitment ends (e.g. `renewalBillingPlanType`, `commitmentRenewalDate`, `commitmentRenewalPrice`, `commitmentRenewalBillingPlanType`), which are present only while the subscription is currently in a commitment. In the example, the customer changed their subscription to renew into a different `BILLED_UPFRONT` plan once the commitment completes.

deepdive_en.title: Bundles and Suites
deepdive_en.body: Previews **Bundles and Suites** as another way to expand subscription offerings. A **Bundle** is a group of subscriptions that can be bought individually but are sold together in a single purchase at a better price; a **Suite** is a group that exists only within the Suite, cannot be purchased individually, and typically serves a related set of apps. The API can be tested starting in Xcode 27, with more program details coming later in 2026.

deepdive_en.title: Offer code redemption
deepdive_en.body: Explains that offer codes can be added to consumable, non-consumable, auto-renewable, or non-renewing subscription products to provide free or discounted IAPs for a set duration. The updated **OfferCodeRedemption** API now returns a `verificationResult` on completion and accepts a set of **RedeemOption** values; success yields a transaction in the verificationResult, failure yields a descriptive error, and a UIKit variant is available via `presentOfferCodeRedeemSheet`.

deepdive_en.title: Sheet to redeem an offer code
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates presenting the redemption sheet with the `.offerCodeRedemption` SwiftUI modifier and handling `.success` (verifying the contained verificationResult) and `.failure` (handling the error) in the closure. Offer code redemption can be tested with the new API across all applicable product types starting in Xcode 27.

deepdive_en.title: Enhanced submission experience
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the enhanced IAP submission experience in App Store Connect: multiple products can be grouped as review items into a single App Review submission and combined with in-app events, custom product pages, and product page optimizations, with status viewable in a centralized view. The **reviewSubmissions** API is also expanding to support IAP, subscription, and subscription group resources, with existing resources being deprecated in favor of reviewSubmission and reviewSubmissionItems—so migration should start now.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Sam summarizes the next steps: add new billing plans to give annual subscription products monthly flexibility while securing a long-term commitment; update offer code redemption call sites across the app to use the extended API; begin testing these features today in Xcode 27 and sandbox; and submit updated IAP products with the enhanced App Review experience when ready.

title: Rev up your CarPlay app
gloss: 強化你的 CarPlay App
takeaway: 運用 CarPlay framework 的新功能，為音訊、導航與對話式 App 打造更完整的車載體驗。
chapters: Disable route sharing for this trip

points.text: 全面檢視 **CarPlay framework** 對音訊、導航與語音對話式 App 的新支援能力。
可透過 **CPNowPlayingTemplate.allowsMiniPlayer** 停用 MiniPlayer，自訂正在播放畫面的呈現方式。
導航 App 可實作 **mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing** 啟用路線分享，並針對單次行程選擇關閉。
新增 **CarPlay 視訊** 能力，拓展車載情境下可呈現的內容類型。
使用 **CarPlay Simulator** 在無實體車機的情況下開發與測試介面。

audience: 開發 **CarPlay 音訊、導航或對話式 App** 並想採用今年新功能的 iOS 開發者。
gloss_en: Rev up your CarPlay app
takeaway_en: Use the new capabilities in the CarPlay framework to build a more complete in-car experience for audio, navigation, and conversational apps.

points_en.text: A full look at the **CarPlay framework**'s new support for audio, navigation, and voice-based conversational apps.
Use **CPNowPlayingTemplate.allowsMiniPlayer** to disable the MiniPlayer and customize how the Now Playing screen is presented.
Navigation apps can implement **mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing** to enable route sharing, opting out on a per-trip basis.
Adds **CarPlay video** support, expanding the kinds of content you can present in the in-car context.
Use the **CarPlay Simulator** to develop and test your interface without physical car hardware.

audience_en: iOS developers building **CarPlay audio, navigation, or conversational apps** who want to adopt this year's new features.
summary: 車體驗團隊工程師 Chris 介紹 **CarPlay** 在 iOS 27 的更新，主軸是替各類別的 CarPlay app 增添新能力。除了既有的音樂、通訊、導航類別，今年新增了**語音對話式 app**，以及最受矚目的 **CarPlay video apps**——在支援 video in car 功能的新車上，使用者可在停車等待時直接在 CarPlay 螢幕上瀏覽與播放影片。只要 app 已支援 **AirPlay** video streaming，搭配 **CarPlay framework** 提供瀏覽 UI 即可；若車輛當下不允許影片播放，內容會自動以 audio-only 形式繼續播放。建議同時宣告 CarPlay audio 與 video entitlement，讓 app 在任何車上都能出現。

在 CarPlay framework 層面，所有類別的 app 都有 UI 強化。清單（list）現在支援直式或橫式比例的圖片，**card** 元素可帶縮圖並疊加 overlay、播放進度與運動賽事資訊；新的 **`CPPlaybackConfiguration`** 提供播放中繼資料（elapsed time、duration、播放動作），需在播放狀態變化時同步更新縮圖。**details header** 可在清單頂端突顯單一項目，組合縮圖、標題、內文、播放設定與動作按鈕。iOS 27 也為 now playing 帶來新的 **MiniPlayer**（可用 `allowsMiniPlayer = false` 關閉），並把今年推出的 **Voice Control template** 開放給所有 app 類別，且可作為 overlay 疊在地圖等其他 template 之上。

針對導航 app 有兩項新功能。**Panels** 讓導航 app 自由掌控 Map template 的主要介面區，能組合 trips、grids、route choices、waypoints 等物件並加上底部按鈕（如 Go／End），在保持地圖可見的同時呈現更多內容。**Route sharing**（需 iOS 26.4 以上與支援車輛）則把 app 規劃的路線以 route segments 陣列分享給車輛，讓自動變換車道、電動車充電站建議等駕駛輔助功能也能在第三方導航 app 下運作；可用 `mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing` 啟用，或對個別行程以 `routeSegmentsAvailableForRegion = false` 停用。最後，**CarPlay Simulator** 現已進駐 Device Hub，可在 Mac 上測試不同螢幕尺寸與車輛配置；影片 app 開發者可透過 Additional Tools for Xcode 取得。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 車體驗團隊工程師 Chris 開場，定位 **CarPlay** 為在車內更聰明、更安全使用 iPhone 的方式。iOS 27 為所有類別的 CarPlay app 帶來新能力，本場將涵蓋新增的 app 類別、適用所有 app 的 framework 更新、導航 app 專屬功能，以及 CarPlay Simulator。

deepdive.title: Apps in CarPlay
deepdive.body: 回顧 CarPlay 支援的類別（音樂、通訊、導航），並指出它們的共通點是讓人不必拿出 iPhone 就完成重要任務。今年新增**語音對話式 app**，並推出 **CarPlay video apps**：在支援 video in car 的車上可瀏覽與播放影片。只要支援 **AirPlay** video streaming 即可，當車輛不允許影片時會自動轉為 audio-only；建議同時宣告 audio 與 video entitlement。

deepdive.title: CarPlay framework
deepdive.body: 說明使用 **CarPlay framework** 時由 iOS 統一管理 UI 佈局與車輛介面，app 不需處理不同解析度或輸入硬體（觸控、旋鈕、觸控板）。以範例 app Landmarks 展示新 UI：list 支援直／橫式圖片、card 縮圖可加 overlay／播放進度／運動資訊、**`CPPlaybackConfiguration`** 提供播放中繼資料，以及在清單頂端突顯單一項目的 **details header**。

deepdive.title: Disable the MiniPlayer
deepdive.body: iOS 27 為 now playing template 新增 **MiniPlayer**，所有顯示 now playing 的 app 都會自動顯示，在較大螢幕上甚至可直接播放、暫停、跳過。MiniPlayer 是 now playing 的最佳選擇，但若不想顯示，可將 `allowsMiniPlayer` 設為 `false`，now playing 圖示會改顯示在導覽列。

deepdive.title: Navigation apps
deepdive.body: 導航 app 現在能用 **panels** 自由掌控 Map template 的主要介面區，把 trips、grids、route choices、route details、waypoints 等既有物件組合起來，並用 button configuration 在底部加上 Go／End 等動作按鈕，在保持地圖可見的同時呈現更多內容與控制。

deepdive.title: Enable route sharing
deepdive.body: 介紹 **Route sharing**：app 以 route segments（地理座標陣列）把路線分享給車輛，讓自動變換車道、電動車依續航建議充電站等駕駛輔助功能在第三方導航 app 下也能運作。需 iOS 26.4 以上與支援車輛，並透過 Map template 以 `mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing` 回傳 `true` 來 opt-in。

deepdive.title: Disable route sharing for this trip
deepdive.body: 若 app 判斷某趟行程不適合分享路線，可針對個別 trip 將 `routeSegmentsAvailableForRegion` 設為 `false` 來停用 route sharing。整體而言，駕駛在配對車輛時的核准與 app 的 opt-in 共同決定 route sharing 何時發生。

deepdive.title: CarPlay Simulator
deepdive.body: **CarPlay Simulator** 讓測試 CarPlay app 只需連接 Mac，可模擬不同螢幕尺寸與車輛配置（如支援影片的車輛），現已進駐 **Device Hub**。導航 app 開發者可試用 route sharing 的新診斷工具，影片 app 開發者則透過 Additional Tools for Xcode 套件下載。

summary_en: Car experience engineer Chris covers what's new in **CarPlay** for iOS 27, focused on bringing new capabilities to every category of CarPlay app. Alongside the existing audio, communication, and navigation categories, this year adds **voice-based conversational apps** and, most notably, **CarPlay video apps** — on new cars that support the video-in-car feature, people can browse and play videos right on the CarPlay display while parked or waiting. If your app already supports **AirPlay** video streaming, you just add a browsing UI with the **CarPlay framework**; when the car indicates video isn't available, content plays back as audio-only. Declaring both the CarPlay audio and video entitlements ensures your app always appears.

At the CarPlay framework level, every app category gets UI enhancements. Lists can now show portrait or landscape images, **card** elements add thumbnails with overlays, playback progress, and sports info, and the new **`CPPlaybackConfiguration`** carries playback metadata (elapsed time, duration, playback action) that you update on state changes. A **details header** prominently features a single item at the top of a list, combining thumbnail, title, body text, playback configuration, and action buttons. iOS 27 also brings a new **MiniPlayer** for now playing (disable with `allowsMiniPlayer = false`) and opens this year's **Voice Control template** to all app categories, including as an overlay on top of templates like the Map template.

Navigation apps get two new features. **Panels** let a navigation app control the primary interface area of the Map template, combining objects like trips, grids, route choices, and waypoints with bottom buttons (Go/End) while keeping the map visible. **Route sharing** (requires iOS 26.4+ and a supported vehicle) shares the app's planned route to the car as an array of route segments, so driver-assistance features like automatic lane changes and EV charging-stop suggestions work even with third-party navigation apps; opt in via `mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing`, or disable per-trip with `routeSegmentsAvailableForRegion = false`. Finally, **CarPlay Simulator** is now in Device Hub for testing different screen sizes and vehicle configurations on a Mac; video app developers get it via Additional Tools for Xcode.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Car experience engineer Chris opens, framing **CarPlay** as the smarter, safer way to use iPhone in the car. iOS 27 brings new capabilities to all CarPlay app categories; the session covers new app categories, framework updates for all apps, navigation-specific features, and the CarPlay Simulator.

deepdive_en.title: Apps in CarPlay
deepdive_en.body: Reviews supported categories (audio, communication, navigation), whose common thread is helping people accomplish tasks without taking out their iPhone. This year adds **voice-based conversational apps** and introduces **CarPlay video apps**: browse and play videos on cars supporting video-in-car. Supporting **AirPlay** video streaming is enough; when video isn't allowed, content falls back to audio-only. Declare both audio and video entitlements to always appear.

deepdive_en.title: CarPlay framework
deepdive_en.body: Explains that with the **CarPlay framework**, iOS manages UI layout and the car interface, so apps don't handle resolutions or input hardware (touchscreens, knobs, touchpads). Using the Landmarks sample, it shows new UI: lists with portrait/landscape images, card thumbnails with overlays/progress/sports info, the **`CPPlaybackConfiguration`** for playback metadata, and the **details header** for featuring a single item atop a list.

deepdive_en.title: Disable the MiniPlayer
deepdive_en.body: iOS 27 adds a **MiniPlayer** to the now playing template, shown automatically by all apps that display now playing and allowing play/pause/skip on larger displays. The MiniPlayer is the best option, but if you don't want it, set `allowsMiniPlayer` to `false` and the now playing icon appears in the navigation bar instead.

deepdive_en.title: Navigation apps
deepdive_en.body: Navigation apps can now use **panels** to control the Map template's primary interface area, combining existing objects like trips, grids, route choices, route details, and waypoints, with a button configuration adding bottom actions like Go/End — showing more content and controls while keeping the map visible.

deepdive_en.title: Enable route sharing
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **Route sharing**: the app shares its route to the vehicle as an array of route segments (geographic coordinates), enabling driver-assistance features like automatic lane changes and EV range-based charging suggestions to work with third-party navigation apps. Requires iOS 26.4+ and a supported vehicle; opt in through the Map template by returning `true` from `mapTemplateShouldProvideRouteSharing`.

deepdive_en.title: Disable route sharing for this trip
deepdive_en.body: If the app determines a trip isn't eligible, it can disable route sharing per-trip by setting `routeSegmentsAvailableForRegion` to `false`. Overall, both the driver's approval at pairing time and the app's opt-in govern when route sharing occurs.

deepdive_en.title: CarPlay Simulator
deepdive_en.body: **CarPlay Simulator** makes testing as easy as connecting to a Mac, simulating different screen sizes and vehicle configurations (like video-capable cars), and is now available in **Device Hub**. Navigation developers should try the new route-sharing diagnostic tools; video app developers download it via the Additional Tools for Xcode package.

title: Translate your app using agents in Xcode
gloss: 在 Xcode 中運用 agent 翻譯你的 App
takeaway: 利用 Xcode 的 coding agent 結合 App 上下文翻譯 String Catalog，並透過審閱與迭代產出高品質的在地化字串。
chapters: Localizing strings in SwiftUI with custom table name
Field for machine-translated strings in the XLIFF

points.text: **Xcode 與 coding agent** 能依據 App 的上下文翻譯 **String Catalog**，加速多語系在地化流程。
在 SwiftUI 中善用 **Text** 的 comment 參數（及 tableName）提供翻譯語境，是讓機器翻譯更準確的關鍵實務。
其他位置可用 **String(localized:)** 與 **LocalizedStringResource** 搭配 comment 標記可在地化字串。
翻譯後需**審閱與迭代**（review and iterate）；XLIFF 會以 state-qualifier="leveraged-mt" 標示**機器翻譯**字串以利辨識。

audience: **需要將 App 在地化為多種語言**、並想用 AI agent 加速翻譯 String Catalog 的開發者。
gloss_en: Translate your app using agents in Xcode
takeaway_en: Use Xcode's coding agents together with your app's context to translate String Catalogs, then review and iterate to produce high-quality localized strings.

points_en.text: **Xcode and coding agents** can translate **String Catalogs** based on your app's context, accelerating multi-language localization.
In SwiftUI, make good use of **Text**'s comment parameter (and tableName) to provide translation context, a key practice for more accurate machine translation.
Elsewhere, use **String(localized:)** and **LocalizedStringResource** with comment to mark localizable strings.
After translating, you need to **review and iterate**; XLIFF marks **machine-translated** strings with state-qualifier="leveraged-mt" to make them easy to identify.

audience_en: Developers who **need to localize their app into multiple languages** and want to use AI agents to speed up translating String Catalogs.
summary: 傳統機器學習翻譯與一般 LLM 在軟體在地化上常因缺乏上下文而出錯——例如英文的 **book** 究竟是「書」還是「訂房」，沒有語境就可能選錯。這場由 Localization 團隊的 Avery 主講，重點是：**String Catalogs** 多年來已逐步累積了字串的上下文（出現在程式碼何處、如何被使用、自動產生的註解），而 **Xcode 27** 起，可以直接在 Xcode 內透過 **coding agents** 把這些上下文一併交給模型來翻譯你的 app。

實際流程是用 Xcode 工具列的 New Conversation 請 agent 把整個專案翻成某個語言（示範為加拿大法語）。agent 先請 Xcode **prepare for localization**：加入語言、建置所有目標平台以確保字串被完整探索、把新字串加進 String Catalogs（沒有的話自動建立，預設表名 Localizable，也可用自訂表名）。接著 agent 選出待譯字串、分批委派給 **subagents**，並由 Xcode 餵給每個 subagent 上下文——字串在程式碼的用法、用語相近的字串清單、甚至其他語言已有的譯法，並確保複數變化（如 `%lld items`）在各語言都正確產生。要調整風格（如把 landmarks 從 lieux d'intérêt 改成更口語的 attraits）也只需再請 agent 修改，且新功能翻譯時 agent 會自動沿用先前確立的術語，維持一致性。

review 與迭代同樣關鍵：可請 agent 用目標語言 render UI 並偵測截斷（法語平均句子較長、Thai 的垂直裁切、Arabic 的 RTL 對齊都能這樣檢查），形成緊密回饋迴圈；但翻成自己不熟的語言時，務必靠 **TestFlight** 找母語者測試與回報。最佳實務包括：確保字串可在地化（SwiftUI 預設可，其餘用 `String(localized:)`）、在 **AGENTS.md** 或獨立的 **TRANSLATION.md** 提供詞彙表／不譯清單／語氣指南、選用 context window 大且擅長長任務的模型，並注意某些語言在訓練資料中較少見可能品質較差；最後可用 XLIFF 的 **leveraged-mt** state qualifier 辨識哪些是機器翻譯的字串。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Localization 團隊的 Avery 開場，點出在地化能讓 app 觸及全球數百萬人。傳統 ML 模型難以處理軟體在地化，現代 **LLM** 雖擅長一般翻譯但缺乏上下文時仍會出錯（如 book 的多義）；好消息是 **String Catalogs** 多年來已累積字串的用法與位置上下文，**Xcode 27** 起可直接用 coding agents 翻譯。

deepdive.title: Add translations
deepdive.body: 示範用 Xcode 工具列的 New Conversation 請 agent 把專案翻成加拿大法語。agent 先請 Xcode **prepare the project**：加入語言、建置所有支援平台的目標以完整探索可在地化字串、再把新字串加進 **String Catalogs**（沒有則自動建立，預設表名 Localizable）。

deepdive.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI
deepdive.body: 強調 SwiftUI 程式碼預設即可在地化：`Text`、`Button` 等 API 會自動把字串暴露給在地化流程。範例以 `Text("Hello, world!", comment:)` 帶 comment 提供翻譯上下文。

deepdive.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI with custom table name
deepdive.body: 說明可用 **自訂表名** 來組織字串：在 `Text` 加上 `tableName:` 參數（如 "Greetings"），Xcode 就會自動把這些字串放進名為 Greetings 的 String Catalog，方便分類管理。

deepdive.title: Review and iterate
deepdive.body: 翻譯只是第一步，還要確認在執行期各語言都正確。可請 agent 用目標語言 **render UI 並找截斷**（法語句子較長易超出版面），藉此判斷是實作 bug、需重新設計版面，或該請模型給較短譯法；同理可檢查 Thai 的垂直裁切與 Arabic 的 RTL 對齊，形成緊密回饋迴圈。另強調用 **TestFlight** 讓母語者測試與回報，彌補開發者不懂該語言的盲點。

deepdive.title: Best practices
deepdive.body: 進入最佳實務段落，核心是讓所有面向使用者的字串都可在地化，並善用上下文與翻譯指南來提升品質與一致性。

deepdive.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI
deepdive.body: 再次提醒 **SwiftUI 預設可在地化**，這是讓翻譯流程順利的前提；只要使用標準 API，字串就會自動被探索並納入 String Catalogs。

deepdive.title: Localizing strings elsewhere
deepdive.body: 非 SwiftUI 的程式碼通常需明確使用 **`String(localized:)`** 或 **`LocalizedStringResource`** 等 API 才能讓字串可在地化。並建議在 **AGENTS.md** 或獨立的 **TRANSLATION.md** 提供詞彙表、不譯清單（產品名／商標）與語氣描述；選模型時偏好 context window 大、擅長長任務者，並注意低資源語言品質可能較差。

deepdive.title: Field for machine-translated strings in the XLIFF
deepdive.body: 處理從 Xcode 匯出的在地化檔時，可檢查 XLIFF 中 `target` 的 **`state-qualifier="leveraged-mt"`** 來辨識哪些譯文是由 agent（機器翻譯）提供，方便後續人工審閱與篩選。

summary_en: Traditional ML translation and general LLMs often get software localization wrong because they lack context—for example, does English **book** mean something to read or to reserve a room? Presented by Avery from the Localization team, the key message is that **String Catalogs** have been accumulating string context for years (where in code a string is used, how it's used, auto-generated comments), and starting in **Xcode 27** you can translate your app directly in Xcode using **coding agents** that receive all of that context.

The flow uses Xcode's New Conversation to ask an agent to translate the whole project into a language (demoed in Canadian French). The agent first asks Xcode to **prepare for localization**: add the language, build all target platforms so every localizable string is discovered, and add new strings to **String Catalogs** (auto-creating them if needed, default table Localizable, with custom table names also supported). The agent then selects strings, splits them into batches delegated to **subagents**, and Xcode feeds each subagent context—how the string is used in code, lists of strings with similar terminology, even how it was translated in other languages—while ensuring plural variations (like `%lld items`) are generated correctly per language. Style adjustments (e.g., changing landmarks from lieux d'intérêt to the more colloquial attraits) just take another request, and when translating new features the agent automatically reuses previously established terminology for consistency.

Review and iteration matter just as much: you can ask the agent to render the UI in the target language and detect truncation (longer French sentences, vertical clipping in Thai, RTL alignment in Arabic all checkable this way) for a tight feedback loop—but for languages you don't speak, rely on **TestFlight** to get native speakers testing and reporting. Best practices include making strings localizable (SwiftUI by default, otherwise `String(localized:)`), providing a glossary / do-not-translate list / tone guidance in **AGENTS.md** or a dedicated **TRANSLATION.md**, choosing a model with a large context window suited to long-running tasks, and being aware that low-resource languages may yield lower quality; finally, you can identify machine-translated strings via the **leveraged-mt** state qualifier in the exported XLIFF.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Avery from the Localization team opens by noting that localizing reaches millions more people. Traditional ML struggled with software localization; modern **LLMs** are great at general translation but still err without context (the book ambiguity). The good news: **String Catalogs** have accumulated usage and location context for years, and **Xcode 27** lets you translate using coding agents directly.

deepdive_en.title: Add translations
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates asking an agent to translate the project into Canadian French via New Conversation. The agent first has Xcode **prepare the project**: add the language, build all supported-platform targets to fully discover localizable strings, then add new strings to **String Catalogs** (auto-created if absent, default table Localizable).

deepdive_en.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI
deepdive_en.body: Stresses that SwiftUI code is localizable by default: APIs like `Text` and `Button` automatically expose their strings. The example uses `Text("Hello, world!", comment:)` to provide translation context via a comment.

deepdive_en.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI with custom table name
deepdive_en.body: Shows organizing strings with a **custom table name**: adding `tableName:` (e.g. "Greetings") to `Text` makes Xcode place those strings in a String Catalog called Greetings for cleaner organization.

deepdive_en.title: Review and iterate
deepdive_en.body: Translation is only step one—verify runtime behavior per language. Ask the agent to **render the UI and find truncations** (French sentences run longer), helping decide whether it's an implementation bug, a needed redesign, or a request for a shorter translation; the same checks catch vertical clipping in Thai and RTL alignment in Arabic, forming a tight feedback loop. Also use **TestFlight** so native speakers can test and report, covering the developer's blind spot in unfamiliar languages.

deepdive_en.title: Best practices
deepdive_en.body: Begins the best-practices segment, centered on making every user-facing string localizable and leveraging context and translation guidance to raise quality and consistency.

deepdive_en.title: Localizing strings in SwiftUI
deepdive_en.body: Reiterates that **SwiftUI is localizable by default**, a prerequisite for smooth translation; using standard APIs ensures strings are discovered and added to String Catalogs automatically.

deepdive_en.title: Localizing strings elsewhere
deepdive_en.body: Non-SwiftUI code typically needs explicit APIs like **`String(localized:)`** or **`LocalizedStringResource`** to be localizable. Recommends providing a glossary, do-not-translate list (product names/trademarks), and tone description in **AGENTS.md** or a dedicated **TRANSLATION.md**; prefer models with a large context window suited to long tasks, and note that low-resource languages may be lower quality.

deepdive_en.title: Field for machine-translated strings in the XLIFF
deepdive_en.body: When handling localizations exported from Xcode, check the XLIFF `target`'s **`state-qualifier="leveraged-mt"`** to identify which translations were provided by an agent (machine translation), aiding later human review and filtering.

title: Get started with the HTML Model Element
gloss: 開始使用 HTML model 元素
takeaway: 用新的 HTML <model> 元素在網頁直接嵌入可互動的 3D USDZ 內容，支援 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS。

points.text: 新的 HTML **<model>** 元素讓你在網站中直接嵌入可互動的 **3D USDZ** 內容，橫跨 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS。
用 **src** 或 **** 載入模型，並提供 **** 影像備援與 **ready** promise 處理載入成功或失敗。
可透過 **entityTransform** 套用 **DOMMatrix** 自訂旋轉與位移，並以 **stagemode** 控制軌道互動。
支援動畫播放（**playbackRate**、**play**）與 **AR Quick Look**（rel="ar"），讓使用者在現實空間中檢視模型。
未支援瀏覽器可用 **polyfill** 備援，並建議在上線前最佳化 USDZ 資產。

audience: **想在網站中加入 3D 與空間內容的網頁開發者**，特別是要支援 Apple 平台與 Vision Pro 的團隊。
gloss_en: Getting started with the HTML model element
takeaway_en: Use the new HTML <model> element to embed interactive 3D USDZ content directly in web pages, with support for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS.

points_en.text: The new HTML **<model>** element lets you embed interactive **3D USDZ** content directly in your website, across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS.
Load models with **src** or ****, provide an **** image fallback, and handle load success or failure with the **ready** promise.
Apply custom rotation and translation via **entityTransform** with a **DOMMatrix**, and control orbit interaction with **stagemode**.
Supports animation playback (**playbackRate**, **play**) and **AR Quick Look** (rel="ar"), letting users view models in real space.
Use a **polyfill** as a fallback for unsupported browsers, and optimize your USDZ assets before shipping.

audience_en: **Web developers who want to add 3D and spatial content to their sites**, especially teams targeting Apple platforms and Vision Pro.
summary: 這場由 Safari 團隊主講，主題是把 **HTML Model element**（`<model>`）從 visionOS 帶到 iOS、iPadOS 與 macOS。它是一個原生 HTML 元素，讓在網頁上嵌入互動式 3D 內容「像放一張圖片一樣簡單」：同一份 markup 在所有 Apple 平台的 Safari 都能運作，由系統直接算繪，毋需像過去用 `model-viewer` 這類 JavaScript 函式庫。講者以一個戶外用品電商網站為貫穿範例，從準備素材一路示範到上線優化。

素材方面建議採 **Capture、Convert、Create** 策略：用 iPhone 掃描實物、轉換既有檔案，或在 Blender 等工具建模；也可透過 Tripo3D、Meshy.ai 等生成式 AI 從照片或文字提示產生模型。最終輸出建議用 **USDZ** 格式，因為它把幾何、材質、貼圖與動畫全打包成單一檔案。嵌入時用 `src` 屬性或 `` 子元素指定 MIME type，並把 `` 放進 `` 內作為舊版瀏覽器的 fallback；用 **ready promise** 在模型載入完成前顯示 spinner、失敗時走 catch 區塊；對尚未原生支援的瀏覽器則載入 **polyfill** 補足功能（但 visionOS 的立體算繪等特性無法被 polyfill）。

互動方面，最簡單的是 **`stagemode="orbit"`**，一個屬性就能讓使用者自由旋轉模型、放手時自動回正並縮放避免裁切。若要精準控制視角，改用 **`entityTransform`** 屬性搭配 `DOMMatrix.rotateSelf` 設定旋轉（需先關閉 orbit），並用 `requestAnimationFrame` 加上 easing 做平滑過渡；內建動畫則用 `play()` 與 `playbackRate`（負值即倒播）控制。最後可把 `<model>` 包進 `rel="ar"` 的 `<a>` 標籤即啟用 **AR Quick Look**。上線前用內建的 **usdcrush** 壓縮檔案（範例從 7.9 MB 降到 1.9 MB 且畫質不變）、用 **usdrecord** 批次產生縮圖，這兩個工具 Mac 已預裝。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Safari 工程師 Aleksei 開場，說明 **Model element** 原本在 visionOS 首發，現在擴展到 **iOS、iPadOS 與 macOS**，同一份 markup 與元素在各平台通用。相較於既有的 `model-viewer` JavaScript 函式庫，`<model>` 是原生元素、由平台直接算繪、不需額外函式庫，且是 W3C 正在推進的新興 web 標準。講者以戶外用品電商網站為例，規劃出素材準備、逐項堆疊功能、再到產線優化三大段。

deepdive.title: Prepare the USDZ model asset
deepdive.body: 建議用 **Capture、Convert、Create** 取得 3D 素材：iPhone 掃描、轉檔或用 Blender 建模，也可透過 Tripo3D、Meshy.ai 等生成式 AI 從照片或文字提示產生模型。講者示範用幾張露營木槌的照片，幾分鐘就生出可用模型並匯出成 **USDZ**。USDZ 是壓縮成單檔的 Universal Scene Description，把幾何、材質、貼圖與動畫全部打包，是最推薦的格式。

deepdive.title: Loading and fallbacks
deepdive.body: 本段概觀如何嵌入模型、判斷何時可顯示，以及處理 fallback。講者將依序帶過載入、影像備援、ready promise 與 polyfill。

deepdive.title: Load a model
deepdive.body: 如同 ``，用 **`src` 屬性**指向檔案、瀏覽器自動處理，毋需外掛；也可用 `` 子元素並指定 `type="model/vnd.usdz+zip"` 這類 MIME type。這種寫法與既有的圖片、影片標籤是相同模式，學習成本低。

deepdive.title: Image fallback
deepdive.body: 最簡單的 fallback 是把 **`` 放進 `` 元素內**：舊版 Safari 或尚未支援 Model element 的瀏覽器會改算繪該圖片，讓訪客仍能對產品有概念。這延續了 HTML 一貫的漸進增強做法。

deepdive.title: Ready promise
deepdive.body: 3D 模型動輒數十 MB，載入需要時間，**`model.ready`** 這個 promise 會在模型真正載入完成可顯示時 resolve。實務上載入期間先顯示 spinner，resolve 後隱藏；若發生意外則在 **catch** 區塊顯示 fallback 內容。

deepdive.title: Polyfill fallback
deepdive.body: **polyfill** 用 JavaScript 補上新標準的 API，讓功能在尚未原生支援的平台也能使用；W3C 的 Model element 範例就示範若 `window` 上沒有原生元素就載入 polyfill 函式庫。講者提醒要同時測試 polyfill 與原生元素，並注意某些特性（如 Apple Vision Pro 的立體顯示）無法被 polyfill。

deepdive.title: Model background
deepdive.body: Model element 在自己的虛擬空間中算繪，不會繼承頁面背景。

deepdive.title: Model background
deepdive.body: 要與頁面設計一致，直接在 `model` 上用 CSS 設定 **`background-color`**。要注意背景一律算繪為不透明，即使指定帶 alpha 的顏色也會被轉成不透明。

deepdive.title: Stage mode
deepdive.body: **`stagemode="orbit"`** 讓訪客自由左右旋轉模型，上下傾斜放手後會輕輕彈回原始角度，互動同時又維持最佳呈現。此屬性也會把模型稍微縮小，重新調整尺寸以確保旋轉時不被裁切。

deepdive.title: Interactions
deepdive.body: 本段帶出讓訪客互動探索模型是自然的下一步，並預告將示範自訂 transform 與播放動畫的做法。

deepdive.title: Custom transforms
deepdive.body: **`entityTransform`** 屬性可用 JavaScript 設定精確視角，講者加上「Side」與「Reset」兩顆按鈕示範。使用前需先停用 orbit（移除 `stagemode` 或設為 `none`），並注意手動旋轉可能讓部分模型裁切或消失、必要時要調整位置。實作上建立 **`DOMMatrix`** 並呼叫 `rotateSelf`（範例繞 Y 軸旋轉 135 度取側視），指派給 `model.entityTransform`；先存下初始 transform 以供 reset 還原。

deepdive.title: Transition animation
deepdive.body: 直接切換 transform 是瞬間跳動的，要讓過渡平滑可用 **`requestAnimationFrame`** 動畫化旋轉。先設好狀態：目前角度、動畫時長（範例 500 毫秒，半秒既俐落又流暢）以及一個用來取消進行中動畫的參照。

deepdive.title: Transition animation
deepdive.body: `animateTo` 函式先取消任何進行中的動畫以免衝突，記下起始角度與起始時間，再用 step 函式逐影格計算進度、做 ease（範例用 cubic ease-out）並以新的 `DOMMatrix` 更新 `entityTransform`，未完成就請求下一影格。最後把 animateTo 綁到按鈕：側視動到 135 度、reset 回到 0；點擊後模型平滑旋轉再滑回原位。

deepdive.title: Animation playback
deepdive.body: 模型也能播放內建動畫，這些動畫通常在 Blender、Maya 中製作並烘焙進 USDZ 檔。

deepdive.title: Animation playback
deepdive.body: Model element 播放第一個動畫軌，用幾行 JavaScript 即可控制 **`playbackRate`**，給負值就倒播。講者實作一個 `play` 函式設定 playbackRate 後呼叫 `play()`，範例用 5 與 -5 做較快的正播與倒播。

deepdive.title: AR and spatial
deepdive.body: 本段把模型帶進真實環境與空間運算情境，預告接下來的 AR Quick Look 與 visionOS 體驗。

deepdive.title: AR Quick Look
deepdive.body: 把 `<model>` 包進帶 **`rel="ar"`** 的 `<a>` 標籤、指向同一資源，iOS 與 iPadOS 上即可獲得完整的 **AR Quick Look** 體驗。在 **visionOS** 上則有立體算繪讓模型具真實深度，使用者能把產品從頁面中「拉出來」端詳；visionOS 還支援沉浸式網站環境，詳見「Explore immersive website environments」場次。

deepdive.title: Optimize assets for production
deepdive.body: 上線前用命令列工具 **usdcrush** 壓縮模型，範例把 boot 模型從 7.9 MB 降到 1.9 MB 且畫質不變，兩版並排在 Safari 中看起來完全相同。若有 3D 檔但缺圖，可用 **usdrecord** 直接產生縮圖或 fallback 影像（可指定輸出格式或自訂相機），且能寫腳本跨整個型錄批次執行。這兩個工具 Mac 已預裝，屬於更大的 USD 工具套件，詳見 WWDC24「What's new in USD and MaterialX」。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 行動建議：用文字提示或既有照片做一個自己的 3D 模型、在網站加上 `<model>` 指向 USDZ 檔、用 USD 工具優化素材並在各平台試玩觀察元素如何適配。團隊正積極在 **W3C** 推進 Model 規格，鼓勵開發者加入 Immersive Web Community Group 提供回饋與使用情境，並參考「Immersive website environments」與 WWDC25「What's new for the spatial web」延伸學習。

summary_en: Presented by the Safari team, this session brings the native **HTML Model element** (`<model>`) from visionOS to iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. It lets you embed interactive 3D content on a web page "as easily as adding an image": the same markup works across every Apple platform's Safari and is rendered directly by the platform, so you no longer need a JavaScript library like `model-viewer`.
