deepdive_en.body: Implementation options: iOS's AVPlayerViewController / macOS's AVPlayerView (fully implemented), AVLegibleMediaOptionsMenuController (for existing UI), and the lower-level **AVPlayerLayer** (you drive it) and **AVCaptionRenderer** (you render it). The AVPlayerLayer flow: get profile IDs with `MACaptionAppearanceCopyProfileIDs` to populate the UI, show a preview on selection with `setCaptionPreviewProfileID` (nil text shows localized system text, position avoids controls), stop with `stopShowingCaptionPreview`, and apply via `MACaptionAppearanceSetActiveProfileID`.

deepdive_en.title: Demo
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates both features together: watching an English-subtitled camping video, switching via the Subtitles menu's Language to the Italian **generated** subtitles marked with a sparkle and "Translated"; then trying Large Text from the Style menu, with existing subtitles replaced by an Italian placeholder preview, and finally applying the custom Bold Yellow style.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recommends exploring generated subtitles (e.g. turning them on while watching travel videos), ensuring your app has a subtitle-selection UI, and implementing subtitle style preview so users who need to adjust styling can do so right while watching.

title: What’s new in Xcode 27
gloss: Xcode 27 的新功能
takeaway: Xcode 27 帶來工作區自訂、編輯器內 coding agent、Device Hub、在地化、Organizer 與 Instruments Top Functions 等多項生產力提升。

points.text: 編輯器內整合 **Coding Agents**，可直接在程式碼旁進行 AI 輔助開發。
**工作區與工具列**可自訂、新增**主題（Themes）**與 **Inline Issues**（行內問題顯示），改善編輯體驗。
新增 **Device Hub** 集中管理裝置，並更新**新專案工作流程**與在地化（Localization）工具。
**Organizer** 與 **Instruments** 強化，新增 **Top Functions** 協助快速定位效能熱點。
**Xcode Cloud** 也獲得更新，持續整合 CI/CD 流程。

audience: **所有使用 Xcode 的 Apple 平台開發者**，想了解最新 IDE 生產力功能與工作流程改進者。
gloss_en: What's new in Xcode 27
takeaway_en: Xcode 27 brings workspace customization, in-editor coding agents, Device Hub, localization, Organizer, and Instruments Top Functions, among many productivity improvements.

points_en.text: **Coding Agents** are integrated right into the editor, enabling AI-assisted development alongside your code.
The **workspace and toolbar** are customizable, with new **Themes** and **Inline Issues** to improve the editing experience.
Adds **Device Hub** to centrally manage devices, and updates the **new project workflow** and Localization tools.
**Organizer** and **Instruments** are enhanced, with a new **Top Functions** view to help you quickly pinpoint performance hot spots.
**Xcode Cloud** also gets updates to keep CI/CD integration moving.

audience_en: **All Apple platform developers using Xcode** who want to learn about the latest IDE productivity features and workflow improvements.
summary: Xcode 27 由設計師 Jake 與工程師 Breckin 以「紙飛機艦隊」app 為主軸，串起從原型發想到上線維運的完整生命週期。前半段聚焦於工作環境的全新外觀與高度客製化：**Toolbar** 與 **Themes** 經過重新設計，歷史導覽、編輯器控制項都移上 Toolbar，分支選擇器則改放底部以容納長分支名稱；主題系統可透過幾條滑桿調整文字與背景強度，甚至產生漸層背景，並支援為不同 workspace 套用不同主題以一眼辨識專案。編輯時的 **Inline Issues** 也改為低調的「預測式 (live) issues」，在打字時以融入主題的淡色背景呈現，建置後才轉為全強度的 warning/error。

在開發流程上，Xcode 27 讓「靈感一來就開專案」變得極為輕鬆：File 選單可直接建立 App、Command Line Tool、Swift Package 或 Playground，甚至產生免命名的 untitled 專案隨意嘗試；單獨開啟一個 Swift 檔也能在 canvas 顯示 playground 結果與 UI preview。最大的升級在於 **Coding Agents** 深度整合到編輯器：agent 對話以 editor 形式存在，可搭配 tab 與分割視窗組織，支援 `/plan` 指令先擬定計畫、派生 sub-agents 平行探索，所有改動與產出 (檔案、screenshot) 即時顯示於右側，側邊欄則彙整所有平行進行的對話。執行 app 時會進入 **Device Hub**，以貼合裝置尺寸的視窗呈現，可展開檢視器測試 accessibility 設定、Dynamic Type、深色外觀與 iPhone Mirroring 縮放，並能在同一介面同時操作 simulator 與實體裝置 (如已配對的 iPad Pro)。

後半段由 Breckin 接手，說明 app 上線後如何持續維運。**Localization** 借助 coding agent 自動檢查字串、建立 **String Catalog** 並翻譯整份 UI，String Catalog 中選定語言後按 Generate Translations 即可在背景補上新語言 (如簡體中文)，搭配 TestFlight 讓母語使用者回饋。**Organizer** 帶來四項更新：重新設計的 Overview 將診斷與 metrics 並置、新增 Storage 與 animation hitches metrics、把 recommendations 升級為依同類 app 校準的 **Metric Goals**，並可用 coding agent 進行 Generate Recommendations 引導式效能分析。

效能調校方面，**Instruments** 的 **Top Functions** 能快速找出被頻繁呼叫的昂貴函式 — 範例中直接指向 `paperPhysics`，搭配 CMD+Shift+O Quick Open 找到那段迴圈迭代過多的除錯殘留程式碼並修正。最後以 **Xcode Cloud** 收尾，這個內建的 CI/CD 服務在 Xcode 27 中只需幾步即可連接遠端 repo，讓 Unit/UI Tests 在每次 commit 時於雲端跨裝置平行執行以捕捉回歸，並無縫銜接 TestFlight 與 App Store。整體而言，Xcode 27 從原型、協作、在地化到上線後問題追蹤都能陪伴開發者，讓人專注於打造真正特別的 app。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 設計師 **Jake** 與工程師 **Breckin** 以他們正在開發的紙飛機艦隊管理 app 為貫穿全場的例子開場。他們預告 Xcode 27 三大亮點：更容易透過 **Coding Agents** 啟動任務、更快速地嘗試新專案點子，以及前所未有可客製化的 workspace，並依序帶到工作環境、新專案、agent、Device Hub 與上線後維運。

deepdive.title: Workspace & Toolbar
deepdive.body: **Toolbar** 經過重新設計，將原本藏在 jump bar 的歷史導覽與編輯器控制項移上來，建置進度等活動資訊顯示於視窗標題下方，中央放置 coding agent 入口與 scheme/destination 選擇器，右上則有 tab、編輯器分割與三段式編輯模式切換 (preview/playground、Assistant Editor、原始碼變更檢視)。分支選擇器移到底部以容納長分支名稱，而最大特點是 Toolbar 完全可自訂，能自由增刪與重排項目。

deepdive.title: Themes
deepdive.body: 新的 **Appearance** 設定面板可用兩條滑桿調整文字色彩強度與背景強度，背景拉到最高甚至會變成鮮豔漸層，且可自選色調 (如粉紅) 讓整個調色盤自動更新。所有個別顏色都由 base palette 生成，手動修改某色 (如 keyword 設為粉紅) 會鎖定該值且可一鍵 reset；字型也採同樣的 palette 機制。主題會影響整個 workspace 視窗，並可為不同 workspace 套用不同主題以一眼區分專案，深色外觀下尤其鮮明。

deepdive.title: Inline Issues
deepdive.body: warning 與 error 重新設計以配合新主題。**預測式 (live) issues** 採用融入主題的低調淡色背景，讓使用者打字時保持專注且能與建置後的 issue 區別。當你修改程式碼時 Xcode 會像要重新建置般自動預測問題，實際 build 後這些預測會轉為全強度色彩的 warning/error，或在已解決時自動消失。

deepdive.title: New Project Workflows
deepdive.body: 從 File 選單可依需求選擇起點：要 SwiftUI 就用 **App**、不需 UI 用 macOS **Command Line Tool**、要做給他人用的函式庫選 **Swift Package**、只想要單一含 Playground macro 的 Swift 檔則選 **Playground**。Xcode 27 會直接建立免命名的 untitled 專案讓你盡情試驗，之後再決定命名儲存或整個捨棄；甚至單獨開啟一個 Swift 檔就能在 canvas 顯示 playground 結果與 UI preview，方便分享輕量點子。

deepdive.title: Coding Agents in the Editor
deepdive.body: **Coding agents** 全面強化，對話與任務以 editor 形式進入編輯區，可搭配 tab、分割視窗自由組織。透過 Toolbar 按鈕啟動對話，使用 `/plan` 指令會呼叫 plan tool 先蒐集脈絡、派生 sub-agents 平行探索而不立即改動，待計畫完成可審閱、給 inline 回饋或放行實作；agent 的所有改動、產出檔案與 screenshot 即時顯示右側，coding assistant 側邊欄則彙整所有平行對話並標示未讀。講者並推薦延伸觀看「Xcode, agents, and you」。

deepdive.title: Device Hub
deepdive.body: 啟動 app 時會在 **Device Hub** 以貼合裝置尺寸的精簡視窗開啟，提供回主畫面、截圖、旋轉等快速動作，展開後可開啟 Inspector 測試提高對比、放大 Dynamic Type、深色外觀等 **accessibility** 設定。也能驗證 macOS 27 上可調整大小的 iPhone Mirroring 縮放模式與不同長寬比，而 SwiftUI 標準視圖讓 app 已具備良好的 resizable 支援。最重要的是側邊欄整合 simulator 與實體裝置 (如已配對運行中的 iPad Pro)，可直接在 Mac 上控制多種尺寸機型。

deepdive.title: Localization
deepdive.body: **Localization** 由 coding agent 大幅分擔工作：因 agent 是大型語言模型，特別適合建議合適翻譯。新建對話後請 agent 設定在地化，它會讀過程式碼、確保字串字面值可被在地化引用、建立涵蓋所有 UI 字串的 **String Catalog** 並翻成指定語言 (示範為西班牙文)，翻譯時運用整個專案脈絡與 Xcode 的語言風格指引。String Catalog 中選定語言 (如簡體中文) 按 Generate Translations 即可在背景補完，並建議先從一兩種語言開始、務必實測版面與截斷問題，並用 TestFlight 收集母語回饋。

deepdive.title: Organizer
deepdive.body: **Organizer** 從只收集報告進化到能協助行動，帶來四項新東西：重新設計的 **Overview** 把最高影響力問題與診斷、metrics 並置於同一畫面 (上方圖表尖峰示警、下方診斷指出程式位置)；新增 **Storage** metric (拆解 documents、data、binary size) 與更全面的 animation **hitches** metric (涵蓋 Liquid Glass 與 SwiftUI 動畫，不限捲動)；recommendations 升級為依同類 app 與自身歷史基準校準的 **Metric Goals** (涵蓋 hang rate、disk writes、battery、storage、hitches)；並可用 coding agent 執行 Generate Recommendations 進行引導式效能分析。

deepdive.title: Instruments & Top Functions
deepdive.body: **Instruments** 在 Xcode 27 中更貼合工作流程，新功能 **Top Functions** 讓效能模式更快浮現，特別適合找出被執行多次的昂貴操作。示範中重現 Organizer 標示的動畫 hitch，選取 CPU profile 中活動密集的時間範圍後按 Top Functions，發現大量時間花在動畫管線、最頂端是昂貴的 `paperPhysics`。透過 CMD+Shift+O Quick Open 找到該函式，原來是除錯時遺留的迴圈迭代過多，改回 5 次後 hitch 消失、Top Functions 中也不再出現自家方法。

deepdive.title: Xcode Cloud
deepdive.body: **Xcode Cloud** 是內建於 Xcode、專為 Apple 平台打造的 CI/CD 服務，可在雲端跨多裝置、Xcode 與 OS 版本平行建置與測試，Xcode 27 中更易上手。示範以 Get Started 按鈕幾步完成設定：確認 app 與開發團隊、連接遠端原始碼 repo，按 Start First Build 後即可在 main 或 feature 分支每次 commit 自動跑 Unit/UI Tests 作為回歸訊號，並無縫整合 TestFlight 與 App Store 交付。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: Jake 總結 Xcode 27 在 app 生命週期每一步都陪伴開發者：從把初步點子化為原型、與 agent 協作、在地化，到上線後解決現場問題，都讓人能專注於打造特別的 app。最後鼓勵下載 Xcode 27、依自己的工作流程客製化，並參考 release notes 與本場 session 資源探索更多新功能。

summary_en: Xcode 27 is presented by designer Jake and engineer Breckin around their paper-airplane fleet app, tracing the full lifecycle from prototyping to post-launch maintenance. The first half focuses on the redesigned, highly customizable workspace: the **Toolbar** and **Themes** are revamped, with history navigation and editor controls moved up into the Toolbar, build activity shown under the window title, and the branch picker relocated to the bottom bar to fit long branch names. The theme system lets you tune text and background intensity with a couple of sliders (even producing a vibrant gradient background) and apply different themes per workspace to tell projects apart at a glance. While editing, **Inline Issues** become subtle predictive (live) issues that blend into the theme as you type, only turning into full-intensity warnings and errors after a build.

On workflow, Xcode 27 makes starting a project effortless: the File menu offers App, Command Line Tool, Swift Package, and Playground starting points, and can create an untitled project with no questions asked for quick experiments; even a standalone Swift file shows playground results and UI previews in the canvas. The biggest upgrade is the deep integration of **Coding Agents** into the editor: agent conversations live as editors you compose with tabs and splits, support the `/plan` command to gather context and spawn parallel sub-agents before making changes, surface all edits and artifacts (files, screenshots) on the right, and roll up parallel conversations in a sidebar. Running an app opens it in **Device Hub**, a compact device-sized window where you can expand the Inspector to test accessibility settings, Dynamic Type, dark appearance, and resizable iPhone Mirroring, and control simulators and physical devices (like a paired iPad Pro) side by side.

Breckin takes the second half, covering life after launch. **Localization** leans on the coding agent to audit strings, build a **String Catalog**, and translate the entire UI; selecting a language in the String Catalog and clicking Generate Translations adds a new language (such as Simplified Chinese) in the background, with TestFlight enabling native-speaker feedback. The **Organizer** gains four things: a redesigned Overview placing diagnostics and metrics together, new Storage and animation hitches metrics, recommendations elevated into **Metric Goals** calibrated against similar apps and your own history, and Generate Recommendations powered by a coding agent for guided performance analysis.

For performance, **Instruments** gains **Top Functions**, which quickly surfaces expensive, frequently-called functions — in the demo pointing straight at `paperPhysics`, where CMD+Shift+O Quick Open reveals a debug leftover looping far too many times, fixed by reducing the count. The talk closes with **Xcode Cloud**, the built-in CI/CD service that in Xcode 27 takes just a few steps to connect to a remote repo, running Unit/UI tests in parallel across devices on every commit to catch regressions and integrating seamlessly with TestFlight and the App Store. Overall, Xcode 27 supports developers from prototype through collaboration, localization, and field issues so they can focus on making something special.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Designer **Jake** and engineer **Breckin** open with the paper-airplane fleet app that runs throughout the session. They preview Xcode 27's three highlights — easier task kickoff with **Coding Agents**, faster iteration on new project ideas, and a more customizable workspace than ever — then map out the journey through workspace, new projects, agents, Device Hub, and post-launch maintenance.

deepdive_en.title: Workspace & Toolbar
deepdive_en.body: The **Toolbar** is redesigned, pulling history navigation and editor controls out of the jump bar, showing build activity under the window title, centering the coding agent entry point and scheme/destination picker, and placing tab, split, and a three-way editor-mode chooser (preview/playground, Assistant Editor, source-control review) at top right. The branch picker moves to the bottom bar to fit long names, and the standout feature is that the Toolbar is fully customizable — you can add, remove, and reorder items freely.

deepdive_en.title: Themes
deepdive_en.body: The new **Appearance** settings panel offers two sliders to tune text color intensity and background intensity, with the background turning into a vibrant gradient at maximum, plus custom tints (like pink) that update the whole palette. Every individual color is generated from a base palette; manually editing one (e.g. setting keywords to pink) locks it and can be reset, and fonts follow the same palette mechanism. Themes affect the entire workspace window and can differ per workspace to distinguish projects at a glance, looking especially vibrant in dark appearance.

deepdive_en.title: Inline Issues
deepdive_en.body: Warnings and errors are redesigned to work with the new themes. Predictive (live) issues use a subtle background that blends into your theme to reduce distraction while typing and to distinguish them from build-time issues. As you edit, Xcode predicts issues as if a build were starting; after you actually build, those predictions turn into full-intensity warnings and errors or are dismissed if resolved.

deepdive_en.title: New Project Workflows
deepdive_en.body: The File menu offers starting points by need: **App** for SwiftUI, a macOS **Command Line Tool** when no UI is needed, a **Swift Package** for libraries others can use, and **Playground** for a single Swift file with a Playground macro. Xcode 27 creates an untitled project with no questions asked so you can experiment freely and later name and save or discard it; even opening a standalone Swift file shows playground results and UI previews in the canvas, making it easy to share lightweight ideas.

deepdive_en.title: Coding Agents in the Editor
deepdive_en.body: **Coding agents** are supercharged, with conversations and tasks entering the editor area as editors you compose with tabs and splits. A Toolbar button starts a conversation, and the `/plan` command invokes the plan tool to gather context and spawn parallel sub-agents without making changes, letting you review the plan, give inline feedback, or approve implementation; all agent edits, produced files, and screenshots appear live on the right, while the coding assistant sidebar rolls up parallel conversations and flags unread messages. The presenter recommends the session 'Xcode, agents, and you' for the full picture.

deepdive_en.title: Device Hub
deepdive_en.body: Launching an app opens it in **Device Hub** as a compact device-sized window with quick actions (home, screenshot, rotate); expanding it reveals an Inspector to test **accessibility** settings like increased contrast, larger Dynamic Type, and dark appearance. You can also exercise the resizable iPhone Mirroring mode on macOS 27 with different aspect ratios, helped by SwiftUI standard views giving the app solid resizable support. Best of all, the sidebar combines simulators and physical devices (like a paired iPad Pro already running the app), so you can control many form factors right on your Mac.

deepdive_en.title: Localization
deepdive_en.body: **Localization** is largely offloaded to the coding agent, which, being an LLM, is ideal for suggesting appropriate translations. After creating a conversation and asking it to set up localization, the agent reads the code, makes string literals localization-ready, builds a **String Catalog** of every UI string, and translates them (Spanish in the demo) using full project context plus Xcode's language-specific style guidance. Selecting a language (like Simplified Chinese) and clicking Generate Translations fills it in the background; the advice is to start with one or two languages, always test for layout and truncation issues, and use TestFlight for native-speaker feedback.

deepdive_en.title: Organizer
deepdive_en.body: The **Organizer** evolves from collecting reports to helping you act, with four new things: a redesigned **Overview** placing the highest-impact issues, diagnostics, and metrics in one view (a chart spike up top signals trouble, diagnostics below point to the code); new **Storage** metric (breaking down documents, data, binary size) and a more complete animation **hitches** metric (covering Liquid Glass and SwiftUI animations beyond scrolling); recommendations elevated into **Metric Goals** calibrated against similar apps and your own historical baselines (covering hang rate, disk writes, battery, storage, hitches); and Generate Recommendations using a coding agent for guided performance analysis.

deepdive_en.title: Instruments & Top Functions
deepdive_en.body: **Instruments** fits better alongside the rest of the work in Xcode 27, and the new **Top Functions** makes performance patterns jump out faster, ideal for finding expensive operations performed many times. Reproducing the hitch the Organizer flagged, the presenter selects the busy time range in a CPU profile and presses Top Functions, finding lots of time in the animation pipeline with `paperPhysics` at the top. CMD+Shift+O Quick Open opens the function, revealing a debug leftover looping far too many times; reducing it to 5 makes the hitch disappear and removes the app's methods from Top Functions.

deepdive_en.title: Xcode Cloud
deepdive_en.body: **Xcode Cloud** is a CI/CD service built into Xcode expressly for shipping to Apple platforms, building and testing in the cloud in parallel across devices, Xcode, and OS versions, and easier to start in Xcode 27. The demo uses Get Started to confirm the app and team, connect the remote source repo, and click Start First Build, after which Unit/UI tests run automatically on every commit to main or feature branches as a regression signal, integrating seamlessly with TestFlight and the App Store.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Jake wraps up that Xcode 27 is there at every step of the app lifecycle — from fleshing out ideas into prototypes, collaborating with agents, and localizing, to resolving field issues — letting developers focus on making something special. He encourages downloading Xcode 27, customizing it for your workflow, and exploring more via the release notes and this session's resources.

title: Xcode, agents, and you
gloss: Xcode、代理人與你
takeaway: 了解如何把 Xcode 的編碼代理人融入開發流程，從探索、建構、精修到協調多步驟任務。

points.text: 示範把 **Xcode 的編碼代理人（coding agents）**融入日常開發流程的多種工作方式。
用代理人**探索（Explore）**既有 App，快速理解程式碼結構與行為。
從**建構（Build）到精修（Refine）**，由代理人協助實作功能並逐步打磨。
進一步**協調（Orchestrate）**多個步驟與任務，讓代理人處理更複雜的工作流程。

audience: **想把 AI 編碼代理人納入 Xcode 開發流程**、提升效率的 iOS 開發者。
gloss_en: Xcode, agents, and you
takeaway_en: Learn how to bring Xcode's coding agents into your development workflow, from exploring to building, refining, and orchestrating multi-step tasks.

points_en.text: Demonstrates multiple ways to bring **Xcode's coding agents** into your everyday development workflow.
Use agents to **Explore** an existing app and quickly understand its code structure and behavior.
From **Build to Refine**, agents help implement features and polish them step by step.
Go further and **Orchestrate** multiple steps and tasks, letting agents handle more complex workflows.

audience_en: iOS developers who want to **bring AI coding agents into their Xcode development workflow** and boost efficiency.
summary: 本場由 Xcode Intelligence 團隊的 Devin 與 Maxwell 以實際開發一款健身追蹤 app 為例，示範如何在 **Xcode 27** 中運用 **coding agents** 貫穿整個開發流程。Xcode 26.3 首度引入 coding agents 與處理多步驟任務的工具，Xcode 27 則擴充了工具集並重新設計與 agent 的互動方式，核心目標是讓你專注在自己喜歡的工作上：你掌握程式碼的願景，Xcode 幫你更快、更有信心地抵達。

整場圍繞四個工作模式展開。**Explore（探索）** 階段，agent 能讀取整個專案（原始碼、build settings、開啟的檔案與當前選取），可請它產出架構 walkthrough 並把知識沉澱成專案內的架構文件，同時透過 **Apple Document Search** 取得最新的 SwiftUI、SwiftData 文件。**Build（建構）** 階段使用 **plan mode** 先當架構師規劃，再透過 queued messages 與 agent 提問形成緊密溝通迴圈，approve 後 agent 以 artifacts 形式呈現 diff，並用 Build、Preview、Test 工具自我驗證（範例中寫出 12 個通過的測試）。

**Refine（精修）** 階段示範以 **Swift Charts** 加入視覺化，強調設計是主觀且會持續迭代的，可用圖片、Freeform 手繪 sketch 表達意圖，並以 **inline annotations** 直接在原始碼指定位置做精準、限定範圍的修改；previews 會被增量渲染以自我驗證結果是否符合預期。**Orchestrate（協調）** 階段以「把 app 在地化成 Filipino」與「為互動元素加上 VoiceOver labels」兩個並行對話為例，說明你只需描述高階目標，Xcode 便自動發現合適工具（如機器翻譯工具）並派出 sub-agents 並行執行。

實務takeaway：agent 讓「把想法變成功能」變得極快，因此工作重心自然轉向「先有好的計畫」。從探索、規劃、建構到精修與協調，Xcode 全程把你留在駕駛座，並提供與你相同的驗證工具（build、preview、test），讓你對程式碼的正確性保有信心。延伸可參考「Create UI Prototypes using Agents in Xcode」與「Translate your app with agents in Xcode」兩場 session。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Xcode Intelligence 團隊的 **Devin** 與 **Maxwell** 開場，說明 **Xcode 27** 在 26.3 引入 coding agents 的基礎上，擴充工具並重新設計 agent 互動方式。核心理念是讓你驅動程式碼願景、Xcode 助你更快達成，並能適應不同熟練度的使用者。整場將依 explore、build、refine、orchestrate 四個模式逐步示範。

deepdive.title: Meet the app
deepdive.body: 兩人介紹他們正在打造的健身追蹤 app，目前已有追蹤練習的 workout 頁與顯示過往紀錄的 history 區。Maxwell 提出想看到隨時間的進步趨勢，因而催生新的 **insights view** 需求。Devin 先用 agent 把 app 起出基本架構，由此展開後續開發。

deepdive.title: Explore
deepdive.body: 示範以 Option+Shift 點選工具列按鈕，在獨立編輯器面板開啟新對話來探索專案。agent 能看到整個專案 context，產出含 data flow 大綱、關鍵區域表格與原始碼參照的 **walkthrough**，並可把成果寫成兩份架構文件作為可隨程式碼演進的知識庫。畫面也區分左側 transcript（對話、工具呼叫、sub-agents）與右側 **artifacts**（檔案、編輯、preview）。同時透過 **Apple Document Search** 自動取得最新的 SwiftUI tables 與 SwiftData 文件。

deepdive.title: Build
deepdive.body: 以 slash command 進入 **plan mode**，讓你先當架構師規劃要新增的 workout insights tab，並帶入 explore 階段學到的裝置呈現細節。透過 **queued messages** 與 agent 主動提問形成溝通迴圈（例如選擇 per-exercise 與 top-level summary 兩種呈現）。approve 計畫後，agent 以 artifacts 顯示 diff，並用 Xcode 的 **build、preview、test** 工具自我驗證，建置錯誤直接回饋給 agent 迭代修正，最終寫出並通過 12 個測試。

deepdive.title: Refine
deepdive.body: 用 **Swift Charts** 為分析畫面加入視覺化，強調圖表外觀、動畫、配色是會持續變動的主觀偏好，因此每次變更都要留在迴圈中。示範先為各種圖表類型以假資料產生 preview 挑選（選定 volume over time），再用 iPad 的 **Freeform** 手繪 sketch 表達設計，agent 據此產出符合的折線圖。最後用 **inline annotations** 在原始碼精確指定位置加入淡入動畫、調整 trend line 顏色以符合主題。

deepdive.title: Orchestrate
deepdive.body: 示範 **orchestration**：以「把所有使用者可見字串翻成 Filipino 並設定 strings catalog」與「為所有互動元素加上 VoiceOver labels 與 accessibility identifiers」兩個並行對話。你只描述高階目標，Xcode 自動發現合適工具（如機器翻譯工具），主對話把工作拆成多個 **sub-agents** 並行執行、底層各自呼叫翻譯能力。最後啟用 VoiceOver 驗證每個主要元素都已標記且可導覽。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 回顧整場用到的能力：以 Xcode Tools 與 Apple Document Search 探索程式碼與 API、用 plan mode 規劃架構、用 build/preview/test 驗證、用圖片與 inline annotations 精修、用 sub-agents 並行協調在地化與無障礙。行動建議是下載 **Xcode 27** 在自己的專案上試用 agents，並參考「Create UI Prototypes using Agents in Xcode」與「Translate your app with agents in Xcode」兩場 session。

summary_en: Hosted by Devin and Maxwell of the Xcode Intelligence team, this session walks through building a real fitness-tracking app to show how **coding agents** in **Xcode 27** can support your entire development process. Building on the agents introduced in Xcode 26.3, Xcode 27 expands the available tools and redesigns how you interact with agents, with the goal of keeping you focused on the work you enjoy: you drive the vision for your code, and Xcode helps you get there faster and with more confidence.

The talk is organized around four ways of working. In **Explore**, an agent can see your whole project (source, build settings, open files, active selection), produce an architecture walkthrough, and capture that knowledge into living architecture documents in the project, while **Apple Document Search** pulls in up-to-date SwiftUI and SwiftData docs. In **Build**, you use **plan mode** to act as the architect, refine the plan through queued messages and agent questions, then approve it so the agent makes changes as reviewable artifacts and validates them with Xcode's Build, Preview, and Test tools (writing 12 passing tests in the demo).

In **Refine**, they add visualizations with **Swift Charts**, emphasizing that visual design is subjective and iterative: you can express intent with images and Freeform sketches, and use **inline annotations** to make precise, scoped changes pointed right at a spot in your source, while previews are rendered incrementally as a self-verification loop. In **Orchestrate**, two parallel conversations localize the app into Filipino and add VoiceOver labels: you describe a high-level goal and Xcode automatically discovers the right tools (like machine translation) and deploys sub-agents to execute the work in parallel.

The practical takeaway is that because agents turn ideas into features so quickly, the center of gravity shifts toward having the right plan first. Across exploring, building, refining, and orchestrating, Xcode keeps you in the driver's seat and gives agents the same validation tools you have (build, preview, test) so you can trust the code is correct. For deeper dives, see the "Create UI Prototypes using Agents in Xcode" and "Translate your app with agents in Xcode" sessions.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: **Devin** and **Maxwell** from the Xcode Intelligence team open by explaining that **Xcode 27** builds on the coding agents introduced in 26.3 by expanding the tools and redesigning agent interaction. The core idea is that you drive the vision for your code while Xcode helps you get there faster, adapting to users of any experience level. The session is structured around four modes: explore, build, refine, and orchestrate.

deepdive_en.title: Meet the app
deepdive_en.body: The pair introduce the fitness-tracking app they are building, which already has a workout page to track exercises and a history section for previous sessions. Maxwell wants to see progress over time, which motivates the new **insights view**. Devin first uses an agent to get the app off the ground, setting up the work that follows.

deepdive_en.title: Explore
deepdive_en.body: They open a new conversation in a separate editor pane (Option+Shift on the toolbar button) to explore the project. The agent sees the whole project context and produces a **walkthrough** with data-flow outlines, tables of key areas, and source references, which can be saved as two architecture documents forming a living knowledge base. The UI distinguishes the left-side transcript (conversation, tool calls, sub-agents) from right-side **artifacts** (files, edits, previews). **Apple Document Search** is invoked automatically to gather current SwiftUI tables and SwiftData documentation.

deepdive_en.title: Build
deepdive_en.body: Using a slash command, they enter **plan mode** to act as the architect and plan the new workout insights tab, bringing in device-presentation details learned during explore. **Queued messages** and agent questions create a tight communication loop (choosing per-exercise and top-level summary presentations). After approving the plan, the agent shows diffs as artifacts and validates with Xcode's **build, preview, and test** tools; build errors are fed straight back so it can iterate, ultimately writing and passing 12 tests.

deepdive_en.title: Refine
deepdive_en.body: They add visualizations with **Swift Charts**, stressing that chart look, animation, and color are subjective preferences that keep changing, so staying in the loop for every change matters. The demo generates previews of multiple chart types with artificial data (picking volume over time), then uses a **Freeform** sketch on iPad to convey the design, which the agent turns into a matching line chart. Finally, **inline annotations** are placed directly in the source to add a fade-in animation and adjust the trend-line color to match the app's theme.

deepdive_en.title: Orchestrate
deepdive_en.body: This section demonstrates **orchestration** with two parallel conversations: one to translate every user-facing string into Filipino and configure the strings catalog, another to add VoiceOver labels and accessibility identifiers to all interactive elements. You describe a high-level goal and Xcode automatically discovers the right tools (such as machine translation); the main conversation breaks the work into pieces and deploys **sub-agents** that each call the needed capabilities in parallel. Enabling VoiceOver confirms every primary element is labeled and navigable.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: They recap the capabilities used: exploring code and APIs with Xcode Tools and Apple Document Search, planning architecture with plan mode, validating with build/preview/test, refining with images and inline annotations, and orchestrating localization and accessibility with parallel sub-agents. The call to action is to download **Xcode 27** and try agents on your own project, and to check out the "Create UI Prototypes using Agents in Xcode" and "Translate your app with agents in Xcode" sessions.

title: Get the most out of Device Hub
gloss: 充分發揮 Device Hub 的效益
takeaway: Device Hub 能集中控制、組織與設定你的測試裝置，加速開發流程並協助重現難解的 bug。

points.text: **Device Hub** 提供集中介面來控制、組織與設定多台開發測試裝置。
可在 Device Hub 中**控制**裝置狀態，並依需求加以**組織與分類**，方便團隊管理。
示範如何運用 Device Hub 一步步**重現 bug**，縮短除錯時間。
搭配命令列工具 **devicectl** 可自動化裝置相關操作，融入既有開發工作流程。

audience: 適合**需要管理多台測試裝置、想加速除錯與開發流程的 iOS／Apple 平台開發者**。
gloss_en: Get the most out of Device Hub
takeaway_en: Device Hub centralizes control, organization, and configuration of your test devices, accelerating development and helping reproduce hard-to-crack bugs.

points_en.text: **Device Hub** provides a centralized interface to control, organize, and configure multiple development and test devices.
In Device Hub you can **control** device state and **organize and categorize** devices as needed, making team management easier.
Demonstrates how to use Device Hub to **reproduce bugs** step by step, cutting down debugging time.
Pair it with the **devicectl** command-line tool to automate device-related operations and fit them into your existing development workflow.

audience_en: For **iOS/Apple platform developers who need to manage multiple test devices and want to speed up debugging and development**.
summary: **Device Hub** 是隨 **Xcode 27** 一同推出的全新 app，是你處理實機與 simulator 的統一入口。由 Devices 團隊的 Matt 與 Hassan 主講，重點在於它不需開啟 Xcode 也能使用，且對裝置與 simulator 提供一致的工具。在 Xcode 中 build and run 到 simulator 時，Device Hub 會自動啟動並以 **compact mode** 呈現精簡視窗：只有螢幕與少數依裝置而變的情境式控制（如 Apple TV 的播放/導覽、Vision Pro 的環境/相機、Apple Watch 的側邊鍵與 Digital Crown），需要更多功能時可展開為 full window。

full window 的功能分為三大領域。**Control**：中央 canvas 提供螢幕的即時顯示與直接互動（點擊、拖曳、捲動、trackpad 手勢），並有放大縮小、snap 到 1:1 實體尺寸、resize mode、以及把 Mac 鍵盤輸入直送裝置的 **capture keyboard**。**Organize**：sidebar 列出所有裝置與 simulator 的完整 inventory，可用 filter 篩選、排序、分組，context-click 做快速動作（如配對 iPhone 與 Apple Watch simulator），並用 tabs 或多個 compact window 同時比對多種螢幕尺寸。**Configure**：右側 inspector 有五個面板，可即時調整外觀（dark mode、文字大小）、模擬條件（如地點變更）、音訊，並查看 diagnostic reports（crash、spin），以及 Info、Apps、Profiles 等管理面板。

session 後段以真實情境串起所有功能：Hassan 在實機上發現「橫向模式下海拔復原建議文字被截斷」的 bug，他先無線 **pair** Apple Watch、安裝 CoreLocation logging 的 configuration profile（並重開機以符合隱私），重現 bug 後截圖、啟動 **sysdiagnose** 收集系統層診斷、複製被截斷的字串，並下載 app data container 一併交給 Matt。Matt 則在對應的 iPhone 17e simulator 上重現：替換成 Hassan 的 data container、依截圖鏡像設定（橫向、Johannesburg 高海拔位置、最大文字大小），三者同時成立才重現出截斷，凸顯 Device Hub 讓比對與重現變得直接。

最後提到自動化可改用 **devicectl** 命令列工具，與 Device Hub 基於相同底層技術，適合在測試環境與 CI 中列出裝置、安裝 app、切換深淺色等，並支援 json-output 以利整合腳本。延伸可參考「Modernize your UIKit app」（resizability）與 WWDC 2019 的「Getting the Most Out of Simulator」。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Devices 團隊的 **Matt** 開場（稍後 Hassan 加入），點出讓 app 在每種裝置、外觀、文字大小下都好看是件繁瑣的事。本場將介紹隨 Xcode 27 推出的 **Device Hub**，並依「介紹、功能走查（organize/control/configure）、實際工作流程示範」的順序展開。

deepdive.title: Device Hub overview
deepdive.body: **Device Hub** 是處理裝置與 simulator 的統一入口，隨 Xcode 27 出貨但不需開啟 Xcode 即可使用。在 Xcode build and run 到 simulator 時會自動啟動，並以 **compact mode** 呈現：精簡視窗只有螢幕與少數情境式控制（home、截圖、旋轉），且會依裝置改變（Apple TV、Vision Pro、Apple Watch 各不同）。點上方 expand 可切到功能更完整的 full window。

deepdive.title: Control
deepdive.body: 由 Hassan 介紹中央 **canvas**：提供螢幕的即時顯示，可直接點擊、拖曳、捲動或用 trackpad 手勢操作，實機與 simulator 體驗一致（示範以 Mac 操控連線的 Apple Watch）。canvas 上方有 compact 沒有的控制：縮放、snap 到 **1:1 實體尺寸**、自由變形的 resize mode（細節見「Modernize your UIKit app」）、以及把 Mac 鍵盤直送裝置以測試 key commands 的 **capture keyboard**。

deepdive.title: Organize
deepdive.body: Matt 介紹 **sidebar**：集中顯示所有裝置與 simulator 的完整 inventory，頂端 filter 可切換可見項目、排序與分組，context-click 提供快速動作（如重啟、配對 iPhone 與 Apple Watch simulator）。為了快速比對，可用 tabs 或多個獨立 compact window 同時檢視多台裝置，例如選取數種 iPhone 尺寸後雙擊，逐一開出 compact window 對照 app 表現。

deepdive.title: Configure
deepdive.body: 右側 **inspector** 提供五個面板做深度設定。device settings 含外觀（dark mode、文字大小，變更即時生效）、條件模擬（如地點變更）、音訊。diagnostic reports 收錄 crash、spin 等裝置記錄，是調查 hang 或 crash 的起點。第三個 tab 含 Info（儲存、型號、序號）、Apps（安裝/移除、下載與替換 data container）、Profiles（管理 configuration 與 provisioning profiles）。

deepdive.title: Reproducing a bug
deepdive.body: Hassan 走查實際工作流程：在 workout app 中發現「橫向模式下，依目前海拔顯示的復原建議文字被截斷」。他聚焦三件事：**pair** 裝置（示範無線配對 Apple Watch）、確保足夠的 log（安裝 CoreLocation logging 的 configuration profile 並重開機）、以及收集診斷（重現 bug 後截圖、啟動 **sysdiagnose**、複製被截斷字串，並下載 app data container 交給 Matt）。

deepdive.title: devicectl
deepdive.body: 針對腳本與自動化，介紹命令列工具 **devicectl**，與 Device Hub 基於相同底層技術。適合在測試環境管理裝置與 app、擷取診斷，例如列出裝置、安裝 app、切換深淺色或查詢裝置資訊，並可用 **json-output** 取得結構化輸出以整合進腳本或 CI 流程。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結 Device Hub 對實機與 simulator 提供一致體驗，從即時螢幕、硬體控制到 app 管理、外觀設定與診斷收集一應俱全。行動建議是下載 **Xcode 27** 試用 Device Hub、自動化情境改用 devicectl，並參考「Modernize your UIKit app」(resizability) 與 WWDC 2019「Getting the Most Out of Simulator」。

summary_en: **Device Hub** is a new app shipping alongside **Xcode 27** that serves as your home for working with both devices and simulators. Presented by Matt and Hassan of the Devices team, the key point is that you don't need to launch Xcode to use it, and it offers a consistent set of tools across devices and simulators. When you build and run to a simulator in Xcode, Device Hub launches automatically in **compact mode**, a focused window with just the screen and a few contextual controls that change per device (play/navigation on Apple TV, environment/camera on Vision Pro, side button and Digital Crown on Apple Watch); click expand to reach the full window.

The full window's features fall into three areas. **Control**: the central canvas gives a live, interactive view of the screen (click, drag, scroll, trackpad gestures), plus zoom, snap to 1:1 physical size, resize mode, and **capture keyboard** to route Mac keystrokes to the device. **Organize**: the sidebar shows your full inventory of devices and simulators, with filtering, sorting, grouping, context-click quick actions (like pairing an iPhone and Apple Watch simulator), and the ability to open tabs or multiple compact windows to compare screen sizes at once. **Configure**: the right-side inspector has five panels to adjust appearance (dark mode, text size) instantly, simulate conditions like location, manage audio, view diagnostic reports (crashes, spins), and manage Info, Apps, and Profiles.

The session ties it together with a real scenario: Hassan finds a bug where altitude-based recovery advice text gets cut off in landscape. He wirelessly **pairs** an Apple Watch, installs a CoreLocation logging configuration profile (rebooting for privacy), reproduces the bug, takes a screenshot, kicks off a **sysdiagnose** for system-level diagnostics, copies the clipped string, and downloads the app's data container to hand to Matt. Matt reproduces it on a matching iPhone 17e simulator by replacing his data container with Hassan's and mirroring the config from the screenshot (landscape, Johannesburg's high elevation, maximum text size); only with all three together does the truncation appear, showing how directly Device Hub supports comparison and reproduction.

Finally, for scripting and automation it points to **devicectl**, a command-line tool built on the same underlying technology, ideal in test environments and CI for listing devices, installing apps, and switching dark/light modes, with json-output for easy script integration. Related sessions include "Modernize your UIKit app" (resizability) and WWDC 2019's "Getting the Most Out of Simulator."

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: **Matt** from the Devices team opens (Hassan joins later), noting how much work it is to make an app look great on every device, appearance, and text size. The session introduces **Device Hub**, shipping with Xcode 27, and follows a plan of introduction, a feature walkthrough (organize/control/configure), and a real workflow demo.

deepdive_en.title: Device Hub overview
deepdive_en.body: **Device Hub** is your home for working with devices and simulators; it ships with Xcode 27 but doesn't require launching Xcode. It launches automatically when you build and run to a simulator, appearing in **compact mode**, a lightweight window with just the screen and a few contextual controls (home, screenshots, rotation) that change per device (different on Apple TV, Vision Pro, Apple Watch). Clicking expand transitions to the more capable full window.

deepdive_en.title: Control
deepdive_en.body: Hassan covers the central **canvas**: a live display of the screen you can interact with directly via click, drag, scroll, or trackpad gestures, working the same for a device or simulator (demoed controlling a connected Apple Watch from the Mac). Above the canvas are controls not in compact mode: zoom, snap to **1:1 physical size**, a freely transforming resize mode (detailed in "Modernize your UIKit app"), and **capture keyboard** to route Mac keystrokes straight to the device for testing key commands.

deepdive_en.title: Organize
deepdive_en.body: Matt introduces the **sidebar**, which shows your full inventory of every device and simulator in one place, with a top filter menu to change visibility, sort, and group, and context-click quick actions (restarting, pairing an iPhone and Apple Watch simulator). For quick access and comparison, you can view many devices at once with tabs or standalone compact windows, for example selecting several iPhone sizes and double-clicking to get a compact window for each.

deepdive_en.title: Configure
deepdive_en.body: The right-side **inspector** offers five panels for deep configuration. Device settings include appearance (dark mode, text size, applied instantly), condition simulation (like a location change), and audio. Diagnostic reports collect crashes, spins, and other logs and are where you start investigating hangs or crashes. A third tab holds Info (storage, model, serial), Apps (install/uninstall, download and replace data containers), and Profiles (configuration and provisioning profiles).

deepdive_en.title: Reproducing a bug
deepdive_en.body: Hassan walks through a real workflow: in the workout app, altitude-based recovery advice text gets cut off in landscape. He focuses on three things: **pairing** devices (demoing wireless pairing of an Apple Watch), ensuring enough logs (installing a CoreLocation logging configuration profile and rebooting), and capturing diagnostics (reproducing the bug, taking a screenshot, starting a **sysdiagnose**, copying the clipped string, and downloading the app data container to send to Matt).

deepdive_en.title: devicectl
deepdive_en.body: For scripts and automation, the session introduces the command-line tool **devicectl**, built on the same underlying technology as Device Hub. It's great for managing devices and apps and capturing diagnostics in a test environment, for example listing devices, installing an app, switching between dark and light modes, or getting device info, with a **json-output** option for structured output to integrate into scripts or CI workflows.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: The session concludes that Device Hub gives a consistent experience across simulators and devices, from live screens and hardware controls to app management, appearance settings, and diagnostics collection. The call to action is to download **Xcode 27** and try Device Hub, use devicectl for scripts and CI, and see "Modernize your UIKit app" (resizability) and WWDC 2019's "Getting the Most Out of Simulator."

title: Build, deliver, and automate with Xcode Cloud
gloss: 用 Xcode Cloud 建置、交付與自動化
takeaway: 認識 Xcode Cloud 的最新更新，快速上手建置與交付，並用 webhooks 與額外儲存庫把 CI／CD 流程自動化。

points.text: 介紹 **Xcode Cloud** 的最新更新，協助你快速開始建置與交付 App。
從**核心概念與快速上手**講起，建立 CI／CD 的基礎認識。
說明**交付（Distribution）**流程，把建置成果送到測試與發佈管道。
用 **webhooks** 串接外部系統，將流程自動化。
支援**額外儲存庫（additional repositories）**，因應多 repo 的專案結構。

audience: **想導入或優化 CI／CD 的 iOS／macOS 開發者與團隊**，希望自動化建置與交付的人。
gloss_en: Build, deliver, and automate with Xcode Cloud
takeaway_en: Get to know the latest Xcode Cloud updates, get started quickly with building and delivery, and automate your CI/CD pipeline with webhooks and additional repositories.

points_en.text: Introduces the latest **Xcode Cloud** updates to help you quickly start building and delivering your apps.
Starts from **core concepts and getting started** to build a foundational understanding of CI/CD.
Explains the **distribution** flow that delivers your build output to testing and release channels.
Use **webhooks** to integrate with external systems and automate your pipeline.
Supports **additional repositories** to accommodate multi-repo project structures.

audience_en: **iOS/macOS developers and teams looking to adopt or optimize CI/CD** who want to automate building and delivery.
summary: **Xcode Cloud** 是內建於 Xcode、專為 Apple 開發者打造的持續整合與交付服務：在雲端建置與測試你的 app，並提供順暢的流程把成果送上 **TestFlight** 或 App Store。今年聚焦打磨基本功，從建置、測試到 distribution 每一環都有有感的改進。在 agent 進駐 Xcode、開發者寫程式比以往更快的當下，講者把 Xcode Cloud 定位為「品質的夥伴」——相較本機開發，它能在雲端跨多裝置與 OS 版本平行建置測試，及早在 bug 與效能問題抵達使用者前攔截。

上手非常簡單：在 Report navigator 的 **Cloud** 分頁選 Get Started，沿著 Onboarding assistant 連接原始碼 repository，Xcode Cloud 就會建立 product 與預設 workflow 並啟動第一次 build。第二個（macOS）app 因共用同一個 workspace 與 style framework，用 Create Workflow 即可加入、且不需再次連接 repository。講者特別強調安全性：build 跑在**短暫的 VM** 上，原始碼只在 build 開始時抓取、結束即丟棄，Apple 不會儲存也無從存取。

**Distribution** 同樣簡化：在 Cloud navigator 對 app 選 Set Up Distribution，填入 app 名稱、Bundle ID 與 SKU（被占用會即時提示並可當場修改），背景就會建立 App Store Connect 的 app record、註冊 Bundle ID 與 SKU，並產生一個 internal TestFlight 的 distribution workflow。另一條路是在 Manage Workflows 中新增 workflow 並加入 distribution 必備的 **archive action**，系統會引導完成 onboarding。

最後是把工作流程推向進階的兩項能力。**Webhooks** 讓 Xcode Cloud 在 build 的各階段（created／started／completed）自動把含 build 資訊的 payload 送到你指定的端點，適合驅動自製 dashboard 等自動化，且每次投遞都有成功與否的紀錄。**Additional repositories** 讓你在主 repository 之外加入更多 repo（如被拆分出去獨立成 repo 的 style framework），用 Manage Repositories 貼上 Git remote URL 即可，因先前已授權故不需再次授權，確保 build 取得正確的相依。延伸推薦「Create practical workflows in Xcode Cloud」「Extend your Xcode Cloud workflows」與「Simplify distribution in Xcode and Xcode Cloud」。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Xcode Cloud 團隊工程師 Tony 開場，定義 **Xcode Cloud** 是內建於 Xcode、專為 Apple 開發者打造的 CI/CD 服務：在雲端建置測試 app，並順暢地把成果送上 TestFlight 或 App Store。今年聚焦打磨基本功，從建置、測試到 distribution 對新手與老用戶都有有感改進。

deepdive.title: Essential concepts
deepdive.body: 鋪陳基本概念：隨 agent 進駐 Xcode，開發者寫程式、迭代功能的速度前所未有，如何在規模化的同時及早攔截 bug 與效能問題成為課題。Xcode Cloud 是「品質的夥伴」——相較本機，它在雲端跨多裝置與 OS 版本平行建置測試，並讓 distribution 到 TestFlight 與 App Store 變得簡單。

deepdive.title: Getting started
deepdive.body: 以講者自製的辦公室咖啡訂單 iOS app 為例上手：在 Report navigator 選 **Cloud** 分頁、Get Started，看到 workspace 中的 product，Developer Team 已自動對應簽章設定，按 Next 後由 Onboarding assistant 載入並連接 repository（步驟依原始碼供應商而異），完成後即建立 product 與預設 workflow 並啟動第一次 build。強調安全性：build 跑在**短暫 VM**，原始碼只在 build 開始時抓取、結束即丟棄，Apple 不儲存也無從存取。接著示範把同一 workspace 內、共用 style framework 的 macOS app 用 Create Workflow 加入，且無需再次連接 repository。

deepdive.title: Distribution
deepdive.body: 示範 distribution 的兩種設定法。其一：在 Cloud navigator 對 iOS app 選 Set Up Distribution，填入 app 名稱、Bundle ID 與 SKU（被占用會即時提示、可當場修改），背景自動建立 App Store Connect 的 app record、驗證並註冊 Bundle ID 與 SKU，產生一個 internal TestFlight 的 distribution workflow。其二：對 macOS app 用 Manage Workflows 新建 workflow，加入 distribution 必備的 **archive action** 時系統會提供 Set Up 引導，依相同流程完成 onboarding。

deepdive.title: Webhooks
deepdive.body: **Webhooks** 是打造進階自動化的利器：設定後，Xcode Cloud 會在 build 的各階段（created、started、completed）自動把含 build 資訊的 payload 送到你選的服務端點。示範對 iOS app 用 Manage Webhooks 新增名為「Dashboard」的 webhook、填入可公開解析的 Payload URL，跑一次 build 後即可在 Webhooks 視圖看到對應 lifecycle 的三筆事件，綠色代表投遞成功，適合餵自製 dashboard。

deepdive.title: Additional repositories
deepdive.body: 隨 app 成長，常見作法是把共用功能拆成獨立 repository 以維持模組化。講者把 style framework 拆成獨立 repo 後，需讓 Xcode Cloud 同步：對 iOS app 用 Manage Repositories，主 repository 已在最上方、Additional 區為空，按 Add 貼上 style framework 的 Git remote URL 即可（因先前已授權故不需再次授權），讓 build 取得正確相依。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾：重溫 Xcode Cloud 概念，先把 app onboard 到建置、測試與 distribution，再用 webhooks 與 additional repositories 自動化、規模化你的專案。延伸推薦「Extend your Xcode Cloud workflows」與「Simplify distribution in Xcode and Xcode Cloud」——Xcode Cloud 讓你更有信心、更快、更安心地以品質出貨。

summary_en: **Xcode Cloud** is a continuous integration and delivery service built into Xcode and designed for Apple developers: it builds and tests your app in the cloud and offers a seamless path to **TestFlight** or the App Store. This year focuses on polishing the fundamentals, with meaningful refinements across building, testing, and distribution. With agents arriving in Xcode and developers writing code faster than ever, the speaker positions Xcode Cloud as your 'companion for quality'—unlike local development, it builds and tests in parallel across multiple devices and OS versions, catching bugs and performance issues before they reach users.

Getting started is simple: in the Report navigator's **Cloud** tab, choose Get Started, follow the Onboarding assistant to connect your source repository, and Xcode Cloud creates a product and default workflow and kicks off the first build. A second (macOS) app sharing the same workspace and style framework is added via Create Workflow with no need to reconnect the repository. The speaker stresses security: builds run on **ephemeral VMs**, source code is fetched only when a build starts and discarded when done, and Apple never stores it or has any way to access it.

**Distribution** is equally streamlined: in the Cloud navigator, choose Set Up Distribution on an app, provide the app name, Bundle ID, and SKU (with live conflict prompts you can edit on the spot), and the system creates the App Store Connect app record, registers the Bundle ID and SKU, and produces an internal TestFlight distribution workflow. An alternative path is creating a new workflow in Manage Workflows and adding the **archive action** required for distribution, with the system guiding the onboarding.

Finally, two capabilities take workflows further. **Webhooks** have Xcode Cloud automatically send a payload with build info to an endpoint of your choice at each build stage (created/started/completed), great for driving custom dashboards and automations, with delivery history showing success per event. **Additional repositories** let you add repos beyond the primary one (like a style framework split into its own repo) via Manage Repositories by pasting a Git remote URL—no re-authorization needed since access was already granted—so builds get exactly the right dependencies. Related sessions: 'Create practical workflows in Xcode Cloud', 'Extend your Xcode Cloud workflows', and 'Simplify distribution in Xcode and Xcode Cloud'.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Xcode Cloud engineer Tony opens, defining **Xcode Cloud** as a CI/CD service built into Xcode for Apple developers: it builds and tests your app in the cloud and seamlessly delivers to TestFlight or the App Store. This year focuses on polishing the fundamentals, with meaningful refinements for newcomers and longtime users alike across building, testing, and distribution.

deepdive_en.title: Essential concepts
deepdive_en.body: Frames the basics: with agents arriving in Xcode, developers iterate faster than ever, raising the challenge of scaling while catching bugs and performance issues early. Xcode Cloud is your 'companion for quality'—compared to local development, it builds and tests in parallel across many devices and OS versions in the cloud and makes distribution to TestFlight and the App Store simple.

deepdive_en.title: Getting started
deepdive_en.body: Onboards the speaker's office coffee-order iOS app: in the Report navigator's **Cloud** tab, Get Started shows the workspace product with the Developer Team already matching signing settings; after Next, the Onboarding assistant loads and connects the repository (steps vary by provider), creating a product and default workflow and starting the first build. Stresses security: builds run on **ephemeral VMs**, source is fetched only when a build starts and discarded afterward, with Apple never storing or accessing it. Then adds a macOS app in the same workspace (sharing a style framework) via Create Workflow without reconnecting the repository.

deepdive_en.title: Distribution
deepdive_en.body: Shows two ways to set up distribution. First: in the Cloud navigator, Set Up Distribution on the iOS app, providing app name, Bundle ID, and SKU (with live conflict prompts you can edit in place), and the system creates the App Store Connect app record, verifies and registers the Bundle ID and SKU, and produces an internal TestFlight distribution workflow. Second: for the macOS app, use Manage Workflows to create a new workflow, and when adding the **archive action** required for distribution the system offers a Set Up flow that completes onboarding the same way.

deepdive_en.title: Webhooks
deepdive_en.body: **Webhooks** power advanced automation: once configured, Xcode Cloud automatically sends a payload with build info to your chosen endpoint at each stage (created, started, completed). The demo adds a webhook named 'Dashboard' on the iOS app with a publicly resolvable Payload URL; after a build, the Webhooks view shows three events for the build lifecycle, with green indicating successful deliveries—ideal for feeding a custom dashboard.

deepdive_en.title: Additional repositories
deepdive_en.body: As an app grows, splitting shared functionality into separate repositories keeps the codebase modular. After splitting the style framework into its own repo, the speaker keeps Xcode Cloud in sync: on the iOS app, Manage Repositories shows the primary repository at the top with an empty Additional section, and Add lets you paste the framework's Git remote URL (no re-authorization needed) so builds get the right dependencies.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wrap-up: revisit Xcode Cloud concepts, onboard your app to build, test, and distribute, then take it further with webhooks and additional repositories to automate and scale. It recommends 'Extend your Xcode Cloud workflows' and 'Simplify distribution in Xcode and Xcode Cloud'—Xcode Cloud builds your confidence to ship with quality, faster and worry-free.

title: What's new in Swift
gloss: Swift 有什麼新東西
takeaway: 語言層大豐收——日常 ergonomics(anyAppleOS、@diagnose、module selector ::)、並行與記憶體安全、@specialized / @inline 等效能控制,跨平台(C / Java / Wasm / Embedded)也大推進。
chapters: Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (catching in the task)
Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (saving the task for later)
Clarifying code with module selectors (module selectors work on members, too)
XCTest interoperability: Using XCTest from Swift Testing
XCTest interoperability: Using Swift Testing from XCTest
Directly control inlining (inlined, but not optimized)
Making generic functions faster with '@specialized'​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ (explicitly requesting specialization)
New Standard Library Types: UniqueBox, UniqueArray, Ref
Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (with un-hoisted access)
Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'inout' parameter)
Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'MutableRef')

points.text: 日常語法:**@available(anyAppleOS 27, *)** 一行取代列舉所有 OS;**@diagnose** 精準控制個別警告(ignored / warning / error);**module selector Module::Symbol** 解決跨模組同名衝突;memberwise init 會依存取層級產生多個版本。
並行:更好的診斷與 Sendable 推斷(**~Sendable、@unchecked Sendable**);**withTaskCancellationShield** 保護不可中斷的關鍵區段。
標準庫:新 **FilePath** 型別、**Dictionary.mapKeyedValues**、init(uniqueKeysWithValues:)。
Swift Testing 同步更新:**Issue severity(.warning)**、Test.cancel、**雙向 XCTest 互通**(呼應 267)。

效能與記憶體:**@inline(always/never)、@specialized(where:)** 直接控制最佳化;**InlineArray** 與 [256 of Int] 固定大小陣列;ownership 強化——~Copyable / ~Escapable、**borrow / mutate accessor**、新型別 UniqueBox / UniqueArray / Ref。
跨平台:**@C** 強化 Swift-C 互通、Swift-Java、**WebAssembly + JavaScriptKit**、Embedded Swift;另有 Subprocess 1.0(串流輸出)與 Foundation 的 ProgressManager / Subprogress。

audience: **所有 Swift 開發者;尤其關心 concurrency 安全、效能調校的人。** 32 分鐘塞了 20+ 主題,屬於「先看一句話總結、再用章節軸跳到在意段落」的典型大場。
gloss_en: What's new in Swift
takeaway_en: A big haul at the language level—everyday ergonomics (anyAppleOS, @diagnose, the :: module selector), concurrency and memory safety, performance controls like @specialized / @inline, plus major cross-platform progress (C / Java / Wasm / Embedded).

points_en.text: Everyday syntax: **@available(anyAppleOS 27, *)** replaces enumerating every OS in one line; **@diagnose** precisely controls individual warnings (ignored / warning / error); the **module selector Module::Symbol** resolves same-name conflicts across modules; memberwise init generates multiple versions based on access level.
Concurrency: better diagnostics and Sendable inference (**~Sendable, @unchecked Sendable**); **withTaskCancellationShield** protects critical sections that must not be interrupted.
Standard library: the new **FilePath** type, **Dictionary.mapKeyedValues**, and init(uniqueKeysWithValues:).
Swift Testing updates in step: **Issue severity(.warning)**, Test.cancel, and **bidirectional XCTest interop** (echoing 267).

Performance and memory: **@inline(always/never), @specialized(where:)** directly control optimization; **InlineArray** and [256 of Int] fixed-size arrays; stronger ownership—~Copyable / ~Escapable, the **borrow / mutate accessor**, and new types UniqueBox / UniqueArray / Ref.
Cross-platform: **@C** strengthens Swift-C interop, Swift-Java, **WebAssembly + JavaScriptKit**, Embedded Swift; plus Subprocess 1.0 (streaming output) and Foundation's ProgressManager / Subprogress.

audience_en: **All Swift developers; especially those who care about concurrency safety and performance tuning.** With 20+ topics packed into 32 minutes, this is a classic large session—read the one-sentence summary first, then jump to the sections you care about via the chapter track.
summary: Swift 團隊的 Becca 與 Evan 回顧 **Swift 6.3 與 6.4** 開發期間的進展，分四大塊：日常語言改善、重要函式庫更新、跨平台與互通性，以及效能調校。日常改善多半是「惱人小事消失」：optional 用 `some`／`any` 不必再加括號、忽略 Task 拋出的錯誤會警告、defer 內可呼叫 async、weak 屬性可用 `weak let` 而不必 `@unchecked Sendable`、可用 `~Sendable` 明確宣告不可傳遞，以及 internal/private 混用的 struct 會多一個 memberwise initializer。

幾個明顯的新語法：**`anyAppleOS`** 讓你把多個平台名稱濃縮成一個 availability 與 `#if os` 條件；**`@diagnose`** 屬性可在單一宣告內把特定警告群組改成 ignored、warning 或 error（例如暫時關掉 deprecation、開啟 strict memory safety、把未來才會報錯的東西提前當 error）；**module selector（`::`）** 用雙冒號明確指定模組名稱，解決兩個模組同名型別或成員的衝突（如 SwiftUI 與資料庫套件都有 `View`）。

函式庫方面：標準庫新增 **task cancellation shield**、`mapKeyedValues`（同時拿到 key 與 value）、以及新的 **`FilePath`** 型別；**Swift Testing** 加入 issue severity（`.warning`）、`Test.cancel` 動態跳過、與 XCTest 雙向互通；**Subprocess 1.0** 提供更簡潔的 API 與以 AsyncBufferSequence 串流輸出；**Foundation** 推出與 async/await 契合的 **ProgressManager**，並持續把 Data、NSURL/CFURL 等以 Swift 重寫。跨平台部分包含 **`@C`** 屬性把 Swift 函式暴露給 C、Swift-Java 支援 async/throwing、官方 Android SDK、VSCode/OpenVSX 編輯器支援、WebAssembly 與 JavaScriptKit（Goodnotes 案例顯示安全橋接快 35–40 倍），以及 Embedded Swift 新增 existential 與 untyped throws。

效能調校聚焦兩塊：直接控制 optimizer 決策——新增 **`@inline(always)`**（搭配 `final`）與 **`@specialized`** where 子句強制特化；以及大幅擴充 **ownership 系統**——`~Copyable`／`~Escapable` 可用於 associated type、新的 **Iterable** 協定讓 for loop 用 borrow 取代複製、**`borrow`／`mutate` accessor** 取代 get/set 以避免大型值複製，並推出 **UniqueBox、UniqueArray、Ref/MutableRef** 等新標準庫型別。最後 Evan 介紹 Swift Build 成為 SwiftPM 預設後端、新增工作組，以及如何在 forums.swift.org 參與貢獻。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Becca 與 Evan 開場，預告本場涵蓋 **Swift 6.3 與 6.4** 的語言改善、函式庫更新、跨平台支援，以及效能調校四大主題，並說明兩人輪流主講的安排。

deepdive.title: Everyday Language Improvements
deepdive.body: 概覽一連串日常小改善的開端，目標是讓你「表達確切意圖、不帶多餘雜訊」。先從幾乎察覺不到、像是惱人小事消失的細節談起，例如 optional 搭配 `some`／`any` 不再需要括號。

deepdive.title: Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (catching in the task)
deepdive.body: 現在若你**默默忽略** Swift Concurrency task 拋出的錯誤，編譯器會給警告，提醒你在 task 內處理錯誤。對應的解法之一是在 task 的 `do/catch` 內妥善處理。

deepdive.title: Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (saving the task for later)
deepdive.body: 另一個解法是把 task 存下來稍後檢查其錯誤；同時舊有「不能在 defer block 內呼叫 async 函式」的限制也已移除。

deepdive.title: Better 'Sendable' conformances
deepdive.body: 需要 `@unchecked Sendable` 的 class（因為有 `weak var`）現在可把屬性改成 **`weak let`** 使其不可變，便能正常通過 Sendable 檢查；若型別不該是 Sendable，可用新的 **`~Sendable`** 語法明確宣告，且不會阻止子類別變成 Sendable。

deepdive.title: More accessible memberwise initializers
deepdive.body: 混用 internal 與 private 屬性的 struct，現在會額外產生一個可從專案其他檔案使用的 memberwise initializer。

deepdive.title: anyAppleOS Availability
deepdive.body: introduces **`anyAppleOS`**：隨著 Apple OS 版本號對齊，可把多個平台名稱濃縮成單一 availability 標註，減少冗長的平台清單。

deepdive.title: 'anyAppleOS' availability (before)
deepdive.body: 示範改用前的寫法：每個函式都要逐一列出 macOS/iOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS 版本，並用 `#if os(...)` 條件編譯，相當冗長。

deepdive.title: 'anyAppleOS' availability (after)
deepdive.body: 示範改用後：以 `@available(anyAppleOS 27, *)` 一次涵蓋所有平台，再對例外（如 tvOS unavailable）加上更具體的標註；`#if os(anyAppleOS)` 亦同。

deepdive.title: Controlling warnings with '@diagnose'
deepdive.body: introduces **`@diagnose`** 屬性，可在單一宣告內改變特定警告群組的行為，無需影響整個專案。

deepdive.title: @diagnose Attribute
deepdive.body: 示範 `@diagnose` 的三種用法：把 DeprecatedDeclaration 設為 ignored 以暫時關掉警告、把 StrictMemorySafety 設為 warning 以稽核 unsafe API、把 ErrorInFutureSwiftVersion 設為 error 以提前攔截未來會報錯的程式碼。

deepdive.title: Clarifying code with module selectors
deepdive.body: 說明兩個模組有同名 API 的問題：例如 Rocket 與 GiftShopToys 都有 `SaturnV` 型別，匯入兩者會造成歧義錯誤。

deepdive.title: Module Selectors (::)
deepdive.body: introduces **module selector `::`**：`Rocket::SaturnV` 中冒號左側一律當作模組名稱，可正確解析；相較 `Rocket.SaturnV` 在模組與型別同名時會誤判。

deepdive.title: Clarifying code with module selectors (module selectors work on members, too)
deepdive.body: module selector 也可用在方法或屬性名稱上，例如 `launchPadTechnician.HumanResources::fire()`，用來區分來自不同模組 extension 的同名成員。建議用於防禦性場景（如 macro 展開），但不鼓勵刻意設計同名 API 再依賴它。

deepdive.title: Library Updates
deepdive.body: Evan 接手，說明函式庫更新延續同一目標：幫你表達確切意圖。涵蓋標準庫、Swift Testing、Subprocess 與 Foundation。

deepdive.title: Standard Library
deepdive.body: 概覽標準庫三大新工具：task cancellation、dictionary 轉換、與 filepath 操作。

deepdive.title: Task cancellation
deepdive.body: 說明有時即使 task 被取消，仍想完成工作（如把資料寫完以免檔案損毀），引出 task cancellation shield。

deepdive.title: Task cancellation shield
deepdive.body: introduces **`withTaskCancellationShield`**：在 shield 區塊內，取消狀態檢查一律回傳 false。建議讓此區域保持簡短，專注於完成或回滾已開始的工作。

deepdive.title: Constructing a new dictionary
deepdive.body: 說明 `mapValues` 只把舊 value 傳入閉包，若計算新值需要 key，就得手動重建字典的痛點。

deepdive.title: Dictionary.mapKeyedValues
deepdive.body: introduces **`mapKeyedValues`**：同時把 key 與舊 value 傳入閉包來計算新值，省去手動重建字典。

deepdive.title: The new FilePath type
deepdive.body: introduces 標準庫新的 **`FilePath`** 型別（源自 Swift System），處理不同平台對 filepath 表示的細微差異，例如以 `components` 安全增刪路徑分段。

deepdive.title: Swift Testing Updates
deepdive.body: 概覽 Swift 6.4 的 Testing 更新，讓你更能控制測試行為：surface 非致命問題與動態跳過 test case。

deepdive.title: Issue Severity
deepdive.body: 可為 `Issue.record` 設定 severity，設為 `.warning` 可呈現值得調查、但不應阻擋 CI 的問題。

deepdive.title: Test Cancellation
deepdive.body: introduces **`Test.cancel`** 可動態取消測試，尤其在 parameterized test 中可只取消不該跑的個別參數，而非整題失敗或全跑完。`swift test` 也新增重複執行直到通過或失敗的功能。

deepdive.title: XCTest interoperability: Using XCTest from Swift Testing
deepdive.body: Swift 6.4 起，從 Swift Testing 呼叫 XCTest assertion 失敗時會被回報為 test issue，讓你遷移時不會悄悄失去測試覆蓋。

deepdive.title: XCTest interoperability: Using Swift Testing from XCTest
deepdive.body: 反向亦然：`#expect` 等 Swift Testing API 可在 XCTestCase 中使用。這些互通問題預設以警告回報，可在 Xcode build setting 升級為失敗。詳見「Migrate to Swift Testing」。

deepdive.title: Subprocess 1.0
deepdive.body: introduces **Subprocess 1.0**：簡化的 execution 型別、改善的錯誤處理、便利的輸出串流 API，以及更完整的跨平台支援（平台專屬的 process file descriptor 與終止狀態）。

deepdive.title: Subprocess Output Stream
deepdive.body: 示範以 AsyncBufferSequence 取得 stdout/stderr，並用新的 `strings()` 方法逐行讀取輸出；該 API 尊重 grapheme cluster 邊界，不會切斷多位元組字元。

deepdive.title: Foundation
deepdive.body: 概覽 Foundation 改善，重點是新的 ProgressManager，以及持續以 Swift 重寫的進度。

deepdive.title: Progress Manager - Concurrency
deepdive.body: introduces **`ProgressManager`**：為 async/await 設計的進度回報型別，清楚分離進度組合與進度回報，並以結構化、型別安全的方式附加 metadata（如 deltaV）。

deepdive.title: Beyond Apple Platforms
deepdive.body: 說明 Swift 廣泛用於每一層軟體堆疊（OS、app、服務、kernel、firmware）。Swift 6.4 擴充語言互通、改善跨平台 IDE 支援，並讓帶 Swift 到 web 與 embedded 更安全。

deepdive.title: Swift–C Interoperability (@C attribute)
deepdive.body: introduces **`@C`** 屬性：類似 `@objc`，但把 Swift 函式暴露給 C，限於 C 相容型別。以 rocket launch window 範例示範用 `@C` 與 `@implementation` 實作既有 C header 的函式，並用 span 取代 array+count 取得安全互通。

deepdive.title: Swift-Java
deepdive.body: **Swift-Java** 現支援從 Java 呼叫 async 與 throwing 的 Swift 函式、捕捉更多泛型特性，讓在 Android 上呼叫 Swift 更自然；swift.org 也提供官方 Android Swift SDK。

deepdive.title: Editor support
deepdive.body: VSCode 的 Swift 擴充整合 **Swiftly** 方便安裝 toolchain，並上架 **OpenVSX**，讓 VSCodium、Cursor、Kiro、Antigravity 等編輯器都能用；新版還有引導式 checklist。

deepdive.title: WebAssembly (Wasm) & JavascriptKit
deepdive.body: 開源 toolchain 可編譯到 **WebAssembly**，讓同一語言寫原生 app、後端與前端。JavaScriptKit 的安全橋接更快更安全；Goodnotes 把既有 Swift 程式以 Wasm 編譯上 web，benchmark 顯示安全橋接比動態橋接快 35–40 倍。

deepdive.title: Embedded Swift
deepdive.body: **Embedded Swift** 新增 existential 型別與 untyped throws；並把必要的 type layout metadata 存入 DWARF debug info 而非 binary，兼顧 binary 大小與 coredump 除錯體驗。`@diagnose` 可控制 EmbeddedRestrictions 警告。

deepdive.title: Performance Tuning
deepdive.body: Becca 回來談效能調校。Swift 預設就有好效能，但在大量運算或受限環境下，有時值得複雜化程式碼換取效能。聚焦兩塊：明確控制 optimizer 決策，以及擴充 ownership 系統避免不必要複製。

deepdive.title: Directly control inlining (source code)
deepdive.body: 以 histogram 與 makeInts 範例作為起點，說明 inlining 是把函式呼叫換成其實作再針對呼叫點最佳化的重要最佳化。

deepdive.title: Directly control inlining (inlined, but not optimized)
deepdive.body: 示範 inlining 後但尚未最佳化的中間狀態：makeInts 的內容被內聯進 histogram，但 if/else 仍保留。

deepdive.title: Directly control inlining (inlined and optimized)
deepdive.body: 示範 inlining 並最佳化後：常數傳遞使 `InlineArray(repeating: 0)` 被選定，整段化簡為一行，展示 inlining 成功時程式做更少工作得到相同結果。

deepdive.title: Optimizer Control: @inline(always) & @specialized
deepdive.body: 概覽兩個 optimizer 控制屬性。除既有 `@inline(never)` 外，Swift 6.4 新增 **`@inline(always)`** 強制內聯；對可能被覆寫的 class 方法，建議搭配 `final`。

deepdive.title: Directly control inlining (preventing inlining)
deepdive.body: 示範 `@inline(never)`：完全禁止內聯 makeInts，適用於你確定內聯永遠不划算時。

deepdive.title: Directly control inlining (forcing inlining)
deepdive.body: 示範 `@inline(always)`：即使 optimizer 不確定划算也強制內聯 makeInts。

deepdive.title: Making generic functions faster with '@specialized'​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
deepdive.body: 說明 specialization：為特定具體型別複製泛型函式以消除泛型開銷並開啟後續最佳化，但 optimizer 有時（尤其在函式庫）看不到使用方式。

deepdive.title: Making generic functions faster with '@specialized'​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ (explicitly requesting specialization)
deepdive.body: introduces **`@specialized`**：用 where 子句明確要求對某些具體型別產生特化版本，讓常與一兩種型別搭配使用的慢速泛型程式碼得到優先特化。

deepdive.title: Ownership System & Noncopyable Types
deepdive.body: 回顧 ownership 系統的核心：許多效能問題源於不必要的資料複製。若儲存會持續存在、且雙方遵守 exclusivity 規則，就可只授予存取而非複製。介紹 borrow（雙方僅可讀）與 mutate（獨占存取）兩種安全共享儲存的方式，皆可在編譯期驗證。

deepdive.title: Associated types can be '~Copyable' and '~Escapable'
deepdive.body: Equatable/Comparable/Hashable 現可用於 noncopyable 型別（Equatable/Comparable 也可用於 non-escapable）；associated type 也可宣告為 `~Copyable` 或 `~Escapable`，為高效能協定導向開發開啟新能力，如 Iterable 協定。

deepdive.title: Iterable Protocol & Borrow/Mutate Accessors
deepdive.body: introduces Swift 6.4 的 **Iterable** 協定：for loop 改以 **borrow** 取出元素而非複製，因此可用於 noncopyable 元素、避免 reference counting，並可在迴圈中拋錯。但 exclusivity 檢查禁止迴圈中改動 Iterable；for loop 優先用 Sequence，否則 fall back 到 Iterable，並以批次 span 提取元素。

deepdive.title: The problem with existing accessors
deepdive.body: 以 UniqueBox 為例說明既有 get/set accessor 的效能問題：存取一個含 256 個 Int 的 InlineArray（2KB struct）時，改一個元素得整份複製進出。

deepdive.title: 'borrow' and 'mutate' accessors
deepdive.body: introduces **`borrow`／`mutate` accessor** 取代 get/set：borrow 給予不複製的唯讀共享存取，mutate 給予就地修改的獨占存取，讓 UniqueBox 直接改動原陣列元素而不複製，並順帶支援 noncopyable 值。

deepdive.title: New Standard Library Types: UniqueBox, UniqueArray, Ref
deepdive.body: introduces 多個新標準庫型別：**UniqueBox**（真實型別）、不可複製的 **UniqueArray**、以 OutputSpan 的安全 withTemporaryAllocation、只能 resume 一次的 Continuation，以及像單值版 Span 的 **Ref/MutableRef**，可存於變數、傳遞與用於泛型。

deepdive.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (with un-hoisted access)
deepdive.body: 以 updateCount 為例：每次遞增都重複查找同一個 dictionary key，是可以 hoist 出迴圈的重複工作。

deepdive.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'inout' parameter)
deepdive.body: 示範過去唯一能 hoist 查找的方式：把迴圈搬進函式並以 inout 參數傳入查找結果——一個相當冷門的技巧。

deepdive.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'MutableRef')
deepdive.body: 示範用 **`MutableRef`** 的更好做法：在迴圈前先從 dictionary 查找建立一個 MutableRef，迴圈內直接用它修改。Ref 為 non-escapable，Swift 知道存取在變數離開作用域時結束。

deepdive.title: The Future of Swift
deepdive.body: Evan 收尾談 Swift 的未來：Swift Build 成為 SwiftPM 預設後端、新增 build/packaging、networking、Windows 等工作組、首個 Android Swift SDK，並邀請大家到 forums.swift.org 參與貢獻。

summary_en: Swift's Becca and Evan recap progress across **Swift 6.3 and 6.4** in four parts: everyday language improvements, key library updates, cross-platform and interop, and performance tuning. The everyday wins are mostly small annoyances going away: no more parentheses for `some`/`any` with optionals, a warning when you silently ignore a Task's thrown error, async calls allowed in `defer`, `weak let` instead of `@unchecked Sendable`, an explicit `~Sendable` syntax, and a second memberwise initializer for structs mixing internal and private properties.

Notable new syntax: **`anyAppleOS`** condenses many platform names into one availability and `#if os` condition; the **`@diagnose`** attribute changes a specific warning group to ignored, warning, or error within a single declaration (e.g. temporarily silencing deprecation, enabling strict memory safety, or promoting future errors early); and the **module selector `::`** treats the left-hand name as a module to resolve clashes when two modules share a type or member name (like SwiftUI and a database package both having `View`).

On libraries: the standard library adds a **task cancellation shield**, `mapKeyedValues` (key and value in the closure), and a new **`FilePath`** type; **Swift Testing** gains issue severity (`.warning`), `Test.cancel` for dynamic skipping, and two-way XCTest interop; **Subprocess 1.0** brings a cleaner API and streaming output via AsyncBufferSequence; and **Foundation** ships **ProgressManager** for async/await and keeps rewriting Data, NSURL/CFURL, and more in Swift. Cross-platform work includes the **`@C`** attribute to expose Swift functions to C, Swift-Java support for async/throwing, an official Android SDK, VSCode/OpenVSX editor support, WebAssembly and JavaScriptKit (Goodnotes saw safe bridging 35–40x faster), and Embedded Swift gaining existentials and untyped throws.

Performance tuning targets two areas: directly controlling optimizer decisions — the new **`@inline(always)`** (pair with `final`) and the **`@specialized`** where-clause to force specialization — and a major expansion of the **ownership system**: `~Copyable`/`~Escapable` associated types, a new **Iterable** protocol so for-loops borrow rather than copy, **`borrow`/`mutate` accessors** replacing get/set to avoid copying large values, and new standard-library types **UniqueBox, UniqueArray, Ref/MutableRef**. Evan closes with Swift Build as SwiftPM's default backend, new workgroups, and how to contribute at forums.swift.org.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Becca and Evan open, previewing four themes across **Swift 6.3 and 6.4**: language improvements, library updates, cross-platform support, and performance tuning, with the two presenters trading off.

deepdive_en.title: Everyday Language Improvements
deepdive_en.body: Begins the run of everyday small wins, aimed at expressing exactly what you mean without extra noise — starting with barely-noticeable annoyances going away, like no longer needing parentheses for `some`/`any` with optionals.

deepdive_en.title: Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (catching in the task)
deepdive_en.body: Silently ignoring an error thrown from a Swift Concurrency task now produces a warning, nudging you to handle it inside the task's do/catch.

deepdive_en.title: Better Swift Concurrency diagnostics (saving the task for later)
deepdive_en.body: The other fix is to save the task and check its error later; also, the old restriction on calling async functions from a `defer` block is removed.

deepdive_en.title: Better 'Sendable' conformances
deepdive_en.body: A class that needed `@unchecked Sendable` due to a `weak var` can change it to **`weak let`** to pass Sendable checking; if a type shouldn't be Sendable, the new **`~Sendable`** syntax states it explicitly without blocking subclasses from being Sendable.

deepdive_en.title: More accessible memberwise initializers
deepdive_en.body: A struct mixing internal and private properties now gets a second memberwise initializer usable from other files in the project.

deepdive_en.title: anyAppleOS Availability
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`anyAppleOS`**: with OS version numbers aligned, you can condense many platform names into a single availability annotation, cutting long platform lists.

deepdive_en.title: 'anyAppleOS' availability (before)
deepdive_en.body: Shows the before: each function spells out macOS/iOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS versions and uses `#if os(...)`, which is verbose.

deepdive_en.title: 'anyAppleOS' availability (after)
deepdive_en.body: Shows the after: `@available(anyAppleOS 27, *)` covers all platforms at once, with more specific attributes for carve-outs (like tvOS unavailable); `#if os(anyAppleOS)` works too.

deepdive_en.title: Controlling warnings with '@diagnose'
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **`@diagnose`** attribute, which changes the behavior of specific warning groups within a single declaration without affecting the whole project.

deepdive_en.title: @diagnose Attribute
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates three uses: setting DeprecatedDeclaration to ignored to silence it, StrictMemorySafety to warning to audit unsafe APIs, and ErrorInFutureSwiftVersion to error to catch future errors early.

deepdive_en.title: Clarifying code with module selectors
deepdive_en.body: Frames the same-name problem: Rocket and GiftShopToys both define a `SaturnV` type, so importing both yields an ambiguity error.

deepdive_en.title: Module Selectors (::)
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **module selector `::`**: in `Rocket::SaturnV` the left side is always a module name and resolves correctly, unlike `Rocket.SaturnV` which misfires when a module and type share a name.

deepdive_en.title: Clarifying code with module selectors (module selectors work on members, too)
deepdive_en.body: Module selectors also work on method/property names, e.g. `launchPadTechnician.HumanResources::fire()`, to disambiguate identically-named members from different modules. Recommended defensively (macro expansions) but not for intentionally clashing API design.

deepdive_en.title: Library Updates
deepdive_en.body: Evan takes over, noting the library updates share the goal of expressing intent. Covers the standard library, Swift Testing, Subprocess, and Foundation.

deepdive_en.title: Standard Library
deepdive_en.body: Overviews three new standard-library tools: task cancellation, dictionary transformations, and filepath manipulation.

deepdive_en.title: Task cancellation
deepdive_en.body: Explains that sometimes you want to finish work even after cancellation (e.g. finishing a disk write to avoid corruption), motivating the cancellation shield.

deepdive_en.title: Task cancellation shield
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`withTaskCancellationShield`**: inside the shield, cancellation checks always return false. Keep the region short, focused on finishing or rolling back already-started work.

deepdive_en.title: Constructing a new dictionary
deepdive_en.body: Explains the pain that `mapValues` only passes the old value, so computing a new value from the key forced you to rebuild the dictionary by hand.

deepdive_en.title: Dictionary.mapKeyedValues
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`mapKeyedValues`**, which passes both the key and old value into the closure to compute the new value, avoiding a manual rebuild.

deepdive_en.title: The new FilePath type
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the standard library's new **`FilePath`** type (based on Swift System), handling subtle cross-platform filepath differences, e.g. safely appending path segments via `components`.

deepdive_en.title: Swift Testing Updates
deepdive_en.body: Overviews Swift 6.4 Testing updates for more control over test behavior: surfacing non-fatal issues and dynamically skipping test cases.

deepdive_en.title: Issue Severity
deepdive_en.body: `Issue.record` can take a severity; setting `.warning` surfaces issues worth investigating without blocking CI.

deepdive_en.title: Test Cancellation
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`Test.cancel`** to dynamically cancel tests — especially powerful in parameterized tests to skip individual arguments rather than fail or run to completion. `swift test` also adds repeat-until-pass/fail.

deepdive_en.title: XCTest interoperability: Using XCTest from Swift Testing
deepdive_en.body: From Swift 6.4, XCTest assertion failures called from Swift Testing are reported as test issues, so migrating doesn't silently lose coverage.

deepdive_en.title: XCTest interoperability: Using Swift Testing from XCTest
deepdive_en.body: The reverse works too: `#expect` and other Swift Testing APIs work from an XCTestCase. These interop issues are warnings by default, promotable to failures in Xcode build settings. See 'Migrate to Swift Testing'.

deepdive_en.title: Subprocess 1.0
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **Subprocess 1.0**: a simplified execution type, improved error handling, convenient output-streaming APIs, and greatly improved cross-platform support (platform-specific process file descriptors and termination statuses).

deepdive_en.title: Subprocess Output Stream
deepdive_en.body: Shows stdout/stderr as AsyncBufferSequences and the new `strings()` method to read output line-by-line, respecting grapheme cluster boundaries so multi-byte characters aren't split.

deepdive_en.title: Foundation
deepdive_en.body: Overviews Foundation improvements, centered on the new ProgressManager and the ongoing rewrite in Swift.

deepdive_en.title: Progress Manager - Concurrency
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`ProgressManager`**: a progress-reporting type built for async/await that cleanly separates progress composition from reporting and attaches metadata (like deltaV) in a structured, type-safe way.

deepdive_en.title: Beyond Apple Platforms
deepdive_en.body: Notes Swift runs at every layer of the stack (OS, apps, services, kernel, firmware). Swift 6.4 extends interop, improves cross-platform IDE support, and makes bringing Swift to web and embedded safer.

deepdive_en.title: Swift–C Interoperability (@C attribute)
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **`@C`** attribute: like `@objc` but exposing Swift functions to C, limited to C-compatible types. The rocket launch-window example uses `@C` with `@implementation` to implement existing C-header functions and passes a span instead of array+count for safe interop.

deepdive_en.title: Swift-Java
deepdive_en.body: **Swift-Java** now supports calling async and throwing Swift functions from Java and captures more generics features, making Swift feel natural from Android; swift.org also offers an official Android Swift SDK.

deepdive_en.title: Editor support
deepdive_en.body: The VSCode Swift extension integrates **Swiftly** for easy toolchain installs and is now on **OpenVSX**, reaching VSCodium, Cursor, Kiro, and Antigravity; a guided checklist eases getting started.

deepdive_en.title: WebAssembly (Wasm) & JavascriptKit
deepdive_en.body: The open-source toolchain compiles to **WebAssembly**, letting one language write native apps, backends, and frontends. JavaScriptKit's safe bridging is faster and safer; Goodnotes compiled existing Swift to the web via Wasm and benchmarked safe bridging 35–40x faster than dynamic bridging.

deepdive_en.title: Embedded Swift
deepdive_en.body: **Embedded Swift** adds existential types and untyped throws, and stores type-layout metadata in DWARF debug info rather than the binary, balancing binary size with coredump debugging. `@diagnose` controls EmbeddedRestrictions warnings.

deepdive_en.title: Performance Tuning
deepdive_en.body: Becca returns on performance tuning. Swift performs well by default, but heavy computation or constrained environments sometimes make complicating code worthwhile. Two areas: explicitly controlling optimizer decisions, and extending ownership to avoid copies.

deepdive_en.title: Directly control inlining (source code)
deepdive_en.body: Uses histogram and makeInts as the starting point to explain inlining: replacing a call with its implementation, then optimizing it for the call site.

deepdive_en.title: Directly control inlining (inlined, but not optimized)
deepdive_en.body: Shows the intermediate state after inlining but before optimization: makeInts's body is inlined into histogram, but the if/else remains.

deepdive_en.title: Directly control inlining (inlined and optimized)
deepdive_en.body: Shows after inlining and optimization: constant propagation selects `InlineArray(repeating: 0)`, collapsing the block to one line — illustrating less work for the same result when inlining pays off.

deepdive_en.title: Optimizer Control: @inline(always) & @specialized
deepdive_en.body: Overviews two optimizer-control attributes. Alongside existing `@inline(never)`, Swift 6.4 adds **`@inline(always)`** to force inlining; for potentially-overridable class methods, pair it with `final`.

deepdive_en.title: Directly control inlining (preventing inlining)
deepdive_en.body: Shows `@inline(never)`: completely forbids inlining makeInts, useful when you know inlining will never be a win.

deepdive_en.title: Directly control inlining (forcing inlining)
deepdive_en.body: Shows `@inline(always)`: forces inlining of makeInts even when the optimizer isn't sure it'll help.

deepdive_en.title: Making generic functions faster with '@specialized'​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
deepdive_en.body: Explains specialization: cloning a generic function for a concrete type to eliminate generic overhead and enable further optimization, though the optimizer (especially in libraries) sometimes can't see how it's used.

deepdive_en.title: Making generic functions faster with '@specialized'​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ (explicitly requesting specialization)
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`@specialized`**: a where clause explicitly requests a specialized version for given concrete types, so slow generic code used heavily with one or two types gets prioritized.

deepdive_en.title: Ownership System & Noncopyable Types
deepdive_en.body: Reviews ownership: many performance problems are unnecessary copies. If storage stays allocated and both sides follow exclusivity rules, you can grant access instead of copying.
