Introduces borrow (both read-only) and mutate (exclusive) as safe ways to share storage, verifiable at compile time.

deepdive_en.title: Associated types can be '~Copyable' and '~Escapable'
deepdive_en.body: Equatable/Comparable/Hashable now work on noncopyable types (Equatable/Comparable also on non-escapable); associated types can be `~Copyable` or `~Escapable`, enabling high-performance protocol-driven development like the Iterable protocol.

deepdive_en.title: Iterable Protocol & Borrow/Mutate Accessors
deepdive_en.body: Introduces Swift 6.4's **Iterable** protocol: for-loops **borrow** elements instead of copying, so they work with noncopyable elements, avoid reference counting, and can throw mid-loop. Exclusivity forbids mutating the Iterable while looping; for-loops prefer Sequence and fall back to Iterable, retrieving elements in batched spans.

deepdive_en.title: The problem with existing accessors
deepdive_en.body: Uses UniqueBox to show the get/set performance problem: accessing an InlineArray of 256 Ints (a 2KB struct) requires copying the whole thing out and back to change one element.

deepdive_en.title: 'borrow' and 'mutate' accessors
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **`borrow`/`mutate` accessors** replacing get/set: borrow gives non-copying read-only shared access, mutate gives in-place exclusive access, letting UniqueBox mutate the original array element without copying — and handle noncopyable values too.

deepdive_en.title: New Standard Library Types: UniqueBox, UniqueArray, Ref
deepdive_en.body: Introduces new standard-library types: the real **UniqueBox**, the noncopyable **UniqueArray**, a safe withTemporaryAllocation using OutputSpan, a Continuation that's resume-once at compile time, and **Ref/MutableRef** — like a single-value Span that can be stored, passed, and used generically.

deepdive_en.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (with un-hoisted access)
deepdive_en.body: Uses updateCount to show repeated lookups of the same dictionary key on every increment — work that could be hoisted out of the loop.

deepdive_en.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'inout' parameter)
deepdive_en.body: Shows the previously-only way to hoist the lookup: moving the loop into a function and passing the lookup as an inout parameter — a fairly obscure trick.

deepdive_en.title: Using 'MutableRef' to eliminate repeated accesses (hoisted by 'MutableRef')
deepdive_en.body: Shows the better approach with **`MutableRef`**: make one MutableRef from the lookup before the loop, then mutate through it inside. Refs are non-escapable, so Swift knows the access ends when the variable leaves scope.

deepdive_en.title: The Future of Swift
deepdive_en.body: Evan closes on Swift's future: Swift Build as SwiftPM's default backend, new build/packaging, networking, and Windows workgroups, the first Android Swift SDK, and an invitation to contribute at forums.swift.org.

title: Build real-time apps and services with gRPC and Swift
gloss: 用 gRPC 與 Swift 打造即時 App 與服務
takeaway: 用 grpc-swift 與雙向串流 RPC，在 Swift App 與後端之間打造高效的即時體驗。
chapters: Setting up Xcode to generate gRPC code
Create a gRPC client connected to a local server
Call the ListRaces RPC and update the view
Disconnect ClientManager when the scene enters the background phase
Inject ClientManager into the view via @Environment
Protobuf message format and binary efficiency
Call the FollowRace RPC in the LiveStreamView

points.text: 介紹開源 RPC 框架 **gRPC**，以 **.proto** 定義服務與訊息（如 ListRaces），並在 Xcode 用 **grpc-swift-proto-generator** 產生 Swift 程式碼。
用 **withGRPCClient** 搭配 **HTTP2ClientTransport** 建立連線，並把產生的 client 包進服務 stub 呼叫 RPC。
以 **@Observable 的 ClientManager** 管理連線生命週期，透過 **@Environment** 注入並在 **scenePhase** 進入背景時斷線。
實作 **FollowRace 雙向串流 RPC**，用 **withThrowingTaskGroup** 同時讀取請求與推送即時的賽車位置與排名更新。
用 **SwiftProtobuf** 取得高效的二進位序列化，並以 **Containerfile** 打包後部署到 Cloud Run。

audience: 想用 **gRPC 串接 Swift App 與後端、打造即時串流功能**的全端 Swift 開發者。
gloss_en: Build real-time apps and services with gRPC and Swift
takeaway_en: Use grpc-swift and bidirectional streaming RPCs to build high-performance real-time experiences between your Swift app and backend.

points_en.text: Introduces the open-source RPC framework **gRPC**, defining services and messages (like ListRaces) in **.proto** and generating Swift code in Xcode with **grpc-swift-proto-generator**.
Use **withGRPCClient** together with **HTTP2ClientTransport** to establish the connection, then wrap the generated client in a service stub to call RPCs.
Manage the connection lifecycle with an **@Observable ClientManager**, inject it via **@Environment**, and disconnect when **scenePhase** enters the background.
Implement the **FollowRace bidirectional streaming RPC**, using **withThrowingTaskGroup** to read requests and push live race position and ranking updates concurrently.
Use **SwiftProtobuf** for efficient binary serialization, then package with a **Containerfile** and deploy to Cloud Run.

audience_en: Full-stack Swift developers who want to **connect a Swift app and backend with gRPC to build real-time streaming features**.
summary: 由 Swift Server 團隊的 George 主講，示範如何用 **gRPC Swift** 在 app 與後端之間打造即時體驗。手寫網路程式碼既耗時又容易出錯，且文件未必同步；而 **gRPC** 這類框架讓你從規格產生程式碼，省時且消除錯誤。gRPC 是 CNCF 專案、業界廣泛採用的標準，與 OpenAPI 不同之處在於 API 是以「具輸入輸出的函式（remote procedure call）」而非 HTTP 來定義。整場以一個 go-kart 賽車聯盟 app（SwiftKart）為例，串連定義服務、產生程式碼、實作與部署。

服務以 **Protocol Buffers（Protobuf）** 的 .proto 檔定義。先定義一個 unary 的 **ListRaces** RPC，請求帶 limit、回應為 repeated Race，並 import Protobuf Well-Known Type 的 timestamp。在 Xcode 中加入 **grpc-swift-nio-transport** 與 **grpc-swift-protobuf** 兩個相依套件，於 Build Phases 掛上 **GRPCProtobufGenerator** build plugin，並以 JSON config 設定只產生 messages 與 clients。接著在 RaceScheduleView 用 withGRPCClient 建立連向本機 server 的 client，呼叫 listRaces 並把回應映射到 view 的資料模型。為避免每個 view 都各自建立連線，課程引入 **ClientManager**（@Observable、以 Mutex 管理連線狀態），透過 environment 傳遞並在 scene 進入 background 時 disconnect 以釋放資源。Protobuf 以欄位編號做二進位序列化，訊息大小約為等價 JSON 的一半，對行動裝置與網路不佳時特別有利。

重點段落示範 gRPC 的一級串流支援。RPC 分為 unary、client streaming、server streaming 與 **bidirectional streaming** 四種。課程以雙向串流的 **FollowRace** 提供即時賽事更新：請求串流告知要追蹤的賽事與訂閱的 event types，回應串流則回傳 KartLocations 或 Standings（以 Protobuf 的 oneof 表達，類似帶關聯值的 Swift enum）。server 端以 SimpleServiceProtocol 實作，FollowRace 用 **withThrowingTaskGroup** 同時處理兩個資料流：一個 task 從 tracker 取得事件並依目前訂閱過濾、寫回 client，另一邊持續消費請求串流以更新訂閱集合（以 Mutex 保護），請求串流結束即 cancelAll。app 端在 LiveStreamView 用 AsyncStream 追蹤 showLeaderboard 變化、於 FollowRace 的兩個 closure 分別寫請求與處理回應，把 kart 位置畫到地圖、把 standings 顯示在排行榜。

最後示範部署到雲端。撰寫 **Containerfile**：以 swift:latest 為 builder，release 模式建置 server，再用 multi-stage build 把 binary 複製到較小的 swift:slim runtime image，expose 8080 並設定 entrypoint。用 **gcloud run deploy** 部署到 Google Cloud Run（指定 --use-http2 與 --allow-unauthenticated），取得 URL 後在 ClientManager 把 transport 目標改為服務的 DNS 名稱，並把 transportSecurity 由 plaintext 改為 **TLS**。實務takeaway：gRPC Swift 從定義、產生、實作到部署都讓 app-to-server 流程更簡單，並具備與 Swift OTel、service lifecycle 整合及自訂 transport、name resolver、client-side load balancing 等進階功能。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Swift Server 團隊的 **George** 開場，指出動態 app 體驗仰賴向 server 取資料，但手寫網路程式碼耗時且容易因文件過時或失誤而出錯。更好的做法是從作為 source of truth 的規格產生程式碼，省時並消除錯誤，這種效益能擴展到所有要互動的 API。

deepdive.title: Meet gRPC
deepdive.body: 介紹 **gRPC** 是一個做 remote procedure call 的框架，為 CNCF 專案且業界廣泛採用。和 OpenAPI 一樣是從規格產生程式碼，但 gRPC 的 API 以具輸入輸出的「函式」而非 HTTP 來定義，讓你能快速開始與服務互動。

deepdive.title: App overview and demo setup
deepdive.body: 以一個附近新成立的 go-kart 賽車聯盟為情境，其後端追蹤賽程與即時賽事資料。George 已備好 iOS app 的幾個 view 並填入範例資料（可列出賽事、點入看細節），目標是改用 **gRPC** 從 server 取得內容。並以 listRaces 這個概念性函式說明 request 由 client 送出、server 執行後回傳賽事清單。

deepdive.title: Defining the ListRaces RPC
deepdive.body: 規劃流程：先定義服務 API，再加相依套件、設定 gRPC build plugin 產生程式碼，最後更新 app 呼叫 server。最常見的 gRPC 服務規格格式即 **Protocol Buffers**。

deepdive.title: ListRaces RPC definition
deepdive.body: 在 .proto 中定義服務與一個 **ListRaces** RPC：輸入 ListRacesRequest、輸出 ListRacesResponse。request 有一個 int 欄位 limit（預設 100），每個欄位都有唯一 field number；response 含 repeated Race。Race 另以 message 定義，含 name、location、championship（string）、laps（int）與 start_time（timestamp），timestamp 屬 Protobuf **Well-Known Types**，需 import 其定義。

deepdive.title: Setting up Xcode to generate gRPC code
deepdive.body: 在 Xcode 的 Project Editor 的 Package Dependencies 加入兩個相依套件：提供高效能網路（基於 SwiftNIO）的 **grpc-swift-nio-transport**，與提供程式碼產生 build plugin 的 **grpc-swift-protobuf**。接著在 app target 的 Build Phases 展開 Run Build Tool Plug-ins，加入 **GRPCProtobufGenerator**。

deepdive.title: grpc-swift-proto-generator-config.json
deepdive.body: plugin 會掃描 target 目錄中的 proto 檔，並以 JSON config 設定要產生什麼。因為這是 app，只需 **clients** 與 **messages**，不需 servers。設定完成後重新編譯即可產生程式碼，首次使用時基於安全會要求信任該 plugin。

deepdive.title: Add gRPC imports
deepdive.body: 在 RaceScheduleView 匯入所需模組：提供共用 runtime 元件的 **GRPCCore**、提供網路程式碼的 **GRPCNIOTransportHTTP2**，以及讓你操作 Protobuf 訊息的 **SwiftProtobuf**。

deepdive.title: Create a gRPC client connected to a local server
deepdive.body: 在 view 加上 **task** modifier，於其中用 **withGRPCClient** 建立 client，並包在 do-catch 中先 print 錯誤。透過設定可選擇網路實作，此處用 SwiftNIO 連到本機 Mac 上 127.0.0.1:8080 的 server。傳入 closure 的 client 只知道 server、不知道 service。

deepdive.title: Call the ListRaces RPC and update the view
deepdive.body: 用產生的程式碼建立 **SwiftKartService.Client** 並以 gRPC client 初始化，接著建立 ListRacesRequest、await 呼叫 **listRaces**，最後把 server 回應 map 成 view 使用的資料模型 RaceInfo，便取得了賽程（例如 Finite Loops 即將開賽）。

deepdive.title: Managing the gRPC client lifecycle
deepdive.body: 目前每次 view 出現都建立新 client，使每個 view 各自建立連線、徒增延遲。改善做法是建立一個 client 並透過 app environment 共享以重用連線，同時在 app 進入背景時 disconnect 以釋放資源。

deepdive.title: ClientManager.swift
deepdive.body: 加入事先寫好的 **ClientManager**：標註 @Observable 與 Sendable，內部用 **Mutex** 保護連線狀態（connected/disconnected）。withClient 會 lazily 連線（connectIfNecessary），建立 GRPCClient 並以 Task 執行 runConnections；disconnect 則取出 client 並呼叫 beginGracefulShutdown 做優雅關閉。

deepdive.title: Propagate ClientManager to child views
deepdive.body: 在 app entry point 的 SwiftKartApp 建立一個 ClientManager 實例，並透過 **.environment(manager)** modifier 將其提供給子 view 使用。

deepdive.title: Disconnect ClientManager when the scene enters the background phase
deepdive.body: 新增 **@Environment(\.scenePhase)** 屬性並以 onChange 監看；當 newPhase 為 **.background** 時呼叫 manager.disconnect()。因為 manager 是被請求 client 時才 lazily 連線，所以進入 active 狀態時不需特別處理。

deepdive.title: Inject ClientManager into the view via @Environment
deepdive.body: 在 RaceScheduleView 以 **@Environment(ClientManager.self) var manager** 取得共享的 manager，並讓它在 preview 中也可用。

deepdive.title: Replace withGRPCClient with manager.withClient
deepdive.body: 把原本直接呼叫 withGRPCClient 的程式碼改為 **manager.withClient { client in ... }**，讓請求改走共享、可重用連線的 manager，listRaces 的呼叫與映射邏輯維持不變。

deepdive.title: Protobuf message format and binary efficiency
deepdive.body: 除了服務 API，Protobuf 也提供訊息交換格式。gRPC 在 client 與 server 間傳送時會序列化成二進位，且以唯一的 **field number**（而非名稱）識別欄位，因此 Protobuf 訊息約為等價 JSON 的一半大小，對行動 app 在網路不佳時尤其有利。

deepdive.title: Using SwiftProtobuf
deepdive.body: **SwiftProtobuf** 有程式碼產生器，讓你直接以 Swift 型別操作訊息。示範建立一個 Race 訊息、填入 name、location、start_time、laps、championship 與 drivers，並呼叫 **serializedBytes()** 取得其二進位表示。此效率也利於 service-to-service、IPC（如 Apple 開源的 Containerization framework 透過 virtual socket 在主機與 Linux VM 間溝通），gRPC Swift 亦是 Private Cloud Compute、iCloud Keychain/Photos、SharePlay 檔案分享乃至內部 OS build/release 系統的關鍵元件。

deepdive.title: Server
deepdive.body: 示範 server 端：建立一個以 transport 與 services 初始化的 **GRPCServer**（此處 http2NIOPosix、plaintext、127.0.0.1:8080），呼叫 **serve()** 啟動。

deepdive.title: Implementing a bidirectional streaming RPC
deepdive.body: 介紹 gRPC 的一級串流支援與四種 RPC：unary、client streaming（如每台 kart 串流遙測）、server streaming（如即時文字賽評）與 **bidirectional streaming**（雙方皆可送任意數量訊息）。George 計畫以雙向串流提供即時賽事更新：請求訊息告知訂閱的事件類型，回應訊息回傳相關事件，客戶端可隨需求變更再送訊息。

deepdive.title: Service
deepdive.body: service 是一個實作 build plugin 產生之協定的型別。展示先前實作的 listRaces：一個 async function，接受 request、查詢 RaceDB 後填入 ListRacesResponse 並回傳。

deepdive.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive.body: 更新服務定義加入 **FollowRace** RPC，因為串流請求與回應，需在輸入輸出前加上 **stream** 關鍵字。同時定義訊息：FollowRaceRequest 含 race_name 與以 enum 表示的 event_types；FollowRaceResponse 以 **oneof**（類似帶關聯值的 Swift enum）承載 KartLocations 或 Standings 兩種訊息之一。

deepdive.title: FollowRace stub
deepdive.body: 在 server 重新建置以產生程式碼後，因協定新增了未實作的需求而出現 build error，先填出一個 stub：丟出 code 為 **.unimplemented** 的 RPCError，作為後續實作的起點。

deepdive.title: Implement the FollowRace RPC
deepdive.body: 實作雙向串流的 FollowRace：request 是請求訊息的 async sequence、response 是寫回訊息的 writer。用 **withThrowingTaskGroup** 同時處理兩個資料流：先 await 第一個請求訊息取得賽事名與訂閱（以 **Mutex** 保護的 Set 儲存事件型別）；一個 task 從 tracker 取得事件、依目前訂閱過濾、填入 FollowRaceResponse（map kart locations 與 standings）後 write 給 client。主流程持續消費請求串流以更新訂閱集合，請求串流結束即視為不再需要事件，呼叫 **cancelAll** 停止送出。

deepdive.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive.body: 切回 app 端，更新 app 專案的 proto 檔以納入新的 FollowRace RPC 與相關訊息，使 app 端與 server 端的服務定義一致。

deepdive.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive.body: 在 app 中重新建置專案以重新產生 gRPC 程式碼，讓 client 取得呼叫 FollowRace 與處理新訊息（含 drivers 欄位）所需的型別。

deepdive.title: Navigation link to LiveStreamView
deepdive.body: 在 RaceInfoView 加入一個 **NavigationLink** 導向事先建立的 **LiveStreamView**，作為進入即時串流畫面的入口（Text 標示為 "Live stream"）。

deepdive.title: Call the FollowRace RPC in the LiveStreamView
deepdive.body: 在 **LiveStreamView**（顯示繪出各 kart 位置標註的地圖，並有開啟 leaderboard sheet 的工具列按鈕）中呼叫 FollowRace。透過 environment 注入 manager，於 task 中 manager.withClient 建立 kart client；FollowRace 有兩個 closure，一個寫請求、一個處理回應。以 **AsyncStream** 追蹤 showLeaderboard 變化（並 yield 初始值），在請求 closure 依其值組裝 event_types（顯示排行榜時加上 .standings）並寫給 server；回應 closure 則迭代訊息，用 handleEvent 把 kart locations 更新到地圖、把 standings 更新到排行榜。

deepdive.title: Deploying the service
deepdive.body: 由於服務只跑在本機，需部署到雲端讓所有使用者可用。George 使用 Google Cloud Platform（也可選 AWS、Fly.io 等），目標是 Linux：把 server 執行檔打包成含 runtime 相依的 container image、推到 registry、建立 deployment，最後更新 app 指向已部署的服務。

deepdive.title: Containerfile
deepdive.body: 撰寫 **Containerfile**：以 swift:latest 為 base image，設定工作目錄、複製套件 manifest 與原始碼，以 release 模式 swift build 出 server 並複製到已知位置。再以 **multi-stage build** 把 binary 複製進較小的 **swift:slim** runtime image，避免帶上整個 Swift toolchain，最後 expose 8080 並設定 entrypoint 為 server。

deepdive.title: Deploy service
deepdive.body: 在終端機用 **gcloud run deploy** 部署，提供 deployment 名稱、image 名稱與 region，並指定服務使用 **http2**（--use-http2）與允許未驗證請求（--allow-unauthenticated）。部署完成後印出服務 URL，供更新 client 時使用。

deepdive.title: Target deployed service
deepdive.body: 回到 app 開啟 ClientManager，把 makeTransport 的連線目標改為服務的 **DNS 名稱**（.dns(host:)），並把 transportSecurity 由 plaintext 改為 **TLS**，讓 app 連向雲端已部署的服務（成功觀賞到 Finite Loops 賽事即時畫面）。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結 gRPC Swift 如何從定義服務、產生程式碼到實作與部署，讓即時體驗與 app-to-server 溝通更簡單。並提及進階能力：與 **Swift OTel**、**Swift service lifecycle** 等套件整合，以及自訂 transport、name resolver 與 client-side load balancing。建議動手把部分 app 互動原型化，或試用 GitHub 上開源專案的教學與範例，甚至參與貢獻。

summary_en: Presented by George of the Swift Server team, this session shows how to build real-time experiences between an app and its backend with **gRPC Swift**. Hand-crafting networking code is time-consuming and error-prone, and docs aren't always up to date; frameworks like **gRPC** let you generate code from a specification, saving time and eliminating mistakes. gRPC is a CNCF project and widely adopted standard, and unlike OpenAPI it defines APIs in terms of functions (remote procedure calls) with inputs and outputs rather than HTTP. The whole talk uses a go-kart racing league app (SwiftKart) to connect defining a service, generating code, implementing it, and deploying.

The service is defined in a **Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)** .proto file. A unary **ListRaces** RPC is defined first, with a request carrying limit and a response of repeated Race, importing Protobuf's Well-Known timestamp type. In Xcode you add two dependencies, **grpc-swift-nio-transport** and **grpc-swift-protobuf**, attach the **GRPCProtobufGenerator** build plugin in Build Phases, and use a JSON config to generate only messages and clients. RaceScheduleView then uses withGRPCClient to connect to a local server, calls listRaces, and maps the response into the view's model. To avoid each view making its own connection, the session introduces **ClientManager** (an @Observable that guards connection state with a Mutex), propagated via the environment and disconnected when the scene enters the background to free resources. Because Protobuf serializes to binary keyed by field numbers, messages are roughly half the size of equivalent JSON, which is especially valuable for mobile apps on poor networks.

A central section demonstrates gRPC's first-class streaming support. RPCs come in four kinds: unary, client streaming, server streaming, and **bidirectional streaming**. The bidirectional **FollowRace** RPC delivers live race updates: request messages declare which event types to subscribe to, and response messages return KartLocations or Standings (expressed with Protobuf's oneof, like a Swift enum with associated values). The server implements it via SimpleServiceProtocol, using **withThrowingTaskGroup** to handle two streams at once: one task pulls events from the tracker, filters them to the current subscriptions, and writes them back, while the main flow keeps consuming request messages to update the subscription set (guarded by a Mutex) and calls cancelAll when the request stream ends. On the app side, LiveStreamView uses an AsyncStream to track showLeaderboard changes and the RPC's two closures to write requests and handle responses, drawing kart positions on a map and standings in a leaderboard.

Finally it shows cloud deployment. A **Containerfile** uses swift:latest as the builder, builds the server in release mode, then uses a multi-stage build to copy the binary into a smaller swift:slim runtime image, exposing 8080 and setting an entrypoint. **gcloud run deploy** ships it to Google Cloud Run (with --use-http2 and --allow-unauthenticated); after getting the URL, ClientManager's transport target is changed to the service's DNS name and transportSecurity is switched from plaintext to **TLS**. The takeaway: gRPC Swift simplifies the whole app-to-server workflow from definition to deployment, and offers advanced features like integration with Swift OTel and service lifecycle, plus custom transports, name resolvers, and client-side load balancing.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: **George** of the Swift Server team opens by noting that dynamic app experiences depend on fetching data from a server, but hand-crafting networking code is time-consuming and error-prone when docs go stale or mistakes creep in. A better approach is to generate code from a specification that acts as the source of truth, saving time and eliminating errors, with benefits that scale across all the APIs you interact with.

deepdive_en.title: Meet gRPC
deepdive_en.body: **gRPC** is introduced as a framework for making remote procedure calls, a CNCF project and widely adopted standard. Like OpenAPI it works with code generated from a specification, but gRPC defines APIs in terms of functions with inputs and outputs rather than HTTP, letting you start working with services quickly.

deepdive_en.title: App overview and demo setup
deepdive_en.body: The scenario is a new nearby go-kart racing league whose backend tracks the schedule and live race data. George has prepared several app views populated with example data (listing races and tapping in for details) and wants to use **gRPC** to fetch this from the server. He illustrates listRaces conceptually: the client sends a request, the server executes the function, and replies with the list of races.

deepdive_en.title: Defining the ListRaces RPC
deepdive_en.body: The plan: define the service API, add dependencies, configure the gRPC build plugin to generate code, then update the app to call the server. The most common format for specifying gRPC services is **Protocol Buffers**.

deepdive_en.title: ListRaces RPC definition
deepdive_en.body: In the .proto, a service is defined with one **ListRaces** RPC taking a ListRacesRequest and returning a ListRacesResponse. The request has one int field limit (default 100), and every field is assigned a unique field number; the response contains a repeated Race. Race is a separate message with name, location, championship (strings), laps (int), and start_time (a timestamp). The timestamp is one of Protobuf's **Well-Known Types**, so its definition must be imported.

deepdive_en.title: Setting up Xcode to generate gRPC code
deepdive_en.body: In Xcode's Project Editor, Package Dependencies, add two dependencies: **grpc-swift-nio-transport** for high-performance networking built on SwiftNIO, and **grpc-swift-protobuf** which provides a build plugin to generate gRPC code from the proto. Then, in the app target's Build Phases, expand Run Build Tool Plug-ins and add **GRPCProtobufGenerator**.

deepdive_en.title: grpc-swift-proto-generator-config.json
deepdive_en.body: The plugin scans the target directory for proto files and is configured with a JSON config that controls what gets generated. Because this is an app, only **clients** and **messages** are needed, not servers. Recompiling then generates the code, and the first time you use it you're asked to trust the plug-in as a security measure.

deepdive_en.title: Add gRPC imports
deepdive_en.body: In RaceScheduleView, import the needed modules: **GRPCCore** for common gRPC runtime components, **GRPCNIOTransportHTTP2** for networking code, and **SwiftProtobuf** to interact with Protobuf messages.

deepdive_en.title: Create a gRPC client connected to a local server
deepdive_en.body: A **task** modifier is added to the view, inside which **withGRPCClient** creates a client within a do-catch that just prints errors for now. gRPC lets you configure the networking implementation; here a SwiftNIO-based one connects to a server running locally at 127.0.0.1:8080. The client passed to the closure only knows about the server, not the service.

deepdive_en.title: Call the ListRaces RPC and update the view
deepdive_en.body: Using the generated code, a **SwiftKartService.Client** is created wrapping the gRPC client, a ListRacesRequest is built, **listRaces** is awaited, and the server's response is mapped into the view's RaceInfo model, fetching the race schedule (for example, Finite Loops starting soon).

deepdive_en.title: Managing the gRPC client lifecycle
deepdive_en.body: Currently the app creates a new client every time the view appears, so each view establishes its own connection and adds latency. The fix is to create one client and share it via the app's environment so connections can be reused, and to disconnect clients when the app enters the background to free resources.

deepdive_en.title: ClientManager.swift
deepdive_en.body: A previously written **ClientManager** is added: marked @Observable and Sendable, it guards connection state (connected/disconnected) with a **Mutex**. withClient connects lazily (connectIfNecessary), creating a GRPCClient and running its connections in a Task; disconnect takes the client and calls beginGracefulShutdown for an orderly shutdown.

deepdive_en.title: Propagate ClientManager to child views
deepdive_en.body: In the app entry point SwiftKartApp, a ClientManager instance is created and made available to child views via the **.environment(manager)** modifier.

deepdive_en.title: Disconnect ClientManager when the scene enters the background phase
deepdive_en.body: A **@Environment(\.scenePhase)** property is added and watched with onChange; when newPhase is **.background**, manager.disconnect() is called. Since the manager connects lazily when asked for a client, nothing special is needed for the active state.

deepdive_en.title: Inject ClientManager into the view via @Environment
deepdive_en.body: RaceScheduleView obtains the shared manager with **@Environment(ClientManager.self) var manager**, and it is also made available in the preview.

deepdive_en.title: Replace withGRPCClient with manager.withClient
deepdive_en.body: The direct withGRPCClient call is replaced with **manager.withClient { client in ... }** so requests use the shared, reusable connection, while the listRaces call and mapping logic stay the same.

deepdive_en.title: Protobuf message format and binary efficiency
deepdive_en.body: Beyond the service API, Protobuf provides a message interchange format. gRPC serializes messages to binary between client and server, identifying each field by its unique **field number** rather than name, so a Protobuf message is roughly half the size of the equivalent JSON, which is especially helpful for mobile apps on poor networks.

deepdive_en.title: Using SwiftProtobuf
deepdive_en.body: **SwiftProtobuf** has a code generator so you can work directly with Swift types representing your messages. The demo creates a Race message, populates name, location, start_time, laps, championship, and drivers, then calls **serializedBytes()** to get its binary form. This efficiency also benefits service-to-service and IPC (like Apple's open-source Containerization framework communicating over virtual sockets between host and a Linux VM), and gRPC Swift is a key component in Private Cloud Compute, iCloud Keychain/Photos, SharePlay file sharing, and internal OS build/release systems.

deepdive_en.title: Server
deepdive_en.body: The server side: a **GRPCServer** is created with a transport and the services it offers (here http2NIOPosix, plaintext, 127.0.0.1:8080) and started by calling **serve()**.

deepdive_en.title: Implementing a bidirectional streaming RPC
deepdive_en.body: gRPC's first-class streaming is introduced with four RPC kinds: unary, client streaming (each kart streaming telemetry), server streaming (a live commentary feed), and **bidirectional streaming** (both sides send any number of messages). George plans bidirectional streaming for live race updates: request messages declare which event types the client subscribes to, response messages return the relevant events, and the client can send more messages when its interests change.

deepdive_en.title: Service
deepdive_en.body: A service is a type implementing a protocol generated by the build plugin. The earlier listRaces is shown: an async function that takes a request, queries the RaceDB, populates ListRacesResponse, and returns it.

deepdive_en.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive_en.body: The service definition is updated to add the **FollowRace** RPC; because it streams requests and responses, the **stream** keyword is added before input and output. The messages are defined: FollowRaceRequest holds race_name and event_types as an enum; FollowRaceResponse uses a **oneof** (like a Swift enum with associated values) carrying either KartLocations or Standings.

deepdive_en.title: FollowRace stub
deepdive_en.body: After rebuilding the server to regenerate code, a build error appears because the protocol has a new unimplemented requirement, so a stub is filled in that throws an **RPCError** with code .unimplemented as the starting point for the implementation.

deepdive_en.title: Implement the FollowRace RPC
deepdive_en.body: FollowRace is implemented for bidirectional streaming: the request is an async sequence of messages and the response is a writer. A **withThrowingTaskGroup** handles both streams: it awaits the first request to learn the race name and subscriptions (stored in a Set guarded by a **Mutex**); one task pulls events from the tracker, filters to the current subscriptions, populates FollowRaceResponse (mapping kart locations and standings), and writes to the client. The main flow keeps consuming request messages to update the subscriptions, and treats the end of the request stream as a signal to **cancelAll** and stop sending.

deepdive_en.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive_en.body: Back on the app side, the app project's proto file is updated to include the new FollowRace RPC and messages, keeping the app's and server's service definitions in sync.

deepdive_en.title: swift_kart_service.proto
deepdive_en.body: The app project is rebuilt to regenerate the gRPC code, giving the client the types needed to call FollowRace and handle the new messages (including the drivers field).

deepdive_en.title: Navigation link to LiveStreamView
deepdive_en.body: A **NavigationLink** to the previously created **LiveStreamView** is added in RaceInfoView as the entry point to the live streaming screen, with its Text labeled "Live stream".

deepdive_en.title: Call the FollowRace RPC in the LiveStreamView
deepdive_en.body: In **LiveStreamView** (which shows a map drawing each kart's position and a toolbar button opening a leaderboard sheet), FollowRace is called. The manager is injected via the environment, and within a task manager.withClient creates a kart client; FollowRace has two closures, one to write requests and one to handle responses. An **AsyncStream** tracks showLeaderboard changes (yielding the initial value); the request closure assembles event_types based on it (adding .standings when the leaderboard is shown) and writes to the server, while the response closure iterates messages and uses handleEvent to update kart locations on the map and standings in the leaderboard.

deepdive_en.title: Deploying the service
deepdive_en.body: Since the service runs locally, it must be deployed to the cloud so all users can reach it. George uses Google Cloud Platform (AWS or Fly.io would also work) targeting Linux: package the server executable into a container image with its runtime dependencies, publish to a registry, create a deployment, then update the app to target the deployed service.

deepdive_en.title: Containerfile
deepdive_en.body: A **Containerfile** uses swift:latest as the base image, sets the working directory, copies the package manifest and sources, builds the server in release mode, and copies it to a known location. A **multi-stage build** then copies the binary into a smaller **swift:slim** runtime image to avoid shipping the whole Swift toolchain, exposes 8080, and sets the entry point to the server.

deepdive_en.title: Deploy service
deepdive_en.body: In the terminal, **gcloud run deploy** deploys the service with the deployment name, image name, and region, specifying that it uses **http2** (--use-http2) and allows unauthenticated requests (--allow-unauthenticated). When deployment finishes it prints the service URL needed to update the client.

deepdive_en.title: Target deployed service
deepdive_en.body: Back in the app, ClientManager is opened and makeTransport's connect target is changed to the service's **DNS name** (.dns(host:)), and transportSecurity is switched from plaintext to **TLS**, so the app connects to the deployed cloud service (successfully showing the Finite Loops race live).

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: The session recaps how gRPC Swift goes from defining a service and generating code to implementing and deploying it, simplifying real-time experiences and app-to-server communication. It mentions advanced capabilities: integration with packages like **Swift OTel** and **Swift service lifecycle**, plus custom transports, name resolvers, and client-side load balancing. The suggestion is to prototype part of your app-to-server interactions, try the tutorials and examples in the open-source GitHub project, and even contribute.

title: Migrate to Swift Testing
gloss: 遷移到 Swift Testing
takeaway: 用新的「互通模式」讓 XCTest 與 Swift Testing 共存,不必一次全改,漸進式遷移。
chapters: Name a test using a raw identifier
Wrap XCTFail in a test helper function
Replace XCTFail with Issue.record in the test helper
Run Swift Package tests with the strict interoperability mode from Terminal
Common migration: halting after test failures
Example of nested loops which can be converted into a parameterized @Test function
Refactor nested loops into a parameterized @Test function
Precondition check on empty input name in an initializer
Add coverage for precondition failure with exit test

points.text: 遷移策略是**漸進式**:既有 XCTest 原地保留,新測試直接用 Swift Testing 寫,不必先大改。
互通(interoperability)讓你在某框架的測試裡安全呼叫另一框架的 API;四種模式 **Limited / Complete / Strict / None**,在 Xcode Test Plan 或 SPM 設定。
常見轉換對照:**XCTSkip → Test.cancel 或 .enabled(if:) trait**;中止行為 → **try #require**;helper 裡的 XCTFail → **Issue.record(sourceLocation:)**。
參數化測試把巢狀迴圈改成 **@Test(arguments:)**,平行執行更快、失敗報告更清楚。
**Exit tests**:#expect(processExitsWith: .failure) 可覆蓋 preconditionFailure / crash 路徑,在子行程中安全執行。

audience: **手上有大量 XCTest、想導入 Swift Testing 但怕一次全改的團隊。** 可以先用 Strict 模式把新舊測試並行跑起來。
gloss_en: Migrate to Swift Testing
takeaway_en: Use the new interoperability modes to let XCTest and Swift Testing coexist, so you can migrate incrementally instead of converting everything at once.

points_en.text: The migration strategy is **incremental**: keep existing XCTest in place, and write new tests directly in Swift Testing without a big upfront rewrite.
Interoperability lets you safely call one framework's APIs from within the other's tests; four modes **Limited / Complete / Strict / None**, configured in an Xcode Test Plan or SPM.
Common conversion mappings: **XCTSkip → Test.cancel or the .enabled(if:) trait**; aborting behavior → **try #require**; XCTFail inside helpers → **Issue.record(sourceLocation:)**.
Parameterized testing turns nested loops into **@Test(arguments:)**, running in parallel for more speed and clearer failure reports.
**Exit tests**: #expect(processExitsWith: .failure) can cover preconditionFailure / crash paths, running safely in a child process.

audience_en: **Teams with a large XCTest suite who want to adopt Swift Testing but fear converting everything at once.** You can start with Strict mode to run old and new tests side by side.
summary: **Swift Testing** 是 Xcode 16 推出的現代測試框架，介面更精簡、表達力更強，且為 Swift concurrency 而生（測試預設平行執行，回饋更快）。由 Swift Testing 團隊的 Jerry 主講，核心訊息是：在 **Xcode 27**，藉由全新的 **test framework interoperability**（測試框架互通），你可以無痛地與既有 XCTest 並存、逐步遷移。基礎建構是用 `@Test` 巨集宣告測試、用 `#expect` 建立期望（取代多數 XCTest assertion），而無條件失敗的 `XCTFail` 對應到 **`Issue.record`**；`@Test` 也支援用反引號 raw identifier 寫出含空格的可讀測試名。少數情境仍須留在 XCTest：UI automation、performance testing、以及處理 Objective-C exception。

遷移策略是「小步前進」：大多數 XCTest 留在原處，只在準備好時、優先挑常更新的測試逐個改寫；新測試直接用 Swift Testing 寫（但不能放進 XCTest class 內）。**interoperability** 讓你在一個框架的測試 body 中安全呼叫另一框架的 API，例如重用包裝了 `XCTFail` 的 helper（`assertUnique`）。當回報 API 與所在測試分屬不同框架就產生 **cross-framework issue**，Xcode 27 預設啟用互通並提供四種模式：**limited**（XCTest 的跨框架 issue 為警告，Xcode 27 前的 test plan 沿用此模式）、**complete**（升為 error，新專案預設）、**strict**（直接以 fatal error 中止，幫你找出該換掉的 XCTest API）、**none**（停用，僅建議短暫使用）。在 Swift Package 中也可用，升到 swift-tools-version 6.4 啟用 complete，或用環境變數 `SWIFT_TESTING_XCTEST_INTEROP_MODE` 覆寫。

常見遷移樣式：跳過測試把 `XCTSkip` 換成 `Test.cancel`，更佳作法是用 **trait**（`.enabled(if:)`／`.disabled`）把啟用邏輯移出 body；首次失敗即中止把 `continueAfterFailure = false` 換成 **`#require`**（失敗即丟錯中止，且可逐項選擇是否中止）。遷移後還能享受 Swift Testing 的強化工具：**parameterized tests** 用 `@Test(arguments:)` 把巢狀迴圈拆成各自獨立、平行執行的測試案例，能清楚看出哪組輸入失敗；**exit tests** 用 `#expect(processExitsWith:)` 在子行程中執行會 crash 的程式碼（如 `preconditionFailure`），安全地為這類路徑補上測試覆蓋（限 macOS、Linux、FreeBSD、Windows）。Swift Testing 為開源、由 Testing Workgroup 治理，鼓勵透過 Swift Forums 與 Swift Evolution 參與。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Swift Testing 團隊的 Jerry 開場，回顧 **Swift Testing**（Xcode 16 推出）是表達力強、精簡的現代測試框架，為 Swift concurrency 而生、預設平行執行。本場將回顧基礎、把 Swift Testing 加進 XCTest 專案、用 **interoperability** 重用既有測試碼，並介紹 Swift Testing 的進階能力。

deepdive.title: Swift Testing basics
deepdive.body: 示範基礎：import Testing 與 `@testable import`，用 **`@Test`** 巨集宣告測試函式、用 **`#expect`** 建立期望。`@Test` 與 `#expect` 是多數測試的核心建構塊。

deepdive.title: Name a test using a raw identifier
deepdive.body: Swift 的 **raw identifier**（反引號）讓測試名可含空格與標點，提升較長測試名的可讀性，如 `` `Default climate: tropical` ``。

deepdive.title: Migration strategy
deepdive.body: 遷移策略是小步前進：改舊測試有風險，故大多數 **XCTest 留在原處**，準備好時優先改常更新的測試。同一 target 可同時含兩框架測試，新測試直接用 Swift Testing 寫（但不能放進 XCTest class 內）。

deepdive.title: Wrap XCTFail in a test helper function
deepdive.body: 以鳥類送水果 app 為例，示範把多步驟 assertion 抽成 helper（`assertUnique`），讓測試「說清楚在測什麼」。helper 內用 `XCTFail` 並傳入 file／line 參數，讓 Xcode 把失敗歸因到呼叫 helper 的那一行。

deepdive.title: Test framework interoperability
deepdive.body: 想在 Swift Testing 測試中重用包了 `XCTFail` 的 helper，靠 **interoperability**：可在一框架的測試 body 安全呼叫另一框架的 API。兩個方向都可能產生 **cross-framework issue**，Xcode 27 預設啟用互通來處理。

deepdive.title: Interoperability modes
deepdive.body: 說明四種模式：**limited**（XCTest 跨框架 issue 為警告，Xcode 27 前 test plan 沿用）、**complete**（升為 error，新專案預設）、**strict**（fatal error 中止，找出該替換的 XCTest API）、**none**（停用，僅短暫使用）。可在 Test Plan Settings 的 Test Execution 切換。來自 Swift Testing 的跨框架 issue 在所有模式都維持 error。

deepdive.title: Replace XCTFail with Issue.record in the test helper
deepdive.body: 示範把 helper 從 XCTest 遷到 Swift Testing：改 import、把 **`XCTFail` 換成 `Issue.record`**，並用 **`sourceLocation`** 取代原本的 file／line 參數，讓新舊測試都如預期失敗。

deepdive.title: Run Swift Package tests with the strict interoperability mode from Terminal
deepdive.body: 在 Swift Package 也可用互通：Swift 6.4 toolchain 預設 limited，升到 **swift-tools-version 6.4** 啟用 complete；用環境變數 **`SWIFT_TESTING_XCTEST_INTEROP_MODE`**（值為小寫模式名）從終端機覆寫，搭配 `swift test` 執行。

deepdive.title: Common migration patterns
deepdive.body: 進入常見遷移樣式段落，提供把 XCTest 慣用寫法轉成 Swift Testing 的實務技巧。

deepdive.title: Common migration: skipping tests
deepdive.body: 跳過測試：XCTest 的 `XCTSkip` 換成 **`Test.cancel`**；新測試更建議用 **trait**（`.enabled(if:)` 或 `.disabled`）把啟用邏輯移出測試 body。

deepdive.title: Common migration: halting after test failures
deepdive.body: 首次失敗即中止：XCTest 設 `continueAfterFailure = false`；Swift Testing 改用 **`#require`**，失敗即丟錯中止測試，且可逐項選擇哪些期望會中止、哪些不會。

deepdive.title: Parameterized tests
deepdive.body: 介紹 **parameterized tests**：以不同引數重複執行，每組引數成為獨立測試案例，且預設平行執行、比序列更快。

deepdive.title: Example of nested loops which can be converted into a parameterized @Test function
deepdive.body: 以鳥類拍翅測試（每隻鳥拍 40~100 次）為例，原本用**巢狀迴圈**產生所有組合；執行慢、失敗時還看不出是哪隻鳥失敗。

deepdive.title: Refactor nested loops into a parameterized @Test function
deepdive.body: 把迴圈移除，將 bird 與 count 定為**測試函式參數**，用 `@Test(arguments:)` 提供輸入，Swift Testing 自動配對並平行執行。結果幾乎瞬間完成，且可在 Test navigator 過濾出失敗組合（swallow 拍不到 43 次）。

deepdive.title: Exit tests
deepdive.body: 介紹 **exit tests**（限 macOS、Linux、FreeBSD、Windows）：用來為會使行程結束的程式碼（如 `preconditionFailure`）補測試覆蓋。

deepdive.title: Precondition check on empty input name in an initializer
deepdive.body: 在 `Bird.init` 中，空名稱會以 `preconditionFailure` 中止程式；用 Code Coverage 檢視可見該行為紅色（未被任何測試執行）。

deepdive.title: Add coverage for precondition failure with exit test
deepdive.body: 用 **`#expect(processExitsWith: .failure)`** 定義 exit test，body 內建立空名稱的 Bird。Swift Testing 在**子行程**執行該段，crash 不影響其他測試，等待子行程結束並檢查 exit status。執行後覆蓋率該行轉綠，代表已被測試。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結無痛遷移之道：不急著改舊 XCTest、新測試用 Swift Testing、靠互通重用 helper 並逐步把 XCTest API 換成 Swift Testing API，升到 complete 或 strict 模式。Swift Testing 為**開源**、屬 SwiftLang 組織、由 Testing Workgroup 治理，今年起完整支援 FreeBSD，鼓勵透過 Swift Forums 與 Swift Evolution 參與。

summary_en: **Swift Testing**, introduced in Xcode 16, is a modern testing library with a concise, expressive interface built for Swift concurrency (tests run in parallel by default for faster results). Presented by Jerry from the Swift Testing team, the core message is that in **Xcode 27**, the new **test framework interoperability** lets you fearlessly coexist with existing XCTest and migrate gradually. The building blocks: declare tests with the `@Test` macro and create expectations with `#expect` (replacing most XCTest assertions), while the unconditional `XCTFail` maps to **`Issue.record`**; `@Test` also supports backtick raw identifiers for readable test names with spaces. A few scenarios stay in XCTest: UI automation, performance testing, and handling Objective-C exceptions.

The migration strategy is small steps: leave most XCTests in place, modifying them a few at a time when ready, prioritizing the ones you update most; write new tests directly in Swift Testing (just not inside an XCTest class). **Interoperability** lets you safely call one framework's API from the other's test body—for example reusing a helper (`assertUnique`) that wraps `XCTFail`. When the issue-reporting API and the test belong to different frameworks you get a **cross-framework issue**; Xcode 27 enables interoperability by default with four modes: **limited** (XCTest cross-framework issues are warnings; pre-Xcode 27 test plans inherit this), **complete** (elevated to errors; default for new projects), **strict** (halts with a fatal error to surface XCTest API to replace), and **none** (opt out, only temporarily). It also works in Swift Packages—bump to swift-tools-version 6.4 for complete, or override via the `SWIFT_TESTING_XCTEST_INTEROP_MODE` environment variable.

Common migration patterns: for skipping tests, replace `XCTSkip` with `Test.cancel`, though preferring a **trait** (`.enabled(if:)`/`.disabled`) to move enablement logic out of the body; for halting on first failure, replace `continueAfterFailure = false` with **`#require`** (it throws to halt, and lets you choose per-expectation whether to halt). After migrating, enjoy Swift Testing's power tools: **parameterized tests** use `@Test(arguments:)` to turn nested loops into independent, parallel test cases that clearly show which input failed; **exit tests** use `#expect(processExitsWith:)` to run crashing code (like `preconditionFailure`) in a child process, safely adding coverage for such paths (macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, Windows only). Swift Testing is open source, governed by the Testing Workgroup, and they encourage contributing via the Swift Forums and Swift Evolution.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Jerry from the Swift Testing team opens by reviewing **Swift Testing** (introduced in Xcode 16) as an expressive, concise modern testing library built for Swift concurrency that runs tests in parallel by default. The session reviews basics, adds Swift Testing to an XCTest project, reuses test code via **interoperability**, and previews Swift Testing's advanced features.

deepdive_en.title: Swift Testing basics
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates the basics: import Testing with `@testable import`, declare a test function with the **`@Test`** macro, and create an expectation with **`#expect`**. `@Test` and `#expect` are the core building blocks for most tests.

deepdive_en.title: Name a test using a raw identifier
deepdive_en.body: Swift's **raw identifiers** (backticks) let test names include spaces and punctuation, improving readability of longer names like `` `Default climate: tropical` ``.

deepdive_en.title: Migration strategy
deepdive_en.body: The strategy is small steps: modifying old tests carries risk, so leave most **XCTests in place** and prioritize frequently updated ones when ready. A single target can hold both frameworks' tests; write new tests in Swift Testing (just not inside an XCTest class).

deepdive_en.title: Wrap XCTFail in a test helper function
deepdive_en.body: Using a bird fruit-delivery app, shows extracting a multi-step assertion into a helper (`assertUnique`) so the test clearly states what it tests. The helper uses `XCTFail` with file/line parameters so Xcode attributes the failure to the helper's call site.

deepdive_en.title: Test framework interoperability
deepdive_en.body: To reuse the `XCTFail`-wrapping helper in a Swift Testing test, use **interoperability**: safely call one framework's API from the other's test body. Both directions can create a **cross-framework issue**, which Xcode 27 handles with interoperability enabled by default.

deepdive_en.title: Interoperability modes
deepdive_en.body: Explains four modes: **limited** (XCTest cross-framework issues are warnings; pre-Xcode 27 test plans inherit it), **complete** (errors; default for new projects), **strict** (fatal error halt to find XCTest API to replace), and **none** (opt out, temporary only). Change it under Test Execution in Test Plan Settings. Cross-framework issues from Swift Testing remain errors in all modes.

deepdive_en.title: Replace XCTFail with Issue.record in the test helper
deepdive_en.body: Shows migrating the helper to Swift Testing: change the import, replace **`XCTFail` with `Issue.record`**, and use **`sourceLocation`** instead of the original file/line parameters, so both old and new tests fail as expected.

deepdive_en.title: Run Swift Package tests with the strict interoperability mode from Terminal
deepdive_en.body: Interoperability works in Swift Packages too: the Swift 6.4 toolchain defaults to limited; bump to **swift-tools-version 6.4** for complete; override from the terminal with the **`SWIFT_TESTING_XCTEST_INTEROP_MODE`** environment variable (lowercase mode name) when running `swift test`.

deepdive_en.title: Common migration patterns
deepdive_en.body: Begins the common-patterns segment, offering practical tips for converting XCTest idioms to Swift Testing.

deepdive_en.title: Common migration: skipping tests
deepdive_en.body: Skipping tests: replace XCTest's `XCTSkip` with **`Test.cancel`**; for new tests, prefer a **trait** (`.enabled(if:)` or `.disabled`) to move enablement logic out of the body.

deepdive_en.title: Common migration: halting after test failures
deepdive_en.body: Halting on first failure: XCTest sets `continueAfterFailure = false`; Swift Testing uses **`#require`**, which throws to halt the test, and lets you choose per-expectation which ones halt and which don't.

deepdive_en.title: Parameterized tests
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **parameterized tests**: they repeat with different arguments, each becoming a separate test case, and run in parallel by default—faster than serial.

deepdive_en.title: Example of nested loops which can be converted into a parameterized @Test function
deepdive_en.body: Using a bird wing-flap test (each bird flaps 40–100 times), the original uses **nested loops** to generate all combinations; it runs slowly and can't tell which bird failed.

deepdive_en.title: Refactor nested loops into a parameterized @Test function
deepdive_en.body: Remove the loops, define bird and count as **test function parameters**, and supply inputs via `@Test(arguments:)`; Swift Testing pairs them and runs in parallel. It finishes almost instantly, and the Test navigator can filter failing combinations (the swallow can't flap under 43 times).

deepdive_en.title: Exit tests
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **exit tests** (macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, Windows only): used to add coverage for code that terminates the process (like `preconditionFailure`).

deepdive_en.title: Precondition check on empty input name in an initializer
deepdive_en.body: In `Bird.init`, an empty name halts via `preconditionFailure`; Code Coverage shows that line in red (run by no test).

deepdive_en.title: Add coverage for precondition failure with exit test
deepdive_en.body: Define an exit test with **`#expect(processExitsWith: .failure)`**, creating a Bird with an empty name in the body. Swift Testing runs it in a **child process** so the crash is isolated, waits for it to finish, and checks the exit status. Afterward the coverage line turns green, indicating it's tested.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Summarizes fearless migration: don't rush to change old XCTests, write new tests in Swift Testing, reuse helpers via interoperability and gradually replace XCTest API with Swift Testing API, upgrading to complete or strict mode. Swift Testing is **open source** under the SwiftLang org, governed by the Testing Workgroup, with full FreeBSD support this year; contribute via the Swift Forums and Swift Evolution.

title: Profile, fix, and verify: Improve app responsiveness with Instruments
gloss: 用 Instruments 剖析、修正並驗證 App 反應速度
takeaway: 用 Swift Concurrency instrument、Time Profiler 與 System Trace 建立「剖析→修正→驗證」的流程,把卡頓工作移出 main actor 來提升反應速度。
chapters: Add signpost interval around Lasso Selection

points.text: 建立清楚的**診斷流程(profile → fix → verify)**,用 **Swift Concurrency instrument、Time Profiler、System Trace** 三件工具搭配。
用 **OSSignposter** 標出關鍵區間(如 Lasso Selection),讓取樣資料更容易對應到實際操作。
比較 **existential(any Foo)、concrete types、generics、enums** 對效能的影響,協助選擇正確的型別表示。
把昂貴工作標成 **@concurrent** 移出 main actor:例如縮圖渲染從 Task 改為 Task { @concurrent } 可避免阻塞 UI。
**System blocking / 檔案寫入**也應移出主執行緒:把 PropertyListEncoder 編碼與 data.write 放進 Task { @concurrent }。

audience: **遇到捲動卡頓、UI 反應遲鈍,想系統化用 Instruments 找出並修正主執行緒瓶頸的 Swift 開發者。**
gloss_en: Profile, fix, and verify: Improve app responsiveness with Instruments
takeaway_en: Use the Swift Concurrency instrument, Time Profiler, and System Trace to build a profile-fix-verify workflow, moving stuttering work off the main actor to improve responsiveness.

points_en.text: Establish a clear **diagnostic workflow (profile → fix → verify)**, pairing the three tools: **Swift Concurrency instrument, Time Profiler, and System Trace**.
Use **OSSignposter** to mark key intervals (such as Lasso Selection) so sampled data maps more easily to actual operations.
Compare the performance impact of **existentials (any Foo), concrete types, generics, and enums** to help choose the right type representation.
Mark expensive work as **@concurrent** to move it off the main actor: for example, changing thumbnail rendering from Task to Task { @concurrent } avoids blocking the UI.
**System blocking / file writes** should also move off the main thread: put PropertyListEncoder encoding and data.write inside Task { @concurrent }.

audience_en: Swift developers **facing scroll stutter or sluggish UI who want to systematically use Instruments to find and fix main-thread bottlenecks**.
summary: 由 Xcode 團隊的 Art 與 Instruments 團隊的 Harjas 共同主講，主題是用 **Instruments 27** 系統化地診斷與修復 app 的反應性（responsiveness）問題。講者先建立一套心智模型：你寫的 Swift 程式碼其實隱藏了 dynamic dispatch、safety checks、reference counting，再往下依賴 OS 的記憶體配置、行程排程與 I/O，最後才到硬體。掉幀或卡頓（hang）時的第一步永遠是 **Time Profiler**——若 CPU 使用率高，代表程式碼執行過久（程式碼效能瓶頸）；若 CPU 閒置卻仍卡住，代表 main thread 在等待某項資源（File I/O、同步鎖、IPC）。

全場以一個正在原型開發的筆記 app 為例，重現三個 hang：存檔不靈敏、捲動不流暢、套索（lasso）工具卡頓。重點實務原則是務必對 **release build** 進行 profiling，並善用 **os_signpost**（透過 `OSSignposter` 標記 interval，設定 subsystem 與 category 為 points of interest）讓事件自動出現在時間軸上，便於把 trace 過濾到特定時段。Instruments 27 的介面有時間軸、依選取而變的 detail 區，以及全新的 Inspector 面板。

三個 hang 對應三種症狀與解法。第一個套索 hang 的 main thread CPU 接近 100%，用新的 **Top Functions** 模式（以 self weight 把分散在各 call path 的同一函式合併）找出兇手是 `swift_project_boxed_opaque_existential`——也就是 existential（`any` 協定型別）的拆箱成本太高；改用 concrete types 與 generics 後，再以全新的 **Run Comparisons** 直接在同一份文件中比對 baseline 與優化後的 trace，綠色代表改善、紅色代表退化，確認 overhead 已消除。第二個捲動 hang 用新的 **Swift executors instrument** 看出多個 renderThumbnail task 全擠在 **Main Actor** 上，替 task 加上 **@concurrent** 屬性即可移到 global executor 並行渲染。

第三個存檔 hang 的 CPU 反而只有約 20%，代表 main thread 被「阻塞（blocked）」而非忙碌。講者用 **System Trace** 模板觀察執行緒的 running／runnable／blocked 狀態轉換，發現一個 write system call 橫跨 on-core 與 off-core 時間；Inspector 顯示它正在 main thread 上同步寫入超過 **1.7 GB** 資料、耗時逾 500ms（其中近 300ms 在等磁碟）。把 `data.write` 包進 `Task { @concurrent }` 移到背景後即解除阻塞。總結：依症狀挑工具——CPU 過載用 Top Functions、資源爭用用 Swift Concurrency instrument、執行緒閒置卡住用 System Trace；並謹記永遠 profile release build、用 os_signpost 標好可靠的 interval。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Art 與 Harjas 開場，點出流暢的 UI 是好 app 的基本盤，但背後牽涉整個軟體堆疊。強調即使簡單的程式碼也隱藏 compiler 與 runtime 注入的 **dynamic dispatch、safety checks、reference counting**，再往下依賴 OS 與硬體；**Instruments 27** 的目標就是讓人更容易看懂並優化這些層次。

deepdive.title: Diagnostic flow
deepdive.body: 建立核心診斷流程：掉幀或卡頓時先用 **Time Profiler** 取得高階全貌。CPU 高 → 程式碼跑太久，靠重構演算法或把工作移到背景解決；CPU 閒置卻仍卡 → main thread 在等資源（**File I/O、同步鎖、IPC**），而 Time Profiler 只看活躍 CPU 週期、看不到這類阻塞。並介紹將用一個筆記 app 重現三個 hang。

deepdive.title: Add signpost interval around Lasso Selection
deepdive.body: 示範用 **OSSignposter** 在套索選取前後標記一個 interval（`beginInterval`／`endInterval`），subsystem 設為 "Demo App"、category 設為 points of interest，讓資料自動出現在 points of interest track。接著可在時間軸上找到該 interval 並用 context menu 把 trace 過濾到此時段，確認 main thread CPU 接近 100%。

deepdive.title: Sampling data visualization
deepdive.body: Art 解釋 Time Profiler 如何把原始執行轉成 call tree：用硬體計時器（預設每 1ms）對所有核心取樣當前 call stack，每個函式累加 weight、堆疊最底的函式得到 self-weight。極快、在兩次取樣間就結束的呼叫（如 `swift_retain`）可能完全不被記錄。

deepdive.title: Existentials
deepdive.body: 對應介紹中的 call tree／flame graph 概念與 existential 主題。flame graph 把 call tree 映成空間區塊（垂直為 call stack、水平為彙總 CPU 時間、越寬越貴）；但被到處呼叫的 runtime 函式其成本會被拆散到各分支，難以判斷誰最耗時——這正是 Top Functions 要解決的問題。並以 `any Foo` 說明 existential。

deepdive.title: Concrete Types
deepdive.body: 示範用 **concrete types** 取代 existential 的替代寫法：為每個具體型別（TypeA、TypeB）各自提供多載函式，讓編譯器掌握更多資訊以做更佳最佳化。

deepdive.title: Concrete Types + Generics
deepdive.body: 進一步加入 **generics**（`func bar<T: Foo>(_:)`）作為兼顧彈性與效能的替代方案，避免 existential 的拆箱開銷；並提及可參考 WWDC22 的 "Embrace Swift generics"。

deepdive.title: Concrete Types + Generics + Enums
deepdive.body: 補上第三種替代方案 **enums**（以 case 包裝不同具體型別），在合適情境下也能取代 existential，同樣給編譯器更多資訊以利最佳化。

deepdive.title: Execution contention
deepdive.body: 回到資料分析：flame graph 顯示時間分散在 canvas 渲染的多條 codepath、沒有單一明顯瓶頸。改用新的 **Top Functions** 模式（以 self weight 合併各處節點），找出最耗時的是 `swift_project_boxed_opaque_existential`，於是請 Xcode coding assistant 把繪圖碼改用 concrete types 與 generics，再以 **Run Comparisons** 在同份文件中比對 baseline 與優化後 trace（紅退化、綠改善），確認該 overhead 已完全移除。

deepdive.title: Thumbnail Rendering
deepdive.body: 處理第二個 hang：對應的 points of interest 沒有 log，改用 Instruments 27 全新的 **Swift executors instrument** 觀察 Main Actor。發現每次 hang 都有名為 renderThumbnail 的 Swift task 在 **Main Actor** 上各跑數百 ms，且 CPU 仍接近 100%——這些 task 因從 SwiftUI 呼叫而繼承了 Main Actor context，與關鍵 UI 更新爭用資源。

deepdive.title: Thumbnail Rendering Off Main Actor
deepdive.body: 解法是把縮圖渲染移出 Main Actor：在 `Task` initializer 加上 **@concurrent** 屬性，讓它移到 global executor；Swift 編譯器會檢查此改動不引入 race condition。更新後的 trace 中，渲染 task 已從 Main Actor track 移到 global executor track，不僅消除 hang 還能並行渲染。

deepdive.title: System blocking
deepdive.body: 處理第三個存檔 hang：用 Writing To File signpost interval 定位後發現 CPU 僅約 20%，代表 main thread 是被「阻塞」而非忙碌。講者解說執行緒在 **running／runnable／blocked** 之間的狀態轉換——資源未就緒時 kernel 會把執行緒逐出 CPU，就緒後先進 runnable 排隊等排程器分配核心；那 20% 正是執行緒短暫醒來協調下一階段所致。

deepdive.title: File Saving
deepdive.body: 用 **System Trace** 模板檢視該 hang：activity lane 出現大量空白代表執行緒被阻塞；紫色 interval 是 system call，點選會一併高亮整個橫跨 on-core 與 off-core 的連續 write call。Inspector 顯示其參數——file descriptor、buffer 位址、以及最關鍵的 size，正在 main thread 上同步寫入逾 **1.7 GB**，單次操作耗時逾 500ms、其中近 300ms 在等磁碟。

deepdive.title: File Saving off Main thread
deepdive.body: 示範修復：原本用 `PropertyListEncoder` 序列化後在 main thread 上同步呼叫 `data.write(options: .atomic)`，正是阻塞元兇。把整段編碼與寫檔包進 `Task { @concurrent }` 移到背景 thread pool，即可解除 Main Actor 阻塞；新 trace 中 main thread 不再有 write system call，該 syscall 出現在背景執行緒上。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結：依症狀匹配工具——CPU 過載用 **Top Functions** 找分散的軟體 overhead、用 **Run Comparison** 驗證改善；task 爭用資源用 **Swift Concurrency instrument** 找 actor 壅塞；執行緒閒置卡住用 **System Trace** 與 Inspector 揪出同步阻塞（如 file I/O）。並再次強調永遠 profile release build、用 os_signpost 確保 interval 可靠；延伸推薦 WWDC23 "Analyze hangs with Instruments"。

summary_en: Presented jointly by Art from the Xcode team and Harjas from the Instruments team, this session shows how to diagnose and fix app responsiveness problems systematically with **Instruments 27**. They first establish a mental model: the Swift you write hides dynamic dispatch, safety checks, and reference counting, then relies on the OS for memory, scheduling, and I/O, and finally on hardware. When an app drops frames or hangs, the first stop is always the **Time Profiler**: high CPU means code is taking too long (a code bottleneck), while a hang with an idle CPU means the main thread is blocked waiting on a resource (File I/O, a lock, or IPC).

The whole talk works through a prototype note-taking app that exhibits three hangs: unresponsive saving, janky scrolling, and a stuttering lasso tool. Two key practices: always profile a **release build**, and use **os_signpost** (mark an interval with `OSSignposter`, setting subsystem and category to points of interest) so events show up on the timeline and you can filter the trace to a specific window. The Instruments 27 UI has a timeline, a selection-driven detail area, and a brand-new Inspector panel.

Each hang maps to a distinct symptom and fix. For the lasso hang the main thread sits near 100% CPU; the new **Top Functions** mode (which merges the same function scattered across call paths by self weight) reveals the culprit is `swift_project_boxed_opaque_existential`, the cost of unwrapping existentials (the `any` protocol type). After switching to concrete types and generics, the new **Run Comparisons** feature diffs the baseline and optimized traces in a single document, marking improvements green and regressions red, confirming the overhead is gone. For the scrolling hang, the new **Swift executors instrument** shows multiple renderThumbnail tasks crowding the **Main Actor**; adding the **@concurrent** attribute moves them onto the global executor to render in parallel.

The save hang shows only ~20% CPU, meaning the main thread is blocked rather than busy. Using the **System Trace** template to watch running/runnable/blocked transitions, they find a write system call spanning on- and off-core time; the Inspector reveals it is synchronously writing over **1.7 GB** on the main thread, taking more than 500ms (nearly 300 of them waiting on disk). Wrapping `data.write` in a `Task { @concurrent }` moves it to the background and unblocks the UI. The takeaway: match the tool to the symptom: Top Functions for CPU overload, the Swift Concurrency instrument for contention, System Trace for idle-thread blocking, and always profile a release build with reliable os_signpost intervals.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Art and Harjas open by noting that a fluid UI is the baseline for a great app, yet a lot happens behind the scenes. They stress that even simple code hides compiler- and runtime-injected **dynamic dispatch, safety checks, and reference counting**, then relies on the OS and hardware; **Instruments 27** aims to make these layers easier to understand and optimize.

deepdive_en.title: Diagnostic flow
deepdive_en.body: Establishes the core flow: when frames drop or the app hangs, start with the **Time Profiler** for a high-level view. High CPU means code is taking too long, fixed by refactoring algorithms or offloading work; an idle CPU during a hang means the main thread is waiting on a resource (**File I/O, a lock, or IPC**), which the Time Profiler can't see since it only watches active CPU cycles. Introduces the note-taking app with three hangs.

deepdive_en.title: Add signpost interval around Lasso Selection
deepdive_en.body: Demos using **OSSignposter** to mark an interval around lasso selection (`beginInterval`/`endInterval`), with subsystem "Demo App" and category points of interest so it surfaces automatically in the points of interest track. The interval can then be found on the timeline and used to filter the trace, confirming the main thread runs near 100% CPU.

deepdive_en.title: Sampling data visualization
deepdive_en.body: Art explains how the Time Profiler turns raw execution into a call tree: a hardware timer (default 1ms) samples the call stack on every core, each function gains weight and the bottom-most gets self-weight. Very fast calls like `swift_retain` that start and finish between samples may never be recorded.

deepdive_en.title: Existentials
deepdive_en.body: Covers the flame graph and the existential topic. A flame graph maps the call tree to spatial blocks (vertical is the call stack, horizontal is aggregated CPU time, wider is more expensive); but runtime functions called from everywhere have their cost fractured across branches, making it hard to see what burned the most cycles, which is exactly what Top Functions addresses. Illustrates an existential with `any Foo`.

deepdive_en.title: Concrete Types
deepdive_en.body: Shows replacing existentials with **concrete types**: provide overloaded functions for each concrete type (TypeA, TypeB) so the compiler has more information for better optimizations.

deepdive_en.title: Concrete Types + Generics
deepdive_en.body: Adds **generics** (`func bar<T: Foo>(_:)`) as an alternative that keeps flexibility while avoiding existential unboxing overhead; references WWDC22's "Embrace Swift generics" for more.

deepdive_en.title: Concrete Types + Generics + Enums
deepdive_en.body: Adds a third alternative, **enums** (wrapping distinct concrete types in cases), which can replace existentials where appropriate and likewise give the compiler more information to optimize.

deepdive_en.title: Execution contention
deepdive_en.body: Back in the data: the flame graph shows time scattered across canvas-rendering codepaths with no single obvious culprit. The new **Top Functions** mode (merging scattered nodes by self weight) surfaces `swift_project_boxed_opaque_existential` as the top cost, so Xcode's coding assistant rewrites the drawing code to use concrete types and generics, and **Run Comparisons** diffs baseline vs optimized in one document (red regressions, green improvements), confirming the overhead is removed.

deepdive_en.title: Thumbnail Rendering
deepdive_en.body: For the second hang, the points of interest track has no logs, so the new **Swift executors instrument** is used to inspect the Main Actor. It shows a renderThumbnail Swift task running a few hundred ms on the **Main Actor** during each hang, with CPU still near 100%; the tasks inherited the Main Actor context because they were called from SwiftUI, competing with critical UI updates.

deepdive_en.title: Thumbnail Rendering Off Main Actor
deepdive_en.body: The fix moves thumbnail rendering off the Main Actor by adding the **@concurrent** attribute to the `Task` initializer, sending it to the global executor; the Swift compiler verifies the change introduces no data races. In the updated trace the rendering tasks move from the Main Actor track to the global executor track, eliminating the hang and enabling parallel rendering.

deepdive_en.title: System blocking
deepdive_en.body: For the third (save) hang, the Writing To File signpost shows CPU at only ~20%, meaning the main thread is blocked rather than busy. They explain thread transitions among **running/runnable/blocked**: when a resource isn't ready the kernel evicts the thread, and once ready it enters runnable to wait for a core; that 20% is the thread briefly waking to coordinate the next stage.

deepdive_en.title: File Saving
deepdive_en.body: Uses the **System Trace** template: large blank space in the activity lane signals a blocked thread; purple intervals are system calls, and selecting one highlights a single continuous write call spanning on- and off-core time. The Inspector shows its arguments, file descriptor, buffer address, and crucially the size, revealing a synchronous write of over **1.7 GB** on the main thread, costing more than 500ms with nearly 300ms off-core waiting on disk.

deepdive_en.title: File Saving off Main thread
deepdive_en.body: Demos the fix: the code used `PropertyListEncoder` then called `data.write(options: .atomic)` synchronously on the main thread, the exact cause of the block. Wrapping the encode-and-write in a `Task { @concurrent }` pushes it onto the background thread pool and unblocks the Main Actor; the new trace shows no write system call on the main thread, with the syscall now on a background thread.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wraps up: match the tool to the symptom, **Top Functions** to isolate scattered software overhead and **Run Comparison** to verify improvements; the **Swift Concurrency instrument** for actor contention; and **System Trace** with the Inspector to uncover synchronous blocking like file I/O. Reiterates always profiling a release build and using reliable os_signpost intervals, and recommends WWDC23's "Analyze hangs with Instruments."

title: What’s new in SwiftUI
gloss: SwiftUI 的新功能
takeaway: SwiftUI 帶來全新的 Document 協定、可重新排序的清單與格線、更靈活的工具列控制，以及把 @State 改為 macro 以支援延遲初始化。
chapters: Toolbar item visibility and overflow menu
Minimize toolbar on scroll with toolbarMinimizeBehavior
Document creation sources with context parameter
Use the context to create a document
Implement document writing: list writable formats
Implement document writing: represent the snapshot
Implement document writing: provide a DocumentWriter
Implement document reading with ReadableDocument protocol
Add PNG to supported formats list
Apply changes to a reorderable list's data source
AsyncImage with URLRequest and custom URLSession
@State converted to macro for lazy initialization

points.text: 全新的 **Document 協定**（`ReadableDocument`、`WritableDocument`、`DocumentWriter`）讓文件型 App 直接以 `@Observable` 模型讀寫，並支援多格式（如 .png）與寫入進度回報。
工具列更靈活：可用 `visibilityPriority`、`ToolbarOverflowMenu` 控制顯示與溢位，並用 **`toolbarMinimizeBehavior`** 讓工具列隨捲動縮小。
新增**可重新排序**的清單與格線（`reorderable()`、`reorderContainer`），swipe actions 也可套用到 `List` 以外的任何 view。
**`@State` 改為 macro**，支援延遲初始化（只在 view 生命週期建立一次），並可在 `init` 中賦值。
其他改進包含 `appearsActive` 環境值、`Tab(role: .prominent)`、`AsyncImage` 支援 `URLRequest` 與自訂 `URLSession`，以及新的 `@ContentBuilder`。

audience: **所有 SwiftUI 開發者**，特別是開發文件型 App 或想採用最新版面與資料流改進的人。
gloss_en: What's new in SwiftUI
takeaway_en: SwiftUI brings a brand-new Document protocol, reorderable lists and grids, more flexible toolbar control, and turns @State into a macro to support lazy initialization.

points_en.text: The new **Document protocol** (`ReadableDocument`, `WritableDocument`, `DocumentWriter`) lets document-based apps read and write directly with `@Observable` models, supporting multiple formats (such as .png) and write progress reporting.
Toolbars are more flexible: use `visibilityPriority` and `ToolbarOverflowMenu` to control visibility and overflow, and **`toolbarMinimizeBehavior`** to minimize the toolbar as you scroll.
Adds **reorderable** lists and grids (`reorderable()`, `reorderContainer`), and swipe actions can now be applied to any view beyond `List`.
**`@State` becomes a macro**, supporting lazy initialization (created only once per view lifecycle) and allowing assignment in `init`.
Other improvements include the `appearsActive` environment value, `Tab(role: .prominent)`, `AsyncImage` support for `URLRequest` and a custom `URLSession`, and the new `@ContentBuilder`.

audience_en: **All SwiftUI developers**, especially those building document-based apps or wanting to adopt the latest layout and data-flow improvements.
summary: 由 UI Frameworks 工程師 Steven 與 Julia 主講，這場以一個「貼紙 app」為貫穿範例，盤點 **2027 releases** 中 SwiftUI 的重大更新，分為四大主軸：刷新的外觀與工具列、強大的全新 Document API、呈現與互動的改進，以及資料流與效能的提升。最直接的好處是 **Liquid Glass** 的精煉外觀會在以 Xcode 27 重建後自動套用、無需改任何程式碼，並能回應新的 Liquid Glass slider 調整色調；iPhone app 在 iOS 27 也變得可調整大小，Live Previews 新增 resize handle 方便測試。

外觀與工具列方面：用 `appearsActive` 環境值在視窗非作用時降低自訂元件透明度；iPad／Mac 選單列預設精簡圖示，用 `labelStyle(.titleAndIcon)` 讓特定項目顯示圖示；新的 **prominent tab role** 讓購物車等 tab 突出顯示。工具列新增一組可調整大小友善的 API：`visibilityPriority(.high)` 指定空間有限時優先保留哪些按鈕、`ToolbarOverflowMenu` 把不常用動作收進溢位選單、`topBarPinnedTrailing` placement 讓 Share 永不隱藏，並用 `toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown)` 在捲動時自動收起導覽列。

**Document API** 是本場重點：在既有 `FileDocument` 基礎上擴充，搭配 **Observation**（`@Observable`）讓 view 只在依賴的屬性變動時更新。新增 **DocumentCreationSource**（如 blank／photo）讓建立文件時透過 context 參數客製初始流程；寫入端遵循 **`WritableDocument`** 協定（列出 `writableContentTypes`、提供 snapshot、提供符合 **`DocumentWriter`** 的 Writer），其 `write` 方法為 nonisolated async、可比對前後 snapshot 只寫改動部分、並用 Foundation 的 **Subprogress** 回報進度；讀取端用 **`ReadableDocument`**。加 `.png` 到 writable types 並在 writer 中以 Core Graphics 即可額外輸出 PNG。

呈現與互動：新的 **reorderable container** API（`reorderable()` + `reorderContainer(for:)`）讓 List 與 LazyVGrid 用同一段程式碼支援拖曳重排，並首度帶到 watchOS；**swipe actions** 現可用於任何 view（搭配 `swipeActionsContainer()`），且 `confirmationDialog` 與 `alert` 支援 item-binding 樣式。效能與資料流：**AsyncImage** 預設支援 HTTP 快取（尊重伺服器 cache header），並可傳入 `URLRequest` 或自訂 `URLSession`；**`@State` 改為 macro** 使以 State 儲存的類別變為 lazy、整個 view 生命週期只初始化一次（回溯到 iOS 17 起）；新的 **`@ContentBuilder`** 統一多個 builder 型別、大幅改善深層巢狀 view 的型別檢查（編譯）效能。Xcode 27 並附 SwiftUI 相關 agent skills 協助採用新 API。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: UI Frameworks 工程師 Steven 與 Julia 開場，以熱愛貼紙的「貼紙 app」作為貫穿範例。本場將涵蓋 **2027 releases** 中 SwiftUI 的更新：刷新外觀與工具列、新的 **Document API**、呈現與互動改進，以及效能與資料流提升。

deepdive.title: Refreshed look and feel
deepdive.body: 以 Xcode 27 重建即自動套用 **Liquid Glass** 精煉外觀、**無需改程式碼**，並能回應新的 Liquid Glass slider 調整色調；macOS 可把自訂元件標為 interactive 更靈敏。iPad／Mac app 非作用時自動 dim，iOS 27 起 iPhone app 也可調整大小。

deepdive.title: appearsActive environment value
deepdive.body: 用 **`appearsActive`** 環境值微調外觀：sidebar 的自訂帳號按鈕在視窗非作用時降低 opacity，與其他 tab 標籤一同 dim。

deepdive.title: Menu icon visibility
deepdive.body: iPad／Mac 選單列預設只保留關鍵動作的精簡圖示；可對特定項目套用 **`labelStyle(.titleAndIcon)`**（如 Store 選單項）讓其圖示顯示、脫穎而出。

deepdive.title: Prominent tab role
deepdive.body: 用新的 **`Tab(role: .prominent)`** 讓特定 tab 突出顯示——範例的購物車 tab 被放到畫面底部尾端，與含商店內容的其他 tab 區隔。

deepdive.title: Toolbar item visibility and overflow menu
deepdive.body: 新工具列 API 指定空間有限時的取捨：對最重要的 Undo／Redo group 套 **`visibilityPriority(.high)`** 保持可見、把不常用動作放進 **`ToolbarOverflowMenu`**、用 **`topBarPinnedTrailing`** placement 讓 Share 永不隱藏。

deepdive.title: Minimize toolbar on scroll with toolbarMinimizeBehavior
deepdive.body: 用 **`toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown, for: .navigationBar)`** 讓系統在向下捲動時自動把導覽列收起，瀏覽大量貼紙時騰出更多空間。

deepdive.title: Document-based apps
deepdive.body: Julia 介紹新的 **Document API**：在既有 `FileDocument`／`ReferenceFileDocument` 基礎上擴充。document-based app（如 Pages、Xcode）自帶 Cmd+N／Cmd+O、edited 指示、autosaving 等；本場聚焦三項改進：document creation context、讀寫效能、與直接 URL 存取。

deepdive.title: Document creation sources with context parameter
deepdive.body: 用 **`DocumentCreationSource`** 宣告多個來源（blank、photo），各自加一個 `NewDocumentButton` 到 launch scene；選擇後 SwiftUI 透過 **context 參數** 傳入建立 closure。

deepdive.title: Use the context to create a document
deepdive.body: 在 initializer 檢查 context：若 source 為 photo，文件開啟時即自動呈現照片選取器，讓使用者一鍵就能在照片上貼貼紙。

deepdive.title: Document app declaration
deepdive.body: 在 app body 以 **`DocumentGroup`** 作為第一個 Scene 加入 document 架構，並用 **`@Observable`** 的 `StickerDocument` 類別描述文件型別；搭配 Observation 讓 view 只在依賴屬性變動時更新，獲得效能提升。

deepdive.title: Implement document writing
deepdive.body: 讓文件符合 **`WritableDocument`** 協定以支援寫入，介紹其三項需求：可寫格式清單、提供內容的 snapshot 方法、以及提供 Writer。目標是讓讀寫盡量快速有效率。

deepdive.title: Implement document writing: list writable formats
deepdive.body: 第一項需求：宣告 **`writableDocumentTypes`**（如自訂的 `.stickerDocument`，以 `UTType(exportedAs:)` 定義），列出 app 能寫的格式。

deepdive.title: Implement document writing: provide snapshot
deepdive.body: 第二項需求：實作 **`snapshot(contentType:)`** 回傳當下文件內容；範例用 `@MainActor`、回傳 `sending PageSnapshot`，作為單一時間點的內容快照。

deepdive.title: Implement document writing: represent the snapshot
deepdive.body: 用自訂 **`PageSnapshot`** struct 代表內容——背景圖、貼紙座標（`StickerPlacements`）與貼紙本身，包含寫入所需的一切。

deepdive.title: Implement document writing: provide a DocumentWriter
deepdive.body: 第三項需求：提供符合 **`DocumentWriter`** 協定的 Writer，傳入請求的 contentType（如 stickerDocument），它知道如何把文件以指定格式寫到磁碟。

deepdive.title: DocumentWriter: Snapshot
deepdive.body: `DocumentWriter` 有 Snapshot 的概念，作為寫入時的內容型別。

deepdive.title: DocumentWriter: PageSnapshot as Snapshot
deepdive.body: 把前面定義的 **`PageSnapshot`** 指定為 Writer 的 `Snapshot` associated type，完美契合寫入需求。

deepdive.title: DocumentWriter protocol implementation
deepdive.body: `DocumentWriter` 唯一需求是 **`write`** 方法：它是 **nonisolated 且 async**，可在背景執行昂貴的磁碟寫入保持 app 回應；藉比對 current 與 previous snapshot，**只寫真正需要更新的部分**。

deepdive.title: Progress reporting during writing
deepdive.body: 即使最佳化後磁碟操作仍可能耗時，SwiftUI 提供 **`progress`** 參數，讓你用 Foundation 的 **`Subprogress`** API 回報寫入進度。

deepdive.title: Implement document reading with ReadableDocument protocol
deepdive.body: 讓文件型別符合 **`ReadableDocument`** 協定以支援讀取，它是 WritableDocument 的對應：兩者都需支援格式清單，WritableDocument 提供 snapshot、ReadableDocument 負責套用；前者的搭檔是 DocumentWriter、後者是 DocumentReader 處理磁碟繁重工作。

deepdive.title: Add PNG to supported formats list
deepdive.body: 要把頁面存成圖片分享給沒有 app 的人，先在 **`writableContentTypes`** 清單加入 **`.png`**。

deepdive.title: Add content type checks
deepdive.body: 因 app 現在能處理多格式，在 `write` 方法中為每種支援型別加 **content type 檢查**（用 `contentType.conforms(to:)` 分流 stickerDocument 與 png）。

deepdive.title: Writing multiple formats including PNG
deepdive.body: PNG 分支用 **Core Graphics**（`CGContext`）把貼紙與背景照片壓平成單一影像寫到 URL。只要再加 content type 就能用任意框架寫出更多格式。

deepdive.title: Presentation and interaction
deepdive.body: 進入呈現與互動段落，介紹 reorderable container、swipe actions、以及 confirmationDialog／alert 的 item-binding 等改進。

deepdive.title: Reorderable list with reorderContainer
deepdive.body: 用 **reorderable container** API：對 ForEach 加 **`reorderable()`**、對 List 加 **`reorderContainer(for:)`**，在 closure 呼叫 helper 套用排序變更，SwiftUI 自動處理拖曳互動與動畫。

deepdive.title: Apply changes to a reorderable list's data source
deepdive.body: helper（`difference.apply`）底層用開源 **swift-collections** 的 `OrderedDictionary` 提交排序變更，依 `destination.position` 計算目的位移並 move keys。

deepdive.title: Reorderable grid with LazyVGrid
deepdive.body: reorderable API 適用任何容器：把同一段 List 程式碼直接搬到 **`LazyVGrid`**，重排程式碼完全不變，即可在不同容器得到相同互動重排行為。

deepdive.title: Swipe actions on List
deepdive.body: 在 List item 套 **`swipeActions`** 並放入 Delete 按鈕，即可滑動移除清單中的貼紙。

deepdive.title: Swipe actions on any view
deepdive.body: iOS 27 起 **swipe actions 可用於任何 view**，不限 List：把 ForEach 移到 `LazyVStack`，加 **`swipeActionsContainer()`** 來協調該 scroll view 中各 item 的滑動動作。

deepdive.title: Confirmation dialog with item binding
deepdive.body: **`confirmationDialog`** 現支援與 sheet 相同的 **item-binding** 樣式：傳入 `item: $stickerToDelete` binding，設值（如點 context menu 的 Delete）即彈出對話框。

deepdive.title: Alert with item binding
deepdive.body: 同樣的 item-binding 樣式也適用於 **`alert`**：傳入 `item:` binding，設值時彈出警示。

deepdive.title: Data flow and performance
deepdive.body: Steven 接手談資料流與效能。許多改進無需改程式碼即生效；謹慎處理資料流動是讓 app 保持回應與流暢的關鍵。

deepdive.title: AsyncImage with URLRequest and custom URLSession
deepdive.body: **`AsyncImage`** 現預設支援標準 **HTTP 快取**（尊重伺服器 cache header），所有 app 自動啟用、捲回頂端不再重新載入。可傳入自訂 **`URLRequest`**（指定 cachePolicy）或用 **`asyncImageURLSession`** 傳入配置了 `URLCache` 的自訂 `URLSession`。

deepdive.title: @State converted to macro for lazy initialization
deepdive.body: **`@State` 改為 macro**：以 State 儲存的類別現為 **lazy**，整個 view 生命週期只初始化一次；先前每次 view 重新初始化都會建立新實例再丟棄。此行為回溯到 `@Observable` 首次推出的 iOS 17／macOS 14 等版本。

deepdive.title: @State macro init assignment error
deepdive.body: State macro 可能造成 source-breaking：若 `@State` 變數同時有預設值、又在 `init` 內賦值，Xcode 會報 use-before-initialization 錯誤。

deepdive.title: Fixed @State macro init assignment error
deepdive.body: 解法是**移除不必要的預設值賦值**（把 `@State private var page: StickerPage` 留待 init 賦值），即可消除該錯誤。

deepdive.title: @ContentBuilder
deepdive.body: 深層巢狀 view 常見「compiler unable to type-check in reasonable time」錯誤，源於 Section／Group／ForEach 各有多個 builder overload 需逐一嘗試。新的 **`@ContentBuilder`** 把常見 builder 統一為單一 builder，留下唯一直接路徑，**大幅改善型別檢查（編譯）效能**；它是 ViewBuilder 的演進，可用於任何最低部署目標。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結行動方案：以 Xcode 27 為 2027 releases 重建專案、檢視刷新後的外觀；若是 document-based app 就導入新 Document API；並試用 Xcode 27 隨附的 **SwiftUI agent skills**（SwiftUI Specialist 與 What's New In SwiftUI），可用 `xcrun agent skills export` 匯出成 markdown 在其他工具使用。

summary_en: Presented by UI Frameworks engineers Steven and Julia, this session uses a 'sticker app' as its running example to survey the major SwiftUI updates in the **2027 releases**, across four themes: a refreshed look and toolbars, a powerful new Document API, presentation and interaction improvements, and data-flow and performance gains. The most immediate benefit is that the refined **Liquid Glass** appearance applies automatically when rebuilt with Xcode 27 with no code changes, and responds to the new Liquid Glass slider for tint; iPhone apps also become resizable in iOS 27, and Live Previews gain resize handles for testing.

On look and toolbars: use the `appearsActive` environment value to dim custom elements when a window is inactive; iPad/Mac menu bars default to minimal icons, with `labelStyle(.titleAndIcon)` to surface a specific item's icon; and the new **prominent tab role** makes tabs like a shopping cart stand out. New resizability-friendly toolbar APIs include `visibilityPriority(.high)` to choose which buttons stay visible when space is tight, `ToolbarOverflowMenu` to keep rare actions in the overflow menu, `topBarPinnedTrailing` placement so Share is never hidden, and `toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown)` to auto-collapse the navigation bar on scroll.

The **Document API** is the centerpiece: it extends the existing `FileDocument` foundation and works with **Observation** (`@Observable`) so views update only when a dependent property changes. A new **DocumentCreationSource** (e.g. blank/photo) lets you customize the initial flow via a context parameter on creation; the write side conforms to **`WritableDocument`** (list `writableContentTypes`, provide a snapshot, provide a Writer conforming to **`DocumentWriter`**), whose `write` method is nonisolated async, can diff current vs. previous snapshots to write only changed parts, and reports progress via Foundation's **Subprogress**; the read side uses **`ReadableDocument`**. Adding `.png` to writable types and using Core Graphics in the writer enables exporting PNG.

Presentation and interaction: the new **reorderable container** API (`reorderable()` + `reorderContainer(for:)`) gives List and LazyVGrid drag-to-reorder with the same code and brings reordering to watchOS for the first time; **swipe actions** now work on any view (with `swipeActionsContainer()`), and `confirmationDialog` and `alert` support the item-binding pattern. Performance and data flow: **AsyncImage** now supports HTTP caching by default (respecting server cache headers) and accepts a `URLRequest` or custom `URLSession`; **`@State` becomes a macro** so class instances stored in State are lazy and initialized once per view lifetime (back-ported to iOS 17+); and the new **`@ContentBuilder`** unifies multiple builder types to dramatically improve type-checking (compile) performance for deeply nested views. Xcode 27 also ships SwiftUI agent skills to help adopt the new APIs.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: UI Frameworks engineers Steven and Julia open with a sticker-loving 'sticker app' as the running example. The session covers SwiftUI updates in the **2027 releases**: a refreshed look and toolbars, the new **Document API**, presentation and interaction improvements, and performance and data-flow gains.

deepdive_en.title: Refreshed look and feel
deepdive_en.body: Rebuilding with Xcode 27 automatically applies the refined **Liquid Glass** appearance with **no code changes**, responding to the new Liquid Glass slider for tint; on macOS you can mark custom elements interactive for more fluid response. iPad/Mac apps dim when inactive, and iPhone apps become resizable in iOS 27.

deepdive_en.title: appearsActive environment value
deepdive_en.body: Use the **`appearsActive`** environment value to fine-tune appearance: the sidebar's custom account button reduces opacity when the window is inactive, dimming alongside the other tab labels.

deepdive_en.title: Menu icon visibility
deepdive_en.body: iPad/Mac menu bars default to a minimal set of icons for key actions; apply **`labelStyle(.titleAndIcon)`** to a specific item (like the Store menu item) to show its icon and make it stand out.

deepdive_en.title: Prominent tab role
deepdive_en.body: Use the new **`Tab(role: .prominent)`** to make a tab stand out—the cart tab is placed at the bottom trailing edge, distinguished from the other content tabs.

deepdive_en.title: Toolbar item visibility and overflow menu
