deepdive.body: 定義讓 widget 令人難忘的三個特質：**glanceable**（如天氣 widget 一眼掌握預報）、**relevant**（如行事曆 widget 隨時間更新顯示下一個事件）與 **personalizable**（如照片回憶 widget）。講者以自製的讀書會 app 為情境，介紹 reading goals、reading log 與 reading schedule 三個 widget。重點說明 widget 透過獨立行程的 **widget extension** 提供給系統，並須以 **app group** 的 shared container 跨行程傳遞資料；內容則以 **timeline** 與其中的 timeline entry 形式提供。

deepdive.title: DailyReadingGoalWidget
deepdive.body: 逐步拆解 reading goals widget 的程式碼。Xcode 建立 widget extension target 時會自動產生骨架，body 回傳 **WidgetConfiguration**；因 widget 自動帶入目前書籍，故選用最單純的 **StaticConfiguration**，需提供 kind、timeline provider 與回傳 View 的 closure，並以 **containerBackground** 標示背景以支援玻璃材質替換。Timeline provider 須提供 snapshot（gallery 以 Atomic Habits 作預覽）、placeholder（同步、用 redacted modifier）與 timeline entry（攜帶激勵訊息、已讀頁數、書名與封面）。Reload policy 採 **atEnd**，因激勵訊息在一天中於不固定時間更新、結束時間未知。

deepdive.title: Supported Families
deepdive.body: Widget extension 與 timeline provider 接好後，便能支援多種 widget family。建議盡量支援多種尺寸讓使用者有更多擺放選擇，並介紹 visionOS 26 引入、macOS/iOS/iPadOS 27 新增的 **system extra large portrait** family，能更完整呈現 app 內容（reading schedule 可重用 medium widget 的資料）。可用 **supportedFamilies** modifier 列出支援的尺寸，新增 family 時可重用同一 widget 與 timeline provider，只需為新尺寸建構合適的 SwiftUI view。

deepdive.title: Integrate with your app
deepdive.body: 說明 widget 是 app 的延伸，可透過三種方式更緊密整合：**deep links**、可設定（configurable）的 widget，以及互動元素（interactive elements）。Widget 預設的互動是開啟 app，這是很好的起點；若 widget 顯示 app 內特定內容，則可進一步提供直達該內容的 deep link。

deepdive.title: Adding deep links
deepdive.body: 回到 reading goals widget 的程式碼，因 widget 顯示目前正在讀的書，講者用 **widgetURL** modifier 指定 deep link URL，URL 中編碼書籍 ID（bookclub://reading/{bookID}），讓 app 啟動時直接導向該書的詳情頁。Deep link 能在 app 與 widget 間移動時保留使用者的情境脈絡。

deepdive.title: Adapt with the system
deepdive.body: 說明 widget 須能適應使用者對系統的客製化。在 iOS 上，系統可被設定為以特定顏色 tint 或採用 clear tint，此時系統會透過玻璃材質渲染 widget、為內容著色並以自適應玻璃效果取代背景，讓 Home Screen 上的所有 widget 視覺一致。SwiftUI 處理了大部分繁重工作，但仍須測試以確保呈現正確。

deepdive.title: Accented rendering mode
deepdive.body: 示範實機測試發現問題：在 clear mode 下 reading goals widget 的書封變成一塊白色方塊，因為在 accented rendering mode 下系統無法正確著色該圖片。解法是在 BookCoverImage view 對圖片套用 **widgetAccentedRenderingMode(.fullColor)**，讓書封以原始全彩呈現。講者強調要在 full color、tinted、clear 各環境測試，記得 iOS widget 也會以 remote widget 出現在 macOS,並善用 SwiftUI previews 與 WidgetKit developer mode 加速迭代。

summary_en: Presented by Jonathan Long, an engineer on the system experience team, this session introduces the fundamentals of **WidgetKit** and how to build your first widget from scratch. Three qualities make widgets memorable: they are **glanceable** (understood at a glance), **relevant** (content matching time, personal patterns, and location), and **personalizable** (configurable with content that matters to you). Whether an app is built with SwiftUI or UIKit, the widgets themselves are built in SwiftUI and provided to the system from a separate **widget extension** process. Because the extension runs separately from your app, you must use a shared container in an **app group** (such as a shared database or user defaults) to pass data from the app to the extension.

A widget's content is delivered through a **timeline**, made up of multiple **timeline entries**, each carrying the data needed to render the view at a specific point in time. Using a book club app's reading goals widget as an example, the talk covers the two configuration types: **AppIntentConfiguration** for user-configurable widgets, and the simplest **StaticConfiguration** that auto-configures with the current book. StaticConfiguration needs a kind (unique identifier), a timeline provider, and a closure returning a View, with the **containerBackground** modifier marking the background so the system can swap in a glass material under colored or clear tints. The timeline provider supplies three states: snapshot (the gallery preview), placeholder (a synchronous, data-free stand-in often built with SwiftUI's redacted modifier), and timeline entries.

Timeline updates are governed by a **reload policy**: **atEnd** (reload when entries are exhausted, suiting the reading goals widget), **afterDate** (reload at a specific known time, suiting the reading schedule widget), and **never** (no automatic reload, suiting the reading log widget that only updates on interaction, triggered via WidgetCenter's reload APIs or a push notification). Best practices include providing multiple entries whenever possible and being aware that the system allocates an update budget based on viewing habits and may throttle frequent foreground reloads. Ephemeral content needing frequent updates and alerting (like a sporting event) should use **Live Activities** instead.

The latter half focuses on integration and adaptation. The **supportedFamilies** modifier lets you support multiple sizes (including the new system extra large portrait family on macOS, iOS, and iPadOS 27), and iOS widgets also appear on CarPlay and as macOS remote widgets. Integration techniques include **widgetURL** for deep links, App Intents for configurable widgets, and buttons and toggles for interactive elements (executed by the system via an App Intent). Finally, the talk stresses testing widgets in full color, tinted, and clear environments; when accented rendering mode can't tint an image correctly (such as a book cover rendering as a white rectangle), **widgetAccentedRenderingMode(.fullColor)** preserves the original colors.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Engineer **Jonathan Long** from the system experience team opens by explaining that widgets surface relevant content in the convenient places people visit most, spanning iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS. The session will cover **WidgetKit** fundamentals, how to build your first widget, how to better integrate your app and widget experience, and how to ensure widgets adapt when the system environment changes, such as to a tinted environment.

deepdive_en.title: Fundamentals
deepdive_en.body: Defines the three qualities that make widgets memorable: **glanceable** (like Weather conveying just enough at a glance), **relevant** (like Calendar updating to show the next event by time), and **personalizable** (like a Photos memory widget). Using a self-built book club app as the running scenario, the talk introduces the reading goals, reading log, and reading schedule widgets. It explains widgets are provided to the system from a separate-process **widget extension**, which must pass data across processes via a shared container in an **app group**, and that content is delivered as a **timeline** of timeline entries.

deepdive_en.title: DailyReadingGoalWidget
deepdive_en.body: Walks through the reading goals widget code. Xcode generates a skeleton when you create the widget extension target, with body returning a **WidgetConfiguration**; because the widget auto-configures to the current book, the simplest **StaticConfiguration** is used, needing a kind, a timeline provider, and a closure returning a View, with **containerBackground** marking the background to support glass material swapping. The provider supplies a snapshot (gallery preview featuring Atomic Habits), a placeholder (synchronous, using the redacted modifier), and timeline entries (carrying the motivational message, pages read, title, and cover). The reload policy is **atEnd**, because the motivational message updates at varied, non-fixed times throughout the day.

deepdive_en.title: Supported Families
deepdive_en.body: Once the widget extension and timeline provider are wired up, many widget families become available. It is recommended to support as many sizes as possible to give people placement choices, and the talk introduces the **system extra large portrait** family (introduced in visionOS 26, new in macOS/iOS/iPadOS 27) that gives a fuller look at app content (the reading schedule reuses the medium widget's data). The **supportedFamilies** modifier lists supported sizes, and adding a family lets you reuse the same widget and timeline provider while building a SwiftUI view suited to the new shape and size.

deepdive_en.title: Integrate with your app
deepdive_en.body: Explains the widget is an extension of your app and can be integrated more tightly through three means: **deep links**, configurable widgets, and interactive elements. The default widget interaction is to open the app, a great starting point; if the widget shows specific content from within the app, it can go further and provide a deep link directly to that content.

deepdive_en.title: Adding deep links
deepdive_en.body: Back in the reading goals widget code, because the widget shows the current book, the presenter uses the **widgetURL** modifier to specify a deep link URL that encodes the book's ID (bookclub://reading/{bookID}), so the app launches directly to that book's details page. Deep links keep people in context as they move between the app and the widget.

deepdive_en.title: Adapt with the system
deepdive_en.body: Explains that widgets must adapt to user customization of the system. On iOS the system can be tinted with a specific color or set to a clear tint, in which case the system renders the widget through a glass material, tinting the content and replacing the background with an adaptive glass effect so all widgets on the Home Screen feel cohesive. SwiftUI does much of the heavy lifting, but the widget still needs testing to confirm it renders as expected.

deepdive_en.title: Accented rendering mode
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates an on-device test revealing a problem: in clear mode the reading goals widget's book cover becomes a large white rectangle, because in accented rendering mode the system cannot accent that image appropriately. The fix is applying **widgetAccentedRenderingMode(.fullColor)** to the image in the BookCoverImage view so covers render in full original color. The presenter stresses testing in full color, tinted, and clear environments, remembering iOS widgets also appear as remote widgets on macOS, and leaning on SwiftUI previews and WidgetKit developer mode to iterate faster.

title: Modernize your UIKit app
gloss: 現代化你的 UIKit App
takeaway: iOS 27 起 iPhone App 在 iPhone Mirroring 與 iPad 上可自由縮放,要全面改用 size class、丟掉一票 legacy API,Xcode 27 還附了能自動改的 agent skill。
chapters: Check available space using view bounds
UIView Body protocols for motion & location
Export Xcode skills for use in other tools

points.text: App 必須能即時適應任意 scene 尺寸;四個要稽核的點:**scene lifecycle、main screen 參照、UI idiom 判斷、interface orientation 判斷**。
**UIScene lifecycle 變成必要**——用最新 SDK 建置時,沒採用的 App 會無法啟動。
**UIScreen.main 不可靠**:改用 windowScene 的 screen、trait collection 的 displayScale、windowScene.effectiveGeometry 取可用空間,並用 registerForTraitChanges 監聽。
UI idiom 與 interface orientation 對 layout 都不再有意義 → **一律改用 size class**(iPhone App 跑在 iPad 仍是 phone idiom 但可縮放;orientation 只是偏好會被忽略)。
導覽列捲動時會自動收合,用 **barMinimizationBehavior** 控制;分頁列新增 sidebar.preferredPlacement 與 prominentTabIdentifier。**.automatic 的 scroll edge effect 視覺有變,之前覆寫成 .soft 的要重新評估**。
Xcode 27 內建 app modernization skill 可自動轉 mainScreen、orientation→size class、遷移 scene lifecycle;xcrun agent skills export 可匯出給其他工具(如 Claude Code)用。

audience: **還在用 UIKit、且有 legacy lifecycle / orientation 假設的成熟專案(像 CUB App)。** 第 10:52「Navigation bars」段落直接對應 iOS 26 導覽列透明問題——很可能就是 scroll edge effect 改版造成的。
gloss_en: Modernize your UIKit app
takeaway_en: Starting in iOS 27, iPhone apps can be freely resized with iPhone Mirroring and on iPad, so you must move fully to size classes, drop a pile of legacy APIs—and Xcode 27 ships an agent skill that can do the migration for you.

points_en.text: Your app must adapt to any scene size on the fly; the four things to audit: **scene lifecycle, main screen references, UI idiom checks, and interface orientation checks**.
**The UIScene lifecycle is now required**—when building with the latest SDK, apps that haven't adopted it will fail to launch.

**UIScreen.main is unreliable**: instead use the windowScene's screen, the trait collection's displayScale, and windowScene.effectiveGeometry for available space, and observe changes with registerForTraitChanges.

UI idiom and interface orientation no longer mean anything for layout → **always use size classes** (an iPhone app running on iPad is still the phone idiom but resizable; orientation is just a preference that gets ignored).

Navigation bars now collapse automatically on scroll, controlled with **barMinimizationBehavior**; tab bars add sidebar.preferredPlacement and prominentTabIdentifier. **The .automatic scroll edge effect looks different now, so reassess anything you previously overrode to .soft.**

Xcode 27's built-in app modernization skill can automatically convert mainScreen, migrate orientation→size class, and migrate the scene lifecycle; xcrun agent skills export can export it for use with other tools (like Claude Code).

audience_en: **Mature projects (like the CUB App) still on UIKit with legacy lifecycle / orientation assumptions.** The 10:52 "Navigation bars" segment maps directly to the iOS 26 transparent navigation bar issue—very likely caused by the scroll edge effect changes.
summary: 這場由 UI Frameworks 團隊的 Michael Ochs 主講，核心訊息是：在 iOS 與 macOS 27，iPhone app 變成**完全可調整大小**——無論是在 Mac 上透過 **iPhone Mirroring** 拉動視窗邊緣，或是 iPhone-only app 跑在 iPad 上，都會像原生 app 一樣自由縮放。因此 app 必須在執行期動態適應任何 scene 尺寸，而不能再依賴固定的螢幕假設。

適應性改造的基礎是從 app lifecycle 遷移到 **scene lifecycle**：用最新 SDK 建置時 **UIScene** 已是必要條件，沒有 **UISceneDelegate** app 將無法啟動。接著要清掉所有對 **main screen** 的引用，改從 window 的 windowScene 動態取得 screen；更好的做法是直接移除 screen 引用，例如以 trait collection 的 **displayScale** 取代 screen scale（搭配 **automatic trait tracking** 或 **registerForTraitChanges**），以 windowScene 的 **effectiveGeometry** 或 view bounds 取代 screen bounds。最關鍵的觀念轉變是：**user interface idiom** 與 **interface orientation** 都不再適合用於任何 layout 決策，應一律改用 **size classes**。遊戲則可用 UIRequiresFullscreen 取得 honor 後的離散式 resizing，每次尺寸變動都切到對應的螢幕配置以維持全畫質。

UI 控制項也有更新。iPhone 的 tab bar 在 iOS 27 可透過 `sidebar.preferredPlacement = .sidebar` 選擇加入 **sidebar**（由系統依空間決定是否顯示，並用 `sidebar.isAvailable` 查詢可用性）；可用 **prominentTabIdentifier** 指定捲動時仍恆常可見的突出 tab；navigation bar 可用 **barMinimizationBehavior** 強制隱藏行為，scroll edge effect 的 `.automatic` 樣式也已更新，先前覆寫過 `.soft` 的設計應重新評估。在 Liquid Glass 下，menu element 的 image 可能預設不顯示，需要時用 **preferredImageVisibility** 覆寫。

在 Apple Intelligence 方面，menu 會自動出現 **Ask Siri** 入口，並可用 **View Annotations API** 將 view 標註為 **AppEntity** 以提供更相關的脈絡；支援 drag and drop 的 app，Siri 會透過 drag delegate 載入內容，因此狀態相關 UI 應移到 sessionDidMove 而非 sessionWillBegin。最後，Xcode 27 新增了 **app modernization skill**，能自動把 main screen 呼叫改成 trait／scene bounds、把 orientation 檢查改成 size class、甚至轉換成 scene lifecycle，並可用 `xcrun agent skills export` 匯出成 markdown 供其他工具使用。實務上的行動：以 iOS 27 SDK 建置，用 Device Hub 的 resizable simulator 測試，並在 macOS 27 的 iPhone Mirroring 上實測。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 UI Frameworks 團隊的 engineering manager **Michael Ochs** 開場，預告本場涵蓋四大主題：**app adaptivity** 需求的重大改變與 iPhone app 完全可調整大小、tab bar／navigation bar／menu 的新 API、如何支援 **Apple Intelligence**，以及一個能自動處理大部分現代化工作的新 agentic skill。

deepdive.title: App adaptivity
deepdive.body: 說明 app 早已身處多種環境——不同螢幕尺寸、並排執行、外接顯示器。iOS 與 macOS 27 進一步強化：**iPhone Mirroring** 讓使用者可自由縮放 iPhone 視窗，iPhone-only app 跑在 iPad 上也完全可調整大小，因此 app 必須在執行期動態適應任何 scene 尺寸。

deepdive.title: Legacy API: App lifecycle
deepdive.body: 適應性的基礎是從 app lifecycle 遷移到 **scene lifecycle**。用最新 SDK 建置時 **UIScene** 已成必要條件，缺少 **UISceneDelegate** app 將無法啟動。講者指引尚未遷移者參考 WWDC25 的「Make your UIKit app more flexible」與相關文件。

deepdive.title: Legacy API: Main screen
deepdive.body: 當 iPhone app 在 Mac 上被 mirror、或在 iPad 上移到外接顯示器時，scene 關聯的 screen 會改變，任何對 **main screen** 的引用都會給出錯誤資訊。應改從 window 的 windowScene 動態取得 screen，並在無法就近取得時把 screen reference 當參數傳入需要的 method。

deepdive.title: Use local screen references
deepdive.body: 示範以 `window?.windowScene?.screen` 動態取得正確的 screen，取代寫死的 main screen。對於 thumbnail 產生這類 method，則把 **UIScreen** 當參數傳入，確保在當前執行環境拿到對的螢幕資訊。

deepdive.title: Replace screen scale with displayScale
deepdive.body: 更好的做法是完全移除 screen 引用。存取螢幕 scale 應改用 trait collection 的 **displayScale**：view 與 view controller 會自動更新 trait collection 並提供合理 fallback。系統還會追蹤 **layoutSubviews**、**drawRect** 等常見覆寫點中用到的 trait，變動時自動重新呼叫，UI 即自動更新。

deepdive.title: Register for trait changes
deepdive.body: 在 automatic trait tracking 不適用之處，可用 **registerForTraitChanges** 觀察特定 trait 變化。範例對 **UITraitDisplayScale** 註冊一個 closure，於變化時 invalidate cache 或更新與該 view 相關的資料。

deepdive.title: Monitor effective geometry changes
deepdive.body: 檢查可用空間不應再用 screen bounds，因為在適應性環境中 scene 的可用空間未必是整個螢幕。改用 windowScene 的 **effectiveGeometry**，並在 scene delegate 實作 `windowScene:didUpdateEffectiveGeometry:` 來監看變化。

deepdive.title: Check available space using view bounds
deepdive.body: 在 view 與 view controller 內部，應以 view 或 superview 的可用尺寸（如 `view.bounds.size`）判斷空間，而非引用 scene bounds。這讓 UI 較不依賴呈現方式，放進 **split view controller** 等其他脈絡時能更好地調整。

deepdive.title: Full-screen mode for games
deepdive.body: 對遊戲而言縮放較具挑戰，因此 iOS 27 起在可調整大小環境仍 honor **UIRequiresFullscreen**，但行為更新為不再完全退出 resizing，而是啟用尊重所支援 interface orientation 的**離散式 resizing**：每次尺寸變動系統就切到對應的螢幕配置，讓遊戲始終以全畫質渲染於可用空間。

deepdive.title: Legacy API: User interface idiom
deepdive.body: **user interface idiom** trait 對任何 layout 決策都已不再有意義。iPhone app 跑在 iPad 或 iPhone Mirroring 上雖完全可調整大小，卻仍以 phone idiom 執行。應停止以 idiom 做 layout 判斷，改用 **size classes**（必要時用周圍 view 的尺寸做更細的控制）。

deepdive.title: Legacy API: Interface orientation
deepdive.body: **interface orientation** 同樣不再適合用於 layout。iOS 27 中所支援的方向只是給系統的偏好，在可調整大小環境會被忽略；iPhone Mirroring 上 app 永遠以 portrait 執行。所有 orientation 檢查都應改用 size classes。講者引用 2014 年 Bruce Nilo 的名言「裝置旋轉只是一次帶動畫的 bounds 變化」呼應此觀念。

deepdive.title: UIView Body protocols for motion & location
deepdive.body: iOS 27 中 **UIView** 也遵循 CoreMotion 與 CoreLocation 的新 **Body protocol**，讓設定 motion 與 location manager 更容易。把它們連接到視覺化資料的 view（如指南針或地圖），可確保資料始終位於正確的座標空間，不受 interface orientation 影響。

deepdive.title: Configure motion and location body
deepdive.body: 示範在 **viewDidLoad** 中把 `motionManager.deviceMotionBody` 與 `locationManager.headingBody` 設為 view。如此一來方向資料自動對齊該 view 的座標空間，無需手動處理旋轉換算。

deepdive.title: Test your resizable iPhone app
deepdive.body: Xcode 27 讓你不必在多個模擬器或裝置上安裝，就能跨不同尺寸迭代。在新的 **Device Hub** app 與 Xcode Previews 中點「enter resize mode」即可拖動邊緣自由縮放；滿意後務必以實機測試 iPhone Mirroring 與 iPad。

deepdive.title: Tab bars and sidebars
deepdive.body: 在 iPad 上 tab bar 可在環境支援時展開為完整 **sidebar** 以呈現更多層級。iPhone 預設在所有尺寸顯示底部 tab bar，iOS 27 起也可選擇加入 sidebar。

deepdive.title: Opt into sidebar layout
deepdive.body: iPhone app 透過設定 tab bar controller 的 `sidebar.preferredPlacement = .sidebar` 選擇加入 sidebar。與 iPad 不同，這是 app 的選擇且 UI 上無法切換；系統會依空間（例如 horizontal size class 為 regular 時）決定是否顯示 sidebar。

deepdive.title: Check sidebar availability
deepdive.body: 用 sidebar 的 **isAvailable** 屬性判斷 sidebar 表現形式目前是否可顯示。若不可用，應把原本要藏在 sidebar 的 UI 改以巢狀 tab 在 app 其他地方呈現。

deepdive.title: Navigation bars
deepdive.body: 切換到 navigation bar 主題。navigation bar 可在捲動時互動式滑出，為內容騰出更多空間，預設在系統定義的條件下 minimize。

deepdive.title: Set prominent tab identifier
deepdive.body: **UITabBarController** 可自訂突出的 tab，該 tab 即使在捲動使 tab bar 收合時仍恆常可見。iOS 27 透過設定 **prominentTabIdentifier**（範例設為 "cart"）讓任一 tab 變得突出。

deepdive.title: Customize bar minimization behavior
deepdive.body: 可在 navigation item 上以 **barMinimizationBehavior** 設為 `.always` 或 `.never` 強制 bar 的最小化行為。若自行處理 safe area 避讓，將 **barMinimizationSafeAreaAdjustment** 設為 `.never` 以免最小化自動更新 inset。此外 scroll edge effect 的 `.automatic` 樣式已更新，先前覆寫過（尤其是 `.soft`）的設計應重新評估。

deepdive.title: Menus
deepdive.body: 在 **Liquid Glass** 的精緻外觀下，設定於 menu element 的 image 在某些脈絡（如 iPadOS 與 macOS 的 menu bar）可能預設不顯示。若仍需顯示，設定 **preferredImageVisibility** 覆寫系統行為，並參考更新後的 HIG 決定何時該顯示。

deepdive.title: Integrate with Apple Intelligence
deepdive.body: iOS 27 的 menu 內建 **Ask Siri** 按鈕，於有相關內容時自動顯示，讓人直接從 app 開啟 Siri 對話。可用新的 **View Annotations API** 把特定 view 標註為 **AppEntity** 以提供更相關資訊；支援 drag and drop 時 Siri 會透過 drag delegate 載入內容，因此有狀態的 UI 應放在 **sessionDidMove** 而非 sessionWillBegin，因為 drag session 可能在無使用者手勢下啟動。

deepdive.title: Agentic coding
deepdive.body: Xcode 27 新增 **app modernization skill**，對前述 adaptivity 任務有深入理解，能依專案脈絡自動完成大量改動：把 main screen 呼叫轉成 traitCollection 或 scene bounds 檢查並加上 invalidation 邏輯、把 orientation 檢查改成 size class、甚至轉換成 scene lifecycle；複雜任務會提出澄清問題，過大的工作則加註解協助追蹤剩餘進度。

deepdive.title: Export Xcode skills for use in other tools
deepdive.body: 可用 `xcrun agent skills export` 把 Xcode 使用的 skill 匯出為 markdown 檔，再匯入到自己的工作流程中於其他工具使用。這類 skill 是為可調整大小環境準備 app 的有力方式。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結行動建議：以 iOS 27 SDK 建置 app、在新的 **Device Hub** app 試用 resizable simulator、並在 macOS 27 的 iPhone Mirroring 上實測，找出需要更有彈性的區域；若喜歡 agentic coding，也試試新 skill 看它能自動完成多少工作。

summary_en: Presented by Michael Ochs of the UI Frameworks team, the core message is that in iOS and macOS 27 iPhone apps become **fully resizable**—whether resized on a Mac via **iPhone Mirroring** by dragging the window edges, or an iPhone-only app running on iPad. Apps must therefore adapt dynamically to any scene size at runtime rather than relying on fixed screen assumptions.

The foundation of adaptivity is migrating from app lifecycle to **scene lifecycle**: building with the latest SDK now requires **UIScene**, and without a **UISceneDelegate** the app will no longer launch. Next, remove all references to the **main screen**—fetch the screen dynamically from the window's windowScene, or better yet remove screen references entirely: replace screen scale with the trait collection's **displayScale** (using **automatic trait tracking** or **registerForTraitChanges**), and replace screen bounds with windowScene's **effectiveGeometry** or view bounds. The key conceptual shift is that the **user interface idiom** and **interface orientation** are no longer meaningful for any layout decision—use **size classes** instead. Games can rely on the now-honored UIRequiresFullscreen for discrete resizing that keeps full render quality at every size.

UI controls also get updates. On iPhone in iOS 27, the tab bar can opt into a **sidebar** via `sidebar.preferredPlacement = .sidebar` (the system decides whether to show it based on space, queryable with `sidebar.isAvailable`); a scroll-persistent **prominentTabIdentifier** can be set; navigation bars expose **barMinimizationBehavior** to force minimization, and the scroll edge effect's `.automatic` style has changed, so prior `.soft` overrides should be re-evaluated. Under Liquid Glass, menu element images may be hidden by default—override with **preferredImageVisibility** when needed.

For Apple Intelligence, menus automatically surface an **Ask Siri** entry point, and the new **View Annotations API** lets you annotate views as **AppEntity** for richer context; for drag-and-drop apps Siri loads content via drag delegate methods, so stateful UI belongs in sessionDidMove rather than sessionWillBegin. Finally, Xcode 27 adds an **app modernization skill** that automatically converts main-screen calls to trait/scene-bounds checks, orientation checks to size classes, and even converts the app to scene lifecycle; it can be exported as markdown with `xcrun agent skills export` for use in other tools. Practical next steps: build with the iOS 27 SDK, test with Device Hub's resizable simulator, and verify in iPhone Mirroring on macOS 27.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: UI Frameworks engineering manager **Michael Ochs** opens, previewing four topics: major changes to **app adaptivity** requirements and fully resizable iPhone apps, new APIs in tab bars/navigation bars/menus, how to support **Apple Intelligence**, and a new agentic skill that automates most of the modernization work.

deepdive_en.title: App adaptivity
deepdive_en.body: Apps already run in many environments—varied screen sizes, side by side, and external displays. iOS and macOS 27 push further: **iPhone Mirroring** lets users freely resize the iPhone window, and an iPhone-only app on iPad is fully resizable, so apps must adjust dynamically to any scene size at runtime.

deepdive_en.title: Legacy API: App lifecycle
deepdive_en.body: The basis of adaptivity is moving from app lifecycle to **scene lifecycle**. Building with the latest SDK now requires **UIScene**, and without a **UISceneDelegate** the app won't launch. Developers who haven't migrated are pointed to WWDC25's "Make your UIKit app more flexible" and the docs.

deepdive_en.title: Legacy API: Main screen
deepdive_en.body: When an iPhone app is mirrored on a Mac or moved to an external display on iPad, the scene's associated screen changes, so any reference to the **main screen** gives incorrect information. Fetch the screen dynamically from the window's windowScene, and pass a screen reference into methods when the context isn't immediately available.

deepdive_en.title: Use local screen references
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates fetching the correct screen via `window?.windowScene?.screen` instead of hardcoding the main screen. For methods like thumbnail generation, pass a **UIScreen** as a parameter so the correct screen info is used for the current environment.

deepdive_en.title: Replace screen scale with displayScale
deepdive_en.body: Better still, remove screen references entirely. Replace screen scale with the trait collection's **displayScale**: views and view controllers update their trait collections automatically with reasonable fallbacks. The system also tracks traits used inside common override points like **layoutSubviews** and **drawRect**, re-invoking them on change so the UI updates automatically.

deepdive_en.title: Register for trait changes
deepdive_en.body: Where automatic trait tracking isn't available, use **registerForTraitChanges** to observe specific trait changes. The example registers a closure on **UITraitDisplayScale** to invalidate a cache or update view-related data when it changes.

deepdive_en.title: Monitor effective geometry changes
deepdive_en.body: Don't use screen bounds to check available space, since in an adaptive environment the scene's space isn't always the full screen. Use windowScene's **effectiveGeometry**, and implement `windowScene:didUpdateEffectiveGeometry:` in the scene delegate to monitor changes.

deepdive_en.title: Check available space using view bounds
deepdive_en.body: Inside views and view controllers, determine space from the view's or superview's available size (e.g. `view.bounds.size`) rather than referencing scene bounds. This makes the UI less dependent on presentation and adjusts better in other contexts like a **split view controller**.

deepdive_en.title: Full-screen mode for games
deepdive_en.body: Because resizing is challenging for games, iOS 27 honors **UIRequiresFullscreen** in resizable environments but with updated behavior: instead of fully opting out of resizing, it enables **discrete resizing** that respects supported interface orientations—each size change transitions the scene to a matching screen configuration so the game always renders at full quality.

deepdive_en.title: Legacy API: User interface idiom
deepdive_en.body: The **user interface idiom** trait is no longer meaningful for any layout decision. An iPhone app on iPad or in iPhone Mirroring is fully resizable yet still runs under the phone idiom. Stop checking the idiom for layout—use **size classes** instead (and the surrounding view's size for finer control).

deepdive_en.title: Legacy API: Interface orientation
deepdive_en.body: **Interface orientation** is likewise no longer useful for layout. In iOS 27 supported orientation is just a preference and is ignored in resizable environments; in iPhone Mirroring the app always runs in portrait. All orientation checks should switch to size classes, echoing Bruce Nilo's 2014 line that "a device rotation is only an animated bounds change."

deepdive_en.title: UIView Body protocols for motion & location
deepdive_en.body: In iOS 27 **UIView** conforms to the new **Body protocols** from CoreMotion and CoreLocation, making it easier to configure motion and location managers. Connecting them to the view that visualizes the data (a compass or map) keeps the data in the correct coordinate space regardless of interface orientation.

deepdive_en.title: Configure motion and location body
deepdive_en.body: Shows setting `motionManager.deviceMotionBody` and `locationManager.headingBody` to the view in **viewDidLoad**. Orientation data then automatically aligns to that view's coordinate space without manual rotation handling.

deepdive_en.title: Test your resizable iPhone app
deepdive_en.body: Xcode 27 lets you iterate across sizes without installing on multiple simulators or devices. In the new **Device Hub** app and Xcode Previews, click "enter resize mode" to drag the edges and resize freely; once satisfied, test iPhone Mirroring and iPad on real devices.

deepdive_en.title: Tab bars and sidebars
deepdive_en.body: On iPad a tab bar can expand into a full **sidebar** when the environment supports it, surfacing more of the app hierarchy. iPhone shows the bottom tab bar across all sizes by default, and new in iOS 27 can also opt into sidebars.

deepdive_en.title: Opt into sidebar layout
deepdive_en.body: An iPhone app opts in by setting the tab bar controller's `sidebar.preferredPlacement = .sidebar`. Unlike iPad this is an app choice with no UI toggle; the system decides whether to show the sidebar based on space, such as when the horizontal size class is regular.

deepdive_en.title: Check sidebar availability
deepdive_en.body: Use the sidebar's **isAvailable** property to determine whether the sidebar representation can currently be shown. If unavailable, surface the UI intended for the sidebar behind nested tabs elsewhere in the app.

deepdive_en.title: Navigation bars
deepdive_en.body: Switches to navigation bars, which can interactively slide away as people scroll to give content more room, minimizing by default under system-defined conditions.

deepdive_en.title: Set prominent tab identifier
deepdive_en.body: **UITabBarController** lets you customize the prominent tab, which stays visible even when the tab bar collapses during scrolling. In iOS 27, set **prominentTabIdentifier** (example: "cart") to make any tab prominent.

deepdive_en.title: Customize bar minimization behavior
deepdive_en.body: Force the navigation item's minimization with **barMinimizationBehavior** set to `.always` or `.never`. If you handle safe-area avoidance yourself, set **barMinimizationSafeAreaAdjustment** to `.never` so minimization doesn't auto-update insets. The scroll edge effect's `.automatic` style has also changed, so prior `.soft` overrides should be re-evaluated.

deepdive_en.title: Menus
deepdive_en.body: Under the refined look of **Liquid Glass**, images set on menu elements may not be shown by default in some contexts like the menu bars on iPadOS and macOS. If you still need them visible, set **preferredImageVisibility** to override the system behavior, consulting the updated HIG for when to show them.

deepdive_en.title: Integrate with Apple Intelligence
deepdive_en.body: iOS 27 menus feature an **Ask Siri** button that appears automatically when relevant content exists, letting people start a Siri conversation from the app. Use the new **View Annotations API** to annotate views with **AppEntity** for more relevant info; for drag-and-drop, Siri loads content via drag delegate methods, so stateful UI belongs in **sessionDidMove** rather than sessionWillBegin since drag sessions can begin without a user gesture.

deepdive_en.title: Agentic coding
deepdive_en.body: Xcode 27 adds an **app modernization skill** with deep understanding of the adaptivity tasks above, able to make many changes automatically from project context: converting main-screen calls to traitCollection or scene-bounds checks with invalidation logic, replacing orientation checks with size classes, and even converting to scene lifecycle. It asks clarifying questions for complex tasks and leaves comments to track remaining work for tasks too large for one session.

deepdive_en.title: Export Xcode skills for use in other tools
deepdive_en.body: Run `xcrun agent skills export` to export the skills Xcode uses as markdown files you can import into your own workflows in other tools. Skills like this are a powerful way to prepare an app for resizable environments.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Closing recommendations: build with the iOS 27 SDK, try the resizable simulator in the new **Device Hub** app, and test in iPhone Mirroring on macOS 27 to find areas needing more flexibility; and if you like agentic coding, try the new skill to see how much it can do automatically.

title: Explore advances in RealityKit
gloss: 探索 RealityKit 的最新進展
takeaway: RealityKit 新增柔和陰影、導航網格、布料模擬、LOD、3D 高斯潑濺與沉浸式音訊等能力，讓 App 與遊戲更擬真、更具沉浸感。

points.text: 強化**光照與陰影**：以 **SpotLightComponent.Shadow** 啟用柔和陰影，並支援投影貼圖與實體空間光照。
新增**導航網格（navigation mesh）**，用 **NavigationController** 計算路徑，支援網格點與離網連結（如梯子）。
提供**布料模擬**，可將布料頂點以 kinematic 方式釘在錨點上。
用 **LevelOfDetailComponent** 依相機距離或螢幕面積切換 LOD，並監聽 thermalState 調整效能。
引入 **3D Gaussian splats（GaussianSplatComponent）**與沉浸式音訊的自訂 reverb 網格與材質。

audience: **開發 visionOS 沉浸式體驗與 3D 遊戲的 RealityKit 開發者**，想提升擬真度與效能的人。
gloss_en: Explore advances in RealityKit
takeaway_en: RealityKit adds soft shadows, navigation meshes, cloth simulation, LOD, 3D Gaussian splats, and immersive audio, making apps and games more realistic and immersive than ever.

points_en.text: Enhanced **lighting and shadows**: enable soft shadows with **SpotLightComponent.Shadow**, with support for projected textures and physical-space lighting.
Adds a **navigation mesh**, using **NavigationController** to compute paths, with support for mesh points and off-mesh links (such as ladders).
Provides **cloth simulation**, letting you pin cloth vertices to anchors in a kinematic manner.
Use **LevelOfDetailComponent** to switch LOD based on camera distance or screen area, and observe thermalState to adjust performance.
Introduces **3D Gaussian splats (GaussianSplatComponent)** and custom reverb meshes and materials for immersive audio.

audience_en: **RealityKit developers building visionOS immersive experiences and 3D games** who want to improve realism and performance.
summary: 這場由 RealityKit 團隊的工程師 Dennis 主講，串連今年一系列讓 3D 空間體驗更逼真、更沉浸的新功能，並以一款示範遊戲 **Chaparral Village**（玩家被縮小、穿越村莊前往煉金區）貫穿全場。RealityKit 可一次建置、部署到 visionOS、iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 tvOS，今年並搭配 **Reality Composer Pro 3** 一同推出。

光影方面有三大進展：用 Reality Composer Pro 3 的 light baker 產生 **lightmap**（間接光、ambient occlusion、beauty）來補強靜態照明；以 **soft shadows** 讓有面積的動態光源產生帶 penumbra 的柔邊陰影（透過 shadow 的 **lightSize** 與 **quality**，quality 須為 medium 或 high）；以及 **projective textures** 搭配 **physical space lighting**（SpotLight 的 **SurroundingsLight** component）讓虛擬光線投射到真實房間的牆面。導航則引入 **navigation mesh**：用 **NavigationMeshResource** 定義可通行區域、區域成本與 **off-mesh connection**，餵進 **NavigationComponent**，再由 **NavigationController** 以 computePath 算出路徑（可區分 meshPoint 與梯子等 off-mesh 連結）。

進階模擬與效能是另一重點。**Cloth simulation** 以 mesh 的頂點為粒子、邊為彈簧，透過 cloth body／cloth collider／cloth simulation component 模擬窗簾、衣物與床單，並可把頂點設為 **kinematic** 把布料釘在固定點（如窗簾掛環）。為了顧及效能，可用 **LevelOfDetailComponent** 以 **addByCameraDistance** 或 **addByScreenArea** 設定 LOD，並監聽 **thermalStateDidChange**，在 serious／critical 時更積極切換 LOD 或降低陰影品質。

最後是擬真呈現與聲音。**3D Gaussian splats** 用一組帶不透明度的 3D 高斯橢球高效呈現真實世界擷取的體積資料，開發者提供 position／scale／rotation／opacity／spherical harmonics 等 buffer，組成 **GaussianSplatResource** 與 **GaussianSplatComponent** 後附加到 entity。沉浸式音訊則以 ray-traced geometrical acoustics 模擬反射與殘響：用 **ReverbMeshResource**（最簡單從 shoebox 開始）搭配 **Audio.Material**（preset 或以 **Audio.Absorption**／**Audio.Scattering** 自訂吸收與散射係數）建立 **ReverbComponent**；此功能僅在 immersive space 生效，shared space 則使用系統依真實環境建立的 room-sense 殘響。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 RealityKit 團隊的軟體工程師 **Dennis** 開場。回顧 RealityKit 自 2019 年起讓開發者一次建置、跨 **visionOS／iOS／iPadOS／macOS／tvOS** 部署 3D 空間體驗，今年並推出 **Reality Composer Pro 3**。接著預告本場涵蓋光影、navigation mesh、cloth simulation、效能、3D Gaussian splats 與沉浸式音訊。

deepdive.title: Lighting and shadows
deepdive.body: 以 **Chaparral Village** 煉金區為例，角落偏暗時可用 **lightmap** 補強照明。用 Reality Composer Pro 3 的 **light baker** 烘焙間接光 lightmap 套用後，角落與陰影因正確反映反射光而變亮。RealityKit API 支援自行附加 indirect lighting、ambient occlusion 與 beauty 的 lightmap，但建議用 light baker 產生以獲得最佳效果。

deepdive.title: Soft shadows
deepdive.body: lightmap 只處理靜態照明，**soft shadows** 則把柔邊陰影帶到動態光源。當光源有面積時陰影會出現 **penumbra**，光的面積越大 penumbra 越大。範例取得 hearth spotlight 的 shadow，把 **lightSize** 從 0 改為 0.7 公尺、並把 **quality** 設為 medium（low 仍會是硬陰影，須 medium 或 high 才有柔陰影），再 set 回 entity。

deepdive.title: Projective textures
deepdive.body: **Projective textures** 模擬「光透過底片投射到表面」的效果，可呈現窗花圖樣或海底 caustics 等。範例為虛擬天文館建立 **SpotLightComponent**（顏色設白以免染色），產生星雲貼圖後以 **SpotLightComponent.ProjectiveTexture** 附加，讓星星與星雲投射到虛擬牆面。

deepdive.title: Physical space lighting
deepdive.body: 要讓投影打到真實房間，需啟用 **physical space lighting**：讓虛擬光透過 RealityKit 的 scene understanding mesh 與真實環境互動（目前僅支援 spotlight 與 point light）。做法只需對 spotlight entity 加上 **SpotLightComponent.SurroundingsLight** component，星雲便會投射到真實牆面。

deepdive.title: Navigation mesh
deepdive.body: 以「從地圖一端走到旗幟、途中出現障礙」說明 **navigation mesh** 如何定義可通行區域並避開密林。可給區域不同的 **traversal cost** 以反映較慢的路徑，並用 **off-mesh connection**（如橋）連接被裂隙分開的兩塊 mesh。資料以 **NavigationMeshResource**（含標記區域、自訂 flag 與連結）定義，可用 Swift API 或 Reality Composer Pro 3 建立，再餵入帶 filter 的 **NavigationComponent**。

deepdive.title: Querying the navigation mesh
deepdive.body: 在 Chaparral Village 的 navigate 擴充函式中，先以 entity 的 navigation component 建立 **NavigationController**，再用 async 的 **computePath** 算出由現位置到玩家點擊處的路徑。結果為 nil 表示找不到路、空陣列表示已到達；否則遍歷 path node，**meshPoint** 直接附加位置，**offMeshConnection** 則另行處理（如爬梯子）。

deepdive.title: Cloth simulation
deepdive.body: **Cloth simulation** 以 mesh 描述布料：頂點是粒子、連接的邊是彈簧，頂點夠多即可逼真模擬金色禮服或床單的皺褶與翻折。需加上 **cloth body component**（含材質與 cloth mesh resource）、選用 **cloth collider component**（可碰撞的剛體），再加 **cloth simulation component**（含材質陣列與 solver、gravity、time step 等模擬屬性）來實際運行。

deepdive.title: Pinning cloth to anchor points
deepdive.body: 示範以自訂 curtain pin component 把窗簾釘在掛環。遍歷 pin 取得位置，建立 **ClothSphereShape** 代表釘子大小，用 `clothMesh.vertices(in:center:)` 取得範圍內頂點，再以 `motionTypes.set(vertexIndices:value: .kinematic)` 把這些頂點設為 **kinematic**——只受 entity transform 影響、不受布料模擬移動，藉此固定窗簾不致掉落。

deepdive.title: Performance
deepdive.body: 前述功能若不謹慎使用可能影響效能。講者先介紹可改善效能的技術（mesh level of detail），再說明如何追蹤效能指標（thermal state）讓 app 與遊戲據以調整。

deepdive.title: LOD by camera distance
deepdive.body: **Mesh level of detail（LOD）** 以較低細節渲染幾何而視覺影響甚微，以煉金區的 cauldron 為例，遠看時 LOD 5 與 LOD 0 差異可忽略卻省下大量計算。範例用 **LevelOfDetailComponent.addByCameraDistance** 設定，依與相機的距離為各 LOD 指定 **maxDistance**，最後一個 LOD 設為 `.infinity`。

deepdive.title: LOD by screen area
deepdive.body: 第二種切換演算法依 entity 佔據的螢幕面積：佔比越小可選越高的 LOD。範例用 **LevelOfDetailComponent.addByScreenArea**，以螢幕面積比例的 **minArea** 為各 LOD 指定門檻，低於該比例就切到下一級 LOD。

deepdive.title: Responding to thermal state changes
deepdive.body: 除了用 LOD 改善效能，也應在效能吃緊時反應。可對 **thermalStateDidChange** 通知註冊 observer，查詢 `ProcessInfo.processInfo.thermalState`：nominal／fair 維持現狀；serious／critical 則採取措施，例如更積極的 LOD 切換門檻或降低陰影品質。

deepdive.title: 3D Gaussian splats
deepdive.body: **3D Gaussian splats** 是高效能、高品質呈現真實世界擷取體積資料的技術，以一組帶不同不透明度的 3D 高斯橢球（ellipsoid）表示場景，渲染時於每像素沿各 gaussian 評估射線，RealityKit API 會處理眾多最佳化。講者展示在 Apple Vision Pro 上渲染盆栽多肉的細節，並提供可從 developer.apple.com 下載的範例。

deepdive.title: Creating a Gaussian splat
deepdive.body: RealityKit 不假設特定檔案格式，需自行提供描述 splat 的 buffer：**position、scale、rotation、opacity 與 spherical harmonics**（搭配 degree 控制隨視角變化的顏色，degree 0 為各方向同色）。將這些組成 **BufferResource** 建立 **GaussianSplatResource**，再建立 **GaussianSplatComponent** 並附加到場景中的 entity 即可渲染。

deepdive.title: Immersive audio
deepdive.body: 沉浸式音訊透過聲音強化 Apple Vision Pro 體驗的真實感。準確的直達與反射路徑方向與時序至關重要，且環境的幾何與材質大幅影響聽感（小客廳與大型博物館差異甚鉅）。RealityKit 以 **ray-traced geometrical acoustics** 模擬反射與殘響，並釋出一個可在博物館場景中聽到虛擬樂團、各樂器聲音獨立可控的範例。

deepdive.title: Creating a custom reverb mesh
deepdive.body: 建立 custom reverb mesh 先以 **ReverbMeshResource** 定義場景幾何，最簡單從 **shoebox**（面朝內的盒子）開始，範例設為 5×4×6 公尺。再把此 mesh 與 **dryWall** preset 材質組成 `.simulated` 的 **Reverb**，最後建立 **ReverbComponent** 附加到 entity 即可生效。

deepdive.title: Creating custom reverb materials
deepdive.body: 除了 preset，也可自訂 **Audio.Material**。範例以 `carpet.scalingAbsorption` 調高吸收度造出 thickCarpet；bookshelf 則從零定義，以 **Audio.Absorption** 指定 10 個中心頻段的吸收係數、以 **Audio.Scattering** 指定數個特定頻率的散射係數（RealityKit 會外插補滿頻譜）。須注意此功能僅在 immersive space 生效，shared space 則改用 Apple Vision Pro 依真實環境建立的 room-sense 殘響。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結本場僅觸及今年 RealityKit 新功能的一部分，另有 coordinated multi-source audio、含 subsurface scattering 與進階毛髮 shader 的高品質角色渲染、可自訂 portal 材質等。建議到 developer.apple.com 下載範例實際體驗，並關注 **Reality Composer Pro 3** 這個重大新版本。

summary_en: Presented by RealityKit engineer Dennis, this session threads together this year's new features for more realistic, immersive 3D spatial experiences, using a demo game **Chaparral Village** (the player is shrunk and must traverse a village to reach an alchemy area) as a running example. RealityKit lets you build once and deploy to visionOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS, and ships this year alongside **Reality Composer Pro 3**.

Lighting sees three advances: **lightmaps** baked with Reality Composer Pro 3's light baker (indirect lighting, ambient occlusion, beauty) to enhance static lighting; **soft shadows** that give area lights penumbra-edged shadows via the shadow's **lightSize** and **quality** (which must be medium or high); and **projective textures** combined with **physical space lighting** (the SpotLight's **SurroundingsLight** component) to cast virtual light onto real-world walls. Navigation introduces a **navigation mesh**: define traversable areas, area costs, and **off-mesh connections** with a **NavigationMeshResource**, feed it into a **NavigationComponent**, then have a **NavigationController** compute the path with computePath (distinguishing meshPoint nodes from off-mesh links like ladders).

Advanced simulation and performance are another focus. **Cloth simulation** treats mesh vertices as particles and edges as springs, simulating curtains, garments, and bedding via cloth body / cloth collider / cloth simulation components, and can pin cloth in place by setting vertices to **kinematic** (e.g. curtain hoops). To manage performance, use the **LevelOfDetailComponent** with **addByCameraDistance** or **addByScreenArea** to set up LODs, and observe **thermalStateDidChange** to switch LODs more aggressively or lower shadow quality when the state turns serious or critical.

Finally, realistic rendering and sound. **3D Gaussian splats** efficiently render real-world volumetric captures as a collection of opacity-bearing 3D Gaussian ellipsoids; developers supply position/scale/rotation/opacity/spherical-harmonics buffers, assemble a **GaussianSplatResource** and **GaussianSplatComponent**, and attach it to an entity. Immersive audio uses ray-traced geometrical acoustics to simulate reflections and reverb: build a **ReverbComponent** from a **ReverbMeshResource** (easiest starting from a shoebox) and **Audio.Material** (presets, or custom absorption/scattering via **Audio.Absorption** and **Audio.Scattering**). This only works in immersive spaces—in shared spaces the system's room-sense reverb built from your real surroundings is used instead.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: RealityKit software engineer **Dennis** opens. He recaps that since 2019 RealityKit has let developers build once and deploy 3D spatial experiences across **visionOS/iOS/iPadOS/macOS/tvOS**, and that **Reality Composer Pro 3** ships this year. He previews the session's topics: lighting, navigation mesh, cloth simulation, performance, 3D Gaussian splats, and immersive audio.

deepdive_en.title: Lighting and shadows
deepdive_en.body: Using the **Chaparral Village** alchemy area, dark corners are enhanced with **lightmaps**. Baking an indirect-lighting lightmap with Reality Composer Pro 3's **light baker** brightens corners and shadows by correctly accounting for reflected light. The RealityKit API supports attaching your own indirect lighting, ambient occlusion, and beauty lightmaps, but the light baker is recommended for best results.

deepdive_en.title: Soft shadows
deepdive_en.body: Lightmaps handle only static lighting; **soft shadows** bring soft edges to dynamic lights. When a light has area, the shadow exhibits a **penumbra** that grows with the light's area. The example gets the hearth spotlight's shadow, sets **lightSize** from 0 to 0.7 meters and **quality** to medium (low yields a hard shadow; medium or high is required for soft shadows), then sets it back on the entity.

deepdive_en.title: Projective textures
deepdive_en.body: **Projective textures** emulate light shining through film onto a surface, rendering effects like intricate window patterns or seafloor caustics. The planetarium example creates a **SpotLightComponent** (color white to avoid tinting), generates a stars-and-nebulae texture, and attaches it via **SpotLightComponent.ProjectiveTexture** so the stars project onto virtual walls.

deepdive_en.title: Physical space lighting
deepdive_en.body: To project onto a real room, enable **physical space lighting**, letting virtual lights interact with the real environment via RealityKit's scene understanding mesh (currently only spotlights and point lights). It's enabled simply by adding the **SpotLightComponent.SurroundingsLight** component to the spotlight entity, after which the stars project onto the real walls.

deepdive_en.title: Navigation mesh
deepdive_en.body: Using a "reach the flag while obstacles appear" example, the **navigation mesh** defines traversable areas and avoids dense forests. Areas can be given different **traversal costs** to reflect slower routes, and an **off-mesh connection** (like a bridge) can join two meshes split by a rift. Data is defined in a **NavigationMeshResource** (labeled areas, custom flags, connections) via the Swift API or Reality Composer Pro 3, then fed into a filtered **NavigationComponent**.

deepdive_en.title: Querying the navigation mesh
deepdive_en.body: In Chaparral Village's navigate extension, a **NavigationController** is created from the entity's navigation component, then the async **computePath** computes a path from the current position to where the player tapped. A nil result means no path; an empty array means the destination is reached; otherwise the path nodes are iterated, appending position for a **meshPoint** and handling an **offMeshConnection** separately (e.g. climbing a ladder).

deepdive_en.title: Cloth simulation
deepdive_en.body: **Cloth simulation** describes cloth as a mesh where vertices are particles and edges are springs; with enough vertices it realistically simulates a flowing gown or bed covers creasing and folding in real time. It requires a **cloth body component** (material plus cloth mesh resource), optionally a **cloth collider component** (rigid objects to collide with), and a **cloth simulation component** (material array plus properties like solver, gravity, and time step) to run.

deepdive_en.title: Pinning cloth to anchor points
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates pinning curtains to hoops with a custom pin component. It iterates over pins, builds a **ClothSphereShape** for the pin's size, gets the enclosed vertices via `clothMesh.vertices(in:center:)`, and sets them to **kinematic** with `motionTypes.set(vertexIndices:value: .kinematic)`—kinematic vertices move only with the entity's transform, not the simulation—keeping the curtains in place.

deepdive_en.title: Performance
deepdive_en.body: The features above can cost performance if used carelessly. The presenter first covers a technique to improve performance (mesh level of detail) and then how to track a performance indicator (thermal state) so apps and games can adapt accordingly.

deepdive_en.title: LOD by camera distance
deepdive_en.body: **Mesh level of detail (LOD)** renders geometry at lower detail with negligible visual impact—using the cauldron, LOD 5 viewed far away is indistinguishable from LOD 0 while requiring far less compute. The example uses **LevelOfDetailComponent.addByCameraDistance**, specifying a **maxDistance** per LOD and setting the last LOD to `.infinity`.

deepdive_en.title: LOD by screen area
deepdive_en.body: The second switching algorithm is based on the screen area an entity occupies: the less area, the higher the LOD selected. The example uses **LevelOfDetailComponent.addByScreenArea**, specifying a **minArea** as a fraction of screen area per LOD; below that fraction it switches to the next LOD.

deepdive_en.title: Responding to thermal state changes
deepdive_en.body: Beyond LODs, apps should react when performance is strained by registering an observer on the **thermalStateDidChange** notification and querying `ProcessInfo.processInfo.thermalState`: nominal/fair means stay the course; serious/critical means take steps like more aggressive LOD switching thresholds or lower shadow quality.

deepdive_en.title: 3D Gaussian splats
deepdive_en.body: **3D Gaussian splats** are a high-performance, high-quality technique for rendering real-world volumetric captures, representing scenes as a collection of opacity-bearing 3D Gaussian ellipsoids; rendering evaluates a ray along all Gaussians per pixel, with RealityKit's API handling the optimizations. The presenter shows a potted succulent rendered flawlessly on Apple Vision Pro and points to a sample on developer.apple.com.

deepdive_en.title: Creating a Gaussian splat
deepdive_en.body: RealityKit assumes no specific file format; you supply buffers describing each splat's **position, scale, rotation, opacity, and spherical harmonics** (with a degree controlling color variation by viewing direction—degree 0 is a solid color). These are assembled into a **BufferResource** to create a **GaussianSplatResource**, then a **GaussianSplatComponent** is created and attached to an entity to render.

deepdive_en.title: Immersive audio
deepdive_en.body: Immersive audio enhances Apple Vision Pro realism through sound. Accurate direction and timing of the direct and reflection paths are essential, and the environment's geometry and materials heavily affect the sound (a small living room versus a large museum). RealityKit simulates reflections and reverb with **ray-traced geometrical acoustics**, and a sample lets you hear a virtual band in a museum with independently controllable instruments.

deepdive_en.title: Creating a custom reverb mesh
deepdive_en.body: To create a custom reverb mesh, first define the scene geometry with a **ReverbMeshResource**—easiest from a **shoebox** (a box with faces pointed inward), set here to 5×4×6 meters. Combine that mesh with the **dryWall** preset material to create a `.simulated` **Reverb**, then build a **ReverbComponent** and attach it to an entity to take effect.

deepdive_en.title: Creating custom reverb materials
deepdive_en.body: Beyond presets, you can create custom **Audio.Material**. The example uses `carpet.scalingAbsorption` to make a more absorbent thickCarpet, and builds a bookshelf from scratch by specifying absorption coefficients for the 10 center-frequency bands via **Audio.Absorption** and scattering coefficients for a few frequencies via **Audio.Scattering** (RealityKit extrapolates across the spectrum). Note this only works in immersive spaces; in shared spaces the Apple Vision Pro's room-sense reverb built from your real surroundings is used instead.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: The session only scratches the surface of this year's RealityKit features, with more such as coordinated multi-source audio, high-quality character rendering with subsurface scattering and advanced hair shaders, and custom portal materials. The recommendation is to download the samples from developer.apple.com and explore **Reality Composer Pro 3**, a major new release.

title: Iterate your spatial scenes faster with Reality Composer Pro 3
gloss: 用 Reality Composer Pro 3 更快迭代空間場景
takeaway: Reality Composer Pro 3 用原型/實例、即時預覽與光照貼圖，大幅加速空間場景的製作迭代。

points.text: 以 **entities 與 components** 的概念組構場景內容，是 Reality Composer Pro 的基礎工作流程。
新的**原型（prototypes）與實例（instances）**機制讓重複內容可一處修改、處處更新。
**即時預覽（Live preview）**能在裝置上即時看到編輯結果，縮短調整迴圈。
支援**光照貼圖（Lightmaps）**提升場景視覺品質，並新增 **Reality Composer Pro Assistant** 協助製作。

audience: 使用 Reality Composer Pro 製作 **visionOS 空間體驗與 3D 場景**的開發者與美術。
gloss_en: Iterate your spatial scenes faster with Reality Composer Pro 3
takeaway_en: Reality Composer Pro 3 uses prototypes/instances, live preview, and lightmaps to dramatically speed up iteration when building spatial scenes.

points_en.text: Compose scene content with the concepts of **entities and components**, the foundational workflow of Reality Composer Pro.
The new **prototypes and instances** mechanism lets you edit repeated content in one place and update it everywhere.
**Live preview** shows editing results in real time on device, shortening the iteration loop.
Supports **Lightmaps** to improve scene visual quality, and adds the **Reality Composer Pro Assistant** to help with authoring.

audience_en: Developers and artists using Reality Composer Pro to build **visionOS spatial experiences and 3D scenes**.
summary: Reality Composer Pro 工程師 JP 示範 **Reality Composer Pro 3** 如何讓你更快地迭代空間內容。最重要的轉變是：RCP 3 不再是 Xcode 的開發者工具，而可直接從 developer.apple.com 下載、從應用程式資料夾啟動，整個工具是為快速、迭代、協作的工作流而生，讓你在不需碰 Xcode 的情況下走得更遠。他以互動遊戲 Chaparral Village 的鍊金區（Alchemy Area）為範例，逐步加入功能，並帶出三大新能力：**Live preview**、**Lightmaps**，以及能用 AI 生成 3D 內容的 **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**。

基礎仍是 **entities 與 components**：匯入 USD 檔會被整理優化成 import bundle，拖入視埠後成為帶 Transform Component 的 entity；可在 hierarchy 中巢狀排列，並用 Add Component 加入光源、physics、audio 等。範例為桌上的魔法效果加入 Point Light 與新的 **Compute Simulation** component（選用 node-based 的 Compute Graph，讓 GPU 程式設計人人可用）。按 Play 進入 **simulation tab** 即可即時預覽 compute graph、物理、腳本與動畫——更棒的是能把 simulation tab 與 scene tab 並排停靠，在遊戲執行的同時繼續編輯，幾乎零部署摩擦。新的 **prototypes 與 instances** 系統則讓你把 entity 拖進 Project Browser 變成 prototype，多次實例化並對個別 instance 提供 override；不滿意可 Reset 回原值，或把 override 反向 propagate 回來源，一切非破壞性。

**Live Preview**（今年稍晚推出）可把 simulation 投放到連接 Mac 的任一 Vision Pro 上，在 RCP 編輯的同時於裝置即時反映，所見即所得，大幅縮短迭代時間。**Lightmaps** 則用來預烘焙不會移動的光源所產生的**間接光照**（indirect lighting），把光線在場景中的彈跳結果存成貼圖，填補如桌下等無直接光照的暗部；可選 Indirect Lighting、Ambient Occlusion 與 Beauty 三種光照項，並用 Bake Settings 與 Lightmap Preview tab 調整品質、預覽後再正式烘焙。最後是 **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**：永遠在右側面板待命，能以生成式模型按需打造 3D 物件與材質（範例直接生成工作檯上的物品與蠟燭），也能回答 RCP 的使用問題。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Reality Composer Pro 工程師 JP 開場，說明 **Reality Composer Pro 3** 主打更快、迭代、協作的工作流，讓你不必碰 Xcode 就能走得更遠。本場以互動遊戲 Chaparral Village 為例，逐步加入功能，並預告 **Live preview**、**Lightmaps** 與能用 AI 生成 3D 內容的 **RCP Assistant**。

deepdive.title: Overview
deepdive.body: 重點轉變：RCP 3 不再是 Xcode 開發者工具，可直接從 developer.apple.com 下載並從應用程式資料夾啟動。以鍊金區（在 Blender 建模、匯入為 USD、在 RCP 佈局）為範例，用 import asset 匯入桌上的 Cauldron USD——匯入時內容會整理優化成 **import bundle**，拖入視埠即成 entity。

deepdive.title: Entities and components
deepdive.body: **entities 與 components** 是一切的核心構件。hierarchy 列出所有 entity，可重排與巢狀；選取 entity 用 Transform Component 調整位置角度，並用 Add Component 加入光源、physics、audio 等。範例建立 Magic Effect 子 entity，加入 Point Light 與新的 **Compute Simulation** component（選 Magic Graph），其 node-based 的 Compute Graph 讓 GPU 程式設計人人可用，但只在 simulation 階段執行。

deepdive.title: Prototypes and instances
deepdive.body: 新增的 **prototypes** 用來建立可重用物件：把 entity 從 hierarchy 拖進 Project Browser 即成 prototype asset，再拖回視埠實例化。可對個別 instance 提供 override（如改用 Brewing Graph、調整顏色與衰減），不滿意可在 context menu 選 Reset 回原值，或把 override propagate 回來源——一切非破壞性，在一處編輯、系統處理其餘。

deepdive.title: Live preview
deepdive.body: **Live Preview**（今年稍晚推出）可用 launch control 把 simulation 投放到連接 Mac 的任一 **Vision Pro**，開啟 visionOS 上的伴隨 app。之後在 RCP 編輯即於裝置即時反映（如新的 physical space lighting 的藍色填充光），在裝置上即時感受空間效果、所見即所得，大幅縮短迭代並去除猜測。

deepdive.title: Lightmaps
deepdive.body: 做完光照編輯後，原本的間接光照不再相符。**Lightmaps** 用來預計算不會移動之光源的**間接光照**並存成貼圖：捕捉光線在場景中的彈跳、填補如桌下等無直接光的暗部。可選 Indirect Lighting、Ambient Occlusion 與 Beauty 三種光照項，於 Bake Settings 調品質（low→high），並用 Lightmap Preview tab 即時預覽後再正式烘焙。

deepdive.title: Reality Composer Pro Assistant
deepdive.body: **Reality Composer Pro Assistant** 永遠在右側面板待命，使用強大的生成式模型按需打造 3D 物件與材質（範例直接生成工作檯上的物品與蠟燭），讓你更快迭代、自由實驗、把點子化為現實，也能回答任何 RCP 使用問題。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結今天只觸及 RCP 3 的皮毛，建議先從 developer.apple.com 下載並探索內附的 sample projects，並參考其他 Reality Composer Pro 場次（如「Supercharge your spatial workflows with Reality Composer Pro 3」）深入學習。

summary_en: Reality Composer Pro engineer JP shows how **Reality Composer Pro 3** lets you iterate on spatial content faster than ever. The biggest shift: RCP 3 is no longer an Xcode developer tool — you download it from developer.apple.com and launch it from your Applications folder, and the whole tool is built for fast, iterative, collaborative workflows that get you further without touching Xcode. Using the Alchemy Area of the interactive game Chaparral Village as a running example, he adds features step by step and highlights three new capabilities: **Live preview**, **Lightmaps**, and the **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**, which generates 3D content with AI.

The foundation is still **entities and components**: importing a USD file organizes and optimizes it into an import bundle, and dragging it into the viewport makes it an entity with a Transform Component; entities can be nested in the hierarchy, and Add Component adds lights, physics, audio, and more. The example adds a Point Light and the new **Compute Simulation** component (choosing a node-based Compute Graph that makes GPU programming accessible) to a table's magic effect. Pressing Play enters the **simulation tab** for real-time preview of compute graphs, physics, scripts, and animation — and crucially, you can dock the simulation tab next to the scene tab to keep authoring while the game runs, with virtually no deployment friction. The new **prototypes and instances** system lets you drag an entity into the Project Browser to make a prototype, instantiate it multiple times, and override individual instances; reset overrides to source values or propagate them back, all non-destructively.

**Live Preview** (shipping later this year) casts a simulation to any Vision Pro connected to your Mac, reflecting RCP edits on-device in real time — what you see is what you get — dramatically cutting iteration time. **Lightmaps** pre-bake the **indirect lighting** from non-moving lights, saving the way light bounces around the scene to a texture to fill in unlit areas like under a table; you can choose Indirect Lighting, Ambient Occlusion, and Beauty terms, tune quality in Bake Settings, and preview in the Lightmap Preview tab before a full bake. Finally, the **Reality Composer Pro Assistant** is always available in the right panel, using powerful generative models to craft 3D objects and materials on demand (the example generates workbench items and candles) and to answer RCP questions.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Reality Composer Pro engineer JP opens, explaining that **Reality Composer Pro 3** is built for faster, iterative, collaborative workflows that get you further without touching Xcode. Using the interactive game Chaparral Village, he adds features step by step and previews **Live preview**, **Lightmaps**, and the AI-powered **RCP Assistant** for generating 3D content.

deepdive_en.title: Overview
deepdive_en.body: Key shift: RCP 3 is no longer an Xcode developer tool — download it from developer.apple.com and launch from Applications. With the Alchemy Area (modeled in Blender, imported as USD, laid out in RCP) as the example, he imports a Cauldron USD via import asset — importing organizes and optimizes content into an **import bundle**, and dragging it into the viewport makes it an entity.

deepdive_en.title: Entities and components
deepdive_en.body: **Entities and components** are the core building blocks. The hierarchy lists all entities, reorderable and nestable; select an entity to adjust position/angle via the Transform Component, and use Add Component for lights, physics, audio, and more. The example creates a Magic Effect child entity, adds a Point Light and the new **Compute Simulation** component (choosing the Magic Graph), whose node-based Compute Graph makes GPU programming accessible but runs only during simulation.

deepdive_en.title: Prototypes and instances
deepdive_en.body: The new **prototypes** create reusable objects: drag an entity from the hierarchy into the Project Browser to make a prototype asset, then drag it back into the viewport to instantiate. Override individual instances (e.g. switch to the Brewing Graph, adjust color and attenuation), and if unhappy, Reset to source values via the context menu or propagate overrides back to source — all non-destructive: edit in one place and the system handles the rest.

deepdive_en.title: Live preview
deepdive_en.body: **Live Preview** (shipping later this year) uses launch control to cast a simulation to any **Vision Pro** connected to the Mac, opening the companion app on visionOS. RCP edits then reflect on-device in real time (e.g. the new physical space lighting's blue fill light), letting you feel spatial effects instantly — what you see is what you get — dramatically cutting iteration and removing guesswork.

deepdive_en.title: Lightmaps
deepdive_en.body: After lighting edits, the original indirect lighting no longer matches. **Lightmaps** pre-calculate the **indirect lighting** of non-moving lights and save it to a texture: capturing how light bounces and filling in unlit areas like under a table. Choose Indirect Lighting, Ambient Occlusion, and Beauty terms, set quality in Bake Settings (low→high), and use the Lightmap Preview tab to preview before committing to a full bake.

deepdive_en.title: Reality Composer Pro Assistant
deepdive_en.body: The **Reality Composer Pro Assistant** is always available in the right panel, using powerful generative models to craft 3D objects and materials on demand (the example generates workbench items and candles), letting you iterate faster and experiment freely, and it can answer any RCP usage questions.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wraps up noting this only scratches the surface of RCP 3, recommending downloading it from developer.apple.com, exploring the included sample projects, and checking out other Reality Composer Pro sessions (like "Supercharge your spatial workflows with Reality Composer Pro 3") to learn more.

title: Extend Reality Composer Pro 3 functionality with Xcode
gloss: 用 Xcode 擴充 Reality Composer Pro 3 的功能
takeaway: 用 Xcode 寫自訂 component、system、action 與 Script Graph 節點,透過 RealityComposerProPlugin 註冊進 Reality Composer Pro 3,打造更大型的空間專案。

points.text: Reality Composer Pro 3 可用 **Xcode 撰寫專案專屬的編輯器擴充**,支援更大、更有野心的空間專案。
自訂 **Component(如 Cauldron)+ System(CauldronSystem)** 控制實體狀態,並用 EntityComponentQuery 在 update 中查詢。
透過 **RealityComposerProPlugin 的 setup(context:)** 以 registerComponent / registerSystem 把擴充註冊進編輯器(搭配 @_cdecl 進入點)。
自訂動畫用 **EntityAction(SetWaterLevelAction)**,以 subscribe(to: .updated) 依 normalizedTime 內插水位。
用 **@Scriptable macro** 將 component 暴露給 **Script Graph**,再以 RKS.Configuration 註冊 scripting module。

audience: **已用 Reality Composer Pro 製作空間內容、想用 Xcode 加入自訂元件/系統/腳本節點的 visionOS 開發者。**
gloss_en: Extend Reality Composer Pro 3 functionality with Xcode
takeaway_en: Write custom components, systems, actions, and Script Graph nodes in Xcode, register them into Reality Composer Pro 3 via RealityComposerProPlugin, and build larger spatial projects.

points_en.text: Reality Composer Pro 3 lets you **author project-specific editor extensions in Xcode**, supporting bigger, more ambitious spatial projects.
Use a custom **Component (such as Cauldron) plus a System (CauldronSystem)** to control entity state, querying it in update with EntityComponentQuery.
Register extensions into the editor via **RealityComposerProPlugin's setup(context:)** using registerComponent / registerSystem (with an @_cdecl entry point).
For custom animation, use an **EntityAction (SetWaterLevelAction)** and subscribe(to: .updated) to interpolate the water level by normalizedTime.
Use the **@Scriptable macro** to expose a component to **Script Graph**, then register the scripting module via RKS.Configuration.

audience_en: **visionOS developers already building spatial content with Reality Composer Pro who want to add custom components, systems, and script nodes using Xcode.**
summary: 由 Niklas 主講，主題是用 **Xcode 撰寫的 plug-in** 來擴充 **Reality Composer Pro 3**（RealityKit 的遊戲與 3D 內容編輯器，今年稍晚推出），讓你的專案專屬內容直接出現在編輯器中，供美術與設計師即時調整、快速迭代。核心情境是 Chaparral Village 遊戲裡的一個 cauldron（大釜）：工程師寫好 plug-in 後，美術不需重新 build 與部署 app，就能在編輯器裡拖動 water level 或 rotation speed 看到水面即時反應。

工作流上，Reality Composer Pro 專案與 Xcode 專案放在同一個 git repo、可從編輯器的 simulation bar 互相連結啟動。匯入檔案會轉成 JSON 內部格式存於磁碟（編輯器附帶比標準 git merge 衝突更少的自訂合併工具），最終以 **Reality File** 匯出供 app 載入。Xcode 專案設兩個 scheme：`ChaparralVillage` build app、`RCPCustomComponents` build 給編輯器用的 plug-in framework，兩者共享所有 custom component 與 system。

擴充編輯器的關鍵機制是實作 **`RealityComposerProPlugin`** protocol，在其 `setup` 方法中用編輯器給的 context 註冊你的 component、system、action 與 scripting module；並提供一個標記為 C 函式、有 exported name 的 `createRealityComposerProPlugin()` 回傳 raw pointer 以供 plug-in loader 找到。Custom component（如儲存 waterLevel 的 Cauldron）需符合 `Component` 與 `Codable`；對應的 custom system 在 update 中找出帶該 component 的 entity 並調整水面位置，甚至取得 **Shader Graph** material 把 vortex 參數餵給 tech artist 做的渦流 shader。每次重 build plug-in 都需重啟編輯器並信任專案。

除了 component 與 system，plug-in 還能擴充兩處：在動畫 sequencer 中加入**自訂 animation action**（實作 `EntityAction` 與 `Codable`、定義 animated value type、用靜態 `subscribe()` 訂閱 `.updated` 事件在動畫期間以 normalized 時間插值更新水位），以及為 **Script Graph** 加入自訂節點（用 `@Scriptable` macro 標記 component，import `RealityKitScripting` 與 `RealityKitScriptingMacros`，在主執行緒建立 scripting configuration／module 並註冊到 `RealityKitScripting`）。如此美術與設計師就能在不寫程式的 Script Graph 裡用按鍵控制水位。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Niklas 開場，說明如何用 plug-in 擴充 **Reality Composer Pro 3**，讓美術與內容創作者直接在編輯器裡操作專案資產、快速迭代。以 cauldron 為例：工程師寫好 plug-in 後，美術可即時調整 water level 或 rotation speed 並看到大釜反應，無需 build 與部署 app。本場專注於「用程式碼能做什麼」，姊妹場另有無程式碼的 Script Graph 介紹。

deepdive.title: Extending the editor
deepdive.body: 介紹擴充機制與團隊協作流程。Reality Composer Pro 專案與 Xcode 專案共處同一 git repo，可透過 simulation bar 連結並從編輯器啟動 app。匯入檔案轉為 **JSON** 內部格式存於磁碟，編輯器附帶比標準 git merge 衝突更少的自訂合併工具；內容最終以 **Reality File** 匯出給 app 載入。`RCPCustomComponents.framework` 把開發者寫的 component 與 system 帶進編輯器供美術編輯。

deepdive.title: Custom components and systems
deepdive.body: 說明 Xcode 專案設兩個 scheme：`ChaparralVillage`（build app）與 `RCPCustomComponents`（build plug-in framework），兩者共享所有 custom component 與 system。目標是為 cauldron 做效果：控制水位升降，並加入攪拌時的渦流。講者比較 Script Graph 與 Swift 程式碼——能力相近、多為偏好問題，但巨大的 Script Graph 難維護，且程式碼能用 SwiftUI 等 Script Graph 沒有的 API，故選擇寫程式。

deepdive.title: Cauldron component
deepdive.body: 建立一個簡單的 **Cauldron** component，只有一個 `waterLevel` 屬性。除了 `Component` protocol，還需符合 **`Codable`** 才能在編輯器中表示並序列化到 Reality File。對於有不該出現在編輯器的 runtime 屬性的進階 component，可實作 `CodingKeys`，但這個簡單 component 想序列化全部屬性，故不需要。

deepdive.title: CauldronSystem
deepdive.body: 建立 custom system 設定水位：在 system update 中找出帶 Cauldron component 的 entity，再找到 water mesh 子 entity，依 Cauldron component 的 waterLevel 調整水面位置。這是把資料屬性轉成實際視覺變化的核心邏輯。

deepdive.title: RCPCustomComponentsPlugin
deepdive.body: 建立實作 **`RealityComposerProPlugin`** protocol 的 plugin class（protocol 來自 RealityComposerPro Swift 套件，於用 Run With Xcode 連結時自動加入）。在 `setup` 方法用編輯器給的 context 註冊 component 與 system；並實作標記為 C 函式、有 exported name 的 `createRealityComposerProPlugin()` 回傳 raw pointer 供 plug-in loader 找到。build plug-in scheme 產生動態庫後開啟專案，編輯器詢問是否信任、選 Trust 載入，匯入的 component 即可加到 Cauldron entity，拖動 waterLevel 就看到水面反應；可設中斷點 attach 到編輯器除錯。

deepdive.title: Controlling the water surface
deepdive.body: 基本水面完成後，要進一步加入攪拌時的渦流效果：玩家攪動大釜時水面彎成 vortex 形狀。tech artist 已用 Reality Composer Pro 3 的 **Shader Graph** 建好 vortex shader，帶有 rotation speed 等參數，講者希望從 custom component 控制這些參數。

deepdive.title: Cauldron component with vortex properties
deepdive.body: 為 Cauldron component 新增引導渦流形狀的屬性（如 rotation speed、vortex coefficient），以便驅動 Shader Graph 的形狀運算。這些屬性會成為美術在編輯器中可調的旋鈕。

deepdive.title: CauldronSystem update with ShaderGraph
deepdive.body: 修改 system 把參數傳遞給 **Shader Graph**：先取得 Shader Graph material，用 helper function 依 Cauldron 屬性算出水面形狀，把結果設到 Shader Graph 參數，再把 material 指回 model。重 build plug-in 後需重啟編輯器、信任專案，並接受 component 變更的 diff 對話框；之後增加 rotation speed 就能看到渦流變深。

deepdive.title: Custom animation actions
deepdive.body: 進入動畫系統的擴充：animation sequencer 支援在 plug-in 中定義、再加到 sequencer 時間軸的 **custom animation action**。講者要做一個設定 cauldron 水位的 action。

deepdive.title: SetWaterLevelAction
deepdive.body: 實作 **`EntityAction`** protocol、並符合 `Codable` 以存入 Reality File。action 取 start 與 end 兩個水位參數以便在兩值間動畫，並需回傳 animated value type 為 **`Transform`**（以便在 animation executor 中存取 entity）。

deepdive.title: SetWaterLevelAction subscribe
deepdive.body: 撰寫執行 action 的程式碼：在 entity action 中建立靜態 **`subscribe()`** 函式，用 `EntityAction` 的 subscribe 方法訂閱 RealityKit 執行動畫時觸發的 **`.updated`** 事件。取得 normalized（0–1）的 elapsed 時間，據此在 start 與 end 水位間插值，取出 cauldron component 更新 waterLevel，再寫回 entity。

deepdive.title: RCPCustomComponentsPlugin with action
deepdive.body: 把 custom animation 註冊到 Reality Composer Pro 3：如同 component 與 system，在 plugin 的 setup 用 context 註冊 action，並呼叫先前建立的 subscribe 函式讓 action 在動畫更新時執行。重啟編輯器開專案後可建 sequence、設根 entity 為含 cauldron 的場景、加 animation track，把 SetWaterLevelAction 拖入時間軸並設 start 0.3、stop 0.5，播放即見水位依 action 變化。

deepdive.title: Custom Script Graph nodes
deepdive.body: 說明 plug-in 也能為 **Script Graph** 加入自訂節點，讓設計師在不寫程式下使用。最快的方式是用 **`@Scriptable`** macro 把 custom component 暴露給 Script Graph。

deepdive.title: Cauldron with @Scriptable macro
deepdive.body: import **`RealityKitScripting`** 與 **`RealityKitScriptingMacros`** 模組（macro 定義處，套件在從編輯器建立 Xcode 專案時自動設好），再把 component struct 標上 **`@Scriptable`** macro。macro 會展開出描述 component 的 schema 變數，供之後註冊到 scripting 系統。

deepdive.title: Register scripting module
deepdive.body: 在 plugin 的 setup 函式註冊 scripting module（須在**主執行緒**）：先建立專案的 scripting configuration，在其 initializer 回傳所有 scripting module 清單（這裡一個含 Cauldron schema 的 module，schema 由 @Scriptable 產生），再把 configuration 加到 RealityKitScripting。之後在 Cauldron entity 加 Scripting component、開 Script Graph，用 update 節點＋If 節點接 keypress，按 a 設水位 0.25、按 z 設 0.5，於 simulation view 測試。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結：用 Xcode 寫 plug-in 即可擴充編輯器、操作 app 資料、甚至在編輯器內執行你的程式碼。建議延伸觀看「Explore advances in RealityKit」了解最新 RealityKit 功能，以及「Supercharge your spatial workflows with Reality Composer Pro 3」提升編輯器生產力。

summary_en: Presented by Niklas, this session shows how **plug-ins written in Xcode** can extend **Reality Composer Pro 3** (RealityKit's game and 3D content editor, shipping later this year) so your project-specific content appears inside the editor for artists and designers to tweak in real time and iterate fast. The running example is a cauldron in the Chaparral Village game: once engineers write the plug-in, artists can drag the water level or rotation speed and watch the water surface react—without rebuilding and deploying the app.

On workflow, the Reality Composer Pro project and the Xcode project live in the same git repo and can be linked and launched from the editor's simulation bar. Imported files are saved on disk as JSON (the editor ships a custom merge tool with fewer conflicts than standard git merge) and content is finally exported as a **Reality File** for the app to load. The Xcode project has two schemes: `ChaparralVillage` builds the app, and `RCPCustomComponents` builds the plug-in framework for the editor, with all custom components and systems shared between them.

The key extension mechanism is implementing the **`RealityComposerProPlugin`** protocol and, in its `setup` method, using the editor-provided context to register your components, systems, actions, and scripting modules; you also provide a `createRealityComposerProPlugin()` function marked as a C function with an exported name returning a raw pointer so the plug-in loader can find it. A custom component (like a Cauldron storing waterLevel) must conform to `Component` and `Codable`; the matching custom system finds entities with that component in its update and adjusts the water surface, and can even fetch the **Shader Graph** material to feed vortex parameters to a tech artist's swirl shader. Rebuilding the plug-in requires restarting the editor and trusting the project.

Beyond components and systems, plug-ins can extend two more areas: **custom animation actions** in the sequencer (implement `EntityAction` and `Codable`, return the animated value type, and use a static `subscribe()` to subscribe to the `.updated` event, interpolating the water level by normalized time during the animation), and **custom Script Graph nodes** (tag a component with the `@Scriptable` macro, import `RealityKitScripting` and `RealityKitScriptingMacros`, build a scripting configuration/module on the main thread, and register it with `RealityKitScripting`). This lets artists and designers control the water level via key presses in a no-code Script Graph.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Niklas opens by explaining how plug-ins extend **Reality Composer Pro 3** so artists and content creators can work with project assets directly in the editor and iterate quickly. Using the cauldron example: once engineers write the plug-in, artists can adjust water level or rotation speed and see the cauldron react in real time, without building and deploying an app. This session focuses on what code can do; a companion session covers no-code Script Graph.

deepdive_en.title: Extending the editor
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the extension mechanism and team workflow. The Reality Composer Pro project and Xcode project share one git repo and can be linked via the simulation bar to launch the app from the editor. Imported files become an internal **JSON** format on disk, with a custom merge tool that conflicts less than standard git merge; content is finally exported as a **Reality File** for the app. The `RCPCustomComponents.framework` brings developer-written components and systems into the editor for artists to edit.

deepdive_en.title: Custom components and systems
deepdive_en.body: The Xcode project has two schemes: `ChaparralVillage` (builds the app) and `RCPCustomComponents` (builds the plug-in framework), sharing all custom components and systems. The goal is a cauldron effect: control the rising/falling water level plus a swirl when stirring. The presenter compares Script Graph and Swift code—similar capabilities, often a matter of preference—but very large Script Graphs are hard to maintain, and code can use APIs like SwiftUI that Script Graph lacks, so he chooses code.

deepdive_en.title: Cauldron component
deepdive_en.body: Create a simple **Cauldron** component with a single `waterLevel` property. Beyond the `Component` protocol, it must conform to **`Codable`** to be representable in the editor and serialized to Reality Files. Advanced components with runtime properties that shouldn't appear in the editor could implement `CodingKeys`, but this simple component serializes all properties, so that isn't needed.

deepdive_en.title: CauldronSystem
deepdive_en.body: Create a custom system to set the water level: in the system update, find entities with the Cauldron component, find the water mesh child entity, and adjust the water mesh position based on the component's waterLevel. This is the core logic turning a data property into actual visual change.

deepdive_en.title: RCPCustomComponentsPlugin
deepdive_en.body: Create a plugin class implementing the **`RealityComposerProPlugin`** protocol (from the RealityComposerPro Swift package, auto-added when linking via Run With Xcode). In `setup`, register the component and system using the editor's context, and implement a `createRealityComposerProPlugin()` function marked as a C function with an exported name returning a raw pointer so the plug-in loader finds it. After building the plug-in scheme, open the project, choose Trust to load, add the imported component to the Cauldron entity, and drag waterLevel to see the surface react; set a breakpoint and attach to the editor to debug.

deepdive_en.title: Controlling the water surface
deepdive_en.body: With the basic surface working, the next step adds a swirl when stirring: the surface bends into a vortex shape as the player stirs. A tech artist already built a vortex shader in Reality Composer Pro 3's **Shader Graph** with parameters like rotation speed, and the presenter wants to drive those from the custom component.

deepdive_en.title: Cauldron component with vortex properties
deepdive_en.body: Add properties to the Cauldron component to guide the vortex shape (such as rotation speed and vortex coefficient) so they can drive the Shader Graph's shape computation. These become the knobs artists adjust in the editor.

deepdive_en.title: CauldronSystem update with ShaderGraph
deepdive_en.body: Modify the system to propagate parameters to the **Shader Graph**: retrieve the Shader Graph material, use a helper to compute the surface shape from the Cauldron properties, set the result as Shader Graph parameters, and assign the material back to the model. After rebuilding the plug-in, restart the editor, trust the project, and accept the component-changes dialog; increasing rotation speed then makes the vortex deeper.

deepdive_en.title: Custom animation actions
deepdive_en.body: Extending the animation system: the sequencer supports **custom animation actions** defined in the plug-in and added to the timeline. The presenter wants an action that sets the cauldron's water level.

deepdive_en.title: SetWaterLevelAction
deepdive_en.body: Implement the **`EntityAction`** protocol and conform to `Codable` to be saved in a Reality File. The action takes start and end water levels so it can animate between them, and must return the animated value type as a **`Transform`** to access the entity in the animation executor.

deepdive_en.title: SetWaterLevelAction subscribe
deepdive_en.body: Write the code that executes the action: create a static **`subscribe()`** function in the entity action that uses `EntityAction`'s subscribe to subscribe to the **`.updated`** event fired when RealityKit runs animations. Get the normalized (0–1) elapsed time, interpolate between start and end water levels, fetch the cauldron component, update waterLevel, and set it back on the entity.

deepdive_en.title: RCPCustomComponentsPlugin with action
deepdive_en.body: Register the custom animation with Reality Composer Pro 3: as with components and systems, register the action in the plugin's setup via the context, and call the subscribe function so the action executes on animation updates. After restarting and opening the project, create a sequence, set the root entity to a scene containing the cauldron, add an animation track, drag SetWaterLevelAction into the timeline, set start 0.3 and stop 0.5, and play to see the level change per the action.

deepdive_en.title: Custom Script Graph nodes
deepdive_en.body: Plug-ins can also add custom nodes to **Script Graph** for designers to use without code. The quickest way to expose a custom component to Script Graph is the **`@Scriptable`** macro.

deepdive_en.title: Cauldron with @Scriptable macro
