deepdive_en.body: Import the **`RealityKitScripting`** and **`RealityKitScriptingMacros`** modules (where the macro is defined; the package is auto-set-up when creating the Xcode project from the editor), then tag the component struct with the **`@Scriptable`** macro. The macro expands to a schema variable describing the component for later registration with the scripting system.

deepdive_en.title: Register scripting module
deepdive_en.body: Register the scripting module in the plugin's setup (must be on the **main thread**): create a scripting configuration whose initializer returns the list of all modules (here one module holding the Cauldron schema generated by @Scriptable), then add the configuration to RealityKitScripting. Then add a Scripting component to the Cauldron entity, open Script Graph, wire an update node and an If node to a keypress—'a' sets the level to 0.25, 'z' to 0.5—and test in a simulation view.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recap: writing plug-ins in Xcode lets you extend the editor, work with your app's data, and even run your code inside the editor. The presenter recommends 'Explore advances in RealityKit' for the latest RealityKit features and 'Supercharge your spatial workflows with Reality Composer Pro 3' for editor productivity.

title: Discover the Spatial Preview framework
gloss: 認識 Spatial Preview 框架
takeaway: 用全新的 Spatial Preview 框架把 Mac 上的文件與 USD 內容即時串到 visionOS 預覽，並搭配 USDKit 進行即時編輯與標註。
chapters: Document Preview Session with Device Picker
Edit USD live using USDKit and Spatial Preview

points.text: 全新的 **Spatial Preview** 框架可把 Mac 上的內容直接送到 **visionOS** 預覽，透過 `SpatialPreviewDevicePicker` 選擇目標裝置。
支援 **Document Preview**（`DocumentPreviewSession`）即時更新內容，並可觀察 session 狀態以在失效時清理。
搭配 **USDKit** 進行 **USD 即時編輯**（`USDPreviewSession`、`USDStage`），可切換 layout variants 並透過 stage observation 監看變更。
支援標註（annotation）、逐物件操作與匯出等 session 選項，並可用 `Observations` 觀察傳輸進度。

audience: **開發 visionOS 空間內容或 3D／USD 工作流程的開發者與創作者**。
gloss_en: Discover the Spatial Preview framework
takeaway_en: Use the new Spatial Preview framework to stream documents and USD content from your Mac directly into a visionOS preview, paired with USDKit for live editing and annotation.

points_en.text: The new **Spatial Preview** framework sends content from your Mac directly to a **visionOS** preview, choosing the target device with `SpatialPreviewDevicePicker`.
Supports **Document Preview** (`DocumentPreviewSession`) for live content updates, and you can observe session state to clean up when it becomes invalid.
Pairs with **USDKit** for **live USD editing** (`USDPreviewSession`, `USDStage`), letting you switch layout variants and watch changes through stage observation.
Supports session options like annotation, per-object manipulation, and export, and you can observe transfer progress with `Observations`.

audience_en: **Developers and creators building visionOS spatial content or 3D/USD workflows**.
summary: 這場由 visionOS 團隊主講，介紹全新的 **Spatial Preview** 框架——讓人能把 Mac 上的內容直接「延伸」到 Apple Vision Pro 的周遭空間中。核心情境延續 **Mac Virtual Display**：透過虛擬螢幕一邊用 Mac 工作，一邊把 3D 設計、Apple 沉浸式影片畫格、spatial photo、PDF 等內容串流到 Vision Pro，由 visionOS 上的 **QuickLook** 接收並讓使用者沉浸地檢視，例如在客廳場景裡走動、切換不同攝影機視角。這些原本只在 macOS 的 Preview app 中可用的能力，現在也以 API 的形式開放給開發者，可用來強化內容創作或審閱類 app。

導入流程相當精簡。第一步是取得 **endpoint**：若正在使用 Mac Virtual Display 可直接沿用該裝置，否則加入 device picker UI 讓使用者挑選同一 iCloud 帳號下的任一台 Vision Pro。第二步建立 preview session，分兩種：**`DocumentPreviewSession`** 處理 spatial photo、影片、PDF 等文件類型，**`USDPreviewSession`** 處理 3D 內容。session 一啟動，QuickLook 就會在 Vision Pro 上開啟並顯示內容，**visionOS 端不需要任何程式碼**。文件類型可用 `updateContents(url:)` 在同一個場景內換頁，做出像沉浸式建築渲染圖庫的即時切換效果，並用 task 觀察 session 狀態（場景被關閉時會收到 invalidated）。

3D 部分建議搭配新的 **USDKit** Swift API 使用。把 USD 載入成 stage 交給 `USDPreviewSession` 啟動後，Vision Pro 會以 volumetric view 顯示，可旋轉檢視或進入沉浸式看 1:1 尺度，並內建攝影機視角切換與 wireframe 等 material override。預設會自動最佳化（mesh decimation、texture 降採樣、必要時重建場景）以確保效能，若不想被改動可傳 `.unmodified` 參數，但過於複雜的場景可能因此無法分享而拋錯。最關鍵的是**雙向即時編輯**：透過 live USD stage，Mac 與 visionOS 兩端都能改動並自動同步——切換 layout variant 重排家具、加 annotation、移動帶有 `spatialEditable` metadata 的物件，都會反映到另一端。

進階能力包含用 `addObserver` 監聽 `UsdStage.ObjectsDidChange` 通知來接收 visionOS 端的變更、用 session options（`.annotations`、`.perObjectManipulation`、`.export`）控制 QuickLook 上開放的功能、訂閱動畫播放時間等非 USD 事件，以及用 Progress Reporter 顯示大型資料同步的載入進度。Spatial Preview 在 visionOS 上**內建 SharePlay 支援**，協作者可加入同一個 live session 一起即時審閱與編輯。實務建議：採用 USDKit Swift API，若 app 已有自己的 USD 安裝可做 bridging，並善用 material override、攝影機視角、object manipulation、variant 與 annotation 等審閱工具。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 visionOS 工程師 Quincy German 開場，以自己最常用的 **Mac Virtual Display** 帶出主題：在 macOS 與 visionOS 27 上，把 Mac 內容預覽到 Vision Pro 變得更容易。介紹全新 **Spatial Preview** 框架，能讓使用者在處理 Mac 上內容時運用 visionOS 的空間運算能力，並以 macOS 的 Preview app 為示範，支援 3D 編輯、擬真渲染、攝影機視角與 spatial media 輸出。

deepdive.title: Learn about Spatial Preview
deepdive.body: 概覽框架組成：先選定指向某台裝置的 **endpoint**（沿用 Mac Virtual Display 連線或加入 device picker 選附近的 Vision Pro），再為內容建立 preview session。session 分 **document**（spatial photo、影片、PDF）與 **USD**（3D 內容）兩類；啟動後 QuickLook 會在 Vision Pro 上開啟並顯示內容，**visionOS 端完全免寫程式**。

deepdive.title: Document Preview
deepdive.body: 以 Apple 沉浸式影片的靜態畫格為例示範文件預覽。用 `ConnectedSpatialEndpointObserver` 取得 Mac Virtual Display 的 endpoint，建立 **`DocumentPreviewSession`**（指定 contentType 與名稱），再 `start` 並提供 content URL，內容就會出現在 QuickLook 中以沉浸模式檢視。

deepdive.title: Document Preview Session with Device Picker
deepdive.body: 因為 Mac Virtual Display 不一定總是啟用，建議把 Spatial Preview 的 **device picker** 當成一個 view 整合進 UI。用 SwiftUI 的 sheet 控制它何時出現，使用者在 picker 中選好裝置 endpoint 後，再照前面流程建立 document preview session。

deepdive.title: Update Document Contents
deepdive.body: 示範建立一個沉浸式建築渲染圖庫。`updateContents` 會**重用**啟動時的同一場景，因此圖庫用一排按鈕呼叫 `updateContents(url:)` 在同一場景內換檔。另設一個 task 觀察 session 狀態，場景在 visionOS 被關閉時會收到 invalidated；用完呼叫 `close` 結束 session、visionOS 會自動關閉場景。

deepdive.title: USD Preview
deepdive.body: 轉入 3D 內容主題，建議先看 Understand USD Fundamentals 與 Discover USDKit 等基礎影片。建立 **`USDPreviewSession`** 與文件類似，差別在內容是 USDKit 的 **stage**；`start` 後 Vision Pro 以 volumetric view 顯示，可進入沉浸式看 1:1 尺度，並內建攝影機視角切換與 wireframe material override，皆免額外設定。

deepdive.title: Edit USD Live
deepdive.body: 說明 USD scene 可能高擬真到 Vision Pro 難以渲染，因此預設會自動最佳化（**mesh decimation**、**texture 降採樣**、必要時整場重建）。被重建的場景不可編輯但仍可檢視與加 annotation。接著介紹從任一端編輯、靠 **live USD stage** 在 macOS 與 visionOS 間複製內容的機制。

deepdive.title: Opt out of optimization
deepdive.body: 若想跳過自動最佳化，在建立 session 時傳 **`.unmodified`** 參數。但停用最佳化後，複雜場景可能無法分享到 Vision Pro，`start` 會拋出 `assetUnshareable` 錯誤需自行處理；如何降低內容渲染成本可參考開發者文件。

deepdive.title: Editing Features
deepdive.body: 回顧 USD 術語：一個 **stage** 由一或多個 **layer** 組成，layer 含 **prim**（可代表 3D 變換、mesh 等），而 **variant set** 可在 prim 上換入替代資料。為後續示範以 variant 改變家具位置與旋轉鋪陳基礎概念。

deepdive.title: USD Layout Variants
deepdive.body: 示範在客廳場景設定改變家具位置與旋轉的 **layout variant**。在 USDKit 中選某個 variant 會改動 stage，編輯結果在 macOS 與 visionOS 間同步；macOS 工具列按鈕切換 variant、visionOS 反映新家具佈局，也可從 QuickLook 選單選 variant 反映回 Mac。

deepdive.title: Edit USD live using USDKit and Spatial Preview
deepdive.body: 程式碼層面：用 USDKit 取得對應 prim 後，呼叫 `prim.variantSets?.setSelection("Layout", variantName:)` 來套用指定的 layout variant，變更會透過 live stage 自動雙向同步。

deepdive.title: USD Stage Observations
deepdive.body: 示範如何監聽來自 visionOS 的變更。用 `stage.addObserver(for: UsdStage.ObjectsDidChange.self)` 訂閱**標準 USD notice**，可從 `resyncedPaths` 取得哪些 prim path 改變，再逐一找出 annotation 並更新 UI。

deepdive.title: Annotation Spec
deepdive.body: 說明文字 annotation 需要的資料：除了實際文字外，還要 author 與唯一 identifier（`AppleTextAnnotation` 規格）。只要 annotation 是被指定為 document annotation group 的 prim 的子節點，就能在 visionOS 上顯示。

deepdive.title: Metadata for Object Manipulation
deepdive.body: 要讓 USD prim 在 visionOS 上能用手勢編輯，需在其上設定 **`spatialEditable`** metadata（customData 中 `apple` 字典的布林值）。使用者也可直接在 macOS 的 Preview 為 USD 資產設定此 metadata，之後就能在兩端移動該物件（示範把椅子移出窗外）。

deepdive.title: Session Options and Events
deepdive.body: 用 `session.start` 的 **options** 控制 QuickLook 上開放的功能，預設啟用 `.annotations`、`.perObjectManipulation`、`.export`。同時可透過 `session.events` 訂閱非 USD 事件，例如動畫播放時間的變化（`timeChanged`）。

deepdive.title: Observe Session Progress
deepdive.body: 用 **Progress Reporter** 監看 session 的分享進度，適合在大型資料同步到 Vision Pro 時於 macOS 顯示載入條。示範把播放與時間事件接上後，按播放鍵就能在兩端同步看到蜂鳥在窗外動畫。最後提到 visionOS 內建 **SharePlay**，協作者可加入同一 live session 一起即時審閱編輯。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 行動建議：採用 **USDKit Swift API**（Spatial Preview 與其無縫整合），既有 USD 安裝可做 bridging 轉移編輯。逐一探索 document 與 USD 兩種 preview session，僅需幾行程式即可整合進 Mac app，並善用 material override、攝影機視角、object manipulation、variant 與 annotation 等審閱工具。

summary_en: Presented by the visionOS team, this session introduces the new **Spatial Preview** framework, which lets people extend content from their Mac into the space around them on Apple Vision Pro. Building on **Mac Virtual Display**, you can stream 3D designs, Apple Immersive Video frames, spatial photos, and PDFs from a Mac while visionOS receives them in **QuickLook**, letting users inspect content immersively—walking around a living-room scene or switching camera viewpoints. Capabilities that previously lived only in the macOS Preview app are now exposed as an API for content creation and review apps.

Adoption is concise. First obtain an **endpoint**: reuse the active Mac Virtual Display device, or add a device picker UI to choose any nearby Vision Pro on the same iCloud account. Then create a preview session—**`DocumentPreviewSession`** for spatial photos, videos, and PDFs, or **`USDPreviewSession`** for 3D content. Once started, QuickLook opens and shows the content on Vision Pro with **no code required on the visionOS side**. For documents, `updateContents(url:)` swaps files within the same scene (e.g., a gallery of immersive renders), and a task observes session state, receiving an invalidated change when the scene is closed.

For 3D, pair Spatial Preview with the new **USDKit** Swift API. Load USD into a stage, start a `USDPreviewSession`, and Vision Pro shows it in a volumetric view—rotatable, or viewable at full scale immersively, with built-in camera viewpoints and wireframe material overrides. By default the content is automatically optimized (mesh decimation, texture downsampling, possible scene reconstruction); pass `.unmodified` to opt out, though very complex scenes may then become unshareable and throw an error. The headline feature is **live two-way editing**: a live USD stage syncs changes from both Mac and visionOS—switching layout variants, adding annotations, and moving objects marked with `spatialEditable` metadata all replicate across devices.

Advanced features include observing visionOS-side changes via `addObserver` for `UsdStage.ObjectsDidChange`, controlling exposed QuickLook capabilities with session options (`.annotations`, `.perObjectManipulation`, `.export`), subscribing to non-USD events like animation playback time, and reporting large-data sync progress with a Progress Reporter. **SharePlay is built in** on visionOS, so collaborators can join the same live session to review and edit together. The recommended path: use the USDKit Swift APIs, bridge from an existing USD installation if needed, and leverage material overrides, camera viewpoints, object manipulation, variants, and annotations as review tools.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: visionOS engineer Quincy German opens with his most-used feature, **Mac Virtual Display**, to frame the topic: in macOS and visionOS 27 it's even easier to preview Mac content on Vision Pro. He introduces the new **Spatial Preview** framework for leveraging visionOS spatial computing while working with Mac content, demoed via the macOS Preview app with 3D editing, photorealistic rendering, camera viewpoints, and spatial media output.

deepdive_en.title: Learn about Spatial Preview
deepdive_en.body: Overview of the components: first select an **endpoint** pointing to a device (reuse an active Mac Virtual Display or add a device picker for nearby Vision Pros), then create a preview session. Sessions come in **document** (spatial photos, video, PDF) and **USD** (3D) flavors; once started, QuickLook launches and shows the content on Vision Pro with **no code needed on visionOS**.

deepdive_en.title: Document Preview
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates document preview with a still from Apple Immersive Video. Use `ConnectedSpatialEndpointObserver` to get the Mac Virtual Display endpoint, create a **`DocumentPreviewSession`** (with contentType and name), then `start` it and provide the content URL so it appears in QuickLook in immersive mode.

deepdive_en.title: Document Preview Session with Device Picker
deepdive_en.body: Since Mac Virtual Display isn't always active, integrate the Spatial Preview **device picker** as a view in your UI. Use a SwiftUI sheet to control when it appears, then create the document preview session with the device endpoint selected in the picker.

deepdive_en.title: Update Document Contents
deepdive_en.body: Builds a gallery of immersive architectural renders. `updateContents` **reuses** the scene launched at start, so the gallery uses a row of buttons calling `updateContents(url:)` to swap files in the same scene. A task observes session state—an invalidated change arrives when the scene is closed on visionOS; calling `close` ends the session and visionOS dismisses the scene.

deepdive_en.title: USD Preview
deepdive_en.body: Shifts to 3D content, recommending USD fundamentals and USDKit videos first. Creating a **`USDPreviewSession`** mirrors documents but the content is a USDKit **stage**; after `start`, Vision Pro shows it in a volumetric view, with immersive full-scale viewing plus built-in camera viewpoints and wireframe material overrides, all with no extra setup.

deepdive_en.title: Edit USD Live
deepdive_en.body: Notes that USD scenes can be too high-fidelity to render on Vision Pro, so the system auto-optimizes (**mesh decimation**, **texture downsampling**, full reconstruction if needed). Reconstructed scenes are non-editable but still viewable and annotatable. Introduces editing from either device via a **live USD stage** that replicates content between macOS and visionOS.

deepdive_en.title: Opt out of optimization
deepdive_en.body: To skip auto-optimization, pass **`.unmodified`** when creating the session. With optimization off, complex scenes may be unshareable and `start` throws an `assetUnshareable` error to handle; see the docs for reducing rendering cost.

deepdive_en.title: Editing Features
deepdive_en.body: Reviews USD terminology: a **stage** is composed of one or more **layers**, layers contain **prims** (transforms, meshes, etc.), and **variant sets** swap alternative data on a prim. Sets the stage for demonstrating furniture repositioning via variants.

deepdive_en.title: USD Layout Variants
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates **layout variants** that change furniture position and rotation in a living-room scene. Selecting a variant in USDKit changes the stage and syncs edits between macOS and visionOS; macOS toolbar buttons switch variants while visionOS reflects the new layout, and variants can also be picked from the QuickLook menu.

deepdive_en.title: Edit USD live using USDKit and Spatial Preview
deepdive_en.body: In code, get the relevant prim via USDKit and call `prim.variantSets?.setSelection("Layout", variantName:)` to apply the chosen layout variant; the change syncs both ways via the live stage.

deepdive_en.title: USD Stage Observations
deepdive_en.body: Shows how to listen for changes from visionOS. Subscribe to **standard USD notices** with `stage.addObserver(for: UsdStage.ObjectsDidChange.self)`, iterate the `resyncedPaths` to find changed prims, and update annotations in the UI.

deepdive_en.title: Annotation Spec
deepdive_en.body: Explains the data a text annotation needs: besides the text, an author and a unique identifier (`AppleTextAnnotation` spec). Annotations appear on visionOS as long as they're children of a prim designated as a document annotation group.

deepdive_en.title: Metadata for Object Manipulation
deepdive_en.body: To make a USD prim editable via gestures on visionOS, set the **`spatialEditable`** metadata on it (a boolean in customData's `apple` dictionary). Users can also set this in macOS Preview, after which the object can be moved on both devices (demoed by moving a chair out the window).

deepdive_en.title: Session Options and Events
deepdive_en.body: Use the **options** on `session.start` to control which QuickLook features are available—`.annotations`, `.perObjectManipulation`, and `.export` are on by default. You can also subscribe to non-USD events via `session.events`, such as animation playback time (`timeChanged`).

deepdive_en.title: Observe Session Progress
deepdive_en.body: Use a **Progress Reporter** to monitor a session's sharing progress, ideal for a loading bar on macOS while large data syncs to Vision Pro. After wiring up time and playback events, pressing play animates a hummingbird outside the window on both apps. Notes that **SharePlay** is built in on visionOS so collaborators can review and edit in one live session.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recommendations: adopt the **USDKit Swift API** (which Spatial Preview works seamlessly with), bridging from an existing USD installation to transfer edits. Explore both document and USD preview sessions—only a few lines to integrate into a Mac app—and take advantage of material overrides, camera viewpoints, object manipulation, variants, and annotations.

title: Explore enhancements to visionOS object tracking
gloss: 探索 visionOS 物件追蹤的強化功能
takeaway: visionOS 大幅強化**物件追蹤**，支援高更新率追蹤移動物件，並導入空間配件（spatial accessories）輸入。
chapters: Discover and connect a spatial accessory

points.text: 以 `ReferenceObject.Configuration` 開啟 **`highFrameRateTrackingEnabled`**，追蹤移動與手持物件。
在 Mac 上用命令列 `xrun createml objecttracker` 的**擴充訓練模式（extended，all-angles）**產生 `.referenceobject`。
用 `coordinateSpace(correction:)` 取得 `.rendered` 或 `.none` 的物件姿態座標，分別對應顯示校正與公制空間。
物件追蹤也可在 **iOS** 上以 ARKit 實作，用 `detectionObjects`（低更新率）與 `trackingObjects`（高更新率）。
透過 GameController 的 `GCSpatialAccessory` 與 `AccessoryTrackingProvider` 探索並連接**空間配件**，支援隨插即用與動態更新。

audience: **開發 visionOS 空間運算或 AR 物件追蹤、配件互動**的開發者。
gloss_en: Explore enhancements to visionOS object tracking
takeaway_en: visionOS significantly enhances **object tracking**, supporting high-frame-rate tracking of moving objects and introducing spatial accessory input.

points_en.text: Enable **`highFrameRateTrackingEnabled`** via `ReferenceObject.Configuration` to track moving and handheld objects.
Generate a `.referenceobject` on Mac using the command-line `xrun createml objecttracker` with its **extended (all-angles) training mode**.
Use `coordinateSpace(correction:)` to get object pose coordinates in `.rendered` or `.none`, corresponding to display correction and metric space respectively.
Object tracking can also be implemented on **iOS** with ARKit, using `detectionObjects` (low frame rate) and `trackingObjects` (high frame rate).
Discover and connect **spatial accessories** through GameController's `GCSpatialAccessory` and `AccessoryTrackingProvider`, with support for hot-plugging and dynamic updates.

audience_en: Developers **building visionOS spatial computing or AR object tracking and accessory interactions**.
summary: 本場介紹 visionOS 27 在 **object tracking**（物件追蹤）與 **spatial accessories**（空間配件）上的進展，承接 visionOS 2.0 起的物件追蹤——只要有物件的 USDZ 模型，就能在 Mac 的 **Create ML** 透過機器學習訓練出 reference object，讓 app 取得實體物件的位置與方向來打造沉浸式體驗。visionOS 27 把追蹤擴展到**移動中與手持物件**，例如用手持醫療探針精準量測脊椎模型上椎骨間的距離，可應用於手術訓練、居家改造或引導組裝。

object tracking 有四項更新。其一，新增 **high frame rate tracking**，透過 ARKit 的 **Reference Object Configuration** API 對單一 reference object 啟用，且因非訓練設定，可依需求套在任何 reference object 上。其二，Create ML 新增 **extended training mode**，提升追蹤的準確度與穩健度（尤其手持時），建議搭配高幀率追蹤使用，但訓練時間明顯較長，CLI 亦可設定以便遠端機器訓練。其三，新增 **ARKit Coordinate Space Correction** API，可取得帶或不帶顯示校正的 anchor transform：`rendered` 維持虛擬內容與實體對齊，`none` 則回傳不受顯示校正影響的 **metric space** 姿態，這對量測類用途至關重要。其四，**object tracking 今年登陸 iOS**——同一份 reference object 在 iOS 與 visionOS 通用，用 world tracking configuration 搭配 `detectionObjects`／`trackingObjects`，並在 delegate 的 `didAdd`／`didUpdate`／`didRemove` 處理 `ARObjectAnchor`。

後半深入 **spatial accessories**：一個空間配件需含一塊電路板，上有供 Vision Pro 追蹤的 **LED 星座**、捕捉方向與加速度的 **IMU**，以及傳訊號的 **Bluetooth** 晶片，並可選配按鈕、觸控板與 haptics。相較物件追蹤，配件提供更高刷新率、更低延遲，在遮擋與低光下仍穩定追蹤，且能用實體按鈕與 haptics 強化互動。設計上要把 LED 散布成從各角度都獨特的圖樣、LED 與 IMU 須剛性固定、並依使用方式（手持／遠距）考量握持區、電池與 LED 數量大小。

驗證與導入流程：先用 Bluetooth 連上 Vision Pro，以開發者模式下的 **ARKit accessory tracking debug view** 透過 IR 相機檢查 LED、用即時指標驗證 IMU、並用 IR 照明器除錯時序。接著用 Create ML bundle 把標註了 IMU 與 LED 位置的 photorealistic USDZ 透過 CLI 產生 **reference accessory** 檔，作為製造商以 exported UTType 在 Info.plist 宣告即可系統層級註冊（第三方開發者則以 imported type 自行 bundle）。也可先用 DFRobot、MIKROE 等廠商即將推出的 **plug-and-play** 配件開發。app 端用新的 **`GCSpatialAccessory`** 探索配件、`Accessory(device)` 由 ARKit 自動解析、跑 `AccessoryTrackingProvider`，並用新的 `updateAccessories` 在不中斷追蹤下切換配件。最後比較四種追蹤路徑的取捨：物件追蹤適合需精準量測的情境（無 3D 模型時可用 marker），空間配件則適合需高刷新、低延遲、快速移動與更強互動的體驗。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: visionOS 團隊的 Nathan Kong 開場：回顧 visionOS 2.0 起的 **object tracking**——用物件的 USDZ 在 Mac 的 Create ML 訓練出 reference object，讓 app 取得實體位置與方向。visionOS 27 把追蹤擴展到**移動中與手持物件**（如用手持醫療探針量測脊椎模型上椎骨間距），並擴大 **spatial accessories** 支援讓任何人都能打造自己的配件（如把 Spatial Anchor 裝進方向盤對齊全尺寸數位車內裝）。

deepdive.title: Object tracking
deepdive.body: 概述 object tracking 的四項更新：支援**高幀率追蹤**讓 app 更掌握移動物件位置；Create ML 新增 **extended training mode** 提升準確度與穩健度（尤其手持時）；新增可取得**metric space** 物件姿態（不受顯示校正影響）的 API 以支援量測；以及**今年把 object tracking 帶上 iOS**。並以手電筒為例：有 photorealistic 3D 模型時可作 reference object，搭配 RealityKit 的 Physical Surroundings Light 即時打光；或 3D 列印一個 marker 貼上以追蹤任何手持物，即使手部部分遮擋仍穩定。

deepdive.title: Enable high frame rate tracking
deepdive.body: 新增 ARKit on visionOS 的 **Reference Object Configuration** API：在建立追蹤 session 前對單一 reference object 啟用高幀率追蹤，並在載入該 reference object 時把此 configuration 物件當額外參數傳入。因為這不是訓練設定，可依 app 需求套在任何 reference object 上。

deepdive.title: Extended training mode via command-line
deepdive.body: Create ML 訓練 reference object 時可在 standard 與 **extended** training mode 間選擇：extended 提升追蹤準確度與穩健度、建議搭配高幀率追蹤，但訓練時間明顯較長。設定位於 Create ML app 的 Object Tracking 範本中、viewing angle 設定下方；其餘訓練流程不變，並可透過 CLI 設定 training mode，方便在遠端機器執行訓練。

deepdive.title: Object pose coordinate spaces
deepdive.body: 預設的 object anchor transform 為了在 mixed immersion 下讓虛擬內容對齊實體，會略微調整姿態以匹配顯示的相機影像，因而影響其在絕對世界座標的準確度，限制了量測用途。visionOS 27 新增 **ARKit Coordinate Space Correction** API：查詢姿態時可選 `rendered`（套用顯示校正、保持視覺對齊）或 `none`（回傳不含校正的 **metric space** 姿態），後者適合量測物件間距或判定物件在實體空間的位置。

deepdive.title: Implement object tracking in iOS
deepdive.body: 今年把 object tracking 帶上 iOS：iOS 27 的 ARKit API 支援 reference object，且因機器學習訓練與平台無關，訓練好的 reference object 在 iOS 與 visionOS 通用。做法是載入 reference object、建立 world tracking configuration，把物件指派給 `detectionObjects`（多為靜止）或 `trackingObjects`（移動物件的高幀率追蹤），跑 session 後在 delegate 處理 anchor——`didAdd` 取得 `ARObjectAnchor` 附加內容、`didUpdate` 提供最新姿態、`didRemove` 清理。

deepdive.title: Spatial accessories
deepdive.body: 進入 spatial accessories：一個空間配件需含一塊電路板，上有供 Vision Pro 追蹤的 **LED 星座**、捕捉方向與加速度的 **IMU**、以及傳訊號的 **Bluetooth** 晶片，並可選配按鈕、觸控板等輸入與 haptics 等輸出。以裝上這些元件的手電筒示範：快速揮動時數位光束仍因 IMU 帶來的低延遲追蹤而平順跟隨，並可用實體按鈕開關數位光。

deepdive.title: Creating a spatial accessory
deepdive.body: 說明配件的好處與設計考量。好處：可達全顯示刷新率的高頻、低延遲追蹤，支援快速運動；遮擋時仍穩定；低光下仍可追蹤；按鈕與 haptics 強化互動沉浸。設計：把 LED 散布成從各角度都獨特的圖樣；LED 與 IMU 須剛性固定於板上以求準確；依主要使用方式安排（手持配件把多數 LED 放在不會被握住處、留意電池大小與位置以求人體工學；遠距使用的大型配件要考量 LED 數量、大小與間距以確保遠處仍可追蹤）。詳見 Accessory Design Guidelines 的 Spatial Accessories 章節。

deepdive.title: Plug-and-play accessories
deepdive.body: 在從零打造前，可先用 plug-and-play 配件開發：DFRobot、MIKROE 等廠商今年稍晚將推出現成的 reference 硬體與開發套件，可立即用於測試或實作於 visionOS app。示範把 seeMote Cap 之類的配件直接裝到手電筒上，用 Spatial Accessories API 實現同樣的數位重打光體驗。

deepdive.title: Implementing in your app
deepdive.body: 概述驗證與導入流程：先用 ARKit accessory tracking debug view 驗證裝置訊號，再用 Create ML bundle 訓練出 reference accessory 檔並準備好給 app 使用。

deepdive.title: Discover and connect a spatial accessory
deepdive.body: 先用 Bluetooth 連上 Vision Pro，並用開發者模式下設定中的 **ARKit accessory tracking debug view** 做三件事：透過頭戴 IR 相機確認 LED 明亮、清晰、同步；以頻率、延遲、各軸即時指標驗證 IMU 的尺度、對齊與動作反應；用裝置 IR 照明器作同步參考除錯時序。接著用 Create ML bundle：把標註 IMU 與 LED 位置的 photorealistic USDZ 經 CLI 產生 reference accessory 檔——製造商以 exported UTType 在 Info.plist 宣告即可系統層級註冊，第三方開發者則以 imported type 自行 bundle。app 端用新的 **`GCSpatialAccessory`** 探索配件，`Accessory(device)` 由 ARKit 自動解析後跑 `AccessoryTrackingProvider`，並用新的 `updateAccessories` 在不中斷追蹤下切換配件。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾比較四種追蹤路徑的取捨：**object tracking** 適合需精準量測的情境，無 photorealistic 3D 模型時可在物件上貼 marker 來訓練 reference object；**spatial accessories** 提供更高刷新率與更低延遲，最適合需快速移動的體驗，若想更互動沉浸還可自製帶按鈕與 haptics 的配件。鼓勵打造工作與娛樂的轉化性體驗。

summary_en: This session covers visionOS 27 advances in **object tracking** and **spatial accessories**, building on object tracking since visionOS 2.0—where a USDZ model of an object lets you train a reference object via machine learning in **Create ML** on a Mac, so your app can get a physical object's position and orientation for immersive experiences. visionOS 27 extends tracking to **moving and handheld objects**, such as using a handheld medical probe to precisely measure the distance between vertebrae on a spine model, enabling uses like surgical training, home remodeling, or guided assembly.

Object tracking gets four updates. First, **high frame rate tracking**, enabled per reference object via ARKit's **Reference Object Configuration** API—and since it's not a training setting, it can be applied to any reference object as needed. Second, Create ML adds an **extended training mode** that improves accuracy and robustness (especially when holding objects), recommended with high frame rate tracking but taking significantly longer, and configurable via the CLI for training on a remote machine. Third, the new **ARKit Coordinate Space Correction** API returns the anchor transform with or without display corrections: `rendered` keeps virtual content aligned, while `none` returns the **metric space** pose unaffected by display corrections, essential for measuring. Fourth, **object tracking comes to iOS** this year—the same reference object works on both iOS and visionOS, using a world tracking configuration with `detectionObjects`/`trackingObjects` and handling `ARObjectAnchor` in the delegate's `didAdd`/`didUpdate`/`didRemove`.

The second half dives into **spatial accessories**: an accessory needs a board with a **constellation of LEDs** visible to Vision Pro for tracking, an **IMU** capturing orientation and acceleration, and a **Bluetooth** chip to send signals, plus optional buttons, a touchpad, and haptics. Compared to object tracking, accessories offer higher refresh rates and lower latency, track robustly through occlusion and in low light, and add interactivity via physical buttons and haptics. Design-wise, spread LEDs into a pattern that's distinct from every angle, rigidly fix the LEDs and IMU, and account for how users hold or view the device when placing the grip area, battery, and LED count/size.

Validation and adoption flow: connect over Bluetooth and use the developer-mode **ARKit accessory tracking debug view** to check LEDs via the IR camera, validate the IMU with live metrics, and debug timing with IR illuminators. Then use the Create ML bundle to generate a **reference accessory** file from a photorealistic USDZ annotated with IMU and LED positions via the CLI—as the manufacturer, declare it as an exported UTType in Info.plist for system-wide registration (third-party developers bundle it as an imported type). You can also start with **plug-and-play** accessories from vendors like DFRobot and MIKROE arriving later this year. In your app, discover accessories with the new **`GCSpatialAccessory`** class, let ARKit resolve `Accessory(device)`, run an `AccessoryTrackingProvider`, and use the new `updateAccessories` to switch accessories without interrupting tracking. The session closes by comparing four tracking approaches: object tracking suits precise measurement (use a marker when there's no 3D model), while spatial accessories suit high-refresh, low-latency, fast-motion, and more interactive experiences.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: visionOS team's Nathan Kong opens by recapping **object tracking** since visionOS 2.0—training a reference object from an object's USDZ in Create ML on a Mac so apps can get physical position and orientation. visionOS 27 extends tracking to **moving and handheld objects** (e.g., a handheld medical probe measuring distances between vertebrae on a spine model) and broadens **spatial accessories** so anyone can build their own (like mounting a Spatial Anchor in a steering wheel to align a full-scale digital car interior).

deepdive_en.title: Object tracking
deepdive_en.body: Overviews four updates: **high frame rate tracking** for better understanding of moving objects; Create ML's new **extended training mode** for accuracy and robustness (especially handheld); a new API to get the object's pose in **metric space** unaffected by display corrections for measuring; and bringing object tracking to **iOS** this year. The flashlight example shows using a photorealistic 3D model as the reference object with RealityKit's Physical Surroundings Light for real-time relighting, or 3D-printing a marker to track any handheld object robustly even when partly occluded.

deepdive_en.title: Enable high frame rate tracking
deepdive_en.body: Adds a **Reference Object Configuration** API in ARKit on visionOS: enable high frame rate tracking per reference object before creating the tracking session, passing the configuration as an extra parameter when loading the reference object. Since it's not a training setting, it can be applied to any reference object as the app needs.

deepdive_en.title: Extended training mode via command-line
deepdive_en.body: When training a reference object in Create ML, you can choose between standard and **extended** training mode: extended improves accuracy and robustness and is recommended with high frame rate tracking but takes significantly longer. The setting lives in Create ML's Object Tracking template below viewing angles; everything else is unchanged, and the training mode can be set via the CLI to run training on a remote machine.

deepdive_en.title: Object pose coordinate spaces
deepdive_en.body: By default, object anchor transforms are tuned to align virtual content with the object in mixed immersion, slightly altering the pose to match the displayed camera images and thus affecting accuracy in absolute world coordinates—limiting measurement. visionOS 27 adds the **ARKit Coordinate Space Correction** API: querying a pose offers `rendered` (display corrections applied, keeping visual alignment) or `none` (the **metric space** pose without corrections), the latter ideal for measuring distances between objects or locating an object in physical space.

deepdive_en.title: Implement object tracking in iOS
deepdive_en.body: Object tracking comes to iOS: iOS 27's ARKit APIs support reference objects, and since ML training is platform-agnostic, trained reference objects work on both iOS and visionOS. Load the reference objects, create a world tracking configuration, assign objects to `detectionObjects` (mostly stationary) or `trackingObjects` (high frame rate tracking of moving objects), run the session, and handle anchors in the delegate—`didAdd` gives an `ARObjectAnchor` to attach content, `didUpdate` provides latest poses, `didRemove` cleans up.

deepdive_en.title: Spatial accessories
deepdive_en.body: Enters spatial accessories: an accessory needs a board with a **constellation of LEDs** visible to Vision Pro for tracking, an **IMU** for orientation and acceleration, and a **Bluetooth** chip to send signals, plus optional button/touchpad inputs and haptic outputs. A flashlight fitted with these components shows the digital beam following smoothly even when waved fast (low-latency IMU tracking), with a physical button toggling the digital light.

deepdive_en.title: Creating a spatial accessory
deepdive_en.body: Covers benefits and design considerations. Benefits: high-frequency, low-latency tracking up to full display rate for fast motion; robust tracking through occlusion; tracking in low light; and buttons/haptics for interactivity. Design: spread LEDs into a pattern distinct from every angle; rigidly fix LEDs and IMU to the board for accuracy; and account for primary use (handheld accessories keep most LEDs away from grip areas, with battery size/position for ergonomics; larger far-field accessories need attention to LED count, size, and spacing for accurate distant tracking). See the Spatial Accessories chapter of the Accessory Design Guidelines.

deepdive_en.title: Plug-and-play accessories
deepdive_en.body: Before building from scratch, you can develop with plug-and-play accessories: vendors like DFRobot and MIKROE will release off-the-shelf reference hardware and dev kits later this year, usable immediately for testing or in your app. The demo mounts a seeMote Cap onto the flashlight and uses the Spatial Accessories API for the same digital relighting experience.

deepdive_en.title: Implementing in your app
deepdive_en.body: Overviews the validation and adoption flow: first validate the device's signals with the ARKit accessory tracking debug view, then train a reference accessory file with the Create ML bundle to prepare it for the app.

deepdive_en.title: Discover and connect a spatial accessory
deepdive_en.body: Connect over Bluetooth and use the developer-mode **ARKit accessory tracking debug view** to do three things: confirm LEDs are bright, distinct, and synchronized via the headset's IR camera; validate the IMU with live frequency/latency/per-axis metrics for scale, alignment, and motion; and debug timing using the device's IR illuminators as a sync reference. Then use the Create ML bundle: generate a reference accessory file via the CLI from a photorealistic USDZ annotated with IMU and LED positions—manufacturers declare it as an exported UTType in Info.plist for system-wide registration, third-party developers bundle it as an imported type. In the app, discover accessories with the new **`GCSpatialAccessory`** class, let ARKit resolve `Accessory(device)` and run an `AccessoryTrackingProvider`, and use the new `updateAccessories` to switch accessories without interrupting tracking.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Closes by comparing four tracking approaches: **object tracking** excels where accurate, precise tracking is needed, and without a photorealistic 3D model you can train a reference object on a marker mounted to the object; **spatial accessories** offer higher refresh rates and lower latency, ideal for fast-moving experiences, and you can build your own with buttons and haptics for more interactivity. It encourages creating transformational experiences for work and play.

title: Collaborate on structured 3D models in visionOS
gloss: 在 visionOS 中協作操作結構化 3D 模型
takeaway: 在 visionOS 中準備結構化 USDZ 模型，並透過 ManipulationComponent 操作個別零件、組裝、裁切與自動展開。

points.text: 說明如何 **準備結構化 USDZ 資產**，讓模型的各個零件可被個別辨識與操作。
透過操作 **entity hierarchy**，使用者可逐一抓取與移動模型中的子零件。
以 **ManipulationComponent** 搭配 InputTargetComponent 實作組裝的開啟與關閉，並用 releaseBehavior 控制放開後行為。
支援 **互動式裁切（interactive clipping）**，可剖視模型內部結構。
提供 **自動展開（autoexpansion）** 讓複雜組件以爆炸圖方式呈現。

audience: 在 **visionOS 上開發 3D 模型檢視或協作體驗** 的開發者與 3D 內容製作者。
gloss_en: Collaborate on structured 3D models in visionOS
takeaway_en: Prepare structured USDZ models in visionOS and use ManipulationComponent to manipulate individual parts, assemble, clip, and auto-expand them.

points_en.text: Explains how to **prepare structured USDZ assets** so each part of the model can be individually identified and manipulated.
By manipulating the **entity hierarchy**, users can grab and move individual sub-parts of the model one by one.
Use **ManipulationComponent** with InputTargetComponent to implement opening and closing of an assembly, and control post-release behavior with releaseBehavior.
Supports **interactive clipping** to cut away and inspect the model's internal structure.
Provides **autoexpansion** to present complex assemblies as exploded views.

audience_en: Developers and 3D content creators **building 3D model viewing or collaboration experiences on visionOS**.
summary: 這場由 Bill 主講，示範如何在 Apple Vision Pro 上協作操作**結構化 3D 模型（structured 3D models）**，做出在平面螢幕上不可能的設計審查體驗。開場以一段 SharePlay 中審查 AirPods Pro 的情境貫穿全場：多人在同一空間、同一保真度下看同一個資產，能拉近、解鎖、拉出底部組件、旋轉給同事看、用手勢指出重點，再收合、開啟**剖面（clipping）**檢視主機板。背後仰賴 Vision Pro 的三項能力：**即時協作**、對多維資料的**豐富表現操作**，以及把虛擬決策落地的**環境光照（environment lighting）**。這些原則不限 CAD，也適用於都市規劃、物流、房地產等任何多維資訊。

全篇圍繞四大主題。首先是**資產準備（asset preparation）**：3D 模型本質是部分與整體的關係，若匯出時把所有幾何攤平到 root（InteriorPart_01、part 25…），雖然在 viewport 看起來正常，但程式無從判斷該隱藏、顯示或操作哪個部件。正確做法是保留**深層巢狀階層（hierarchy）**，讓每個節點都被命名、分組，程式才能找到並隔離出單一活塞或曲軸。

第二是**操作階層**，靠 RealityKit 的 **ManipulationComponent** 實作。元件放在哪一層就決定行為：放 root 時整個 spread 當一個物件移動；把 ManipulationComponent 往子節點搬，就能單獨拉開上蓋、旋轉一只耳機。`openAssembly` 移除實體上的 ManipulationComponent 與 InputTargetComponent，再逐一替子實體加上，並把 `releaseBehavior` 設為 `.stay` 讓放手後留在原位；`closeAssembly` 則反向操作收合。講者特別提醒：**別忘了加 CollisionComponent**，否則事件無法處理。

第三是 visionOS 27 新增的**剪裁（clipping）**，用 **ClippingComponent**（重點屬性是 entity local space 的 `bounds`，以及 `shouldClipChildren`、`shouldClipSelf`）讓內部如外部一樣可見。互動模型是把 AABB 的六個面變成六個可拖曳平面（六平面、六個數字），並用 `.off／.on／.editing` 三態狀態機管理。難點在座標系轉換：拖曳事件發生在 clipping plane 座標系，須經 World → Model 轉換、用**投影（projection，即點積／向量長度）**約束到平面法線方向後更新 bounds，再轉回 plane 座標系移動視覺平面。第四是**自動展開（autoexpansion）**：用**體積加權位置變異數（volume-weighted position variance）**沿每個軸計算，挑變異數最大的軸（範例中是 y 軸），再以 FromToBy 動畫把子組件散開。最後鼓勵大家熟悉統計、向量數學與線性代數，並下載官方範例專案。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 講者 Bill 以一段 SharePlay 中審查 AirPods Pro 的情境開場：多人在共享空間以相同保真度看同一資產，能拉近、解鎖、拉出底部組件、旋轉給同事看、用手勢指出重點，並開啟**剖面**看主機板。他歸納 Vision Pro 三項關鍵能力——**即時協作**、對多維資料的**豐富表現操作**、以及**環境光照**——並指出這些原則適用於 CAD 以外的都市規劃、物流、房地產等領域。全場將涵蓋資產準備、操作 assembly、clipping 與 autoexpansion 四大主題。

deepdive.title: Asset preparation
deepdive.body: 重點是模型的**階層結構**。3D 模型是部分與整體的關係，若匯出時把所有幾何攤平到 root（如 InteriorPart_01、part 25），即使在 viewport 看起來完全正常，程式也無從判斷要隱藏、顯示或讓哪個部件可操作——想隔離某顆活塞根本找不到。正確做法是保留**深層巢狀的 hierarchy**，讓每個節點被命名、分組，程式才能找到並單獨動畫、highlight 或讓人徒手拉出。

deepdive.title: Manipulating the hierarchy
deepdive.body: 用 RealityKit 的 **ManipulationComponent** 讓人以自然手勢選取、移動、旋轉、縮放部件，關鍵在於**元件放在樹的哪一層就決定行為**。放在 root 時整個展開的模型當作單一物件移動且內部關係不變；把元件下移到子節點，就能單獨拉開上蓋、讓兩人同時旋轉各自的耳機。這個從「觀看之物」到「探索之物」的轉變，純粹來自元件在樹中的位置。

deepdive.title: Opening an assembly
deepdive.body: 對應 `openAssembly()`：先移除實體上的 **ManipulationComponent** 與 **InputTargetComponent** 讓它本身不可操作，再迭代子實體，為每個子節點加上 InputTargetComponent 與 ManipulationComponent，並把 `releaseBehavior` 設為 `.stay`，讓人放手後部件留在原位。講者特別強調：範例未顯示但**務必為實體加上 CollisionComponent**，否則事件無法被處理。

deepdive.title: Closing an assembly
deepdive.body: 對應 `closeAssembly()`，流程與開啟相反：先把每個子實體的 ManipulationComponent 與 InputTargetComponent 移除，再把這兩個元件加回父實體（同樣 `releaseBehavior = .stay`）。如此一來整棵樹既能在收合時當作**單一元素**被操作，也能在開啟時當作各自獨立的實體，幾何與階層皆未改變，差別只在元件所在的位置。

deepdive.title: Interactive clipping
deepdive.body: 介紹 visionOS 27 新的 **ClippingComponent**，讓內部如外部一樣可見。重點屬性是 entity local space 的 `bounds`（AABB，超出範圍每幀被丟棄），以及 `shouldClipChildren`（預設 false，子節點不剪裁多半因為它）與 `shouldClipSelf`（預設 true）。互動把六個面變成六個可拖曳平面（**六平面、六個數字**），以 `.off／.on／.editing` 三態管理，並用 ClippingBoundsCache、ClippingTransformSync 等自訂元件輔助。最難處是座標系：拖曳事件在 clipping plane 座標系，須經 World → Model 轉換、用**投影（點積除以長度平方）**約束到平面法線方向更新 bounds，再轉回 plane 座標系移動視覺平面，讓互動手感自然。

deepdive.title: Autoexpansion
deepdive.body: 示範讓組件**自動沿單一軸展開**以揭露內部結構，且不強迫使用者選方向，而是讓程式用數學決定。講者先科普**變異數（variance）**與**加權（weighting）**：把每個值的離均差平方後平均得變異數，再乘上權重得加權變異數。接著計算各軸的**體積加權位置變異數（volume-weighted position variance）**，以體積為權重，挑變異數最大的軸——範例中 x 與 z 因部件多聚在一起而變異數小，**y 軸**因大體積部件距離較遠而勝出，最後用 FromToBy 動畫把子組件沿 y 軸散開。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 回顧今天涵蓋的資產階層準備、部件操作、clipping 透視與沿軸展開，並指出這套流程能打造大幅提升生產力的設計審查 app。講者鼓勵大家從 developer.apple.com 下載範例專案，並熟悉**統計、向量數學與線性代數**。延伸方向包括用 spatial preview framework 從 Mac 即時控制模型，以及結合 object tracking 把虛擬內容疊在實體物件（如賽車模擬座艙）上探索其內部結構。

summary_en: Presented by Bill, this session shows how to collaborate on **structured 3D models** on Apple Vision Pro to build design-review experiences that simply aren't possible on a flat screen. A running scenario of a SharePlay AirPods Pro design review threads through the talk: multiple people in the same space, at the same fidelity, see the same asset — pulling it closer, unlocking it, lifting out the bottom assembly, rotating it for a colleague, pointing with a gesture, then collapsing it and engaging **clipping** to expose the logic board. This rests on three things Vision Pro does well: **real-time collaboration**, **manipulation of rich representations** of multidimensional data, and **environment lighting** that grounds every virtual decision. The principles extend beyond CAD to urban planning, logistics, real estate, and more.

The talk covers four topics. First, **asset preparation**: a 3D model is a part-whole relationship, and if it's exported with everything flattened to the root (InteriorPart_01, part 25, …) it looks fine in the viewport but the code can't decide what to hide, show, or make manipulable. The fix is a deep, nested **hierarchy** where every node is named and grouped, so code can find and isolate a single piston or the crankshaft.

Second, **manipulating the hierarchy** with RealityKit's **ManipulationComponent**, where placement in the tree drives behavior: at the root the whole spread moves as one object, while moving the component down to the children lets you pull off the top enclosure or rotate one earbud independently. `openAssembly` removes the ManipulationComponent and InputTargetComponent from the entity, then adds them to each child with `releaseBehavior` set to `.stay` so parts stay where released; `closeAssembly` reverses this. The presenter stresses a key caveat: **don't forget the CollisionComponent**, which is critical for event processing.

Third is **clipping**, new in visionOS 27, via the **ClippingComponent** (key properties: `bounds` in entity local space, plus `shouldClipChildren` and `shouldClipSelf`) so the inside becomes as visible as the outside. The interaction turns the six faces of the AABB into six draggable planes (six planes, six numbers), managed by an `.off / .on / .editing` state machine. The hard part is coordinate-frame conversion: drag events arrive in the clipping-plane frame and must be transformed through World → Model, constrained to the plane normal via **projection (a dot product over length squared)** to update the bounds, then converted back to move the visual plane. Fourth is **autoexpansion**: the code computes a **volume-weighted position variance** along each axis and expands along the axis with the largest variance (y in the example), then uses FromToBy animations to fan the sub-assemblies apart. The session closes by encouraging familiarity with statistics, vector math, and linear algebra, and pointing to the downloadable sample project.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Bill opens with a SharePlay AirPods Pro design-review scenario that threads through the talk: multiple people in a shared space, at the same fidelity, examine one asset — pulling it closer, unlocking it, lifting out the bottom assembly, rotating it for a colleague, pointing with a gesture, and engaging **clipping** to reveal the logic board. He distills three key Vision Pro capabilities — **real-time collaboration**, **manipulation of rich representations** of multidimensional data, and **environment lighting** — and notes these principles apply beyond CAD to urban planning, logistics, and real estate. The session will cover asset preparation, manipulating assemblies, clipping, and autoexpansion.

deepdive_en.title: Asset preparation
deepdive_en.body: The focus is the model's **hierarchy**. A 3D model is a part-whole relationship, and if it's exported with all geometry flattened to the root (InteriorPart_01, part 25), it looks completely fine in the viewport but the code can't decide what to hide, show, or make manipulable — isolating a single piston becomes impossible. The right approach is a deep, nested **hierarchy** where each node is named and grouped, so code can find a part and animate, highlight, or let a person pull it free.

deepdive_en.title: Manipulating the hierarchy
deepdive_en.body: RealityKit's **ManipulationComponent** lets people select, move, rotate, and scale parts with natural hand input, and the key idea is that **where the component lives in the tree drives behavior**. At the root the whole expanded model moves as a single object with internal relationships intact; moving the component down to the children lets you pull off the top enclosure or let two people rotate separate earbuds at once. That shift from 'thing to look at' to 'thing to explore' comes entirely from the component's position in the tree.

deepdive_en.title: Opening an assembly
deepdive_en.body: This maps to `openAssembly()`: first remove the **ManipulationComponent** and **InputTargetComponent** from the entity so it isn't manipulable on its own, then iterate the children and add an InputTargetComponent and ManipulationComponent to each, with `releaseBehavior` set to `.stay` so a part stays where the person puts it on release. The presenter stresses a critical note not shown in the snippet: **always add a CollisionComponent**, since it's essential for event processing.

deepdive_en.title: Closing an assembly
deepdive_en.body: This maps to `closeAssembly()`, the reverse of opening: remove the ManipulationComponent and InputTargetComponent from each child, then add both back to the parent entity (again with `releaseBehavior = .stay`). The tree can then be manipulated as a **single element** when closed or as independent entities when open, with neither the geometry nor the hierarchy changing — only where the component lives.

deepdive_en.title: Interactive clipping
deepdive_en.body: This introduces the **ClippingComponent**, new in visionOS 27, making the inside as visible as the outside. Key properties are `bounds` (an AABB in entity local space, with anything outside discarded each frame), `shouldClipChildren` (defaults to false — the usual reason children aren't clipping), and `shouldClipSelf` (defaults to true). The interaction turns the six faces into six draggable planes (**six planes, six numbers**), managed by an `.off / .on / .editing` state machine with helper components like ClippingBoundsCache and ClippingTransformSync. The hard part is the coordinate frames: drag events arrive in the clipping-plane frame and must be transformed through World → Model, constrained to the plane normal via **projection (a dot product over length squared)** to update the bounds, then converted back to move the visual plane so the interaction feels natural.

deepdive_en.title: Autoexpansion
deepdive_en.body: This demonstrates expanding the assembly **along a single axis** to reveal its inner structure, without forcing the person to choose the direction — the code decides with math. The presenter explains **variance** and **weighting**: square each value's deviation from the mean and average them for variance, then multiply by a weight for weighted variance. It then computes a **volume-weighted position variance** along each axis using volume as the weight and picks the axis with the largest variance — x and z are small because parts cluster together, while **y** wins because large-volume parts sit farther apart — then uses FromToBy animations to fan the sub-assemblies out along y.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: The session recaps preparing an asset hierarchy, manipulating parts, using clipping to see through an assembly, and expanding parts along an axis, noting this workflow enables productivity-boosting design-review apps. The presenter encourages downloading the sample project from developer.apple.com and getting comfortable with **statistics, vector math, and linear algebra**. Extensions include using the spatial preview framework to control models in real time from a Mac, and combining object tracking to overlay virtual content on a physical object (like a race-car simulator cockpit) to explore its internal structure.

title: Discover USDKit and what’s new in OpenUSD
gloss: 認識 USDKit 與 OpenUSD 的新功能
takeaway: 全新 Swift 原生的 USDKit 讓你以類型安全的 API 開啟、走訪與編輯 USD Stage，並支援無障礙中繼資料與網格／紋理壓縮匯出。
chapters: OpenUSD: Industry Foundation and New Standards
3D Editing in Preview and New Renderers
Spatial Preview: Live Collaboration Between Mac and Vision Pro

Moving a Prim with a Transform Operation
Exporting with Mesh and Texture Compression

points.text: 推出 **Swift 原生的 USDKit**，可建立／開啟 **USDStage**、走訪 prim 階層、定義 Xform 並加入檔案參照。
OpenUSD 採用新標準，支援 **Gaussian Splats 與 Particle Fields**；Preview 可進行 3D 編輯，並與 Vision Pro 即時協作。
可在 USD 中套用 **AccessibilityAPI schema**，為 3D 物件加上 label 與 description 等**無障礙中繼資料**。
匯出 **USDZ** 時可用 preferSmallTextureFiles 與 preferSmallMeshFiles 進行**網格與紋理壓縮**；Safari 也支援 model 標籤呈現 USD。

audience: **處理 3D 內容、AR/visionOS 場景或遊戲資產管線**、需要在 Apple 平台上以 Swift 操作 USD 的開發者。
gloss_en: Discover USDKit and what's new in OpenUSD
takeaway_en: The new Swift-native USDKit lets you open, traverse, and edit a USD Stage with type-safe APIs, with support for accessibility metadata and mesh/texture-compressed export.

points_en.text: Introduces **Swift-native USDKit**, which can create/open a **USDStage**, traverse the prim hierarchy, define Xforms, and add file references.
OpenUSD adopts new standards supporting **Gaussian Splats and Particle Fields**; Preview enables 3D editing and real-time collaboration with Vision Pro.
Apply the **AccessibilityAPI schema** in USD to add **accessibility metadata** such as label and description to 3D objects.
When exporting **USDZ**, use preferSmallTextureFiles and preferSmallMeshFiles for **mesh and texture compression**; Safari also supports rendering USD via the model tag.

audience_en: **Developers working with 3D content, AR/visionOS scenes, or game asset pipelines** who need to work with USD in Swift on Apple platforms.
summary: 本場由 Apple 空間標準團隊工程師 Lee 主講，介紹 **OpenUSD** 在 Apple 平台上的最新進展，以及全新的 Swift 系統框架 **USDKit**。**USD**（Universal Scene Description）由 Pixar 創建，已成為橫跨電影、AAA 遊戲、工廠、手術室、自駕車與 AI 模擬等產業的通用 3D 語言。它並非單打獨鬥，而是與來自 Lucasfilm 的 **MaterialX**（材質描述）及今年新加入、來自 DreamWorks 的 **OpenVDB**（體積資料）整合，三者今年皆已更新。Apple 是 Academy Software Foundation 成員與 Alliance for OpenUSD 的創始成員,今年協助發布了 USD 核心的首份正式規格。

在技術亮點方面，Apple 與 NVIDIA、Adobe、Pixar 等夥伴合作，導入新的 USD primitive 型別 **Particle Fields**，能描述 **Gaussian Splats**（以數百萬顆模糊重疊粒子捕捉真實場景，各自編碼位置、顏色與透明度）等新興表示法，首度讓 splats 與 mesh、材質等傳統 3D 資料共存於同一場景。**Preview** 與 **Quick Look** 今年帶來 Mac 上的基本 3D 編輯能力與多種 renderer 選擇（**RealityKit**、Storm,以及為複雜場景打造的全新 **Raytracer**），三者皆支援比 USDPreviewSurface 更先進的 **OpenPBR**。Preview 並整合 macOS 27 的 **Spatial Preview** 框架，讓 Mac 上的編輯能即時在 Vision Pro 的 Quick Look 中呈現，並可透過 SharePlay 多人協作；Safari 也新增 **Model tag**，讓 USD 內容如同圖片或影片般原生嵌入網頁。

整場核心是全新系統框架 **USDKit**，為 Swift app 帶來一流的 USD 支援，並深度整合 RealityKit 與 Spatial Preview。講者先說明關鍵概念：**Layer**（單一資料檔）、**Composition**（組合多個 layer）、**Stage**（組合後的完整場景視窗）、**Prim**（場景中的每個物件，由 **Schema** 定義型別，並帶有 **Attributes** 與 **Metadata**）。接著以 ALab 場景示範完整流程：用 USDStage.open 載入 stage、用 descendants 遍歷階層尋找示波器、用 definePrim 定義 Xform prim 並以 references.add 加入輕量參考（展現 composition 威力，他人更新會自動反映），再用 addTransformOperation 搭配 xformOp:translate 把資產移到工作檯正確位置。

講者也強調無障礙與壓縮兩大重點。Apple 推動將 **accessibility metadata** 標準化進 USD,可對 3D 物件定義輔助標籤與描述,並已在 Blender 與 Maya 直接支援;示範以 applyAPISchema 套用 **AccessibilityAPI** schema 並建立 label 與 description 屬性。在壓縮方面,與 Alliance for Open Media 合作導入可將 mesh 縮小達 90% 的編碼,結合既有的 **AVIF** 紋理壓縮,平均資產縮小七倍而不損視覺品質,可透過 exportPackage 的選項、Preview 或 usdcrush 命令列工具達成。最後說明整合路徑:app 開發者首選 **USDKit**,進階或跨平台需求可用 **SwiftUSD**（Swift Package Manager）或直接嵌入 **OpenUSD** C++ 框架,三者共用同一基礎,USD 檔案可自由流通。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Apple 空間標準（Spatial Standards）團隊工程師 **Lee** 開場,點出 **USD** 是 Apple 創造空間體驗、表示空間場景的骨幹,從你打造的 app 到平台上的內容皆建立在 USD 之上。USD 由 Pixar 創建,Apple 很早就看出其潛力並持續合作。本場將涵蓋 USD 在 Apple 平台上的最新進展,以及一個能在 Mac 與 Vision Pro 間搭橋、帶來無縫 3D 體驗的強大新框架 **USDKit**。

deepdive.title: OpenUSD: Industry Foundation and New Standards
deepdive.body: 說明 **OpenUSD** 是 USD 背後的開源專案,為描述 3D 場景的業界標準函式庫。它與來自 Lucasfilm 的 **MaterialX**（材質描述）及今年新加入、來自 DreamWorks 的 **OpenVDB**（體積資料）整合,三者今年皆更新。Apple 身為 **Academy Software Foundation** 成員與 **Alliance for OpenUSD** 創始成員,今年協助發布了 USD 核心的首份正式規格,幾何、材質與物理的領域規格也已展開,並鼓勵開發者參與這些決定 USD 未來的工作小組。

deepdive.title: Gaussian Splats and Particle Fields
deepdive.body: 介紹 **Gaussian Splats** 是近年 3D 表示法的重大突破:不使用傳統幾何,而是以數百萬顆模糊重疊的粒子捕捉場景,每顆編碼位置、顏色與透明度,能忠實重建複雜真實環境並捕捉細微光照反應。Apple 與 NVIDIA、Adobe、Pixar 等 Alliance 夥伴合作,導入新的 USD primitive 型別 **Particle Fields**,可描述 Gaussian Splats 及此快速演進領域的其他表示法,首度讓 splats 與 mesh、材質等傳統 3D 資料共存於同一場景。

deepdive.title: Introducing USDKit
deepdive.body: 帶出本場核心:全新框架 **USDKit** 負責處理繁重工作,讓開發者專注於內容與應用。這一切都建立在前述標準化工作的基礎之上,接下來將展示橫跨各平台的強大新體驗以及為驅動它們而打造的 USDKit。

deepdive.title: 3D Editing in Preview and New Renderers
deepdive.body: **Preview** 長久以來是 Mac 上檢視圖片、PDF 與 3D 內容的首選,今年將其開箱即用的編輯哲學帶到 3D:可直接在場景中操作物件、編輯屬性與光照、處理完整場景階層、轉換與壓縮資產,無須學習專門 3D 軟體,且背後由量產品質的渲染與處理管線支撐。Preview 與 **Quick Look** 提供 renderer 選擇:**RealityKit**(跨 Mac、iPhone、iPad、Vision Pro 一致)、Storm(現有量產管線),以及為最複雜場景打造、提供精準反射陰影與物理正確光照的全新 **Raytracer**;三者皆支援比 USDPreviewSurface 更先進的 **OpenPBR**。

deepdive.title: Spatial Preview: Live Collaboration Between Mac and Vision Pro
deepdive.body: Preview 整合 macOS 27 的全新 **Spatial Preview** 框架,在 Mac 與 Vision Pro 的 Quick Look 間建立直接連線。當你在 Preview 編輯 USD 場景時,變更會即時呈現在你自己空間中的 Vision Pro Quick Look,並透過 **SharePlay** 讓整個團隊同時加入,創意總監與藝術家可一起繞著同一場景走動,即時檢視光照、構圖與空間尺度。此框架讓這類協作式空間工作流程更容易帶進你自己的 Mac app。

deepdive.title: USD on the Web: The Safari Model Tag
deepdive.body: USD 現在也進入網頁。**Safari** 推出 **Model tag**,讓 3D 內容如同圖片或影片般自然地帶進網頁。在頁面中嵌入 USD 模型後,macOS 與 iOS 使用者能在瀏覽器中獲得完全互動的 3D 體驗;在 **visionOS** 上更進一步,同一模型會突破頁面框架,在使用者空間中以空間方式呈現。

deepdive.title: USDKit: Key Concepts and Swift API Walkthrough
deepdive.body: 說明 **USDKit** 為 Swift app 帶來一流 USD 支援,深度整合 RealityKit 與 Spatial Preview,既讓熟悉 USD 的開發者立刻上手,也以 Swift 既有的模式迎接初次接觸 USD 的人。接著鋪陳關鍵概念:**Layer**(單一資料檔)、**Composition**(組合多個 layer)、**Stage**(組合後的完整場景視窗),場景中每個物件都是 **Prim**,由 **Schema** 定義型別,並帶有存放實際資料的 **Attributes** 與描述 prim 本身的 **Metadata**。

deepdive.title: Opening a USD Stage
deepdive.body: 示範以 USDKit 入門皆從 stage 開始。可用簡單的 **USDStage** 初始化器在記憶體中建立全新 stage;但此 demo 中講者要處理既有場景,故傳入 file URL 給 **USDStage.open**。由於涉及檔案存取會 throw,因此使用 try。場景順利載入且外觀已相當不錯,但講者發現工作檯上應有的示波器(oscilloscope)不見了。

deepdive.title: Traversing the Stage Hierarchy
deepdive.body: 為了確認示波器是否已在場景中,講者先用 stage 的 **descendants** 遍歷整個 stage 階層、比對 prim.name 是否為 "scope"。結果並未找到,於是用 **definePrim** 在想要的路徑定義一個新的 Xform transform prim,再以 **references.add** 加入輕量參考——資產存在於他人撰寫的獨立檔案(layer)中,僅是被引入而非整份複製。這正是 **composition** 的威力:每人各自處理場景的一部分,而 USD 將其組合在一起,且他人的更新會自動反映到自己的 stage。

deepdive.title: Moving a Prim with a Transform Operation
deepdive.body: 資產雖已進入場景,但位置不對。講者先呼叫 **addTransformOperation**,它會自動建立正確的 transform 屬性並更新 transform 順序;之後只需設定 **xformOp:translate** 的平移值(如 [2.5, 0.0, -1.0]),資產便移到工作檯上正確的位置。

deepdive.title: Accessibility Metadata in USD
deepdive.body: 強調無障礙是 Apple 的核心價值,空間內容亦然。Apple 推動將 **accessibility metadata** 直接標準化進 USD,確立如何在 3D 物件上定義輔助標籤與描述,並以彈性設計讓其未來能演進。由於它原生於 USD,可透過任何 USD API 撰寫,且為方便採用,已在 **Blender** 與 **Maya** 直接支援。

deepdive.title: Applying Accessibility Metadata
deepdive.body: 示範為新資產加入無障礙資料:先用 **applyAPISchema** 對 prim 套用 **AccessibilityAPI** schema(以 instance name "default"),加入必要 metadata 表明 schema 存在。由於 USDKit 未提供所有 schema 專屬 API,講者依規格定義的正確屬性名稱直接以 makeAttribute 建立 label 與 description 屬性,再設定其值——一個精簡的 label("Oscilloscope")與一段豐富的 description,讓輔助技術充分理解該物件。

deepdive.title: Asset Compression: Mesh and Texture
deepdive.body: 指出量產品質的 USD 場景(如 ALab)可達數 GB,分享不易。Apple 與 **Alliance for Open Media** 合作,加入最先進的 mesh 壓縮編碼,可將 mesh 大小縮減達 90%;結合既有以 **AVIF** 進行的紋理壓縮,平均資產縮小七倍而不損視覺品質,帶來更快傳遞、更低儲存成本與更佳體驗。

deepdive.title: Exporting with Mesh and Texture Compression
deepdive.body: 說明壓縮支援直接內建於 **exportPackage** API:將輸出 URL 傳入 stage 的 exportPackage 方法,並透過 export options 啟用 **preferSmallTextureFiles**(紋理)與 **preferSmallMeshFiles**(mesh)壓縮,寥寥數行即可完成。若不寫程式,也可直接在 Preview 或透過 **usdcrush** 命令列工具達到相同結果;Apple 正與 Pixar 合作將此壓縮支援帶進 OpenUSD 專案,讓整個生態系受惠。

deepdive.title: Integration Paths: USDKit, SwiftUSD, and OpenUSD
deepdive.body: 因整合 USD 可能複雜,講者列出多種存取技術的路徑。平台上的 app 開發者首選 **USDKit**,它由系統提供、深度整合,今日所展示的一切皆建立其上。對於更進階或超出 USDKit 範圍的跨平台工作流程,**SwiftUSD** 提供可透過 Swift Package Manager 取得的開源 Swift 綁定;跨平台 C++ 程式庫則可更輕易地直接嵌入 **OpenUSD** 框架。三條路徑都建立在同一基礎之上,USD 檔案可在它們之間自由流通。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結今年 USD 在 Apple 平台的重大進展:**Preview** 帶來基本 3D 編輯與強大渲染選項、**Spatial Preview** 讓人沉浸於內容並與他人分享、Safari 的 **Model tag** 將 USD 原生帶上網頁,而這一切的核心是讓 Swift 操作 USD 成為一流體驗的新系統框架 **USDKit**。講者建議想在 app 中創作 3D 內容者從 USDKit 著手,並指向關於 Spatial Preview、USD on the web 與 RealityKit/Reality Composer Pro 的延伸 session。

summary_en: Presented by Lee, an engineer on Apple's Spatial Standards team, this session covers the latest advances in **OpenUSD** on Apple platforms and a new Swift system framework, **USDKit**. **USD** (Universal Scene Description), created by Pixar, has become the common 3D language across industries spanning award-winning films, AAA games, factory floors, surgical suites, autonomous vehicles, and AI-driven simulations. It doesn't work alone but integrates with **MaterialX** from Lucasfilm (material descriptions) and, new this year, **OpenVDB** from DreamWorks (volumetric data), all three updated this year. Apple is a member of the Academy Software Foundation and a founding member of the Alliance for OpenUSD, and this year helped release the first formal specification for the core of USD.

Among the highlights, Apple worked with partners including NVIDIA, Adobe, and Pixar to introduce a new USD primitive type, **Particle Fields**, capable of describing **Gaussian Splats** (which capture real-world scenes as millions of fuzzy, overlapping particles each encoding position, color, and opacity), bringing splats into the same scene as meshes and materials for the first time. **Preview** and **Quick Look** bring essential 3D editing to the Mac this year along with a choice of renderers (**RealityKit**, Storm, and a brand new **Raytracer** for complex scenes), all supporting **OpenPBR**, a significant upgrade over USDPreviewSurface. Preview integrates with the macOS 27 **Spatial Preview** framework so edits on the Mac appear live in Quick Look on Vision Pro, with SharePlay enabling team collaboration, and Safari adds a **Model tag** so USD content embeds natively in web pages like images or video.

The centerpiece is the new system framework **USDKit**, which brings first-class USD support to Swift apps with deep RealityKit and Spatial Preview integration. The presenter first explains key concepts: a **Layer** (a single data file), **Composition** (combining layers), a **Stage** (the composed result, your window into the full scene), and a **Prim** (every object in the scene, typed by a **Schema** and carrying **Attributes** and **Metadata**). He then demonstrates the full flow with the ALab scene: loading a stage with USDStage.open, traversing the hierarchy via descendants to find an oscilloscope, defining an Xform prim with definePrim and adding a lightweight reference via references.add (showing composition's power, where others' updates flow through automatically), and moving the asset onto the workbench with addTransformOperation and xformOp:translate.

The talk also emphasizes accessibility and compression. Apple has driven standardizing **accessibility metadata** directly in USD, letting you define assistive labels and descriptions on 3D objects, with direct support already in Blender and Maya; the demo applies the **AccessibilityAPI** schema via applyAPISchema and creates label and description attributes. For compression, working with the Alliance for Open Media, Apple added a codec reducing mesh sizes by up to 90%, which combined with existing **AVIF** texture compression makes the average asset seven times smaller without compromising quality, achievable via exportPackage options, Preview, or the usdcrush command-line tool. Finally, on integration paths: app developers should start with **USDKit**, while advanced or cross-platform needs can use **SwiftUSD** (via Swift Package Manager) or embed **OpenUSD** C++ directly, all built on the same foundation so USD files move freely between them.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Engineer **Lee** from Apple's Spatial Standards team opens by noting that **USD** is the backbone of the spatial experiences Apple creates and how it represents spatial scenes, with everything from the apps you build to the content across platforms built on top of USD. USD was created by Pixar, and Apple recognized its potential early and has collaborated ever since. The session covers the latest advances in USD on Apple platforms plus a powerful new framework, **USDKit**, that can bridge Mac and Vision Pro for seamless 3D experiences.

deepdive_en.title: OpenUSD: Industry Foundation and New Standards
deepdive_en.body: Explains that **OpenUSD** is the open-source project behind USD, the industry-standard library for describing 3D scenes. It integrates with **MaterialX** from Lucasfilm (material descriptions) and, new this year, **OpenVDB** from DreamWorks (volumetric data), all three updated this year. As a member of the **Academy Software Foundation** and a founding member of the **Alliance for OpenUSD**, Apple this year helped release the first formal specification for the core of USD, with domain specifications for geometry, materials, and physics underway, and encourages developers to join these working groups shaping USD's future.

deepdive_en.title: Gaussian Splats and Particle Fields
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **Gaussian Splats** as one of the most exciting recent 3D breakthroughs: rather than traditional geometry, splats capture a scene as millions of fuzzy, overlapping particles, each encoding position, color, and opacity, faithfully reconstructing complex real-world environments and capturing subtle lighting responses. Working with Alliance partners including NVIDIA, Adobe, and Pixar, Apple introduces a new USD primitive type, **Particle Fields**, capable of describing Gaussian Splats and other representations from this rapidly evolving area, bringing splats into the same scene as meshes and materials for the first time.

deepdive_en.title: Introducing USDKit
deepdive_en.body: Sets up the session's centerpiece: the new framework **USDKit** takes care of the heavy lifting so developers can stay focused on their content and applications. All of this is made possible by the standardization work built towards, and the talk now turns to the powerful new experiences across platforms and the USDKit framework built to power them.

deepdive_en.title: 3D Editing in Preview and New Renderers
deepdive_en.body: **Preview** has long been the go-to for viewing images, PDFs, and 3D content on Mac, and this year brings its out-of-the-box editing philosophy to 3D: manipulate objects directly, edit properties and lighting, work with full scene hierarchies, and convert and compress assets without a dedicated 3D app, all backed by a production-quality pipeline. Preview and **Quick Look** offer a choice of renderer: **RealityKit** (consistent across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Vision Pro), Storm (for existing production pipelines), and a brand new **Raytracer** for the most complex scenes delivering accurate reflections, precise shadows, and physically correct lighting; all three support **OpenPBR**, a significant upgrade over USDPreviewSurface.

deepdive_en.title: Spatial Preview: Live Collaboration Between Mac and Vision Pro
deepdive_en.body: Preview integrates with the new macOS 27 **Spatial Preview** framework, creating a direct connection between the Mac and Quick Look on Vision Pro. As you work on a USD scene in Preview, changes appear live in Quick Look on Vision Pro in your own space, and through **SharePlay** an entire team can join at once, with creative directors and artists walking around the same scene together to review lighting, composition, and spatial scale in real time. The framework makes this kind of collaborative spatial workflow easier to bring into your own Mac apps.

deepdive_en.title: USD on the Web: The Safari Model Tag
deepdive_en.body: USD is now part of the web too. **Safari** introduces the **Model tag**, bringing 3D content to web pages as naturally as images or video. Embed a USD model in a page, and on macOS and iOS users get a fully interactive 3D experience right in the browser; on **visionOS** it goes further, with the same model breaking out of the page and presented spatially in the user's own space.

deepdive_en.title: USDKit: Key Concepts and Swift API Walkthrough
deepdive_en.body: Explains **USDKit** brings first-class USD support to Swift apps with deep RealityKit and Spatial Preview integration, feeling immediately familiar to those who know USD while meeting Swift developers new to USD with patterns they already know. It then lays out key concepts: a **Layer** (a single data file), **Composition** (combining layers), a **Stage** (the composed result, your window into the full scene), with every object a **Prim** typed by a **Schema** and carrying **Attributes** (holding the actual data) and **Metadata** (describing the prim itself).

deepdive_en.title: Opening a USD Stage
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates that getting started with USDKit begins with a stage. You can create a fresh one in memory with a simple **USDStage** initializer; but for this demo the presenter works with an existing scene, opening it by passing a file URL to **USDStage.open**. Since this involves file access it can throw, so try is used. The scene loads and looks great, but the presenter notices the oscilloscope that should be on the bench is missing.

deepdive_en.title: Traversing the Stage Hierarchy
deepdive_en.body: To check whether the oscilloscope is already in the scene, the presenter first traverses the stage hierarchy using the stage's **descendants**, comparing prim.name to "scope". With no luck, he uses **definePrim** to define a new Xform transform prim at the desired path, then adds a lightweight reference via **references.add** — the asset lives in its own file (layer) authored by someone else and is simply pulled in rather than copied. This is the power of **composition**: everyone works on their own piece and USD brings it all together, with others' updates automatically showing up in your stage.

deepdive_en.title: Moving a Prim with a Transform Operation
deepdive_en.body: The asset is in the scene but not where it should be. The presenter first calls **addTransformOperation**, which creates the correct transform attributes and updates the transform order automatically; then he only needs to set the **xformOp:translate** value (such as [2.5, 0.0, -1.0]) and the asset moves up onto the workbench, right where it should be.

deepdive_en.title: Accessibility Metadata in USD
deepdive_en.body: Emphasizes that accessibility is a core value at Apple, and that includes spatial content. Apple has driven standardizing **accessibility metadata** directly in USD, establishing how assistive labels and descriptions are defined on 3D objects across the industry, designed with flexibility so it can evolve. Because it is native to USD, you can author it through any USD API, and to ease adoption there is direct support in **Blender** and **Maya**.

deepdive_en.title: Applying Accessibility Metadata
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates adding accessibility data to the new asset: first apply the **AccessibilityAPI** schema to the prim via **applyAPISchema** (with instance name "default"), adding the metadata that signals the schema is present. Since USDKit does not provide all schema-specific APIs, the presenter creates the label and description attributes directly with makeAttribute, using the correct attribute names from the specification, then sets their values — a concise label ("Oscilloscope") and a rich description giving assistive technologies everything they need to understand the object.

deepdive_en.title: Asset Compression: Mesh and Texture
deepdive_en.body: Notes that production-quality USD scenes (like ALab) can grow to many gigabytes, making sharing impractical. Working with the **Alliance for Open Media**, Apple added a state-of-the-art mesh compression codec capable of reducing mesh sizes by up to 90%; combined with existing texture compression using **AVIF**, the average asset is now seven times smaller without compromising visual quality, meaning faster delivery, lower storage costs, and a better experience.

deepdive_en.title: Exporting with Mesh and Texture Compression
deepdive_en.body: Explains compression support is built right into the **exportPackage** API: pass the output URL to the stage's exportPackage method and enable **preferSmallTextureFiles** (textures) and **preferSmallMeshFiles** (mesh) compression through the export options, done in a couple of lines. If you're not writing code, the same results are available directly in Preview or via the **usdcrush** command-line tool; Apple is working with Pixar to bring this compression to the OpenUSD project so the whole ecosystem benefits.

deepdive_en.title: Integration Paths: USDKit, SwiftUSD, and OpenUSD
deepdive_en.body: Because integrating USD can be complex, the presenter lays out several access paths. For app developers on Apple platforms, **USDKit** is the way to go — system-provided, deeply integrated, and the basis of everything shown. For more advanced or cross-platform workflows beyond USDKit, **SwiftUSD** offers open-source Swift bindings via Swift Package Manager, and cross-platform C++ codebases can embed **OpenUSD** directly as a framework. All paths build on the same foundation, so USD files move freely between them.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recaps the year's big step forward for USD on Apple platforms: **Preview** brings essential 3D editing and powerful rendering options, **Spatial Preview** lets you immerse in and share content, and Safari's **Model tag** brings USD natively to the web, all centered on the new system framework **USDKit** that makes working with USD in Swift a first-class experience. The presenter recommends starting with USDKit for authoring 3D content in your app and points to follow-up sessions on Spatial Preview, USD on the web, and RealityKit/Reality Composer Pro.

title: Use foveated streaming to bring immersive content to visionOS
gloss: 用注視點串流把沉浸式內容帶到 visionOS
takeaway: 用 FoveatedStreaming 框架把遠端算繪的場景以全保真度串流到 Apple Vision Pro，並與 SwiftUI、RealityKit 內容整合。
chapters: Display a Foveated Streaming session in your immersive space
Compose SwiftUI content with Foveated Streaming
Compose RealityKit content with Foveated Streaming

points.text: **注視點串流（Foveated Streaming）**能把遠端算繪的場景以**全保真度**串流到 Apple Vision Pro。
了解其運作原理，並設定**串流端點（streaming endpoint）**與打造 visionOS 接收端 App。
用 **FoveatedStreamingSession** 連線，並透過 **ImmersiveSpace(foveatedStreaming:)** 在沉浸式空間中顯示。
可與 **SwiftUI** 及 **RealityKit** 內容合成，並量測效能、結合更多 visionOS 功能強化體驗。

audience: **開發 visionOS 沉浸式體驗、需要串流遠端高保真算繪內容**到 Vision Pro 的開發者。
gloss_en: Use foveated streaming to bring immersive content to visionOS
takeaway_en: Use the FoveatedStreaming framework to stream remotely rendered scenes to Apple Vision Pro in full fidelity, integrating with SwiftUI and RealityKit content.

points_en.text: **Foveated Streaming** can stream remotely rendered scenes to Apple Vision Pro in **full fidelity**.
Understand how it works, set up the **streaming endpoint**, and build the visionOS receiving app.
Connect with **FoveatedStreamingSession** and display it in an immersive space via **ImmersiveSpace(foveatedStreaming:)**.
Compose it with **SwiftUI** and **RealityKit** content, measure performance, and combine it with more visionOS features to enhance the experience.

audience_en: Developers **building immersive visionOS experiences who need to stream remotely rendered, high-fidelity content** to Vision Pro.
summary: 這場介紹 visionOS 26.4 引入、本場深入的 **Foveated Streaming**——讓 Apple Vision Pro 連到 PC 等外部裝置，把 **OpenXR** 內容以視訊與音訊串流過來，同時 visionOS 自動把手部、控制器位置與麥克風等輸入資料回傳給外部裝置。已有不少優秀案例，例如 Laminar Research 的 X-Plane 12 飛行模擬、iRacing 的賽車模擬，以及 Innoactive 把 Autodesk VRED 帶到 Vision Pro 讓設計師以 1:1 尺度檢視 Kia 車款。畫質之所以驚人，是因為系統會依使用者眼睛凝視處做 **foveated**（中央凹）壓縮——你正注視的區域以更高細節串流，這套處理內建於 visionOS。

底層採用內建的 **NVIDIA CloudXR™** 串流，以高效能、低延遲協定運作，甚至能無線透過 Wi-Fi 從本機 PC 或雲端串流沉浸式內容。架構分兩端：你的 OpenXR app（streaming endpoint）需實作 Apple 的 **Foveated Streaming Protocol**（處理配對與認證）並使用 CloudXR SDK 提供的 OpenXR runtime；visionOS 端的 receiver app 則用 **FoveatedStreaming** 框架連線，並可整合 ARKit、SwiftUI、RealityKit。Apple 在 GitHub 與 developer.apple.com 提供 Windows 與 visionOS 的開源範例，講者強調「一個下午」就能讓串流跑起來、「一天」內開始串流自家 OpenXR app、「一週」內加上 visionOS 專屬能力。

receiver app 採 **session-based API**：建立 `FoveatedStreamingSession` 並呼叫 `connect`，框架會自動列出可連的 endpoint；配對時 endpoint 顯示含 client token 與安全連線憑證 hash 的 **QR code**（皆由 CloudXR SDK 提供），使用者用「看」的方式掃描即可。連上後用 SwiftUI 的 **ImmersiveSpace** 呈現串流內容，可加入一般視窗（含 volumetric window）與原生空間手勢，並建議搭配 **progressive immersion** 風格，讓人透過 portal 在實體環境中檢視體驗。endpoint 端的協定是輕量 TCP、JSON 編碼、採 request-acknowledge 模式，並需密切監看 session status（例如脫下裝置入睡時會先通知 paused，並保持可重連）。

效能可用 Xcode 新的 **Foveated Streaming instrument** 量測頻寬、pose 延遲、frame rate 等。進階強化包含 **message channels API**（visionOS 端在 `FoveatedStreamingSession` 上、endpoint 端透過 CloudXR 的 OpenXR 擴充），訊息為不透明資料 blob 可任意傳遞——例如用 SwiftUI 選關卡後送指令讓 OpenXR app 載入、回報進度，或傳 ARKit 資料對齊真實空間（X-Plane 12 即以此把實體飛行模擬器與虛擬座艙對齊；`FoveatedStreamingSession` 提供 OpenXR 與 ARKit 座標系互轉）。也可在 ImmersiveSpace 加 RealityView 讓 RealityKit 內容與串流內容無縫合成，若提供 depth 甚至能互相遮擋；別忘了提供 alpha channel 以與環境混合。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Apple 工程師 Adrian 開場，說明部分既有空間 app 需仰賴 PC 或 OpenXR 等外部技術，而 **Foveated Streaming**（visionOS 26.4 引入）讓 Vision Pro 連到外部裝置串流 OpenXR 內容、並自動回傳手部與控制器位置與麥克風。以 **X-Plane 12**、**iRacing**、Innoactive 帶來的 **Autodesk VRED**（Kia 1:1 檢視）為案例。關鍵是依眼動凝視做 **foveated 壓縮**，注視區域以更高細節串流，全部內建於 visionOS。

deepdive.title: How Foveated Streaming works
deepdive.body: 用方塊圖說明兩端要建構的框架。底層是內建的 **NVIDIA CloudXR™**，提供高效能、低延遲、可無線（Wi-Fi、本機 PC 或雲端）的串流。你的 OpenXR app 需實作 Apple 的 **Foveated Streaming Protocol**（管理配對）並用 CloudXR SDK 的 OpenXR runtime；visionOS 端用 **FoveatedStreaming** 框架連線並可整合 ARKit、SwiftUI、RealityKit。

deepdive.title: Set up the streaming endpoint
deepdive.body: Apple 在 GitHub 提供端到端開源範例：Windows 範例含 Foveated Streaming Protocol 的參考實作、一個範例 OpenXR app，以及設定 NVIDIA CloudXR runtime 的指南。直接複製參考實作即可在一個下午內把 endpoint 設定好。

deepdive.title: Create a visionOS receiver app
deepdive.body: receiver app 是體驗的入口，用 **FoveatedStreaming.framework** 連到 endpoint，並透過 visionOS 框架加入專屬功能。可從 developer.apple.com 下載 visionOS 範例，搭配 Windows 範例就能在一個下午內讓 app 開始串流。

deepdive.title: Connect to a streaming endpoint
deepdive.body: 框架採 **session-based API**：建立 `FoveatedStreamingSession`，呼叫 `connect` 時框架自動列出可連的 endpoint。配對需 endpoint 顯示含配對資訊的 **QR code**，框架會自動呈現掃描 UI，使用者用「看」的方式掃描即完成連線並開始呈現串流內容。

deepdive.title: Display a Foveated Streaming session in your immersive space
deepdive.body: 用 SwiftUI 呈現串流內容：在 visionOS 上以 **ImmersiveSpace** 呈現空間內容，把 `FoveatedStreamingSession` 傳給 ImmersiveSpace 即會納入串流內容，並可像一般 SwiftUI app 一樣加上其他視窗。

deepdive.title: Compose SwiftUI content with Foveated Streaming
deepdive.body: 範例 app 加了暫停／恢復的視窗、ImmersiveSpace 內重開主視窗的 widget，並設定 **progressive immersion** 風格——很適合 Foveated Streaming，讓人透過 portal 在實體環境中檢視。使用 Foveated Streaming 時可用 SwiftUI 全部功能：原生空間手勢、volumetric window、各種 immersion style。

deepdive.title: Integrate with the streaming endpoint
deepdive.body: endpoint 端要做兩件事：實作處理認證與配對的 **Foveated Streaming Protocol**，以及使用 CloudXR SDK 的 OpenXR runtime。協定是輕量 **TCP** 連線、與串流連線分開建立，用來認證安全的 foveated stream 並在兩端傳遞 session 狀態；GitHub 有參考實作。連線流程：endpoint 以 Bonjour 對本地網路可見、visionOS 建立連線、配對、串流開始後 `connect()` 返回。配對訊息為 **JSON 編碼**、採 request-acknowledge，barcode 含 client token 與憑證 hash（皆由 CloudXR 提供）。務必監看 session status（脫下裝置入睡前會通知 paused，且應保持可重連）。CloudXR 自動把 visionOS 輸入餵給 OpenXR（手部追蹤、PS VR2 Sense 控制器），建議用 depth buffer 並提供 alpha channel。

deepdive.title: Measure performance
deepdive.body: Xcode 提供 **Foveated Streaming instrument** 量測串流的頻寬、pose 延遲、frame rate 等統計，可用來診斷串流內容問題；詳見 developer.apple.com 的文章。

deepdive.title: Enhance with visionOS features
deepdive.body: 用 **message channels API** 讓兩端溝通——visionOS 端在 `FoveatedStreamingSession` 上、endpoint 端透過 CloudXR 的 OpenXR 擴充。訊息為不透明資料 blob，可任意傳遞，例如用 SwiftUI 選關卡送指令讓 OpenXR app 載入並回報進度，或傳 **ARKit** 資料對齊真實空間。X-Plane 12 即用 ARKit 定位實體飛行模擬器並以 message channel 同步到 PC；`FoveatedStreamingSession` 提供 OpenXR 與 ARKit 座標系互轉，控制器與手部追蹤已內建，並用 alpha channel 與環境混合。

deepdive.title: Compose RealityKit content with Foveated Streaming
deepdive.body: 可把串流內容與原生 **RealityKit** 渲染合成：只要在 ImmersiveSpace 加一個 **RealityView**，RealityKit 內容就會與串流內容無縫合成；若為 OpenXR 場景提供 depth，兩者甚至能互相遮擋。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 邀請大家下載並研究範例程式，試著建立自己的 receiver app 並把 OpenXR client 整合進 Apple 的協定，輕鬆上手 Foveated Streaming。

summary_en: This session dives into **Foveated Streaming**, introduced in visionOS 26.4, which lets Apple Vision Pro connect to an external device like a PC to stream **OpenXR** content as video and audio, while visionOS automatically sends back input data—hands, controller positions, and microphone. Standout examples include Laminar Research's X-Plane 12 flight sim, iRacing's sim racing, and Innoactive bringing Autodesk VRED to Vision Pro so designers view Kia cars at 1:1 scale. Quality is striking because the system applies **foveated** compression based on where you're looking—the focused region streams at higher detail—and this processing is built into visionOS.

Under the hood it uses built-in **NVIDIA CloudXR™** streaming, a high-performance, low-latency protocol that can stream immersive content wirelessly over Wi-Fi, from a local PC or the cloud. The architecture has two sides: your OpenXR app (the streaming endpoint) implements Apple's **Foveated Streaming Protocol** (pairing and authentication) and uses the OpenXR runtime from the CloudXR SDK, while the visionOS receiver app uses the **FoveatedStreaming** framework to connect and can integrate ARKit, SwiftUI, and RealityKit. Apple provides open-source Windows and visionOS samples on GitHub and developer.apple.com; you can get streaming working in an afternoon, start streaming your own OpenXR app in a day, and add visionOS-only capabilities in a week.

The receiver app uses a **session-based API**: create a `FoveatedStreamingSession` and call `connect`, and the framework presents a list of endpoints; pairing shows a **QR code** containing a client token and the secure connection's certificate hash (both from the CloudXR SDK), which you scan just by looking at it. Once connected, present the streamed content in a SwiftUI **ImmersiveSpace**, adding regular windows (including volumetric ones) and native spatial gestures, ideally with a **progressive immersion** style so people view the experience through a portal grounded in their environment. The endpoint protocol is a lightweight, JSON-encoded TCP connection using a request-acknowledge pattern, and you must monitor session status (e.g., it reports paused just before the device sleeps and should stay available for reconnection).

Performance can be measured with Xcode's new **Foveated Streaming instrument** for bandwidth, pose latency, frame rate, and more.
