Enhancements include the **message channels API** (on `FoveatedStreamingSession` on visionOS, via a CloudXR OpenXR extension on the endpoint), where messages are opaque data blobs—e.g., pick a level in SwiftUI and tell the OpenXR app to load it and report progress, or send **ARKit** data to align the scene to real space (X-Plane 12 uses this to align a physical flight sim with the virtual cockpit; `FoveatedStreamingSession` converts between OpenXR and ARKit coordinate frames). You can also add a RealityView to the ImmersiveSpace to compose RealityKit content with the stream, with mutual occlusion if you supply depth, and provide an alpha channel to blend with the environment.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Apple engineer Adrian opens, noting some spatial apps rely on a PC or OpenXR, and that **Foveated Streaming** (introduced in visionOS 26.4) lets Vision Pro connect to an external device to stream OpenXR content while automatically sending back hand and controller positions and microphone. Cites **X-Plane 12**, **iRacing**, and Innoactive's **Autodesk VRED** (Kia at 1:1) as examples. The key is **foveated compression** driven by eye tracking—the focused area streams in higher detail—all built into visionOS.

deepdive_en.title: How Foveated Streaming works
deepdive_en.body: A block diagram shows the frameworks each side builds on. At the base is built-in **NVIDIA CloudXR™**, a high-performance, low-latency, wireless-capable (Wi-Fi, local PC, or cloud) protocol. Your OpenXR app implements Apple's **Foveated Streaming Protocol** (pairing) and uses CloudXR's OpenXR runtime; the visionOS app uses the **FoveatedStreaming** framework to connect and integrates ARKit, SwiftUI, and RealityKit.

deepdive_en.title: Set up the streaming endpoint
deepdive_en.body: Apple provides an end-to-end open-source sample on GitHub: the Windows sample has a reference implementation of the Foveated Streaming Protocol, an example OpenXR app, and guides for setting up the NVIDIA CloudXR runtime. Copy the reference implementation to set up the endpoint in an afternoon.

deepdive_en.title: Create a visionOS receiver app
deepdive_en.body: The receiver app is the entry point, using **FoveatedStreaming.framework** to connect to endpoints and adding unique features via visionOS frameworks. Download the visionOS sample from developer.apple.com; with the Windows sample you can get the app streaming in an afternoon.

deepdive_en.title: Connect to a streaming endpoint
deepdive_en.body: The framework uses a **session-based API**: create a `FoveatedStreamingSession`, and calling `connect` automatically presents a list of endpoints. Pairing requires the endpoint to display a **QR code** with pairing info; the framework presents a scanning UI, and you scan by looking at the code to connect and begin presenting the stream.

deepdive_en.title: Display a Foveated Streaming session in your immersive space
deepdive_en.body: Present streamed content with SwiftUI: on visionOS use an **ImmersiveSpace**, passing the `FoveatedStreamingSession` to it to include the stream, and add additional windows just like any SwiftUI app.

deepdive_en.title: Compose SwiftUI content with Foveated Streaming
deepdive_en.body: The sample adds a pause/resume window, a widget in the ImmersiveSpace to reopen the main window, and a **progressive immersion** style—a great fit for Foveated Streaming, letting people view through a portal grounded in their environment. With Foveated Streaming you get all of SwiftUI: native spatial gestures, volumetric windows, and immersion styles.

deepdive_en.title: Integrate with the streaming endpoint
deepdive_en.body: The endpoint does two things: implement the **Foveated Streaming Protocol** (authentication and pairing) and use the CloudXR SDK's OpenXR runtime. The protocol is a lightweight **TCP** connection established separately from the stream, authenticating the secure foveated stream and communicating session state; a reference implementation is on GitHub. Flow: the endpoint is visible via Bonjour, visionOS connects, pairing occurs, streaming begins, and `connect()` returns. Pairing messages are **JSON-encoded** request-acknowledge; the barcode holds a client token and certificate hash (both from CloudXR). Monitor session status (paused before sleep; stay available for reconnect). CloudXR auto-feeds visionOS input to OpenXR (hand tracking, PS VR2 Sense controllers); use a depth buffer and provide an alpha channel.

deepdive_en.title: Measure performance
deepdive_en.body: Xcode provides a **Foveated Streaming instrument** that reports the stream's bandwidth, pose latency, frame rate, and more to diagnose issues; see the article on developer.apple.com.

deepdive_en.title: Enhance with visionOS features
deepdive_en.body: Use the **message channels API** to let both sides communicate—on `FoveatedStreamingSession` on visionOS, via a CloudXR OpenXR extension on the endpoint. Messages are opaque data blobs you can use freely, e.g., select a level in SwiftUI and command the OpenXR app to load it and report progress, or send **ARKit** data to align the scene to real space. X-Plane 12 uses ARKit to locate a physical flight sim and message channels to sync it to the PC; `FoveatedStreamingSession` converts between OpenXR and ARKit coordinate frames, controller and hand tracking are built in, and an alpha channel blends with the environment.

deepdive_en.title: Compose RealityKit content with Foveated Streaming
deepdive_en.body: Compose the stream with native **RealityKit** rendering: simply add a **RealityView** to the ImmersiveSpace, and RealityKit content composes seamlessly with the streamed content; supply depth to the OpenXR scene and the two can even occlude each other.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: An invitation to download and review the sample code, set up your own receiver app, and integrate your OpenXR client with Apple's protocol to get started easily with Foveated Streaming.

title: Build next-generation experiences with visionOS 27
gloss: 用 visionOS 27 打造次世代體驗
takeaway: visionOS 27 提供多條建構空間體驗的路徑，涵蓋 RealityKit、第三方遊戲引擎、Foveated Streaming、物件追蹤與沉浸式媒體等新能力。
chapters: Paths to build a visionOS experience

points.text: 介紹建構 visionOS 體驗的多條路徑，從 **RealityKit** 與 **Reality Composer Pro** 到第三方遊戲引擎皆可選擇。
**Foveated Streaming** 依注視點優化串流畫質，提升沉浸式內容的效能與品質。
新增 **object tracking** 與 **spatial accessories** 支援，擴展實體互動的可能性。
強化 **immersive media** 與 **Spatial Preview**，讓沉浸式媒體製作與預覽更順暢。

audience: 適合**想在 visionOS 27 上開發 App、遊戲或空間體驗的開發者**，尤其想了解整體建構路徑者。
gloss_en: Build next-generation experiences with visionOS 27
takeaway_en: visionOS 27 offers multiple pathways for building spatial experiences, spanning new capabilities like RealityKit, third-party game engines, Foveated Streaming, object tracking, and immersive media.

points_en.text: Introduces the multiple pathways for building visionOS experiences, from **RealityKit** and **Reality Composer Pro** to third-party game engines.
**Foveated Streaming** optimizes streaming quality based on the gaze point, improving the performance and quality of immersive content.
Adds support for **object tracking** and **spatial accessories**, expanding the possibilities for physical interaction.
Enhances **immersive media** and **Spatial Preview**, making immersive media production and previewing smoother.

audience_en: **Developers who want to build apps, games, or spatial experiences on visionOS 27**, especially those wanting to understand the overall building pathways.
summary: 這場由 Vision Products Group 的 Norman 主講，是 visionOS 27 的總覽性場次，把「該怎麼把你的內容搬上 Apple Vision Pro」這件事拆成清楚的路徑圖。最新一代 Apple Vision Pro 改用 **M5** 晶片提供桌機級即時算繪、每眼超過 4K 的超高解析度顯示、90Hz 手部追蹤，並與 Apple 生態系深度整合。系統提供 **Shared Space**（window 或 volume，可與其他 app 並存）與 **Immersive Space**（獨佔執行，含 Mixed／Progressive／Full 三種沉浸風格）兩大算繪場景。

建立 visionOS 體驗有三條主要路徑。第一條給既有 iOS／iPadOS app：透過 App Store Connect 勾選相容性，或把 visionOS 加進 Xcode 的 deployment target 重新編譯。第二條是為空間運算從零打造：用 **SwiftUI**、**RealityKit** 與 **Reality Composer Pro**，或自帶算繪引擎搭配 **CompositorServices**，也可用 **Unity**、**Unreal**、**Godot** 等第三方引擎。第三條是全新的路徑，把既有 macOS／PC 內容帶上來：用 **Spatial Preview** framework 從 Mac 延伸影像與 3D 內容，或用 **Foveated Streaming** framework 串流 PC 的 OpenXR 沉浸內容。

在工具與框架更新上，RealityKit 新增 **physical space lighting**、**Projective Textures**、**Cloth Simulation**、**Custom Reverb Mesh** 與 **Gaussian Splatting**；Reality Composer Pro 升級為第三版，帶來 AI 的 **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**、**Animation Graph**、**Script Graph**、**Navigation Meshes** 與 subsurface scattering 等 shader graph 強化。互動方面，**object tracking** 支援高幀率追蹤、Create ML 延伸訓練與 metric space 姿態，並擴及 iOS；**spatial accessories** 開放開發者自製（LED constellation＋IMU＋Bluetooth）。

媒體管線方面，**Apple Immersive Video (AIV)** 以 90fps、每幀超過 100 megapixels 的立體 180 度規格交付最高保真度，並透過 **Immersive Media Support (IMS)** framework 新增 camera presentation override、**ImmersivePreviewRenderer** 與 wide-aspect-ratio portal，還有 static foveation 範例與 ASAF 音訊套件更新。其餘更新包含 Safari 的更寬視窗與預設啟用的 Web Environments、改良的 Control Center、4K High Quality Capture 與 accessory widget。實務結論是：無論你從 iOS、原生空間、第三方引擎或既有 Mac／PC 出發，visionOS 27 都備好了對應的路徑。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Vision Products Group 的 director Norman 開場，回顧過去一年開發者在平台上的成果，包括 YouTube、Valve 把 **Steam Link** 帶上來、Resolution Games，以及 Kia、Innoactive 用 **Autodesk VRED**、Nvidia **CloudXR SDK** 與新的 **Foveated Streaming** framework 設計次世代車輛、Laminar Research 用 X-Plane 打造沉浸式訓練。強調開發者回饋持續形塑 visionOS 的未來方向。

deepdive.title: visionOS overview
deepdive.body: 說明最新 Apple Vision Pro 的硬體：**M5** 晶片提供桌機級即時算繪、每眼超過 4K 解析度、90Hz 手部追蹤與跨 Apple 生態整合。算繪場景分為 **Shared Space**（window 或 volume，可與其他 app 並存於 infinite canvas）與 **Immersive Space**（獨佔執行），後者提供 Mixed、Progressive、Full 三種 immersion style，構成一整段沉浸光譜。

deepdive.title: Paths to build a visionOS experience
deepdive.body: 提出三條建構路徑：既有 iOS／iPadOS app 透過 App Store Connect 勾選相容性或加 visionOS deployment target 重新編譯；為空間運算原生打造則用 SwiftUI／**RealityKit**／Reality Composer Pro 或自帶引擎搭 **CompositorServices**，亦可用 Unity／Unreal／Godot；第三條全新路徑用 **Spatial Preview** 從 Mac 延伸內容、用 **Foveated Streaming** 串流 PC 的 OpenXR 內容（如駕駛艙用 RealityKit 原生算繪、遠端串流高耗效的地景）。

deepdive.title: RealityKit and Reality Composer Pro
deepdive.body: RealityKit 新增 **physical space lighting**、為 spotlight 加紋理的 **Projective Textures**（可模擬彩繪玻璃投影或水下焦散）、即時 **Cloth Simulation**、模擬聲音被木石金屬吸收散射的 **Custom Reverb Mesh**，以及可掃描實物的 **Gaussian Splatting**。Reality Composer Pro 升級為第三版，導入 AI 的 **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**、狀態機式的 **Animation Graph**、節點式邏輯的 **Script Graph**、可生成微調的 **Navigation Meshes**，以及把 subsurface scattering 開放到 Shader Graph 來做出逼真皮膚、眼睛、毛髮。

deepdive.title: Third-party game engines
deepdive.body: 說明第三方引擎支援：Unity 自始即相容，windowed 遊戲用 RealityKit 原生算繪、immersive 遊戲可選 RealityKit 或 **CompositorServices**，並提供 PSVR 2 Sense controller 等 spatial accessory 外掛。Unreal 支援 immersive 模式（Polyarc 的 Glassbreakers 用 static foveation 提升銳利度），Godot 則支援 CompositorServices 算繪、RealityKit 外掛與 **PHASE** 空間音訊外掛，這些引擎外掛皆可從 GitHub 下載。

deepdive.title: Spatial Preview
deepdive.body: 介紹全新的 macOS framework **Spatial Preview**：無需建立 visionOS app，即可把 Mac 上的空間內容（spatial photo、Apple immersive video、USD 3D 內容）直接在 Apple Vision Pro 上預覽，並透過 **SharePlay** 協作。它建立在 visionOS 的 **Quick Look** 之上，可即時編輯、移動、調整材質覆寫、加註解，並直接內建於 macOS 27 的 Preview，apps 如 Cinema4D、SketchUp 可做即時協作 3D 工作流。

deepdive.title: Foveated Streaming
deepdive.body: **Foveated Streaming** 讓 Apple Vision Pro 連到 PC 等外部裝置串流 **OpenXR** 內容，系統自動回傳手部、控制器位置與麥克風輸入。已於 visionOS 26.4 推出，案例包含 X-Plane 12、iRacing（ARKit 對齊實體方向盤）、Innoactive 帶來的 Autodesk VRED ray tracing。它依注視點智慧壓縮——焦點區高畫質、周邊低頻寬，協定由 **NVIDIA CloudXR** 驅動，可在 Wi-Fi 上串流、無需傳輸線。

deepdive.title: Object tracking and spatial accessories
deepdive.body: object tracking 自 visionOS 2.0 起可把實物變成虛擬 anchor（以 USDZ 在 Create ML 訓練 reference object）。新增高幀率追蹤、Create ML 的延伸訓練（改善手持物精度）、metric space 姿態 API（高精度空間量測，如醫療探針的手術導航訓練），並擴及 iOS。**spatial accessories** 則開放自製：裝置需含可被追蹤的 **LED constellation**、**IMU** 與 **Bluetooth** 晶片，DFRobot、MikroE 將推出參考硬體與開發套件，且支援按鈕與觸覺回饋、能在遮蔽或低光下穩定追蹤。

deepdive.title: Immersive media
deepdive.body: **Apple Immersive Video (AIV)** 是 visionOS 上最高保真的沉浸影片，以 metadata 驅動的鏡頭校正維持真實立體尺度，90fps、每幀超過 100 megapixels（每秒逾百億像素）、立體 180 度，支援 VOD 與 live broadcast。**Immersive Media Support (IMS)** framework 可讀寫 AIV 的 metadata，新增 camera presentation override 指令、即時預覽的 **ImmersivePreviewRenderer**、wide-aspect-ratio portal（用 AVPlayerViewController 或 RealityKit 的 VideoPlayerComponent 設定），並提供 static foveation 範例與 **ASAF** 音訊製作套件更新。

deepdive.title: Other visionOS 27 updates
deepdive.body: 收尾的其他更新：Safari 視窗可調更寬、超大視窗自然彎曲、**Web Environments** 預設啟用讓網站可有背景（以 Apple TV 影集 Severance 環境為例）；改良的 **Control Center** 整合通知、系統狀態與環境；**High Quality Capture** 可在裝置上直接擷取 4K 影片、無需 Mac；以及 accessory widget 支援，讓你用小型可一眼掌握的 widget 延伸 app 到 Apple Vision Pro。另外還有 Siri 強化、全新 Iceland 環境、Spatial Panoramas、Personal Environments 與 Freeform 更新。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結 visionOS 27 從更深的沉浸、更豐富的媒體到強大的新互動方式，給開發者大量可建構的素材，並以期待開發者接下來的作品作結。

summary_en: Presented by Norman from the Vision Products Group, this is an overview session for visionOS 27 that frames "how to bring your content to Apple Vision Pro" as a clear set of pathways. The latest Apple Vision Pro is powered by the **M5** chip for desktop-class real-time rendering, with ultra-high-resolution displays of over 4K pixels per eye, 90Hz hand tracking, and deep Apple-ecosystem integration. The system offers two rendering scene types: the **Shared Space** (a window or volume that coexists with other apps) and the **Immersive Space** (your app runs exclusively, with Mixed, Progressive, and Full immersion styles).

There are three main paths to build for visionOS. The first is for existing iOS/iPadOS apps: check a box in App Store Connect for compatibility, or recompile by adding visionOS as a deployment target in Xcode. The second is building natively for spatial computing using **SwiftUI**, **RealityKit**, and **Reality Composer Pro**, a custom engine with **CompositorServices**, or third-party engines like **Unity**, **Unreal**, and **Godot**. The third is a new path that brings existing macOS/PC content over: the **Spatial Preview** framework extends images and 3D content from a Mac, while the **Foveated Streaming** framework streams immersive OpenXR content from a PC.

On tools and frameworks, RealityKit adds **physical space lighting**, **Projective Textures**, **Cloth Simulation**, **Custom Reverb Mesh**, and **Gaussian Splatting**; Reality Composer Pro 3 brings the AI-powered **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**, **Animation Graph**, **Script Graph**, **Navigation Meshes**, and subsurface scattering through Shader Graph. For interaction, **object tracking** gains high-frame-rate tracking, extended Create ML training, and metric-space poses, and is extended to iOS; **spatial accessories** open up to developers building their own (an LED constellation plus IMU and Bluetooth).

On the media pipeline, **Apple Immersive Video (AIV)** delivers the highest fidelity at 90fps and over 100 megapixels per frame in stereoscopic 180 degrees, and the **Immersive Media Support (IMS)** framework adds camera presentation override commands, the **ImmersivePreviewRenderer**, and wide-aspect-ratio portals, plus a static foveation sample and ASAF audio suite updates. Other updates include wider Safari windows with Web Environments enabled by default, an improved Control Center, 4K High Quality Capture, and accessory widgets. The practical takeaway: wherever you start from — iOS, native spatial, a third-party engine, or existing Mac/PC content — visionOS 27 has a path ready for you.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Norman, a director in the Vision Products Group, opens by reviewing a year of developer work on the platform, including YouTube, Valve bringing **Steam Link**, Resolution Games, and companies like Kia and Innoactive using **Autodesk VRED**, Nvidia's **CloudXR SDK**, and the new **Foveated Streaming** framework to design next-generation vehicles, plus Laminar Research's immersive training with X-Plane. He stresses that developer feedback continues to shape the future of visionOS.

deepdive_en.title: visionOS overview
deepdive_en.body: Covers the latest Apple Vision Pro hardware: the **M5** chip for desktop-class real-time rendering, over 4K pixels per eye, 90Hz hand tracking, and deep Apple-ecosystem integration. Rendering scene types are split into the **Shared Space** (a window or volume that coexists with other apps on the infinite canvas) and the **Immersive Space** (exclusive execution), the latter offering Mixed, Progressive, and Full immersion styles that form a full spectrum of immersion.

deepdive_en.title: Paths to build a visionOS experience
deepdive_en.body: Lays out three build paths: existing iOS/iPadOS apps via an App Store Connect checkbox or by adding a visionOS deployment target and recompiling; building natively for spatial computing with SwiftUI/**RealityKit**/Reality Composer Pro or a custom engine with **CompositorServices**, or Unity/Unreal/Godot; and a new third path using **Spatial Preview** to extend Mac content and **Foveated Streaming** to stream a PC's OpenXR content (e.g., a cockpit rendered natively with RealityKit while a processor-intensive landscape is streamed remotely).

deepdive_en.title: RealityKit and Reality Composer Pro
deepdive_en.body: RealityKit adds **physical space lighting**, **Projective Textures** that add textures to spotlights (simulating stained glass or underwater caustics), real-time **Cloth Simulation**, a **Custom Reverb Mesh** that simulates how sound is absorbed and scattered by wood, metal, and stone, and **Gaussian Splatting** for scanning real-world objects. Reality Composer Pro becomes version 3, introducing the AI **Reality Composer Pro Assistant**, state-machine **Animation Graph**, node-based **Script Graph**, generatable **Navigation Meshes**, and subsurface scattering exposed through Shader Graph for lifelike skin, eyes, and hair.

deepdive_en.title: Third-party game engines
deepdive_en.body: Explains third-party engine support: Unity has been compatible since launch, with windowed games using RealityKit for native rendering and immersive games choosing RealityKit or **CompositorServices**, plus plugins for spatial accessories like the PSVR 2 Sense controller. Unreal supports immersive mode (Polyarc's Glassbreakers uses static foveation for sharper visuals), and Godot supports CompositorServices rendering, a RealityKit plugin, and a **PHASE** spatial-audio plugin — all downloadable from GitHub.

deepdive_en.title: Spatial Preview
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new macOS framework **Spatial Preview**: without building a visionOS app, you can preview spatial content from a Mac (spatial photos, Apple immersive video, USD 3D content) directly on Apple Vision Pro and collaborate via **SharePlay**. Built on **Quick Look** in visionOS, it supports real-time editing, moving around scenes, material overrides, and annotations, and is built directly into Preview on macOS 27, enabling real-time collaborative 3D workflows for apps like Cinema4D and SketchUp.

deepdive_en.title: Foveated Streaming
deepdive_en.body: **Foveated Streaming** lets Apple Vision Pro connect to external devices like a PC to stream **OpenXR** content, with the system automatically sending hands, controller positions, and microphone input. Launched in visionOS 26.4, examples include X-Plane 12, iRacing (ARKit aligning a physical racing wheel), and Innoactive bringing Autodesk VRED with ray tracing. It compresses video by gaze — high quality in focus, lower bandwidth in the periphery — powered by **NVIDIA CloudXR**, streaming over Wi-Fi with no cables.

deepdive_en.title: Object tracking and spatial accessories
deepdive_en.body: Object tracking (since visionOS 2.0) turns physical objects into virtual anchors by training a reference object from a USDZ in Create ML. New features add high-frame-rate tracking, extended Create ML training (better accuracy for handheld objects), a metric-space pose API for high-precision spatial measurement (e.g., a medical probe for surgical navigation training), and iOS support. **Spatial accessories** open up to custom builds: a device needs an **LED constellation**, an **IMU**, and a **Bluetooth** chip, with DFRobot and MikroE shipping reference hardware, plus buttons and haptics and robust tracking under occlusion or low light.

deepdive_en.title: Immersive media
deepdive_en.body: **Apple Immersive Video (AIV)** is the highest-fidelity immersive video on visionOS, using metadata-driven lens calibration to maintain real stereoscopic scale, at 90fps and over 100 megapixels per frame (over ten billion pixels per second) in stereoscopic 180 degrees, supporting VOD and live broadcast. The **Immersive Media Support (IMS)** framework reads and writes AIV metadata and adds camera presentation override commands, the real-time **ImmersivePreviewRenderer**, and wide-aspect-ratio portals (set via AVPlayerViewController or RealityKit's VideoPlayerComponent), plus a static foveation sample and **ASAF** production suite updates.

deepdive_en.title: Other visionOS 27 updates
deepdive_en.body: Final additions: Safari windows can go wider, very large windows naturally curve, and **Web Environments** are enabled by default so websites can have backgrounds (shown with the Apple TV show Severance). An improved **Control Center** unifies notifications, system status, controls, and environments; **High Quality Capture** records 4K video right on the device with no Mac; and accessory widget support lets you extend your app to Apple Vision Pro with small, glanceable widgets. Also mentioned: Siri enhancements, a new Iceland environment, Spatial Panoramas, Personal Environments, and Freeform updates.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wraps up by summarizing that visionOS 27 gives developers a lot to build with — from deeper immersion to richer media to powerful new ways to add interactivity — and closes by looking forward to what developers will build next.

title: Modernize your AppKit app
gloss: 現代化你的 AppKit App
takeaway: 用手勢辨識、控制事件、現代拖放與狀態還原把 AppKit App 更新到當代 macOS 慣例，並導入 macOS 27 的 Liquid Glass 與同心圓角。
chapters: Modern event handling with gesture recognizers
Selection, context menus, and drag and drop
Set window identifiers for state restoration

points.text: 以**手勢辨識器（gesture recognizers）**處理現代輸入，並用 **NSPasteboardWriting** 採用現代拖放委派。
使用 **control events**（如 `.trackingEndedOutside`）與 hitTest 覆寫，改善控制項互動。
以 **autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop** 與 **NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate** 強化鍵盤導覽與狀態列項目。
透過 **encodeRestorableState / restoreState** 與視窗識別碼做**狀態還原**，並優雅處理 App 終止。
導入 **macOS 27 的 Liquid Glass**，以 **cornerConfiguration** 實現同心圓角（concentricity）。

audience: **維護既有 AppKit macOS App 的開發者**，想跟上現代 macOS 慣例與 Liquid Glass 外觀的人。
gloss_en: Modernize your AppKit app
takeaway_en: Bring your AppKit app up to contemporary macOS conventions with gesture recognition, control events, modern drag and drop, and state restoration, and adopt macOS 27's Liquid Glass and concentric corners.

points_en.text: Handle modern input with **gesture recognizers**, and adopt modern drag and drop with **NSPasteboardWriting**.
Use **control events** (such as `.trackingEndedOutside`) and hitTest overrides to improve control interactions.
Strengthen keyboard navigation and status bar items with **autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop** and **NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate**.
Do **state restoration** via **encodeRestorableState / restoreState** and window identifiers, and handle app termination gracefully.
Adopt **macOS 27's Liquid Glass**, achieving concentric corners (concentricity) with **cornerConfiguration**.

audience_en: **Developers maintaining an existing AppKit macOS app** who want to keep up with modern macOS conventions and the Liquid Glass look.
summary: Mac UI 框架工程師 Ujjaini 在這場「Modernize your AppKit app」中，從三個面向幫你的 **AppKit** app 與現代 macOS 和諧共處：人們如何操作你的 app（輸入）、系統如何管理它（退出與還原），以及它在螢幕上的外觀（look and feel）。核心觀念是現代 app 善用 AppKit 與 Mac 的介接方式，讓形式與功能都與系統其餘部分一致。

在**現代輸入**上，傳統的 `mouseDown` 與 tracking loop 應讓位給 **gesture recognizers**——這是 SwiftUI、UIKit（透過 Mac Catalyst）與 AppKit 三者共通的事件處理語言。針對常見的 `mouseDown` override 用途，AppKit 提供更可靠的專用 API：選取改為觀察 `NSCollectionViewItem`／`NSTableRowView` 的 `selected` 屬性或 delegate callback；context menu 用 `defaultMenu`／`menu`／`menuForEvent`；拖放用現代 dragging delegate（如 `tableView pasteboardWriterForRow`）；NSTextView 之外的文字選取用 macOS 27 新的 **NSTextSelectionManager**。此外 UIKit 的 **control events** 來到 AppKit，可直接對按鈕等標準控制項註冊 target／action 反應 tracking 狀態變化，不需子類化；重疊的 sibling view 會默默吃掉點擊，可重設大小或 override `hitTest` 回傳 nil 讓事件穿透。鍵盤導覽則建議開啟 window 的 `autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop`，並用 `NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate` 管理 status item 展開自訂視窗時的鍵盤焦點生命週期。

在**跨啟動的延續性**上，好的 Mac app 能順暢退出、快速還原。app 應只在真正必要時阻擋退出——對不需強制介入的 sheet／modal 把 `preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal` 設為 false，讓系統（如隔夜更新重開機）能優雅終止。**state restoration** 分三步：用 `NSWindowRestoration` opt-in（設 window identifier、autosave name、`isRestorable`、`restorationClass`）、用 `encodeRestorableState` 編碼 UI 狀態（只存重建 UI 所需、不重新序列化整個 app，並在視圖階層變動時呼叫 `invalidateRestorableState`），以及重啟後用 `restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)` 重建視窗、`restoreState` 還原各視窗 UI（務必呼叫 completionHandler）。最後是 macOS 27 的**設計更新**：採用 Liquid Glass 的 app 多數變化自動生效（硬邊 scroll edge effect、側邊欄延伸到邊緣、玻璃點擊回彈效果），並有新的 **cornerConfiguration** API 讓視圖圓角與容器同心（`.containerConcentric` 搭配最小半徑）。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Mac UI 框架工程師 Ujjaini 開場，定義現代 app 善用 AppKit 與 Mac 的介接，使形式與功能都與系統和諧。和諧展現在三處：人們如何操作 app、系統如何管理 app、app 在螢幕上的外觀——本場依序分享這三方面的建議。

deepdive.title: Modern input
deepdive.body: 從輸入裝置談起：Mac 自始就有鍵盤與滑鼠，而 `mouseDown` 與 tracking loop 長年是實作互動行為的慣用模式。但 AppKit 並非 Mac 上唯一框架，現代做法是改用 gesture recognizers 作為跨框架共通的事件處理語言。

deepdive.title: Modern event handling with gesture recognizers
deepdive.body: **gesture recognizers** 讓 AppKit 不必自行打造即享進階行為，並支援跨框架相容。講者將介紹三種與其良好介接的方案：view-based API、control events 與自訂 gesture recognizer，提供與 tracking loop 同等的客製能力。

deepdive.title: Selection, context menus, and drag and drop
deepdive.body: 常見的 `mouseDown` override 用途各有更可靠的專用 API：選取改觀察 `NSCollectionViewItem`／`NSTableRowView` 的 `selected` 屬性或用 `NSTableViewDelegate`／`NSOutlineViewDelegate` callback；context menu 用 `NSView` 的 `defaultMenu`、`NSResponder` 的 `menu` 或 `menuForEvent` 動態建立。

deepdive.title: Modern dragging delegate
deepdive.body: 若用 collection 容器 view，改用現代 dragging delegate 方法（如 `tableView pasteboardWriterForRow`）：建立 `NSPasteboardItem`、設好資料並回傳；`NSCollectionView`、`NSOutlineView`、`NSBrowser` 也有類似方法。

deepdive.title: Text selection in custom views
deepdive.body: 若需在 `NSTextView` 之外做文字選取，用 macOS 27 新的 **NSTextSelectionManager**：它善用 gesture recognizers，把經典 macOS 文字選取行為帶到任何 view。掛上並設定 text selection data source 後，即支援雙向選取、文字拖放、toggling 等。

deepdive.title: Control events and gesture recognizers
deepdive.body: 下一個方案對熟悉 UIKit 的人很眼熟：**control events** 來到 AppKit，可加到按鈕、slider 等標準控制項，讓程式反應使用者驅動的 tracking 狀態變化，不必實作複雜的 `mouseDown` 邏輯。

deepdive.title: Control events
deepdive.body: 範例：實例化 `NSButton` 並對某 control event 註冊 target 與 action——**無需子類化 NSButton** 即可運作。多數 control events 自 OS 10.11 起即可用，AppKit 在事件觸發時呼叫註冊的 target／action。

deepdive.title: hitTest override
deepdive.body: 因 gesture recognizers 作用於 view 及其子 view，重疊的 sibling view 會默默擋住滑鼠事件。若控制項對點擊無反應，先確認沒有重疊的 sibling；可重設大小，或若是 overlay 不應縮放，則 override `hitTest` 回傳 `nil` 讓 hit testing 穿透到底下內容。

deepdive.title: Keyboard navigation and status items
deepdive.body: 鍵盤導覽對速度與無障礙都重要。可在系統設定開啟，焦點以 tab／shift-tab 在控制項間移動，其順序即 key view loop。導覽也延伸到選單列與 status items——後者與主選單項略有不同。

deepdive.title: autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop
deepdive.body: 要在每次新增／移除 view 時自動重算 key view loop，於 window 開啟 **`autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop`**；若不設，則需自行建立與維護 loop。會顯示選單的 status item 行為已像選單列上的選單，但 status item 也可作為觸發動作或顯示暫時 UI 的觸發器。

deepdive.title: Expanded interface delegate — setup
deepdive.body: 當 status item 顯示自訂視窗時，AppKit 需知道該 UI 何時作用以正確處理鍵盤焦點。第一步：在建立 item 時設定 **expanded interface delegate**（範例在 `applicationDidFinishLaunching` 對 `NSStatusItem` 設 `expandedInterfaceDelegate`）。

deepdive.title: Expanded interface delegate — methods
deepdive.body: 實作 `NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate` 的方法：在 `statusItem(_:didBegin:)` 顯示視窗、在 `statusItemDidEndExpandedInterfaceSession` 隱藏視窗。這些由 AppKit 呼叫以管理 expanded interface session 的生命週期。

deepdive.title: Expanded interface delegate — cancel
deepdive.body: 當需要結束 session（例如已選取某動作），對 `expandedInterfaceSession?` 呼叫 `.cancel` 請求關閉視窗。注意若焦點自然移往他處，session 可能會被系統自動取消。SwiftUI 的 menu bar extra 會替你處理許多此類工作。

deepdive.title: Continuity across launches
deepdive.body: 談跨啟動延續性：好的 Mac app 能順暢退出、快速還原——退出不拖泥帶水，回來時彷彿從未退出。人們應能隨時退出 app（自願或因系統需重開機，如隔夜軟體更新）。

deepdive.title: Graceful app termination
deepdive.body: app 應只在真正必要時阻擋退出。當呈現 sheet 時 window 可能無法關閉，連帶讓 app 無法退出。`NSWindow` 的 `preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal` 預設為 true（為避免遺失資料，如需存檔的文件）。

deepdive.title: preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal
deepdive.body: 對不需強制介入的 modal／sheet，把 **`preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal`** 設為 `false`，以允許更優雅的應用程式終止。

deepdive.title: State restoration
deepdive.body: 用 `NSWindowRestoration` 客製 app 如何回來。**state restoration** 需三步：opt-in、編碼 UI 狀態、解碼以還原視窗與 UI。接著走過使用 `NSWindowRestoration` 的程式碼。

deepdive.title: Set window identifiers for state restoration
deepdive.body: 在 window controller 為 window 設 identifier；常見視窗（主視窗、偏好設定）設 autosave name 以還原到同一 space 與 frame（文件視窗不需）。確保 `window.isRestorable = true` 讓 AppKit 能呼叫 encode／restore，並設 `restorationClass` 供重啟時還原視窗本身。

deepdive.title: encodeRestorableState
deepdive.body: 用 **`encodeRestorableState`** 保存重建視窗狀態所需的一切，並呼叫 super。範例以 `productIdentifier` key 編碼所選項目的 identifier。避免編碼存在文件或資料庫的資料——目標是重建 UI 狀態，而非重新序列化整個 app。所有 `NSResponder` 都有可 override 的 encode 方法。

deepdive.title: invalidateRestorableState
deepdive.body: `encodeRestorableState` 僅在物件狀態被標記失效時呼叫。每當視圖階層有應改變已存狀態的變動，呼叫 **`invalidateRestorableState()`**（範例在側邊欄選取不同產品時呼叫），稍後 AppKit 才會對所有被失效者呼叫 encode。

deepdive.title: restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)
deepdive.body: 重啟後先還原視窗：在 window restoration class 實作 **`restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)`** 重建各視窗，參數含 identifier 與須呼叫的 completionHandler。依 identifier 重建 window controller 與 window（主視窗已在 app delegate 上）。即使建立失敗也務必以 error 呼叫 completionHandler——AppKit 會等待每個可還原視窗。

deepdive.title: restoreState
deepdive.body: 視窗還原後，最後在 window controller 的 **`restoreState`** 還原各視窗 UI：AppKit 交回先前編碼的 coder，於此取回重建狀態所需資料、解碼 identifier 並交給對應 view controller，完成後視窗即回到先前狀態。可參考 sample「Restoring your app's state with AppKit」。

deepdive.title: Design updates
deepdive.body: 進入第三面向——UI。macOS 26 引入的 **Liquid Glass** 材質持續演進，許多更新會自動套用，不必重建 app 即可受惠。

deepdive.title: Liquid Glass updates in macOS 27
deepdive.body: 若在 macOS 26 採用了 Liquid Glass，於 macOS 27 會自動獲得多項變化：自動的 `NSScrollEdgeEffectStyle` 在有自由浮動文字（如標題列的視窗標題）時解析為硬邊效果；側邊欄延伸到視窗邊緣、選取使用半粗體強調、內容仍流動於其後；側邊欄上的 bordered toolbar item 也採用 Liquid Glass。

deepdive.title: Concentricity
deepdive.body: macOS 27 新增點擊時玻璃微微回彈的效果，給人控制項正在回應互動之感（Maps 用於部分自訂控制項），但只應用於控制項、按鈕或互動控制項的玻璃容器。圓角矩形是 Apple 生態長年標誌，AppKit 為**同心**（concentricity）提供新 API：角落內容可隨容器形狀調整。

deepdive.title: cornerConfiguration
deepdive.body: view 越靠近容器角落，其圓角半徑就應越貼合容器曲線。用 **`cornerConfiguration`** API 達成：建立自訂 view 子類，override `cornerConfiguration` 回傳 `NSViewCornerConfiguration?`，半徑用 `NSViewCornerRadius` 的 `.containerConcentric`（依容器計算並設最小值確保總是圓角），並可用 `.uniformCorners` 維持四角一致。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結重點：找出 app 中 override `mouseDown` 之處改用 view API、control events 或 gesture recognizers；以使用者意圖取代 tracking loop；確保鍵盤與滑鼠操作同樣好用；讓退出與重啟無縫銜接；並在 view 與按鈕採用同心圓角。

summary_en: Mac UI frameworks engineer Ujjaini's "Modernize your AppKit app" helps your **AppKit** app feel in harmony with modern macOS across three areas: how people drive your app (input), how the system manages it (termination and restoration), and how it looks on screen. The core idea is that a modern app takes advantage of how AppKit interfaces with the Mac so its form and function feel consistent with the rest of the system.

For **modern input**, the traditional `mouseDown` and tracking loops should give way to **gesture recognizers** — the common event-handling language shared across SwiftUI, UIKit (via Mac Catalyst), and AppKit. For common `mouseDown` override uses, AppKit offers more reliable dedicated APIs: observe the `selected` property on `NSCollectionViewItem`/`NSTableRowView` or use delegate callbacks for selection; use `defaultMenu`/`menu`/`menuForEvent` for context menus; use modern dragging delegate methods (like `tableView pasteboardWriterForRow`) for drag and drop; and use the new macOS 27 **NSTextSelectionManager** for text selection outside NSTextView. UIKit's **control events** also come to AppKit, letting you register target/action on standard controls to react to user-driven tracking changes without subclassing; overlapping sibling views silently block clicks, so resize them or override `hitTest` to return nil so events fall through. For keyboard navigation, enable the window's `autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop`, and use `NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate` to manage keyboard focus lifecycle when a status item shows a custom window.

For **continuity across launches**, a great Mac app quits gracefully and restores quickly. An app should block quit only when truly necessary — set `preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal` to false for sheets/modals that don't strictly require intervention so the system (e.g. an overnight update reboot) can terminate gracefully. **State restoration** has three steps: opt in with `NSWindowRestoration` (set the window identifier, autosave name, `isRestorable`, and `restorationClass`), encode UI state with `encodeRestorableState` (store only what's needed to rebuild the UI, not re-serialize the whole app, and call `invalidateRestorableState` when the view hierarchy changes), and after relaunch recreate windows with `restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)` and restore each window's UI with `restoreState` (always call the completionHandler). Finally, macOS 27's **design updates**: apps that adopted Liquid Glass get most changes automatically (hard-edge scroll edge effect, sidebars extending to edges, a click-bounce glass effect), plus a new **cornerConfiguration** API to make a view's corners concentric with its container (`.containerConcentric` with a minimum radius).

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Mac UI frameworks engineer Ujjaini opens, defining a modern app as one that takes advantage of how AppKit interfaces with the Mac so form and function feel in harmony with the system. That harmony shows up in three places: how people drive the app, how the system manages it, and how it looks on screen — covered in turn.

deepdive_en.title: Modern input
deepdive_en.body: Starts at the input device: the Mac has always had a keyboard and mouse, and `mouseDown` with tracking loops has long been the go-to for interactive behavior. But AppKit isn't the only framework on Mac, so the modern approach is gesture recognizers as a cross-framework common event-handling language.

deepdive_en.title: Modern event handling with gesture recognizers
deepdive_en.body: **Gesture recognizers** let AppKit provide advanced behaviors without building them yourself, with cross-framework compatibility. The talk covers three solutions that interface well with them — view-based APIs, control events, and custom gesture recognizers — offering the same customizability as tracking loops.

deepdive_en.title: Selection, context menus, and drag and drop
deepdive_en.body: Common `mouseDown` override uses each have more reliable dedicated APIs: for selection, observe the `selected` property on `NSCollectionViewItem`/`NSTableRowView` or use `NSTableViewDelegate`/`NSOutlineViewDelegate` callbacks; for context menus, use `NSView`'s `defaultMenu`, `NSResponder`'s `menu`, or `menuForEvent` to build dynamically.

deepdive_en.title: Modern dragging delegate
deepdive_en.body: For collection container views, use modern dragging delegate methods (like `tableView pasteboardWriterForRow`): create an `NSPasteboardItem`, set the data, and return it; similar methods exist on `NSCollectionView`, `NSOutlineView`, and `NSBrowser`.

deepdive_en.title: Text selection in custom views
deepdive_en.body: For text selection outside `NSTextView`, use the new macOS 27 **NSTextSelectionManager**: it leverages gesture recognizers and brings classic macOS text selection behaviors to any view. Attach it and set up a text selection data source for bidirectional selection, drag and drop with text, toggling, and more.

deepdive_en.title: Control events and gesture recognizers
deepdive_en.body: The next solution is familiar to UIKit developers: **control events** come to AppKit and can be added to standard controls like buttons and sliders, letting code react to user-driven tracking state changes without complex `mouseDown` logic.

deepdive_en.title: Control events
deepdive_en.body: Example: instantiate an `NSButton` and register a target and action for a control event — it works **without subclassing NSButton**. Most control events have been available since OS 10.11, and AppKit calls the registered target/action when the event triggers.

deepdive_en.title: hitTest override
deepdive_en.body: Because gesture recognizers operate on a view and its subviews, overlapping sibling views can silently block mouse events. If a control doesn't respond to a click, check for an overlapping sibling; resize it, or if it's an overlay that shouldn't be resized, override `hitTest` to return `nil` so hit testing falls through to the content underneath.

deepdive_en.title: Keyboard navigation and status items
deepdive_en.body: Keyboard navigation matters for speed and accessibility. It can be enabled in system settings, with focus moving between controls via tab/shift-tab in the order of the key view loop. Navigation also extends to the menu bar and status items — the latter behaving a bit differently from main menu items.

deepdive_en.title: autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop
deepdive_en.body: To automatically recalculate the key view loop whenever a view is added or removed, enable **`autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop`** on the window; otherwise you maintain the loop yourself. Status items that show a menu already behave like menu bar menus, but a status item can also be a trigger for actions or transient UI.

deepdive_en.title: Expanded interface delegate — setup
deepdive_en.body: When a status item shows a custom window, AppKit needs to know when that UI is active for correct keyboard focus. Step one: set the **expanded interface delegate** when the item is created (the example sets `expandedInterfaceDelegate` on `NSStatusItem` in `applicationDidFinishLaunching`).

deepdive_en.title: Expanded interface delegate — methods
deepdive_en.body: Implement the `NSStatusItemExpandedInterfaceDelegate` methods: show the window in `statusItem(_:didBegin:)` and hide it in `statusItemDidEndExpandedInterfaceSession`. AppKit calls these to manage the expanded interface session's lifecycle.

deepdive_en.title: Expanded interface delegate — cancel
deepdive_en.body: When it's time to end the session (e.g. an action was selected), call `.cancel` on `expandedInterfaceSession?` to request dismissal. Note the session may be canceled for you if focus naturally moves elsewhere. SwiftUI menu bar extras do a lot of this for you.

deepdive_en.title: Continuity across launches
deepdive_en.body: On continuity across launches: a great Mac app quits without pushback and comes back as if never quit. People should be able to quit at any time — because they want to, or because the system needs to reboot (e.g. an overnight software update).

deepdive_en.title: Graceful app termination
deepdive_en.body: An app should block quit only when genuinely necessary. When presenting a sheet, the window might not close, which prevents the app from quitting. `NSWindow`'s `preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal` defaults to true (for good reason — to avoid losing data, e.g. a document that needs saving).

deepdive_en.title: preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal
deepdive_en.body: For modals/sheets that don't strictly require intervention, set **`preventsApplicationTerminationWhenModal`** to `false` to allow more graceful application termination.

deepdive_en.title: State restoration
deepdive_en.body: Use `NSWindowRestoration` to customize how your app comes back. **State restoration** requires three steps: opt in, encode UI state, and decode to restore windows and UI. The talk then walks through code using `NSWindowRestoration`.

deepdive_en.title: Set window identifiers for state restoration
deepdive_en.body: Set an identifier for the window in the window controller; for common windows (main, preferences) set an autosave name to restore to the same space and frame (not needed for document windows). Ensure `window.isRestorable = true` so AppKit can call encode/restore, and set a `restorationClass` invoked at relaunch to restore the window itself.

deepdive_en.title: encodeRestorableState
deepdive_en.body: Use **`encodeRestorableState`** to preserve everything needed to recreate the window's state, calling super. The example encodes the selected item's identifier with a `productIdentifier` key. Avoid encoding data that lives in your document or database — the goal is to reconstruct UI state, not re-serialize the whole app. All `NSResponder`s have an overridable encode method.

deepdive_en.title: invalidateRestorableState
deepdive_en.body: `encodeRestorableState` is only called when an object's state has been invalidated. Whenever a view hierarchy change should alter the saved state, call **`invalidateRestorableState()`** (the example does so when a different product is selected in the sidebar); later AppKit calls encode on everything invalidated.

deepdive_en.title: restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)
deepdive_en.body: After relaunch, restore windows first: implement **`restoreWindow(withIdentifier:)`** in the window restoration class to recreate each window, with parameters including the identifier and a completionHandler you must call. Recreate the window controller and window by identifier (the main window is already on the app delegate). Even if creation fails, always call the completionHandler with the error — AppKit waits on every restorable window.

deepdive_en.title: restoreState
deepdive_en.body: Once windows are restored, finally restore each window's UI in the window controller's **`restoreState`**: AppKit hands back the same coder you encoded, where you fetch the data to reconstruct state, decode identifiers, and hand them to the corresponding view controllers, returning windows to their prior state. See the sample "Restoring your app's state with AppKit".

deepdive_en.title: Design updates
deepdive_en.body: Moves to the third area — the UI. The **Liquid Glass** material introduced in macOS 26 continues to evolve, with many updates applying automatically so your app benefits without rebuilding.

deepdive_en.title: Liquid Glass updates in macOS 27
deepdive_en.body: If you adopted Liquid Glass in macOS 26, you get several changes automatically on macOS 27: the automatic `NSScrollEdgeEffectStyle` resolves to a hard-edge effect when there's free-floating text (like a title bar window title); sidebars extend to the window's edges, selection uses semi-bold text for emphasis, and content flows behind them; bordered toolbar items over the sidebar also adopt Liquid Glass.

deepdive_en.title: Concentricity
deepdive_en.body: macOS 27 adds an effect where glass subtly bounces when clicked, giving a sense the control is responding (Maps uses it for some custom controls), but it should apply only to controls, buttons, or glass containers of interactive controls. Rounded rectangles are a long-standing Apple signature, and AppKit has new API for **concentricity**: corner content can adapt to the shape of its container.

deepdive_en.title: cornerConfiguration
deepdive_en.body: The closer a view sits to its container's corner, the more its radius should match the container's curve. Achieve this with the **`cornerConfiguration`** API: create a custom view subclass, override `cornerConfiguration` to return an `NSViewCornerConfiguration?`, use `.containerConcentric` on `NSViewCornerRadius` for the radius (computed from the container, with a minimum so corners are always rounded), and use `.uniformCorners` for the same radii across all four corners.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recap: identify where your app overrides `mouseDown` and use view APIs, control events, or gesture recognizers instead; prioritize user intent over tracking loops; make the app work as well from the keyboard as the mouse; make quit and relaunch feel seamless; and adopt concentricity in views and buttons.

title: Craft clear names for features and labels in your app
gloss: 為 App 的功能與標籤取清楚的名稱
takeaway: 好的功能與標籤命名能直接影響使用者是否看得懂、找得到，值得用明確準則與流程來打磨。

points.text: 命名會決定使用者如何**理解與瀏覽**你的 App，是體驗的一部分而非小事。
提出評估名稱好壞的**準則（Criteria）**，作為取名時的判斷依據。
介紹一套可重複的**命名流程（Process）**，協助團隊系統化地產生候選名稱。
說明如何**評估（Evaluation）**候選名稱並做出選擇。

audience: 負責 App 功能命名、UX 文案與資訊架構的**設計師、產品與工程團隊**。
gloss_en: Craft clear names for features and labels in your app
takeaway_en: Good feature and label naming directly affects whether users understand and can find things, and is worth refining with clear criteria and a process.

points_en.text: Naming determines how users **understand and navigate** your app; it's part of the experience, not a minor detail.
Presents **criteria** for evaluating whether a name is good, to guide your naming decisions.
Introduces a repeatable **naming process** to help teams generate candidate names systematically.
Explains how to **evaluate** candidate names and make a choice.

audience_en: **Designers, product, and engineering teams** responsible for feature naming, UX copy, and information architecture.
summary: 命名往往被當成設計的最後一步，但其實它和版面、互動與視覺一樣，深刻影響使用者怎麼理解與操作你的 app。Apple HI 設計團隊的 UX writer 指出，從 app 名稱到選單、分頁列、設定項目，每一層的命名都會累積成使用者對 app 的整體感受。好的命名讓人「一打開就知道往哪裡去」，那種篤定感其實是被設計出來的。

本場提出三個檢視名稱好壞的核心標準：**Belongs**（是否真正契合 app、和你已命名的其他事物和諧共存）、**Expectations**（是否清楚地預告使用者會找到什麼、進而建立信任）、以及 **Works everywhere**（能否跨語言、市場與平台情境而不出現摩擦）。講者強調這三者是「指南而非規則」，名稱不必每項都滿足，你可以依功能所在的脈絡決定要偏向清晰還是偏向品牌表達。以 Apple Cash 的餘額為例，Spending Power 太抽象又可能變成評判、Current Funds 像試算表用語，最終選用業界標準、清楚又中性的 **Balance**。

在「如何想出好名字」上，講者提供一套可操作的練習：先確立**受眾**，再以便利貼寫下「希望他們 think／feel／do 什麼」，盡量發散不要過早篩選，接著依主題分群，最後把候選名稱放進真實對話句子裡做「自然度測試」。以 Apple Maps 為例，從 ease／excitement／security 等主題出發，最終選定 **Visited Places**——描述清楚、契合既有以 places 為核心的介面、傳達擁有權，也好翻譯。

命名不必侷限於直白描述：Photos 的 **Memories** 用情感而非解釋來達成清晰、Podcasts 的 **Enhance Dialogue** 用動詞把使用者放在主導位置並同時回答「強化什麼、為了誰」、Apple Music 的 **AutoMix** 則用 Auto 加 Mix 造出一個雖不存在卻能秒懂的新詞。三種風格（描述、情感、品牌）的標準不變，差別只在你如何權衡。最後的收穫是:命名和版面同等基礎，最好的名字不只描述功能,更能對說使用者本身,而每個好名字都會讓下一個更容易,逐漸累積成你 app 的語言。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Human Interface 設計團隊的 UX writer Heej 開場，點出**命名**是個容易被忽略卻極具威力的設計工具。她以 Mac、iPhone、iCloud 等 Apple 五十年來的經典名稱破題，但強調命名其實發生在**每一個層級**——從選單、分頁列到設定項目，這些大小選擇加總起來決定使用者對 app 的感受。本場將依序談標準、流程與評估三部分。

deepdive.title: Criteria
deepdive.body: 提出三個檢視名稱的標準：**Belongs**（契合度，名字要在每個層級都站得住、和其他命名和諧共存）、**Expectations**（清晰與信任，讀到名字就能預測會找到什麼）、與 **Works everywhere**（跨語言、市場、平台皆可用）。講者強調這是指南而非規則，名稱不必全中。隨後以 Apple Cash 為例，否決抽象且可能變評判的 Spending Power、像試算表的 Current Funds，最終選用業界標準、中性清楚的 **Balance**；並以健身房 app 的 Lightweight／Heavyweight 說明何時可為品牌承擔額外的學習成本。

deepdive.title: Process
deepdive.body: 示範一套發想流程：先釐清**受眾**（新手父母？馬拉松訓練者？），再用便利貼分別寫下希望他們 **think／feel／do** 什麼，盡量發散、暫不篩選，然後依重複出現的**主題**分群。以 Apple Maps 記錄造訪地點的功能為例，歸納出 ease、excitement、security 三個主題，並用「把名字放進和朋友說的句子」做自然度測試，最終選定描述清楚、契合介面、傳達擁有權又好翻譯的 **Visited Places**。

deepdive.title: Evaluation
deepdive.body: 用三個實例說明如何評估名稱，且風格不必只有直白描述：Photos 的 **Memories** 以情感而非解釋達成清晰；Podcasts 的人聲強化功能因為是「使用者去做的動作」而採動詞，從 Isolate Vocals、Clarify Speech 一路淘汰，選定同時回答「強化什麼、為了誰」且已用於 Apple TV 的 **Enhance Dialogue**；Apple Music 的 **AutoMix** 則用 Auto＋Mix 造出可秒懂的新詞。結語點出命名與版面同等基礎，好名字會累積成 app 的語言。

summary_en: Naming is often treated as an afterthought, but it shapes how people understand and navigate your app just as much as layout, interaction, and visual design. A UX writer on Apple's Human Interface design team explains that naming happens at every level—from the app name down to menus, tab bars, and settings—and all those choices add up to how someone feels about your app. That feeling of opening an app and just knowing where to go is, in fact, designed.

The session offers three criteria for judging a name: **Belongs** (it fits your app and lives well among everything else you've named), **Expectations** (it clearly predicts what people will find and thereby builds trust), and **Works everywhere** (it holds up across languages, markets, and platforms without friction). These are a guide, not a rulebook—a name needn't check every box, and you decide whether to lean into clarity or brand based on where a feature lives. With Apple Cash, Spending Power is too abstract and can feel like a judgment, Current Funds sounds like a spreadsheet, and the winner is **Balance**: the clear, neutral, industry-standard term.

For generating names, the talk gives a concrete exercise: define your **audience** first, then write down on sticky notes what you want them to **think, feel, and do**—diverging freely without filtering—then group the ideas by recurring theme, and finally drop candidate names into natural conversational sentences as a gut check. For an Apple Maps feature that remembers places you've been, themes of ease, excitement, and security led to **Visited Places**: descriptive, at home in an interface built around "places," conveying ownership, and easy to translate.

Names don't have to be purely descriptive: Photos' **Memories** earns clarity from emotion rather than explanation, Podcasts' **Enhance Dialogue** uses a verb to put the person in control while answering both "what's enhanced" and "for whom," and Apple Music's **AutoMix** invents a word from Auto + Mix that you understand instantly. The criteria don't change across descriptive, emotional, and branded styles—only how you weigh them. The takeaway: naming is as fundamental as layout, the best names speak to the person and not just the function, and every good name makes the next one easier, gradually becoming the language of your app.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Heej, a UX writer on the Human Interface design team, opens by framing **naming** as a powerful but easily overlooked design tool. She cites 50 years of iconic Apple names—Mac, iPhone, iCloud—but stresses that naming happens at **every level**, from menus to tab bars to settings, and those choices add up to how someone feels about the app. The session will cover criteria, process, and evaluation in turn.

deepdive_en.title: Criteria
deepdive_en.body: Three criteria are introduced: **Belongs** (fit—the name works at every level and lives well among your others), **Expectations** (clarity and trust—the name predicts what people will find), and **Works everywhere** (holds up across languages, markets, and platforms). These are a guide, not a rulebook. Using Apple Cash, the talk rejects the abstract, judgment-prone Spending Power and the spreadsheet-like Current Funds in favor of the clear, neutral, industry-standard **Balance**; a gym app's Lightweight/Heavyweight plans illustrate when leaning into brand is worth the extra learning curve.

deepdive_en.title: Process
deepdive_en.body: A generative exercise is demonstrated: clarify the **audience** first, then use sticky notes to capture what you want them to **think, feel, and do**, diverging freely without filtering, then group ideas by recurring **theme**. For an Apple Maps feature that remembers visited places, the themes ease, excitement, and security emerge, and a "say it to a friend" naturalness test helps narrow down to **Visited Places**—descriptive, at home in the interface, conveying ownership, and easy to translate.

deepdive_en.title: Evaluation
deepdive_en.body: Three examples show how to evaluate a name, and that styles need not be purely descriptive: Photos' **Memories** achieves clarity through emotion; the Podcasts voice-isolation feature uses a verb because it's something you *do*, progressing from Isolate Vocals and Clarify Speech to **Enhance Dialogue**, which answers both "what's enhanced" and "for whom" and already ships on Apple TV; Apple Music's **AutoMix** invents an instantly understandable word from Auto + Mix. The close: naming is as fundamental as layout and accumulates into the language of your app.

title: Design intuitive search experiences
gloss: 設計直覺的搜尋體驗
takeaway: 從搜尋欄的呈現、放置位置到最佳實務,設計讓人快速找到內容的直覺搜尋體驗。

points.text: 探討在 App 中實作搜尋的**新模式與最佳實務**,讓搜尋在「幫人找到內容」上扮演關鍵角色。
**Search field(搜尋欄)**:說明搜尋欄本身的設計與呈現方式。
**Patterns and placement(模式與放置)**:這是最長的章節,聚焦搜尋入口要放在哪、用何種模式呈現。
**Best practices(最佳實務)**:歸納設計搜尋體驗時應遵循的原則。
整體偏**設計導向**,著重使用者如何更快速、直覺地找到所需內容。

audience: **負責 App 搜尋體驗的設計師與產品團隊,想了解搜尋入口的擺放與互動模式。**
gloss_en: Design intuitive search experiences
takeaway_en: From how the search field is presented to where it's placed and the best practices, design intuitive search experiences that help people find content fast.

points_en.text: Explores **new patterns and best practices** for implementing search in your app, where search plays a key role in helping people find content.
**Search field**: covers the design and presentation of the search field itself.
**Patterns and placement**: the longest chapter, focused on where to put the search entry point and which patterns to present it with.
**Best practices**: distills the principles to follow when designing search experiences.
Overall it's **design-oriented**, emphasizing how users can find what they need more quickly and intuitively.

audience_en: **Designers and product teams responsible for an app's search experience who want to understand search entry-point placement and interaction patterns.**
summary: 這場由 Apple Design 團隊主講，主題是如何設計直覺的 **search（搜尋）** 體驗。搜尋是使用者開啟 app 時最常尋找的功能，能讓人不必花時間翻找就直達所需內容；隨著 app 內容愈來愈豐富，一個好的搜尋設計變得格外重要。配合 **Liquid Glass**，iOS 推出更符合人因的新搜尋模式，並充分善用 iPad 與 Mac 的大螢幕。

Apple 提供的 **Search Field** 元件內含使用者已習慣的核心元素：前導的放大鏡 **Search icon**、placeholder 提示文字、輸入後出現的 **clear button**，以及 iOS 上 focus 時出現、可退出搜尋並收起鍵盤的 **Cancel button**。Search Field 會依放置位置自動採用正確呈現樣式——放在 Toolbar 用 glass、放在捲動區則用標準內容樣式。若 app 有自家品牌圖示，務必保留搜尋的核心元素，自訂圖示也要貼近原本符號，因為放大鏡已是全球公認的搜尋象徵。

在版面模式上，**放置位置直接影響 focus 後欄位的動畫去向**。iOS 上搜尋可放在底部 Toolbar（最符合可及性、focus 時欄位上浮到鍵盤之上，如 Mail）、頂部 Toolbar（底部被 sheet 佔據時，如 Stocks）、tab bar 中的 **Search Tab**（標準 tab 進入 landing page，或 prominent 按鈕樣式立即叫出鍵盤如 Phone），或直接 inline 在內容中（範圍限定於該分頁，如 Apple Music 資料庫）。iPad 與 Mac 共用相近的導覽模型，建議兩者體驗盡量一致：主要搜尋可放在 Toolbar 的 trailing 位置（Split View 如 Mail、Files）、sidebar 頂部（過濾 sidebar 內容如 Settings、Stocks），或專屬的 Search Tab／section。

最佳實務聚焦於降低摩擦：focus 時即顯示 **recent searches**（並允許滑動或標頭按鈕清除），輸入時盡快顯示結果並整合 **predictive suggestions**（在視覺上區分使用者輸入與預測補完）。過濾方面，由廣到窄，輕量過濾用 **scope bar**（如 Mail 切換信箱），多類別用情境相關的 filters（如 Maps），或用 **search tokens** 以接近自然語言的方式組合條件（如 Photos 看「2021 年 Joshua Tree」的照片）——但 token 較不易被發現，不應取代可見的過濾 UI。最後要優雅地處理無結果：用 **content unavailable view** 顯示搜尋符號、標題與副標，並帶出目前搜尋字串以利使用者發現拼字錯誤。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Apple Design 團隊的 Rob 開場，定位 **search** 是幫助人們尋找、導覽與探索內容最重要的工具之一，讓使用者擁有直達所需、不必花時間翻找的「超能力」。搜尋常是開啟 app 後第一個被尋找的功能（如 Pages 找文件、Apple TV 找電影、Apple Music 探索新歌手）。配合 **Liquid Glass**，iOS 推出更符合人因的新搜尋模式，並善用 iPad 與 Mac 的大螢幕。

deepdive.title: Search field
deepdive.body: Apple 提供的 **Search Field** 元件包含使用者期待的核心元素：建立搜尋視覺識別的前導放大鏡 icon、placeholder 提示文字、輸入後出現的 clear button，以及 iOS 上 focus 時出現、可退出搜尋並收起鍵盤的 **Cancel button**。欄位會依放置位置自動採用正確樣式——在 Toolbar 用 **glass**、在捲動區用標準內容樣式。若 app 有自家品牌圖示，須保留核心元素且自訂圖示要貼近原符號，因為放大鏡已是公認的搜尋象徵。

deepdive.title: Patterns and placement
deepdive.body: 本段概觀各種搜尋版面，核心觀念是**放置位置直接決定 focus 後欄位動畫的去向**。iOS 上：底部 Toolbar 最符合可及性，欄位 focus 時上浮到鍵盤之上（如 Mail，寬度依相鄰項目自動調整，項目過多時可先當按鈕再展開成欄位）；底部被 sheet 佔據時改放頂部 Toolbar（如 Stocks）。Tabbed app 建議建立單一 **Search Tab** 作為主要入口：標準 tab 會進到帶建議內容的 landing page（適合探索型，如 Apple TV 先呈現分類），prominent 按鈕樣式則立即叫出鍵盤（適合明確目標，如 Phone）；也可把搜尋直接 inline 於內容以限定範圍（如 Apple Music 只搜資料庫）。iPad 與 Mac 導覽相近、建議體驗一致：主要欄位可放 Toolbar 的 trailing 位置（Split View 如 Mail、Notes、Files，或結果出現在 detail view 如 Freeform）、sidebar 頂部（過濾 sidebar 內容如 Settings、Stocks），或專屬 Search Tab／section（多區塊 app 如 Apple Music）。

deepdive.title: Best practices
deepdive.body: 降低摩擦的關鍵實務：focus 時顯示 **recent searches**（iOS inline、iPad/Mac 在 Toolbar/Sidebar 用選單或在 Search Tab 與建議並列），可選擇性只顯示使用者實際看過或互動過的結果，並允許滑動或標頭按鈕清除。輸入時盡快顯示結果並整合 **predictive suggestions**，在視覺上區分使用者輸入與預測補完並限制數量。過濾由廣到窄：輕量用 **scope bar**（如 Mail 切換信箱）、多類別用情境相關 filters（如 Maps）、或用 **search tokens** 以近自然語言組合條件（如 Photos 的「2021 年 Joshua Tree」），但 token 較不易發現、不應取代可見的過濾 UI，與 scope bar 搭配最佳。無結果時用 **content unavailable view** 顯示搜尋符號、標題與副標，並帶出目前搜尋字串以利發現拼字錯誤。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 結尾鼓勵開發者檢視自家 app 的機會：是否有可把搜尋移到底部以提升可及性之處？tabbed app 是否該加入 **Search Tab**？是否充分運用 suggestions 與 filters 讓搜尋更不費力？並建議參閱 **Human Interface Guidelines**、design resources，以及往年的設計系統相關場次延伸學習。

summary_en: Presented by the Apple Design team, this session is about designing an intuitive **search** experience. Search is one of the most important tools for helping people find, navigate, and discover content, giving users the superpower of getting straight to what they need without frustration; as apps offer ever-richer content, great search design matters more than ever. With **Liquid Glass**, iOS introduces new, more ergonomic search patterns and takes fuller advantage of the larger displays on iPad and Mac.

Apple's **Search Field** component includes the core elements people expect: a leading magnifying-glass **Search icon**, placeholder text, a **clear button** once text is entered, and on iOS a **Cancel button** when focused that exits search and dismisses the keyboard. The field automatically adopts the right presentation for its placement—glass in a Toolbar, standard content styling in a scroll region. If your app has its own brand iconography, keep the core search elements intact and make custom icons closely resemble the originals, since the magnifying glass is universally recognized as search.

For placement, **where you put search directly impacts where the field animates when active**. On iOS, search can live in the bottom Toolbar (most ergonomic, animating up over the keyboard, as in Mail), the top Toolbar (when the bottom is occupied by a sheet, as in Stocks), a **Search Tab** in the tab bar (a standard tab leading to a landing page, or a prominent button that immediately raises the keyboard, as in Phone), or inline in content to scope search to that section (as in the Apple Music library). iPad and Mac share similar navigation models and should be kept aligned: place the primary field in the trailing Toolbar position (Split View apps like Mail and Files), at the top of the sidebar (to filter sidebar content, as in Settings and Stocks), or in a dedicated Search Tab or section.

Best practices focus on reducing friction: show **recent searches** on focus (and let people clear them via swipe or a header button), show results quickly on typing, and integrate **predictive suggestions** (visually distinguishing user input from the predicted completion). For filtering, start broad and narrow: use a **scope bar** for lightweight filtering (Mail switching mailboxes), contextual filters for multiple categories (Maps), or **search tokens** to combine criteria in near-natural language (Photos showing "Joshua Tree in 2021")—but tokens are less discoverable and shouldn't replace visible filter UI. Finally, fail gracefully with a **content unavailable view** showing a search symbol, title, and subtitle, surfacing the current query so users can catch typos.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Apple Design team's Rob opens by positioning **search** as one of the most important tools for finding, navigating, and discovering content, giving users the superpower of reaching exactly what they need without wasting time. Search is often the first thing people look for when opening an app (getting back to a Pages document, finding a movie on Apple TV, exploring artists in Apple Music). With **Liquid Glass**, iOS introduces more ergonomic search patterns and takes fuller advantage of iPad and Mac displays.

deepdive_en.title: Search field
deepdive_en.body: Apple's **Search Field** component includes the elements people expect: a leading magnifying-glass icon that visually establishes the UI as search, placeholder text, a clear button once text is entered, and on iOS a **Cancel button** when focused that exits search and dismisses the keyboard. The field automatically adopts the correct styling for its placement—**glass** in a Toolbar, standard content styling in a scroll region. If your app has its own brand iconography, keep the core elements intact and make custom icons closely resemble the originals, since the magnifying glass is universally recognized as search.

deepdive_en.title: Patterns and placement
deepdive_en.body: This section surveys search layouts, with the core idea that **placement directly determines where the field animates when active**. On iOS: the bottom Toolbar is most ergonomic, floating the field up over the keyboard (as in Mail, with width adapting to adjacent items and the option to start as a button then expand when there are many items); when the bottom is occupied by a sheet, use the top Toolbar (as in Stocks). Tabbed apps should create a single **Search Tab** as the primary entry point: a standard tab leads to a landing page with helpful suggestions (good for exploratory use, as Apple TV surfaces genres first), while a prominent button appearance immediately raises the keyboard (good for known intent, as in Phone); search can also be placed inline in content to scope it (as Apple Music searches only the library). iPad and Mac have similar navigation and should stay aligned: place the primary field in the trailing Toolbar position (Split View apps like Mail, Notes, Files, or where results appear in the detail view as in Freeform), at the top of the sidebar (to filter sidebar content as in Settings and Stocks), or in a dedicated Search Tab or section (multi-section apps like Apple Music).

deepdive_en.title: Best practices
deepdive_en.body: Key friction-reducing practices: show **recent searches** on focus (inline on iOS; in a menu in the Toolbar/Sidebar on iPad/Mac, or alongside suggestions in a Search Tab), optionally surfacing only results the user actually viewed or engaged with, and letting people clear them via swipe or a header button. On typing, show results quickly and integrate **predictive suggestions**, visually distinguishing user input from the predicted completion and limiting their number. Filter from broad to narrow: a **scope bar** for lightweight filtering (Mail switching mailboxes), contextual filters for multiple categories (Maps), or **search tokens** to combine criteria in near-natural language (Photos' "Joshua Tree in 2021")—but tokens are less discoverable, shouldn't replace visible filter UI, and pair well with a scope bar. When there are no results, use a **content unavailable view** showing a search symbol, title, and subtitle, surfacing the current query so users can catch typos.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: The session closes by encouraging developers to look for opportunities in their own apps: are there places to move search to the bottom for reachability? Would a tabbed app benefit from a **Search Tab**? Are you leveraging suggestions and filters to make search feel effortless? It points to the **Human Interface Guidelines**, design resources, and prior-year design-system talks for going deeper.

title: Validate your App Intents adoption with AppIntentsTesting
gloss: 用 AppIntentsTesting 驗證你的 App Intents
takeaway: 用全新的 AppIntentsTesting 框架，透過與 Siri、Shortcuts 相同的基礎架構來自動化測試你的 App Intents、entity 查詢、Spotlight 索引與畫面標註。
chapters: Your first test: execute an intent
Chain multiple intents in one test

points.text: 全新的 **AppIntentsTesting** 框架透過 Siri 與 Shortcuts 相同的基礎架構執行測試，用 `IntentDefinitions` 取得並 `run()` 你的 intent。
可測試 **entity 查詢**（含 `EntityStringQuery` 的 `entities(matching:)`），驗證搜尋結果是否正確。
支援在單一測試中**串接多個 intent**（如建立後再更新事件），並可用 `isDiscoverable = false` 建立僅供測試的 intent。
能驗證 **Spotlight 索引**（`spotlightQuery`）與**畫面標註（view annotations）**，搭配 `XCUIApplication` 確認 UI 呈現正確內容。

audience: **已採用或正在採用 App Intents、想為 Siri 與 Shortcuts 整合建立自動化測試的開發者**。
gloss_en: Validate your App Intents with AppIntentsTesting
takeaway_en: Use the new AppIntentsTesting framework to automate testing of your App Intents, entity queries, Spotlight indexing, and view annotations through the same infrastructure as Siri and Shortcuts.

points_en.text: The new **AppIntentsTesting** framework runs tests through the same infrastructure as Siri and Shortcuts, using `IntentDefinitions` to obtain and `run()` your intent.
You can test **entity queries** (including `EntityStringQuery`'s `entities(matching:)`) to verify that search results are correct.
Supports **chaining multiple intents** in a single test (such as creating an event and then updating it), and lets you create test-only intents with `isDiscoverable = false`.
Can validate **Spotlight indexing** (`spotlightQuery`) and **view annotations**, using `XCUIApplication` to confirm the UI presents the correct content.

audience_en: **Developers who have adopted or are adopting App Intents and want to build automated tests for their Siri and Shortcuts integration**.
summary: App Intents 已是 app 與系統整合的核心，每年驅動越來越多體驗——Siri、Shortcuts 自動化、Spotlight 全系統搜尋、主畫面 Widget 都仰賴它。既然這麼多介面都靠 intent、entity 與 query 運作，這些程式碼一旦回歸就會讓使用者遇到難以預期的系統行為。本場介紹全新的 **AppIntentsTesting** 框架，讓你能透過 Siri 與 Shortcuts 使用的同一套基礎設施來驗證 App Intents。

AppIntentsTesting 是一個**整合測試**框架，類似 UI 測試:測試以字串尋找你的 intent，不需存取 app 內部。測試住在標準的 **XCUITest** bundle、在獨立行程執行，app 在另一個行程跨行程邊界**在裝置上實際執行** intent 並回傳結果，雙方不共享狀態。實務意義是:測試走過完整的 App Intents 堆疊(無 mock、無 stub)、不需把 app 程式碼編譯進測試 target(只傳入 bundle identifier)、CI 會自動納入、且因不依賴任何 UI 而能跨版本穩定。最小範例只需五行:建立 **IntentDefinitions**(傳入 bundle id)、以 `intents["CreateCalendarIntent"]` 取得定義、`makeIntent(...)` 填入參數、`.run()` 執行、再用 dynamic member lookup 對 `result.value` 斷言。

進階部分示範測試 **entity query**:用 `entities(matching:)` 觸發 **EntityStringQuery** 並以 TDD 方式先寫測試再實作 query;以及**串接多個 intent**:把前一個 intent 的結果(EventEntity)直接餵給下一個 intent,且 calendar 這類 entity 參數只要傳字串、執行階段就會自動呼叫對應的 EntityStringQuery 補上——正是 Shortcuts 中組合 intent 的方式。為了讓測試自我隔離,講者介紹 **test-only intents**:標上 `isDiscoverable = false` 並包在 `#if DEBUG`,可用來播種已知資料(如 SeedSampleEventsIntent)或直接跳轉到任一畫面,甚至包裝尚未採用 App Intents 的功能。

最後是觸及 app 之外的**系統層整合**測試:用 `spotlightQuery()` 驗證 entity 是否正確索引進 **Spotlight**(範例抓到一個被註解掉、未重新啟用的索引呼叫並寫測試防止回歸);用 `viewAnnotations()` 驗證 **view annotation** 是否正確告訴系統當前畫面顯示哪個 entity,讓 Siri 能回答「這個活動是幾點?」(範例修正了誤把 calendar id 當識別碼的 bug)。整體工作流是:先用 AppIntentsTesting 為 actions／data／queries 等基礎型別寫單元測試,再為 Spotlight、view annotation、跨 app 傳遞等系統整合寫整合測試,最後仍記得用 Siri 與 Shortcuts 親手實測一次。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: App Intents 團隊的 Venkatesh 開場,說明 **App Intents** 是 app 與系統整合的核心,逐年驅動更多體驗:**Siri** 互動、**Shortcuts** 自動化、**Spotlight** 全系統搜尋與主畫面 **Widget**。正因如此,每個 intent、entity 與 query 都必須正確運作,而全新的 **AppIntentsTesting** 框架就是用來測試這一切。並指引新手與想了解新進展者分別參考 WWDC25／WWDC26 的相關場次。

deepdive.title: Meet CometCal: your first test
deepdive.body: 介紹貫穿全場的範例 app **CometCal**——一個以 SwiftUI 打造、管理行事曆／活動／參與者並完整整合 App Intents 的太空主題日曆 app。講者將以它示範如何用 AppIntentsTesting 測試,並指向同事 Justin 講解如何讓 CometCal 支援 Siri 的 code-along。

deepdive.title: How AppIntentsTesting works
deepdive.body: 說明開始測試只需一個 **UI Testing bundle**:建立時須選對 development team(測試 runner 與 app 必須用同一個團隊簽章)、bundle identifier 與 target。隨後示範第一個測試的骨架:`import AppIntentsTesting`、標準 **XCTestCase**,建立 **IntentDefinitions**(傳入 CometCal 的 bundle id),即可在**不 import app** 的情況下取用其所有 intent、entity 與 query。

deepdive.title: Your first test: execute an intent
deepdive.body: 完整走一遍執行 intent:以 `definitions.intents["CreateCalendarIntent"]` 取得定義,呼叫 `makeIntent(name:color:)` 填入參數(這裡建立名為 Occupy Saturn、紅色的行事曆),其中 color 是 **AppEnum**,只要傳入其 raw string 值框架就會自動轉型。接著 `.run()` 在裝置上實際執行,用 `result.value` 取回 **CalendarEntity** 並以 dynamic member lookup 斷言 title。講者特別提醒:測試不對 app 編譯,故參數名稱與型別**沒有自動完成**,須自行填對;自訂型別則參考 IntentValueConvertibleWrapper。實機驗證確認新行事曆確實出現,僅五行程式碼即執行了一個 on-device intent。

deepdive.title: Testing entity queries
deepdive.body: 說明 entity query 是 App Intents 整合的基石,負責在 Shortcuts、Siri 或任何 App Intents 浮現 entity 之處回傳正確結果,一旦回歸就會造成異常的系統行為。AppIntentsTesting 可驗證 **string query**、**識別碼查詢**與 **suggested entities**。以「把 Cosmic Ray Calibration 活動改名」的情境鋪陳,並指出在 Shortcuts 搜尋時因 string query 尚未實作而「No Options Available」,接著用 TDD 補上。

deepdive.title: Test an entity string query
deepdive.body: 撰寫測試:先建立 entity／intent 定義並執行 **SeedSampleEventsIntent** 來重置並植入已知活動,接著用 EventEntity 定義的 `entities(matching: "Cosmic Ray")` 在裝置上執行 string query,對回傳的 EventEntity 陣列斷言 count 與 title。講者建議把定義抽離測試函式、把資料植入移到 setUp 以利重用。此時測試**如預期失敗**,精準指出接下來該實作什麼。

deepdive.title: Implement the EntityStringQuery under test
deepdive.body: 回到 **EventEntityQuery**——它原本只能依識別碼回傳活動與提供 suggested entities,缺少 string query 能力。講者新增 **EntityStringQuery** 的 conformance 並實作 `entities(matching:)`,以 `localizedCaseInsensitiveContains` 依 title 過濾活動再映射成 entity。重新執行測試即通過,並到 Shortcuts 實機確認這次能搜到活動——先寫測試、再做功能,正是搭配 AppIntentsTesting 的 TDD。

deepdive.title: Combining multiple intents
deepdive.body: 說明複雜的 Shortcuts 常把一個 intent 的結果當作另一個 intent 的參數,這種串接是許多自動化的基礎。以「原本為團隊安排 Asteroid Dodgeball 練習、後改為講解規則」的情境,說明要為這個核心工作流寫一個模擬測試。

deepdive.title: Chain multiple intents in one test
deepdive.body: 示範串接:先以 **CreateEventIntent** 建立活動,其中 calendar 參數雖型別為 **CalendarEntity**,但只要傳入字串,App Intents 執行階段就會自動呼叫對應的 EntityStringQuery 填入首個符合值。接著把第一個 run 回傳的 **EventEntity** 直接餵給 **UpdateEventIntent** 更新 title,最後斷言更新後的標題——完全對應人們在 Shortcuts 中組合 intent 的方式。此次 setUp 還啟動了 app 以便目視確認建立與更新流程。

deepdive.title: Test-only intents
deepdive.body: 強調 AppIntentsTesting 測試輕量、快速、可在每次 commit 執行,而可靠的前提是每個測試**自我隔離**,**test-only intents** 正是為此而生。它們是只為測試存在的聚焦型 intent,可精確建立測試所需資料(避免前次殘留造成 flaky)、不經 UI 直接跳轉到任一畫面,甚至能包裝 app 中**尚未採用 App Intents** 的功能(內部導覽、資料管理、狀態操作)以便透過 AppIntentsTesting 測試。

deepdive.title: Make an intent test-only
deepdive.body: 示範作法:把 intent 標上 `static let isDiscoverable = false`(避免系統在任何地方曝露它),再包進 `#if DEBUG` 編譯指令(讓只有測試能存取)。以稍早 string query 測試用到的 **SeedSampleEventsIntent** 為例,它會在行事曆建立一組已知活動。

deepdive.title: Testing Spotlight indexing
deepdive.body: 轉向觸及 app 之外的系統整合。**Spotlight** 讓人從單一入口搜尋全系統,索引 entity 後使用者不必開 app 就能找到內容。以「指揮官急問 Dark Matter Symposium 何時舉行、但 Spotlight 卻搜不到」的情境揭露 bug:開發期間索引程式碼被註解掉且從未重新啟用,因 app 行為沒變而未被察覺。修法是取消註解,並要寫測試防止再次發生。

deepdive.title: Test Spotlight indexing
deepdive.body: 撰寫防回歸測試:用 `spotlightQuery("Supernova Viewing Party")` 與 Spotlight 對話,先斷言結果為空、再以 **CreateEventIntent** 建立活動,然後再查一次並斷言恰好一筆且 title 相符。測試通過後即可在每次 commit 執行,Spotlight 整合若再壞掉就會立即被攔截。

deepdive.title: Testing view annotations
deepdive.body: **View annotation** 告訴系統你的畫面當前顯示哪個 entity,讓 **Siri** 理解螢幕內容並直接行動。CometCal 每次導覽到活動都會告訴 Siri 對應的 **EventEntity**,於是即使手機被「蟲洞」拽走也能喊「Siri,這個活動是幾點?」。若 annotation 壞了 Siri 就無從得知,講者藉此引出要修的 bug。

deepdive.title: Test view annotations
deepdive.body: 撰寫測試:先用 **OpenEventIntent** 導覽到活動頁,因測試位於 XCUITest bundle,可用 **XCUI Automation**(`app.staticTexts[...]` 加 `waitForExistence`)確認畫面確實渲染正確活動。接著呼叫 `viewAnnotations()` 取回系統回報的 view annotation 清單,斷言只有一個,並透過 ViewAnnotation 的 `entity` 屬性以 dynamic member lookup 斷言 title。測試先失敗,於 EventDetailView 發現**誤把 calendar id 當識別碼**,改成 event id 後通過,Siri 便能正確回答活動時間與地點。

deepdive.title: The App Intents testing workflow
deepdive.body: 總覽如何把 AppIntentsTesting 納入開發流程:先實作 actions／data／queries 等基礎型別,用 AppIntentsTesting 為其撰寫驗證——這些等同 App Intents 整合的**單元測試**;接著做更深的系統整合(view annotation、Spotlight 捐贈、跨 app 傳資料),再用 AppIntentsTesting 撰寫**整合測試**。各層都有覆蓋後,別忘了仍要用 **Siri** 與 **Shortcuts** 親手實測,體驗真實使用情境。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 收尾:**AppIntentsTesting** 是單一框架,能在 app 之外、全自動地測試你的 intent、entity、enum、query 與系統整合。鼓勵下載 **CometCal** 範例專案試做並查閱完整測試集,參考文件取得完整 API,並指向學習用 App Intents 打造 Siri 體驗的場次。

summary_en: App Intents is a core part of how your app integrates with the system, powering more experiences every year—Siri, Shortcuts automations, system-wide Spotlight search, and Home Screen Widgets all depend on it. Because so many surfaces rely on your intents, entities, and queries, a regression in that code can leave people facing unexpected system behavior. This session introduces the brand-new **AppIntentsTesting** framework, which validates your App Intents through the same infrastructure used by Siri and Shortcuts.

AppIntentsTesting is an **integration testing** framework that, like UI tests, finds your intents by string without any access to the app's internals. Your tests live in a standard **XCUITest** bundle and run in their own process; the app runs separately and **executes intents on-device** across the process boundary, returning results without sharing state. In practice this means tests run through the full App Intents stack (no mocks, no stubs), never compile your app code into the test target (you only pass a bundle identifier), are picked up automatically by CI, and stay stable across releases since they depend on no UI. The minimal example is five lines: build an **IntentDefinitions** with the bundle id, fetch a definition via `intents["CreateCalendarIntent"]`, call `makeIntent(...)` with parameters, `.run()` it, then assert on `result.value` using dynamic member lookup.

More advanced tests cover **entity queries**—`entities(matching:)` triggers an **EntityStringQuery**, demonstrated TDD-style by writing the test before implementing the query—and **chaining multiple intents**, feeding one intent's result (an EventEntity) directly into the next, where an entity parameter like calendar can be passed as a plain string and the runtime automatically calls its EntityStringQuery to fill it in, mirroring how people compose intents in Shortcuts. To keep tests self-contained, the talk introduces **test-only intents**: mark them `isDiscoverable = false` and wrap them in `#if DEBUG` to seed known data (like SeedSampleEventsIntent), jump directly to any view, or even wrap functionality you haven't yet adopted App Intents for.

Finally it covers **system-level integration** tests that reach beyond your app: `spotlightQuery()` verifies entities are correctly indexed in **Spotlight** (an example catches a commented-out indexing call and adds a regression test), and `viewAnnotations()` verifies that **view annotations** correctly tell the system which entity is on screen so Siri can answer "what time is this event?" (an example fixes a bug where the calendar id was used as the identifier). The overall workflow: write AppIntentsTesting unit tests for foundational actions/data/queries, then integration tests for Spotlight, view annotations, and cross-app data passing—and still test manually with Siri and Shortcuts to experience them as people would.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Venkatesh from the App Intents team opens by framing **App Intents** as a core part of system integration that powers more experiences each year: **Siri** interactions, **Shortcuts** automations, system-wide **Spotlight** search, and Home Screen **Widgets**. Because every intent, entity, and query must work correctly, the new **AppIntentsTesting** framework exists to test all of it. He points new and returning developers to the relevant WWDC25/WWDC26 talks.

deepdive_en.title: Meet CometCal: your first test
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the running sample app **CometCal**—a space-themed SwiftUI calendar app managing calendars, events, and attendees with full App Intents integration. The session will use it to demonstrate AppIntentsTesting, and points to a colleague's code-along on making CometCal available to Siri.

deepdive_en.title: How AppIntentsTesting works
deepdive_en.body: Getting started needs only a **UI Testing bundle**: when creating it you must pick the correct development team (the test runner and app must use the same team for code signing), bundle identifier, and target. The first test's skeleton is shown: `import AppIntentsTesting`, a standard **XCTestCase**, and an **IntentDefinitions** object built from CometCal's bundle id, giving access to every intent, entity, and query **without importing the app**.

deepdive_en.title: Your first test: execute an intent
deepdive_en.body: A full walk-through of executing an intent: fetch the definition via `definitions.intents["CreateCalendarIntent"]`, call `makeIntent(name:color:)` (creating a red calendar named Occupy Saturn) where color is an **AppEnum**—pass its raw string value and the framework converts it. Then `.run()` executes on-device; `result.value` returns the **CalendarEntity** and dynamic member lookup asserts its title. The speaker warns that because the test doesn't build against the app, parameter names and types offer **no auto-completion** and must be filled in correctly; custom types use IntentValueConvertibleWrapper. On-device verification confirms the new calendar appears—an on-device intent executed in just five lines.

deepdive_en.title: Testing entity queries
deepdive_en.body: Entity queries are a building block of App Intents integration, responsible for returning the right results wherever entities are looked up—in Shortcuts, via Siri, or anywhere—so a regression causes unexpected system behavior. AppIntentsTesting verifies **string queries**, **identifier lookups**, and **suggested entities**. The "rename the Cosmic Ray Calibration event" scenario sets up the problem: searching in Shortcuts shows "No Options Available" because the string query isn't implemented yet, to be added via TDD.

deepdive_en.title: Test an entity string query
deepdive_en.body: The test first builds entity/intent definitions and runs **SeedSampleEventsIntent** to reset and seed known events, then calls `entities(matching: "Cosmic Ray")` on the EventEntity definition to run the string query on-device, asserting on the returned array's count and title. The speaker recommends lifting the definitions out of the function and moving seeding into setUp for reuse. The test **fails as expected**, telling you exactly what to build.

deepdive_en.title: Implement the EntityStringQuery under test
deepdive_en.body: Back in **EventEntityQuery**—which previously only returned events by identifier and suggested entities—the speaker adds an **EntityStringQuery** conformance and implements `entities(matching:)`, filtering events by title with `localizedCaseInsensitiveContains` and mapping to entities. Re-running the test now passes, confirmed on-device in Shortcuts: write the test first, then build the feature—TDD with AppIntentsTesting.

deepdive_en.title: Combining multiple intents
deepdive_en.body: Complex Shortcuts often take one intent's result and pass it as a parameter into another—this chaining underpins many automations. With the scenario of an Asteroid Dodgeball practice session repurposed to a rules overview, the speaker sets up a test to simulate this core workflow.

deepdive_en.title: Chain multiple intents in one test
deepdive_en.body: Chaining is demonstrated: run **CreateEventIntent** where the calendar parameter, though typed as a **CalendarEntity**, accepts a plain string—the App Intents runtime automatically calls the associated EntityStringQuery and fills in the first match. The **EventEntity** returned by the first run is then passed directly into **UpdateEventIntent** to change the title, with a final assertion on the updated title—exactly how people compose intents in Shortcuts. This time setUp launches the app to visually confirm creation and update.

deepdive_en.title: Test-only intents
deepdive_en.body: AppIntentsTesting tests are lightweight, fast, and runnable on every commit, but reliability requires each test to be **self-contained**—which **test-only intents** enable.
