Introduces the **hardware cost** API (0–1, the share of session hardware in use; above 1 the system can't support it), affected by camera count, active formats (1080p vs 4K), frame rate (assumes the format's max; lower it with frameRateOverride), and binned formats (grouped pixels, less bandwidth).

deepdive_en.title: Monitor for system pressure
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **system pressure cost** API (0–1, the cost of the current configuration; above 1 is unsustainable) and recommends observing `AVCaptureDevice`'s **systemPressureState**: as it rises, reduce the device frame rate, throttle GPU or Apple Neural Engine, and minimize UI work. Use these APIs after initial setup—after committing, confirm hardware cost is at or below 1, then register a handler for state changes to adapt.

deepdive_en.title: Deterministic file writing
deepdive_en.body: Explains that traditional file I/O is **non-deterministic** because the system juggles competing operations, memory fragmentation, and storage wear, while high-bit-rate recording like ProRes needs sustained high-bandwidth I/O to avoid dropped frames. Leads into iOS 27's new `AVProVideoStorage`.

deepdive_en.title: Manage pro video storage
deepdive_en.body: **`AVProVideoStorage`** is a system-wide shared resource tracking and managing pre-allocated storage, working with existing recording APIs: set `usesProVideoStorage` on `AVCaptureMovieFileOutput` (or the asset writer when recording with a video data output) and the system handles allocation and I/O so high-bit-rate write performance stays consistent. Camera settings let people control allocation, with remaining-capacity and open-settings methods.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt AVProVideoStorage for deterministic file write speeds
deepdive_en.body: Shows adoption: check support with `isProVideoStorageSupported`, get the singleton via `shared`, create the movie file output, session, connections, and format, confirm compatibility with `isProVideoStorageSupported` on the output, ensure storage isn't busy resizing or servicing requests before recording, then enable pro video storage and start. Recording writes to pre-allocated storage and is moved to the target location afterward; this also works with `AVAssetWriter`. Closes by recommending deferred start with a quality photo output, measuring with instruments, and testing in real, harsh conditions like a hot day.

title: Implement high resolution photo capture
gloss: 實作高解析度照片拍攝
takeaway: 運用 AVFoundation 設定 maxPhotoDimensions 與品質優先級，並預先準備管線，在 App 中拍出超高解析度照片同時維持回應速度。

points.text: 介紹三種拍攝選項與各自適用時機，協助為高解析度照片做正確選擇。
在 **AVCapturePhotoOutput** 上設定 **maxPhotoDimensions**，並從 activeFormat 取得支援的最大尺寸。
透過 **AVCapturePhotoSettings** 的 **photoQualityPrioritization** 在畫質與速度間取得平衡。
以 **setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray** 預先準備管線，並在實際拍攝時建立全新的 settings，維持回應式拍攝。

audience: 適合**開發相機或攝影類 App、需要拍攝高解析度照片的開發者**。
gloss_en: Implement high resolution photo capture
takeaway_en: Use AVFoundation to set maxPhotoDimensions and quality prioritization, and prepare the pipeline ahead of time to capture super high resolution photos in your app while staying responsive.

points_en.text: Introduces three capture options and when each is appropriate, helping you make the right choice for high resolution photos.
Set **maxPhotoDimensions** on **AVCapturePhotoOutput**, and get the maximum supported dimensions from activeFormat.
Balance quality against speed with **AVCapturePhotoSettings**' **photoQualityPrioritization**.
Prepare the pipeline ahead of time with **setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray**, and create a fresh settings object for each actual capture to stay responsive.

audience_en: **Developers building camera or photography apps who need to capture high resolution photos.**
summary: 這場由 Camera Software 團隊的 Mohit Setia 主講，主題是用 **AVFoundation** 在 app 中實作高解析度照片拍攝，核心是管理「處理時間」與「最終畫質」之間的取捨。preview stream 只給螢幕解析度的影像，但拍照情境需要更高細節與低雜訊，才能支援裁切、放大細節與影像分析。講者先定義高解析度照片的層級：典型的 **12MP**、進階的 **24MP** 與 **48MP**。自 iPhone 14 Pro 起的 48MP Quad sensor 可單張全解析度拍攝；自 iPhone 15 起的 24MP 則由 **Photonic Engine** 把多幀融合的 12MP HDR 影像與全感光元件的 48MP 影像結合，畫質加倍而檔案僅約增 50%。
可請求的拍攝型別有四種：最常見的 **fully processed**（多幀融合、經 Photonic Engine）、**exposure brackets**（多張不同曝光）、**Bayer RAW**（感光元件最小處理原始資料），以及 Apple 的 **ProRAW**（結合 RAW 彈性與 iPhone 影像處理）。

設定流程上：先建立 **AVCaptureSession** 並用 `.photo` preset（只有此 preset 支援 24／48MP）；在 **AVCapturePhotoOutput** 上設定 `maxPhotoQualityPrioritization`（讓系統為 speed／balanced／quality 三級預備資源）；用 `activeFormat.supportedMaxPhotoDimensions` 選最大尺寸並設給 `maxPhotoDimensions`，務必在 commit 前完成設定，否則會觸發冗長的管線重設。拍攝時在 **AVCapturePhotoSettings** 上設定 `maxPhotoDimensions` 與 `photoQualityPrioritization`——這是「請求」而非保證，實際尺寸會回傳於 delegate 的 **AVCaptureResolvedSettings**。可用 `setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray` 提前預配資源，避免拍攝當下才配置而拖慢速度（注意 prepare 與 capture 必須用不同但設定相符的 settings 物件）。

最後是讓 app 保持流暢的最佳化。quality／balanced／speed 三種 prioritization 在處理時間與畫質間取捨；48MP 因為單張只需 balanced 或 quality，18／24MP 為多幀融合則只在 quality 可用。透過 **responsive capture** 讓拍攝可重疊（觀察 `captureReadiness`）、**deferred photo processing** 先交付 proxy 照片再於背景完成最終處理（`didFinishCapturingDeferredPhotoProxy`），以及 **fast capture prioritization** 在連拍時自動把畫質從 quality 降到 balanced，都能大幅縮短 shot-to-shot delay。實務結論是：先決定要的解析度，再選對 prioritization，需要最高畫質時務必開啟 deferred 與 responsive capture，才不會每張都卡住下一張、錯過難以重來的瞬間。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Camera Software 團隊的工程師 Mohit Setia 開場，點出相機硬體與計算攝影讓高解析度拍攝成為可能，但要善用畫質就得管理 **處理時間與最終畫質** 之間的取捨。本場路線圖為：先介紹高解析度照片的種類，接著示範如何設定與拍攝，最後談如何在整個過程中讓 app 保持流暢回應。

deepdive.title: High-resolution photos
deepdive.body: 說明 preview stream 只提供螢幕解析度影像，而拍照需要更高細節、低雜訊以支援裁切、放大與影像分析。定義解析度層級：**12MP**、**24MP**、**48MP**。自 iPhone 14 Pro／14 Pro Max 起採用 **48MP Quad sensor**，可單張全解析度拍攝或以 2x2 同色像素群組吸收更多光；24MP 自 iPhone 15 起由 **Photonic Engine** 將多幀融合的 12MP HDR 與全解析度 48MP 結合，畫質加倍而檔案僅約增 50%，並已延伸到 iPhone 16 Pro 望遠與 iPhone 17 超廣角鏡頭。

deepdive.title: Types of captures
deepdive.body: 列出 app 可請求的四種拍攝型別：最常見的 **fully processed photo**（多幀融合、經 Photonic Engine 擴展動態範圍與細節）、**exposure brackets**（同場景多張不同曝光，用於 HDR 或挑選曝光）、**Bayer RAW**（感光元件最小處理的原始資料，適合後製）、以及 **ProRAW**（結合 RAW 彈性與 iPhone 影像處理，編輯曝光、色彩、細節更有彈性）。

deepdive.title: Configure a capture session
deepdive.body: 進入設定環節的概觀：講者先建立 **AVCaptureSession**，再依序設定 session、AVCapturePhotoOutput 與每次拍攝的 AVCapturePhotoSettings，作為後續各小節的鋪陳。

deepdive.title: Configure the AVCaptureSession
deepdive.body: 建立 `AVCaptureSession` 並呼叫 `beginConfiguration()`，將 `sessionPreset` 設為 **`.photo`**。特別提醒：只有 photo preset 支援 24 與 48MP 照片，其他 preset 並不支援，因此高解析度拍攝必須採用此 preset。

deepdive.title: Configure AVCapturePhotoOutput
deepdive.body: 在 **AVCapturePhotoOutput** 上選擇適合 app 的 prioritization：speed 最快、處理最少，balanced 速度與畫質折衷，quality 最久但畫質最佳。示範把 `maxPhotoQualityPrioritization` 設為 `.quality`，這會讓 session 為 speed、balanced、quality 三級都預備資源，且部分高解析度的可用性取決於此設定。

deepdive.title: Add maxPhotoDimensions to AVCapturePhotoOutput
deepdive.body: 選擇此 session 會請求的最大尺寸：自 iOS 16 起可透過裝置 `activeFormat.supportedMaxPhotoDimensions` 查詢目前格式支援的所有尺寸，範例以面積（width×height）挑出最大者設給 `photoOutput.maxPhotoDimensions`。務必在 `commitConfiguration()` 前完成所有 photo output 設定，commit 後再改會觸發冗長的管線重設。

deepdive.title: Update AVCapturePhotoSettings
deepdive.body: 準備拍攝時，在 **AVCapturePhotoSettings** 上設定 `maxPhotoDimensions` 與 `photoQualityPrioritization`，再設定 delegate 並呼叫 `capturePhoto(with:delegate:)`。強調設定 `maxPhotoDimensions` 是「請求」而非保證——系統會依光線、場景與可用處理能力挑最佳路徑，實際尺寸回傳於 delegate 的 **AVCaptureResolvedSettings**，且每次拍攝都能客製畫質與尺寸而無須重設管線。

deepdive.title: Prepare resources for the capture
deepdive.body: 高解析度拍攝需依 `photoQualityPrioritization` 與 `maxPhotoDimensions` 做特定資源配置；若系統未預配，會在拍攝當下才配置而拖慢速度。解法是儘早用 **`setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray`** 告知未來打算如何拍攝（例如 48MP 模式啟用時就呼叫）。關鍵：prepare 用的 settings 物件不能重用，拍攝時須另建一個設定相符的新 settings 物件，才能對齊預配的資源。

deepdive.title: Responsive capture best practices
deepdive.body: 高解析度拍攝需處理大量像素、可能耗時數秒，因此介紹保持流暢的最佳實務。照片會先經 capture 階段再進 processing 階段，**AVCapturePhotoCaptureDelegate** 全程以 `didCapturePhotoFor` 與 `didFinishCaptureFor` 等回呼通報。可用 `photoProcessingTimeRange` 預估交付時間；開啟 **responsive capture** 讓拍攝重疊（觀察 `captureReadiness`）、**deferred photo processing** 先交付 proxy（`didFinishCapturingDeferredPhotoProxy`）再於背景完成（這也是 18／24MP 多幀融合得以實現的關鍵），以及 **fast capture prioritization** 在連拍時自動由 quality 轉 balanced，全面縮短 shot-to-shot delay。

summary_en: Presented by Mohit Setia from the Camera Software team, this session covers implementing high-resolution photo capture in your app with **AVFoundation**, centered on managing the tradeoff between processing time and final image quality. The preview stream only gives a screen-resolution image, but photography needs more detail and lower noise to support cropping, zooming into details, and image analysis. He defines the tiers of high-resolution photos: the typical **12MP**, the more advanced **24MP**, and **48MP**. The 48MP Quad sensor (since iPhone 14 Pro) captures full resolution in a single frame, while 24MP (since iPhone 15) uses the **Photonic Engine** to combine a multi-frame-fused 12MP HDR image with a full-sensor 48MP image — doubling resolution for only about a 50% increase in file size.

There are four capture types you can request: the most common **fully processed** photo (multi-frame fused, through the Photonic Engine), **exposure brackets** (multiple exposures of the same scene), **Bayer RAW** (minimally processed sensor data), and Apple's **ProRAW** (combining RAW flexibility with iPhone image processing).

For configuration: create an **AVCaptureSession** with the `.photo` preset (only this preset supports 24/48MP); set `maxPhotoQualityPrioritization` on **AVCapturePhotoOutput** so the system prepares resources for all three levels (speed, balanced, quality); query `activeFormat.supportedMaxPhotoDimensions` to pick the largest size and set `maxPhotoDimensions`, completing this before commit to avoid a lengthy pipeline reconfiguration. At capture time, set `maxPhotoDimensions` and `photoQualityPrioritization` on **AVCapturePhotoSettings** — a request, not a guarantee, with the actual dimensions returned in the delegate's **AVCaptureResolvedSettings**. Use `setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray` to preallocate resources ahead of time (the prepare and capture settings objects must differ but match in configuration).

Finally, optimizing for responsiveness. The quality/balanced/speed prioritizations trade processing time against fidelity; 48MP (single frame) is available with balanced or quality, while 18/24MP (multi-frame fused) require quality. Enabling **responsive capture** allows overlapping captures (observe `captureReadiness`), **deferred photo processing** delivers a proxy immediately and finishes in the background (`didFinishCapturingDeferredPhotoProxy`), and **fast capture prioritization** automatically drops from quality to balanced during rapid bursts — all of which dramatically reduce shot-to-shot delay. The takeaway: decide the resolution you want, pick the right prioritization, and for highest-quality captures turn on deferred and responsive capture so each photo doesn't block the next and people don't miss moments they can't get back.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Mohit Setia, an engineer on the Camera Software team, opens by noting that camera hardware and computational photography make high-resolution captures possible, but taking advantage of that quality means managing the tradeoff between **processing time and final image quality**. The roadmap: first the types of high-resolution photos, then how to configure and capture them, and finally how to keep the app responsive throughout the process.

deepdive_en.title: High-resolution photos
deepdive_en.body: Explains that the preview stream gives only a screen-resolution image, whereas photography needs higher detail and low noise for cropping, zooming, and image analysis. Defines the tiers — **12MP**, **24MP**, **48MP**. Since iPhone 14 Pro / 14 Pro Max, the **48MP Quad sensor** can capture full resolution in a single frame or group pixels in 2x2 clusters to gather more light; 24MP (since iPhone 15) uses the **Photonic Engine** to combine a multi-frame-fused 12MP HDR image with a full-resolution 48MP image, doubling resolution for only ~50% more file size, and has been extended to the iPhone 16 Pro telephoto and iPhone 17 ultra-wide cameras.

deepdive_en.title: Types of captures
deepdive_en.body: Lists the four capture types an app can request: the most common **fully processed photo** (multi-frame fused, through the Photonic Engine to extend dynamic range and detail), **exposure brackets** (multiple exposures of the same scene, for HDR or selecting an exposure), **Bayer RAW** (minimally processed sensor data, ideal for post-processing), and **ProRAW** (combining RAW flexibility with iPhone image processing for more latitude editing exposure, color, and detail).

deepdive_en.title: Configure a capture session
deepdive_en.body: An overview of the configuration section: the presenter first creates an **AVCaptureSession**, then configures the session, the AVCapturePhotoOutput, and the per-capture AVCapturePhotoSettings, setting up the subsequent subsections.

deepdive_en.title: Configure the AVCaptureSession
deepdive_en.body: Creates an `AVCaptureSession`, calls `beginConfiguration()`, and sets `sessionPreset` to **`.photo`**. The key note: only the photo preset supports 24 and 48MP photos; other presets do not, so high-resolution capture must use this preset.

deepdive_en.title: Configure AVCapturePhotoOutput
deepdive_en.body: On **AVCapturePhotoOutput**, choose the right prioritization for your app: speed is fastest with least processing, balanced gives medium speed and good quality, quality takes longest but delivers the best. The demo sets `maxPhotoQualityPrioritization` to `.quality`, which tells the session to prepare resources for all three levels (speed, balanced, quality); the availability of some high resolutions depends on this setting.

deepdive_en.title: Add maxPhotoDimensions to AVCapturePhotoOutput
deepdive_en.body: Selects the largest dimensions the session will request: since iOS 16 you can query the device's `activeFormat.supportedMaxPhotoDimensions` for all sizes supported on the current format, and the example picks the largest by area (width×height) and sets it on `photoOutput.maxPhotoDimensions`. Complete all photo output configuration before `commitConfiguration()` — changing these after commit triggers a lengthy pipeline reconfiguration.

deepdive_en.title: Update AVCapturePhotoSettings
deepdive_en.body: When ready to capture, set `maxPhotoDimensions` and `photoQualityPrioritization` on **AVCapturePhotoSettings**, set up the delegate, and call `capturePhoto(with:delegate:)`. Emphasizes that setting `maxPhotoDimensions` is a request, not a guarantee — the system looks at light level, scene, and available processing to pick the best path, with the actual dimensions returned in the delegate's **AVCaptureResolvedSettings** — and that quality and dimensions can be customized per capture with no lengthy reconfiguration between captures.

deepdive_en.title: Prepare resources for the capture
deepdive_en.body: High-resolution captures need specific resource allocations based on `photoQualityPrioritization` and `maxPhotoDimensions`; if the system hasn't preallocated them, allocation happens at capture time and slows things down. The fix is to call **`setPreparedPhotoSettingsArray`** as early as possible to signal how you plan to capture (e.g., as soon as 48MP mode activates). Key point: you cannot reuse the prepare settings object for the actual capture — create a new settings object whose configuration matches so the capture aligns with the preallocated resources.

deepdive_en.title: Responsive capture best practices
deepdive_en.body: Because high-resolution captures process many pixels and can take several seconds, this section covers keeping the app responsive. A photo goes through a capture stage then a processing stage, with the **AVCapturePhotoCaptureDelegate** notified throughout via callbacks like `didCapturePhotoFor` and `didFinishCaptureFor`. Use `photoProcessingTimeRange` to estimate delivery; enable **responsive capture** for overlapping captures (observe `captureReadiness`), **deferred photo processing** to deliver a proxy immediately (`didFinishCapturingDeferredPhotoProxy`) and finish in the background (what makes 18/24MP multi-frame fusion feasible), and **fast capture prioritization** to automatically shift from quality to balanced during rapid bursts — all reducing shot-to-shot delay.

title: Enhance RAW image processing with Core Image
gloss: 用 Core Image 強化 RAW 影像處理
takeaway: Core Image RAW 第 9 版大幅提升畫質與效能，並讓 CIImageProcessor 支援自訂輸出 tile 大小與暫存 PixelBuffer，打造更佳的互動式編輯。
chapters: Enable and edit RAW 9 with CIRAWFilter API
CIImageProcessor with explicit output tile sizes

points.text: Core Image **RAW 第 9 版**大幅改善影像**畫質**，並回顧 RAW 支援的演進。
以 **CIRAWFilter API** 啟用並編輯 RAW 9，搭配說明其**效能**特性。
針對**互動式編輯**與匯出其他格式提供建議，例如以 `.cacheIntermediate: false` 與 memoryLimit 設定匯出用的 CIContext。
**CIImageProcessorKernel** 新增以明確 tile 大小套用處理（`apply(withTiledExtent:)`）的能力。
可向 Core Image 取得**暫存 PixelBuffer**（temporaryPixelBuffer）作為運算 scratch 緩衝。

audience: **開發相機、相片編輯或專業影像 App 的開發者**，需處理 RAW 與自訂影像管線的人。
gloss_en: Enhance RAW image processing with Core Image
takeaway_en: Core Image RAW version 9 dramatically improves image quality and performance, and lets CIImageProcessor support custom output tile sizes and temporary PixelBuffers for better interactive editing.

points_en.text: Core Image **RAW version 9** dramatically improves image **quality**, with a look back at the evolution of RAW support.
Enable and edit RAW 9 with the **CIRAWFilter API**, along with an explanation of its **performance** characteristics.
Offers recommendations for **interactive editing** and exporting to other formats, such as configuring an export CIContext with `.cacheIntermediate: false` and a memoryLimit.
**CIImageProcessorKernel** adds the ability to apply processing with an explicit tile size (`apply(withTiledExtent:)`).
You can request a **temporary PixelBuffer** (temporaryPixelBuffer) from Core Image to use as a scratch buffer for computation.

audience_en: **Developers building camera, photo editing, or professional imaging apps** who need to handle RAW and custom image pipelines.
summary: 由 Core Image 工程師 David Hayward 主講，介紹 Core Image 對相機 **RAW** 影像檔支援的重大更新。講者先回顧 Apple 平台處理 RAW 的完整管線：解析中繼資料與解包感測器值（此時每個像素僅有 R、G 或 B 的馬賽克）、**demosaic** 補齊三色、**denoise** 去除光子／讀取／熱噪、套用 convolution 銳化與局部對比，最後調整白平衡、曝光、色彩與色調。這些演算法內建於 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS，凡使用 Image IO API 的 app 都能自動獲得 RAW 支援；而用 **CIRAWFilter** API 的 app（如 Photos、Pixelmator Pro）更能提供進階編輯控制。

本次最大亮點是 **RAW 9**——史上最大幅度的更新。它建構在一個 tiled 的 **Core ML** 模型上，把 demosaic 與 denoise 合併以求最佳品質，並在 **Apple Neural Engine** 上執行以兼顧效能。講者以三組對比展示：低噪的 Sony Alpha 7 II 影像在 RAW 9 下更銳利、文字更清楚；高噪 ISO 51,200 的 Canon 5D Mark III 蠟筆照在 RAW 9 下顏色準確、連高光都還原；非傳統感測器 pattern 的 Fujifilm X-T5 影像在 RAW 9 下細節與紋理皆明顯更好。RAW 的核心價值在於——多年前拍的舊照都能用最新演算法重新處理。

啟用 RAW 9 只需幾行：用 CIRAWFilter 載入檔案後，檢查 **supportedDecoderVersions** 是否含 `version9`，再把 **decoderVersion** 設為 `version9`（預設不啟用）；可用新的類別方法 **supportedCameraModels** 查詢支援機型，清單會透過 OTA 更新持續成長，原生拍 DNG 的相機（如 iPhone）自動支援。編輯上有 20 個校準屬性，最重要的是 exposure、luminanceNoiseReductionAmount、sharpnessAmount 與 contrastAmount；而 colorNoiseReductionAmount 在 RAW 9 已無作用（Core ML 自動處理色噪），detailAmount 與 moireReductionAmount 也不再支援，可用 isSupported 系列屬性檢查。

由於 RAW 9 每張影像會跑 Core ML 模型數百次，較耗資源，但因 Core Image 會 cache 中間結果，調整屬性後的後續 render 仍快速。講者依兩大情境給出效能建議：**互動式編輯**（同一張在螢幕解析度反覆 render）應善用 `scaleFactor`、每個 view 用一個 `CIContext` 並開啟 `cacheIntermediates`、加上 Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement、直接 render 到 Metal-backed view；**匯出**（多張各以全解析度 render 一次）則應把 `cacheIntermediates` 設為 false、調高 `memoryLimit`（iOS 預設 256MB，設 512 或 1024MB 更快）、並用 context 的 `heifRepresentation`／`jpegRepresentation`。最後介紹為 RAW 9 而擴充的 **CIImageProcessor** 新功能：可明確指定 output tile sizes（自行建立 512×512 等 tile 陣列傳給 `apply`），以及由 Core Image 代管生命週期的 temporary buffers（用 `temporaryPixelBuffer(identifier:)` 取得暫存區，避免重複建立／銷毀的開銷）。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: David Hayward 開場，預告四大主題：Core Image 如何支援 RAW、iOS／iPadOS／macOS／visionOS 27 即將帶來的 RAW 品質大幅提升、render RAW 的最佳效能做法，以及為 RAW 而新增的 **CIImageProcessor** 功能。

deepdive.title: How Core Image supports RAW
deepdive.body: 回顧 RAW 處理管線：先解析中繼資料並解包感測器值（此時每像素僅有 R、G 或 B 的馬賽克 pattern），接著 **demosaic** 讓每像素都有 RGB、**denoise** 去除 photon／read／thermal noise，再用 convolution 銳化邊緣與加局部對比，最後調整白平衡、曝光、色彩與色調成為討喜的成品。

deepdive.title: The evolution of RAW support
deepdive.body: 說明這些演算法內建於各 Apple 平台，因此 Finder、Preview、Freeform 等系統 app 都能檢視 RAW；凡用 **Image IO** API 的 app 或框架皆自動獲得支援，而用 **CIRAWFilter** 的 app（如 Photos、Pixelmator Pro、Nitro、Acorn）可提供進階編輯。RAW 支援自 2006 年的 21 款機型成長到 784 款，且涵蓋 iPhone 的 Apple ProRAW。

deepdive.title: RAW 9 overview
deepdive.body: 介紹 RAW 是 Apple 第 8 次更新後迄今最大的躍進——**RAW 9**。它建構在 tiled 的 **Core ML** 模型上，將 demosaic 與 denoise 結合以求最佳品質，並在 **Apple Neural Engine** 核心上執行以取得最佳效能。RAW 的關鍵價值在於舊照可用最新演算法重新處理。

deepdive.title: RAW 9 quality improvements
deepdive.body: 以三組放大對比展示品質提升：低噪的 Sony Alpha 7 II 影像在 RAW 9 下更銳利、細小文字更易讀；高噪 ISO 51,200 的 Canon 5D Mark III 蠟筆照在 RAW 8 僅勉強還原顏色，RAW 9 則色彩準確、連蠟筆上的高光都可見；非傳統感測器 pattern 的 Fujifilm X-T5（ISO 12,800）在 RAW 9 下文字更清楚、紗線紋理更分明。

deepdive.title: Enable and edit RAW 9 with CIRAWFilter API
deepdive.body: 示範啟用步驟：用 **CIRAWFilter** 載入 RAW 檔，檢查 **supportedDecoderVersions** 是否含 `version9`（預設不啟用），符合則把 **decoderVersion** 設為 `version9`。新類別方法 **supportedCameraModels** 可查詢某版本支援的機型；清單透過 OTA 更新成長，原生拍 DNG 的相機（如 iPhone）自動支援。並說明 20 個可調校準屬性中最重要的 exposure、luminanceNoiseReductionAmount、sharpnessAmount、contrastAmount，以及在 RAW 9 已失效或不再支援的 colorNoiseReductionAmount、detailAmount、moireReductionAmount（可用 isSupported 屬性檢查）。

deepdive.title: RAW 9 performance overview
deepdive.body: 說明 RAW 9 因每張影像跑 Core ML 模型數百次而更耗效能與資源，但因 Core Image 會 cache 中間結果，使用者在編輯 CIRAWFilter 屬性後的後續 render 仍快速且靈敏。接著針對兩大常見情境給出最佳實務。

deepdive.title: Interactive editing
deepdive.body: 互動式編輯（同一張 RAW 在螢幕解析度反覆 render，例如調整 exposure 或 sharpness）的建議：用 **scaleFactor** 以縮小尺寸顯示、減少超過螢幕像素的渲染量；每個 view 用一個 **CIContext** 並把 **cacheIntermediates** 設為 true 以略過密集的 Core ML 工作；加上 **Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement** 讓 Core Image 用更多記憶體做 cache；並直接 render 到 **Metal-backed view** 以便在前一幀完成前就開始下一幀。

deepdive.title: Exporting to other formats
deepdive.body: 匯出情境（多張 RAW 各以全解析度 render 一次成 HEIF／JPEG）的建議：用 **cacheIntermediates 設為 false** 的 CIContext；調高 context 的 **memoryLimit**（iOS 預設保守的 256MB，設 512 或 1024MB 可顯著加速）；並用 context 的 **heifRepresentation** 或 **jpegRepresentation** 方法取代直接呼叫 Image IO 以省記憶體。

deepdive.title: Contact for exports
deepdive.body: 延續匯出最佳實務，補充以 context 方法產生 HEIF／JPEG 表示形式可比直接走 Image IO 取得額外的記憶體節省，是匯出大量 RAW 時的關鍵手法。

deepdive.title: New CIImageProcessor features
deepdive.body: 介紹 RAW 9 之所以使用 **CIImageProcessor** API，是因為它能讓 Core ML 與其他 CIKernel 協同運作。為此 Core Image 團隊替 CIImageProcessor 新增兩項功能：明確的 output tile sizes 與 temporary buffers，開發者也可在自己的 app 中採用。

deepdive.title: CIImageProcessor with explicit output tile sizes
deepdive.body: 說明典型 CIImageProcessor 會實作 region of interest callback 與在 process callback 中處理 input.region／output.region；記憶體充足時 Core Image 會一次處理整張、受限時則切小。新功能讓 processor 可明確控制 output tile 大小：自行建立陣列填入要覆蓋影像的所有 tile（範例以 512×512 切分），再呼叫 **apply** 並傳入該 tile 陣列。

deepdive.title: CIImageProcessor using temporary PixelBuffer
deepdive.body: 說明呼叫 Core ML 的 processor 常需 temporary buffer，因為 Core Image 用 interleaved 緩衝、Core ML 需 planar 資料；逐 tile 反覆建立／銷毀會傷效能。**CIImageProcessorOutput** 新增方法可用 **temporaryPixelBuffer(identifier:)** 取得暫存 CVPixelBuffer（多個暫存區時 identifier 很重要），由 Core Image 代管其生命週期、自動釋放並在下一個 tile 回收。

summary_en: Presented by Core Image engineer David Hayward, this session covers a major update to Core Image's support for camera **RAW** files. He first reviews the full RAW pipeline on Apple platforms: parse metadata and unpack sensor values (where each pixel holds only an R, G, or B value in a mosaic), **demosaic** to give every pixel full RGB, **denoise** to remove photon/read/thermal noise, apply convolutions for sharpening and local contrast, and finally adjust white balance, exposure, color, and tone. These algorithms are built into iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, so any app using the Image IO API gets RAW support automatically, while apps using the **CIRAWFilter** API (like Photos and Pixelmator Pro) can offer advanced editing controls.

The headline is **RAW 9**, the biggest update yet. It is built atop a tiled **Core ML** model that combines demosaic with denoise for best quality and runs on the **Apple Neural Engine** for performance. He shows three before/after crops: a low-noise Sony Alpha 7 II image looks sharper with more legible text under RAW 9; a high-noise ISO 51,200 Canon 5D Mark III crayon shot recovers accurate colors and even specular highlights; and a Fujifilm X-T5 image with a non-traditional sensor pattern shows clearly better detail and texture. The core value of RAW is that a photo shot years ago can be reprocessed with the latest algorithms.

Enabling RAW 9 takes only a few lines: load the file with CIRAWFilter, check that **supportedDecoderVersions** contains `version9`, then set **decoderVersion** to `version9` (it is not on by default). The new class method **supportedCameraModels** lists supported models, the list grows via OTA updates, and cameras that shoot DNG natively (like iPhones) are supported automatically. There are 20 calibrated editing properties; the most important are exposure, luminanceNoiseReductionAmount, sharpnessAmount, and contrastAmount. Note that colorNoiseReductionAmount now has no effect (the Core ML model handles color noise automatically), and detailAmount and moireReductionAmount are no longer supported, check with the isSupported properties.

Because RAW 9 runs the Core ML model hundreds of times per image, it is more resource-intensive, but since Core Image caches intermediate results, subsequent renders after a property change stay fast. He gives guidance for two cases. For **interactive editing** (one image rendered repeatedly at screen resolution): use the `scaleFactor` property, use one `CIContext` per view with `cacheIntermediates` set to true, add the Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement, and render directly to a Metal-backed view. For **exporting** (many files each rendered once at full resolution): use a `CIContext` with `cacheIntermediates` set to false, raise the `memoryLimit` (the iOS default of 256MB can go to 512 or 1024MB), and use the context's `heifRepresentation`/`jpegRepresentation` methods. Finally he covers two **CIImageProcessor** additions made for RAW 9: explicit output tile sizes (build your own tile array, e.g. 512×512, and pass it to `apply`) and temporary buffers whose lifecycle Core Image manages (request one with `temporaryPixelBuffer(identifier:)` to avoid repeated create/destroy overhead).

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: David Hayward opens by previewing four topics: how Core Image supports RAW, the RAW quality improvements coming in iOS/iPadOS/macOS/visionOS 27, how to get optimal performance when rendering RAW, and the **CIImageProcessor** features added for RAW.

deepdive_en.title: How Core Image supports RAW
deepdive_en.body: Reviews the RAW pipeline: parse metadata and unpack sensor values (each pixel only an R, G, or B mosaic value), **demosaic** so every pixel has RGB, **denoise** to remove photon/read/thermal noise, apply convolutions to sharpen edges and add local contrast, and finally adjust white balance, exposure, color, and tone for a pleasing result.

deepdive_en.title: The evolution of RAW support
deepdive_en.body: Explains these algorithms are built into every Apple platform, so system apps like Finder, Preview, and Freeform can view RAW; any app using **Image IO** gets support automatically, while apps using **CIRAWFilter** (Photos, Pixelmator Pro, Nitro, Acorn) offer advanced editing. Support has grown from 21 models in 2006 to 784 models, including iPhone's Apple ProRAW.

deepdive_en.title: RAW 9 overview
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **RAW 9** as the biggest leap after Apple's eighth update. It is built atop a tiled **Core ML** model that combines demosaic with denoise for best quality, running on the **Apple Neural Engine** for optimal performance. The key value of RAW is that older photos can be reprocessed with the latest algorithms.

deepdive_en.title: RAW 9 quality improvements
deepdive_en.body: Shows three zoomed crops: a low-noise Sony Alpha 7 II image is sharper with more legible fine text under RAW 9; a high-noise ISO 51,200 Canon 5D Mark III crayon shot, only acceptably recovered by RAW 8, gets accurate colors and visible specular highlights under RAW 9; and a Fujifilm X-T5 (ISO 12,800) with a non-traditional sensor pattern shows clearer text and yarn texture under RAW 9.

deepdive_en.title: Enable and edit RAW 9 with CIRAWFilter API
deepdive_en.body: Demos enabling: load the RAW with **CIRAWFilter**, check that **supportedDecoderVersions** contains `version9` (not on by default), then set **decoderVersion** to `version9`. The new class method **supportedCameraModels** lists supported models; the list grows via OTA updates and DNG-native cameras (like iPhones) are supported automatically. Covers the most important of the 20 calibrated properties (exposure, luminanceNoiseReductionAmount, sharpnessAmount, contrastAmount) and those deprecated in RAW 9 (colorNoiseReductionAmount, detailAmount, moireReductionAmount), checkable via the isSupported properties.

deepdive_en.title: RAW 9 performance overview
deepdive_en.body: Notes RAW 9 is more performance- and resource-intensive because it runs the Core ML model hundreds of times per image, but since Core Image caches intermediate results, subsequent renders after editing CIRAWFilter properties stay fast and responsive. Sets up best practices for two common cases.

deepdive_en.title: Interactive editing
deepdive_en.body: For interactive editing (one RAW rendered repeatedly at screen resolution while adjusting properties like exposure or sharpness): use the **scaleFactor** property when displaying smaller to cut work for over-resolution images; use one **CIContext** per view with **cacheIntermediates** true to skip the intensive Core ML work; add the **Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement** for more cache memory; and render directly to a **Metal-backed view** so the next frame can start before the previous one finishes.

deepdive_en.title: Exporting to other formats
deepdive_en.body: For exporting (many RAWs each rendered once at full resolution to HEIF/JPEG): use a CIContext with **cacheIntermediates set to false**; raise the context's **memoryLimit** (the conservative iOS default of 256MB can go to 512 or 1024MB for a significant speedup); and use the context's **heifRepresentation** or **jpegRepresentation** methods instead of calling Image IO directly to save memory.

deepdive_en.title: Contact for exports
deepdive_en.body: Continues the export best practices, noting that generating HEIF/JPEG representations via the context methods yields extra memory savings over going through Image IO directly, a key technique when exporting many RAW files.

deepdive_en.title: New CIImageProcessor features
deepdive_en.body: Explains that RAW 9 uses the **CIImageProcessor** API because it lets Core ML work in conjunction with other CIKernels. As a result the Core Image team added two features you may want in your own app: explicit output tile sizes and temporary buffers.

deepdive_en.title: CIImageProcessor with explicit output tile sizes
deepdive_en.body: Describes a typical CIImageProcessor implementing the region-of-interest callback and handling input.region/output.region in process; with plenty of memory Core Image processes the whole image, with limited memory it tiles smaller. The new feature lets a processor explicitly control output tile sizes: build an array of tiles covering the image (the example uses 512×512), then call **apply** passing that tile array.

deepdive_en.title: CIImageProcessor using temporary PixelBuffer
deepdive_en.body: Explains that Core ML processors often need temporary buffers because Core Image uses interleaved buffers that must be converted to planar data for Core ML; repeatedly creating and destroying them per tile hurts performance. **CIImageProcessorOutput** now offers **temporaryPixelBuffer(identifier:)** to request a scratch CVPixelBuffer (the identifier matters when using more than one), with Core Image managing its lifecycle, releasing it automatically and recycling it for the next tile.

title: Explore Retention Messaging in App Store Connect
gloss: 探索 App Store Connect 的挽留訊息
takeaway: 用 Retention Messaging 在訂閱者取消前即時提供訊息、替代方案或促銷優惠，提高續訂率。
chapters: Retention Messaging in App Store Connect

points.text: **Retention Messaging** 讓你在訂閱者按下取消前主動觸及他們，是降低流失的新工具。
可在 **App Store Connect** 直接設定挽留訊息，無需改動 App 即可上線基本情境。
**即時（Real-time）** 模式會在取消當下向你的伺服器發出請求，由你動態決定回應內容。
回應可選擇純**訊息（message）**、**替代產品（alternateProduct）**，或帶簽章的**促銷優惠（promotionalOffer）**。
透過 **Retention Messaging API** 設定 URL、訊息與圖片，並可在 Sandbox 進行效能測試。

audience: 經營**自動續訂訂閱、想在取消前挽留訂閱者**的 App Store 開發者與營運團隊。
gloss_en: Explore Retention Messaging in App Store Connect
takeaway_en: Use Retention Messaging to deliver a timely message, an alternate product, or a promotional offer to subscribers before they cancel, improving renewal rates.

points_en.text: **Retention Messaging** lets you proactively reach subscribers before they tap cancel, a new tool for reducing churn.
Configure retention messages directly in **App Store Connect**, with no app changes needed to launch the basic scenarios.
**Real-time** mode sends a request to your server at the moment of cancellation, letting you decide the response dynamically.
The response can be a plain **message**, an **alternateProduct**, or a signed **promotionalOffer**.
Set the URL, message, and image via the **Retention Messaging API**, and run performance testing in Sandbox.

audience_en: App Store developers and operations teams running **auto-renewable subscriptions who want to retain subscribers before they cancel**.
summary: 由 App Store server 團隊工程師 Tori 主講，介紹 **Retention Messaging**——一個在訂閱者考慮取消、抵達 manage subscriptions 取消確認頁時，向他們展示有說服力的價值訊息或優惠，以挽留訂閱的全新功能。它支援三種版面：純訊息、訊息加圖片、訊息加 offer；當顧客符合 offer 資格時，圖片會被 offer 取代。Apple 觀察到採用後平均 **save rate 提升 +1.4 分（約 82%）**，其中 promotional offer 訊息表現最佳達 +5.5 分（約 223%），但結果因開發者而異。

第一條路是 **Retention Messaging in App Store Connect**：在 Subscriptions 頁點 Get Started 建立 retention message，左側編輯訊息文字、圖片（取自 **Asset Library**）、適用訂閱與 offer，右側即時預覽。訊息文字為必填、圖片與 offer 選填，並可選多種 localization；一則訊息可關聯多個訂閱，也可選多個 offer，App Store 會自動為符合資格的顧客挑選最佳 offer。這些都可透過 **App Store Connect API** 設定，並可在 sandbox 完整測試取消流程。新增的 **retention offer**（offerType 值為 5）會出現在 signed transaction 與 renewal info 中，連同 offer identifier、discount type、period 等欄位。

若想在顧客將取消當下更直接互動，第二條路是 **real-time Retention Messaging**：你架設一個端點，回應 App Store 發來的 server-to-server HTTP 請求，即時決定要顯示哪則訊息。請求會帶 `originalTransactionId`、顧客 locale、`requestIdentifier` 等；回應可採三種格式——回 `messageIdentifier`（訊息或訊息加圖片）、回 `messageIdentifier` ＋ `productId` 的 **alternateProduct**（同訂閱群組內換方案，real-time 獨有的 switch plan 版面）、或回 `messageIdentifier` ＋ `promotionalOfferSignature` 的 promotional offer。它由 **Retention Messaging API** 驅動（管理 URL、訊息、預設訊息與圖片），上線前須通過 sandbox 的 performance test，且 iOS 26.5 的「12 個月承諾月訂閱」也可用 `billingPlanType` 作 switch plan。

兩者的關鍵差異是**決策權**：App Store Connect 版設定後由 App Store 自動決定顯示什麼，real-time 版則由你即時為每位顧客選擇。設定管道（ASC／ASC API vs Retention Messaging API server-to-server）、offer 類型（retention offer vs promotional offer）與版面（前者三種、後者多 switch plan）也不同。實務上 real-time 建立於 ASC 版之上：當你的伺服器逾時或回應錯誤，App Store 會 fallback 到 ASC 偏好（含合格 offer），再不行才用 API 預設訊息——因此即使用 real-time 也應同時設好 ASC Retention Messaging 作後援。real-time 需填寫 interest form 申請存取。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 App Store server 團隊的 Tori 開場。販售自動續訂訂閱很有回報，但在顧客考慮取消的關鍵時刻接觸他們具挑戰性，而那正是提醒價值的理想時機。本場介紹 **Retention Messaging**：先概覽功能與在 App Store Connect 的設定，再說明 real-time Retention Messaging 如何與之搭配。

deepdive.title: Retention Messaging in App Store Connect
deepdive.body: 以 Exercise app 示範取消流程：取消頁會顯示取消的影響（如家庭將失去存取），這正是提供訊息或 offer 的機會。**Retention Messaging** 在取消流程加入有說服力的價值主張，支援三種版面：純訊息、訊息＋圖片、訊息＋offer（例如 Yoga+ 三個月免費）。並引用數據：平均 save rate +1.4 分（約 82%），promotional offer 訊息最高達 +5.5 分（約 223%），結果因開發者而異。

deepdive.title: Signed transaction updates
deepdive.body: 說明在 ASC 設定 Retention Messaging：可建立 retention message 映射到任何訂閱、從 **Asset Library** 選圖、設定 retention offer，且 **App Store Connect API** 亦支援。可在 **sandbox** 完整測試取消流程；若設了 retention offer，可驗證 signed transaction 或 renewal info 中的 offer 欄位。新增的 retention offer 以 **offerType 值 5** 標示，連同 offer identifier、discount type、period 等欄位一併出現。

deepdive.title: Real-time Retention Messaging
deepdive.body: 示範在 ASC 建立 Yoga Message 的流程：點 Get Started、命名、在左側編輯文字（可多語系，如標題「Launching Next Month: Guided Yoga」與描述）、選 Asset Library 圖片、選 Yoga+ 訂閱（可多個）、加入符合資格的 retention offer（可多個，App Store 自動挑最佳），右側即時預覽。並說明顧客符合 offer 時圖片會被 offer 取代，可用下拉切換預覽不同或無 offer。

deepdive.title: Retention Messaging API
deepdive.body: 介紹 **real-time Retention Messaging**：你架設端點回應 App Store 的 server-to-server HTTP 請求，提供即時訊息偏好；可回傳自設的 message／image 配對，或指向 ASC 中設定的訊息。相較 ASC 版，real-time 還支援 **switch plan** 版面，可在同訂閱群組內提供不同方案（例示提供年訂閱）作為取消的替代。

deepdive.title: Real-time requests
deepdive.body: 說明驅動它的 **Retention Messaging API**——一組 server-to-server 端點，可設定 Exercise app 端點 URL、建立訊息、為各訂閱選預設訊息、上傳管理圖片。僅 **sandbox** 環境支援 performance test，提供啟動與查結果的端點；通過 performance test 是上 production 使用 real-time 的必要條件。App Store 發請求時會帶 `originalTransactionId`、顧客 locale、`requestIdentifier` 等資訊。

deepdive.title: Real-time requests with message
deepdive.body: 回應的第一種格式：以 **`messageIdentifier`** 回傳一則訊息或訊息加圖片。講者選了一個指向 yoga 訂閱訊息並搭配對應圖片的 messageIdentifier。

deepdive.title: Real-time request with alternate product
deepdive.body: 第二種格式 **alternateProduct**：提供 `messageIdentifier` ＋ `productId`，在同訂閱群組內提供 switch plan。講者選擇提供 Yoga+ 的年訂閱方案作為取消的替代。

deepdive.title: Real-time request with promotional offer
deepdive.body: 第三種格式 **promotional offer**：提供 `messageIdentifier` ＋ `promotionalOfferSignature` 給顧客 offer（例如 Yoga+ 三個月免費；promotional offer 仍需 signature）。並提醒 real-time 需快速回應的伺服器：逾時或回應錯誤時，App Store 會先 fallback 到 ASC 偏好（含合格 offer），再不行才用 API 預設訊息。也說明 sandbox 上線流程：設訊息與圖片、設端點、跑 performance test、通過後再設 production。

deepdive.title: Retention Messaging comparison
deepdive.body: 比較兩者。關鍵差異是**決策**：ASC 版設定後由 App Store 自動顯示，real-time 版由你即時為每位顧客選擇。設定管道、offer 類型（ASC 用 retention offer、real-time 用 promotional offer）、版面（real-time 多 switch plan）皆不同。ASC 版適合無伺服器或想讓 App Store 決定者，real-time 適合想掌控每位顧客訊息與 offer 者；real-time 建於 ASC 之上，應同時設 ASC 作後援，並需填 interest form 申請存取。

summary_en: Presented by Tori, an App Store server team engineer, this session introduces **Retention Messaging**—a new feature that shows a compelling value-proposition message or offer to subscribers when they reach the cancel confirmation page in manage subscriptions, helping you retain them. It supports three views: message only, message with an image, or message with an offer; when a customer is eligible for an offer, the image is replaced by the offer. Apple observed an average **save-rate increase of +1.4 points (≈82%)** after adoption, with promotional-offer messages highest at +5.5 points (≈223%), though results vary across developers.

The first path is **Retention Messaging in App Store Connect**: on the Subscriptions page, tap Get Started to create a retention message, edit the message text, image (from **Asset Library**), applicable subscriptions, and offers on the left, with a live preview on the right. Message text is required; image and offer are optional, and multiple localizations are supported; one message can map to many subscriptions, and you can select multiple offers—the App Store automatically picks the best one for eligible customers. All of this is configurable via the **App Store Connect API** and fully testable in sandbox during cancellation. A new **retention offer** (offerType value 5) appears in the signed transaction and renewal info alongside offer identifier, discount type, and period.

To interact more directly the moment a customer is about to cancel, the second path is **real-time Retention Messaging**: you stand up an endpoint that responds to a server-to-server HTTP request from the App Store, deciding in real time which message to show. The request includes the `originalTransactionId`, customer locale, and a `requestIdentifier`; you can respond in three formats—a `messageIdentifier` (message or message with image), an **alternateProduct** with `messageIdentifier` + `productId` (a switch plan within the same subscription group, a view unique to real-time), or a promotional offer with `messageIdentifier` + `promotionalOfferSignature`. It's powered by the **Retention Messaging API** (managing the URL, messages, default messages, and images), requires passing a sandbox performance test before going live, and iOS 26.5's monthly subscriptions with a 12-month commitment can be offered as a switch plan via `billingPlanType`.

The key difference is **decisioning**: the App Store Connect version decides what to show automatically once configured, while the real-time version lets you choose for each customer in real time. The configuration channels (ASC/ASC API vs server-to-server Retention Messaging API), offer types (retention offer vs promotional offer), and views (the former three, the latter adding switch plan) also differ. In practice real-time builds on top of the ASC version: if your server times out or responds malformed, the App Store falls back to your ASC preference (including eligible offers), then to API default messaging—so you should always set up ASC Retention Messaging as a fallback even when using real-time. Real-time requires filling out an interest form to request access.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Tori of the App Store server team opens. Selling auto-renewable subscriptions can be rewarding but reaching customers at the critical moment they consider canceling is challenging—and that's the ideal time to remind them of value. This session introduces **Retention Messaging**: first an overview and setup in App Store Connect, then how real-time Retention Messaging works alongside it.

deepdive_en.title: Retention Messaging in App Store Connect
deepdive_en.body: An Exercise app demos the cancellation flow: the cancel page shows the impact of canceling (e.g., the family loses access), which is the moment to provide a message or offer. **Retention Messaging** adds a compelling value proposition, supporting three views: message only, message + image, and message + offer (e.g., three months free of Yoga+). Cited data: average save rate +1.4 points (≈82%), promotional-offer messages highest at +5.5 points (≈223%), results varying by developer.

deepdive_en.title: Signed transaction updates
deepdive_en.body: Setup in ASC: create retention messages mapped to any subscription, pick images from **Asset Library**, configure retention offers, and the **App Store Connect API** supports it too. The cancellation flow is fully testable in **sandbox**; with a retention offer set, you can verify offer fields in the signed transaction or renewal info. The new retention offer is indicated by **offerType value 5**, alongside offer identifier, discount type, and period fields.

deepdive_en.title: Real-time Retention Messaging
deepdive_en.body: Demos creating a Yoga Message in ASC: tap Get Started, name it, edit text on the left (multiple localizations—e.g., title 'Launching Next Month: Guided Yoga' and a description), choose an Asset Library image, select the Yoga+ subscription (multiple allowed), add eligible retention offers (multiple, App Store picks the best), with a live preview. When a customer is eligible the image is replaced by the offer, and a dropdown previews different or no offers.

deepdive_en.title: Retention Messaging API
deepdive_en.body: Introduces **real-time Retention Messaging**: you set up an endpoint to provide a real-time message preference in response to the App Store's server-to-server HTTP request; you can return your own message/image pairs or point to a message configured in ASC. Compared to the ASC version, real-time also supports a **switch plan** view, offering a different plan in the same subscription group (an annual subscription in the example) as an alternative to canceling.

deepdive_en.title: Real-time requests
deepdive_en.body: The **Retention Messaging API** powers it—a server-to-server set of endpoints to configure the app's endpoint URL, set up messages, choose default messages per subscription, and upload/manage images. Only the **sandbox** environment supports performance testing, with endpoints to initiate and check results; passing a performance test is required before using real-time in production. The App Store's request includes the `originalTransactionId`, customer locale, and a `requestIdentifier`.

deepdive_en.title: Real-time requests with message
deepdive_en.body: The first response format: respond with a **`messageIdentifier`** to show a message or message with an image. The presenter chose a messageIdentifier indicating a yoga-subscription message paired with a corresponding image.

deepdive_en.title: Real-time request with alternate product
deepdive_en.body: The second format, **alternateProduct**: provide a `messageIdentifier` + `productId` to offer a switch plan in the same subscription group. The presenter chose to offer an annual tier of Yoga+ as the alternative to canceling.

deepdive_en.title: Real-time request with promotional offer
deepdive_en.body: The third format, **promotional offer**: provide a `messageIdentifier` + `promotionalOfferSignature` to give an offer (e.g., three months free of Yoga+; promotional offers still need a signature). Real-time requires a fast server: on timeout or malformed response, the App Store falls back first to the ASC preference (with eligible offers), then to API default messaging. The sandbox go-live flow: set messages and images, set the endpoint, run a performance test, then set up production once it passes.

deepdive_en.title: Retention Messaging comparison
deepdive_en.body: Compares the two. The key difference is **decisioning**: ASC shows automatically once configured, while real-time lets you choose per customer in real time. Configuration channels, offer types (ASC uses retention offers, real-time uses promotional offers), and views (real-time adds switch plan) all differ. ASC suits those without a server or who want the App Store to decide; real-time suits those wanting per-customer control of messages and offers. Real-time builds on top of ASC, so set up ASC as a fallback, and request access via the interest form.

title: What’s new in Shortcuts
gloss: 捷徑有什麼新東西
takeaway: Shortcuts 新增自動化與「Use Model」動作,讓你能用 App 的 AppEntity 內容串接 Apple Intelligence 模型,打造更強大的捷徑。

points.text: 用 App 的內容打造更強大的捷徑,**新的 automations** 解鎖更多整合 App 的方式。
新增 **Use Model** 動作,可在捷徑中直接呼叫模型處理 App 的資料。
示範以 **AppEntity(SoupEntity)** 暴露 App 內容,搭配 @Property 標註可被捷徑使用的屬性。
用 **TypeDisplayRepresentation 與 DisplayRepresentation** 定義 entity 在捷徑中的顯示(含 numericFormat)。
涵蓋 **Storage** 章節,說明捷徑如何存取與保存資料。

audience: **想讓 App 內容透過 Shortcuts 與 Apple Intelligence 模型串接、提供自動化能力的開發者。**
gloss_en: What's new in Shortcuts
takeaway_en: Shortcuts adds new automations and a "Use Model" action, letting you wire your app's AppEntity content into Apple Intelligence models to build more powerful shortcuts.

points_en.text: Build more powerful shortcuts with your app's content; **new automations** unlock additional ways to integrate your app.
Adds the **Use Model** action, letting you call a model directly within a shortcut to process your app's data.
Demonstrates exposing app content with an **AppEntity (SoupEntity)**, using @Property to annotate which properties are available to Shortcuts.
Use **TypeDisplayRepresentation and DisplayRepresentation** to define how an entity appears in Shortcuts (including numericFormat).
Covers the **Storage** chapter, explaining how shortcuts access and persist data.

audience_en: **Developers who want to wire their app's content into Apple Intelligence models through Shortcuts and provide automation capabilities.**
summary: 這場由 Shortcuts 團隊主講，主軸是讓你 app 的 actions 與內容更自然地融入 Shortcuts，並帶來三項重要更新。**Shortcuts** 能把你每天在 app 裡執行的動作組合起來，從 Siri、Control Center、Action Button 等系統各處快速執行；講者以一個叫 **Soup Chef** 的點湯 app 為貫穿範例，逐一示範新的 automation 設定方式、更強大的 **Use Model** action，以及全新的 **Storage** 功能。

第一塊是 **Automations**。自動化現在直接住進 Shortcuts editor，與 actions 並列、設定更簡單，只要在 editor 的「Automation」區即可瀏覽與加入。除了既有類型外，新增三種：**screenshot automation**（截圖存檔時觸發）、**keyboard automation**（外接鍵盤連接／中斷時觸發）、與 **notification automation**（收到特定 app 通知時觸發）。範例用 notification automation 在收到 Soup Chef「arriving」通知時自動開啟門廊燈並讓 HomePod 廣播，並強調遵循 Human Interface Guidelines 設計簡潔、具體、可操作的通知，使用者才能據以打造強大自動化。

第二塊是 **Use Model** action，現在可接上更強的 Apple Intelligence 模型、甚至能上網取得即時資訊，並能直接處理你 app 的內容。講者用 **EntityPropertyQuery** 搭配 App Intents 暴露的 Find Soups 與 Order Soup 串成「Soup of the Day」捷徑；當模型挑錯湯時，可用新的方式 **檢視 model transcript**——加上 Show Content action 並選取其輸出的 Transcript property，即可看到傳給模型的原始 **SoupEntity** 與屬性。診斷發現只有 name、availability 不足以判斷辣度，於是替 entity 補上 ingredients property，模型便挑出夠辣的 Tom Yum。

第三塊是 **Storage**，可在捷徑執行之間持久保存資料。editor 新增可建立、檢視、編輯儲存值的畫面，也能建立跨捷徑共享的 global value（例如 API key）；透過 getter／setter 等 action 在捷徑內讀寫資料。範例讓賽車冷知識捷徑記錄 Previous Facts 以避免重複，也讓 Soup of the Day 記住近期選擇而不再天天重複。實務重點：儲存值會 **跨裝置同步**，因此 App Entity 必須有跨裝置一致的 identity——講者改用線上資料庫的 row ID 作為穩定識別碼，確保 iPhone 存的湯在 iPad、Mac 上被辨識為同一個。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Shortcuts 團隊的 Duraid 開場，說明 **Shortcuts** 能組合你每天在 app 裡執行的動作，並從 **Siri**、**Control Center**、**Action Button** 等系統各處快速執行。講者預告本場三大主題：automations 的設定更新與新類型、更強大的 **Use Model** action 與其除錯方式、以及讓資料在捷徑執行間持久化的 **Storage**。

deepdive.title: Automations
deepdive.body: 自動化現在直接整合進 **Shortcuts editor**，與 actions 並列、設定比以往更簡單，只要造訪 editor 的「Automation」區即可瀏覽與加入。除了既有類型，新增三種：**screenshot automation**（截圖存檔時）、**keyboard automation**（外接鍵盤連接／中斷時）、與 **notification automation**（收到特定 app 通知時）。講者以一個離開公司就算路線並傳訊給夥伴 Helen 的捷徑開場，說明事件觸發的概念。

deepdive.title: Use Model
deepdive.body: 示範 notification automation 的實例：當 **Soup Chef** 送出含外送員姓名與抵達時間的通知時自動執行。為避免每則通知都觸發，講者加上對「**arriving**」一詞的 filter，只在湯快送到時才開門廊燈並讓 HomePod 廣播。重點是好的通知要簡潔、具體（動詞）且可操作（時間），並遵循 **Human Interface Guidelines**，使用者才容易在捷徑中解析運用。

deepdive.title: Soup Entity Example
deepdive.body: 進入 **Use Model** 主題：此 action 可接上更強且能上網的 **Apple Intelligence** 模型，並處理 app 內容。講者用 **EntityPropertyQuery** 暴露的 Find Soups（可篩出今日供應）與 Order Soup 串成「Soup of the Day」捷徑，由模型依辣度偏好挑湯，但首次卻挑了偏溫和的 chicken tortilla soup，引出除錯需求。

deepdive.title: Storage
deepdive.body: 示範新的除錯方式：可 **檢視 model transcript**，看到以原始格式傳給模型的全部內容。做法是在 Use Model 後加 **Show Content** action 並選取輸出的 **Transcript** property，即可展開每個傳入的 **SoupEntity** 與其屬性。診斷發現只有 name 與 availability 不足以判斷辣度，於是在 SoupEntity 加上 ingredients（每項成分與份量的字串陣列），模型便改挑出夠辣的 Tom Yum。

deepdive.title: Soup Entity Example
deepdive.body: 進入 **Storage**：可在捷徑執行間持久保存資料，editor 新增建立／檢視／編輯儲存值的畫面，也支援跨捷徑共享的 **global value**（如 API key），並以 getter／setter action 讀寫。範例讓賽車冷知識捷徑保存 Previous Facts 避免重複、讓 Soup of the Day 記住近期選擇。關鍵在於儲存值會 **跨裝置同步**，因此 App Entity 需有一致 identity——講者改以線上資料庫的 row ID 作為穩定識別碼，確保各裝置辨識為同一個 entity。

summary_en: Presented by the Shortcuts team, this session is about making your app's actions and content fit naturally into Shortcuts, and it ships three big updates. **Shortcuts** lets you combine actions you perform in your apps every day and run them quickly from across the system, like Siri, Control Center, and the Action Button. Using a soup-ordering app called **Soup Chef** as a running example, the speaker walks through the new way automations are set up, a more powerful **Use Model** action, and a brand-new **Storage** feature.

The first part is **Automations**. They now live directly in the Shortcuts editor alongside your actions and are easier than ever to set up via the editor's "Automation" section. Beyond the existing types, three new ones arrive: the **screenshot automation** (fires when a screenshot is saved), the **keyboard automation** (fires when an external keyboard is connected or disconnected), and the **notification automation** (fires when a notification arrives from a specific app). The example uses a notification automation to turn on porch lights and have a HomePod announce when a Soup Chef "arriving" notification is received, and stresses following the Human Interface Guidelines to design concise, specific, actionable notifications so users can build powerful automations on them.

The second part is the **Use Model** action, which now taps more capable Apple Intelligence models that can even go to the web for fresh information, and can work with your app's content. Using **EntityPropertyQuery** with App Intents, the speaker exposes Find Soups and Order Soup and strings them into a "Soup of the Day" shortcut; when the model picks the wrong soup you can now **inspect the model transcript** by adding a Show Content action and selecting its Transcript property, revealing the raw **SoupEntity** values and properties passed in. The diagnosis shows that name and availability alone can't judge spice level, so adding an ingredients property leads the model to pick a properly spicy Tom Yum.

The third part is **Storage**, which persists data between runs of a shortcut. The editor gains a view to create, inspect, and edit stored values, plus a **global value** shared across shortcuts (handy for an API key), with getter/setter actions to read and write from within a shortcut. The examples keep a racing-fact shortcut from repeating itself via Previous Facts, and give Soup of the Day a memory of recent picks. The practical caveat: stored values **sync across devices**, so an App Entity needs a consistent identity across devices—the speaker uses each soup's online-database row ID as a stable identifier so a soup stored on iPhone is recognized as the same entity on iPad or Mac.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Duraid from the Shortcuts team opens by explaining that **Shortcuts** combines actions you perform in your apps daily and runs them quickly from across the system—**Siri**, **Control Center**, the **Action Button**, and more. He previews the session's three themes: updates to how automations are set up plus new automation types, a more powerful **Use Model** action with a new way to debug it, and **Storage** for persisting data between runs.

deepdive_en.title: Automations
deepdive_en.body: Automations now live directly in the **Shortcuts editor** alongside actions and are easier to set up than ever—just visit the editor's "Automation" section to browse and add one. Three new types join the existing set: the **screenshot automation** (when a screenshot is saved), the **keyboard automation** (when an external keyboard connects or disconnects), and the **notification automation** (when a notification arrives from a specific app). He frames the event-driven idea with a shortcut that, on leaving work, computes the route home and texts his partner Helen.

deepdive_en.title: Use Model
deepdive_en.body: A concrete notification-automation example: when **Soup Chef** sends a notification with the driver's name and arrival time, a shortcut runs automatically. To avoid firing on every notification, he adds a filter for the word "**arriving**," so it only turns on the porch lights and has the HomePod announce when soup is en route. The takeaway: good notifications are concise, specific (a clear verb), and actionable (the time), and following the **Human Interface Guidelines** makes them easy to parse inside a shortcut.

deepdive_en.title: Soup Entity Example
deepdive_en.body: Into the **Use Model** topic: the action can now tap more capable, web-aware **Apple Intelligence** models and work with app content. Using Find Soups (filterable to those available today) and Order Soup—exposed via an **EntityPropertyQuery**—he builds a "Soup of the Day" shortcut that asks the model to pick by spice preference, but it first picks a mild chicken tortilla soup, motivating a way to debug the model.

deepdive_en.title: Storage
deepdive_en.body: He demonstrates the new debugging path: you can **inspect the model transcript** to see everything passed to the model in raw form. Add a **Show Content** action after Use Model and select its **Transcript** property to expand each **SoupEntity** and its properties. The diagnosis: name and availability aren't enough to judge spice, so he adds an ingredients property (a string array of each ingredient and quantity), after which the model picks a genuinely spicy Tom Yum.

deepdive_en.title: Soup Entity Example
deepdive_en.body: Into **Storage**: data can persist between runs, with a new editor view to create/inspect/edit stored values and a cross-shortcut **global value** (e.g., an API key), accessed via getter/setter actions. Examples keep a racing-fact shortcut from repeating via Previous Facts and give Soup of the Day a memory of recent picks. The key point is that stored values **sync across devices**, so an App Entity needs a consistent identity—he uses the soup's online-database row ID as a stable identifier so every device recognizes it as the same entity.

title: Meet the Now Playing framework
gloss: 認識 Now Playing 框架
takeaway: 用全新的 Now Playing 框架，讓 App 的媒體播放透過 MediaSession 連接到鎖定畫面等系統介面，並支援遠端播放與裝置控制。

points.text: 全新的 **Now Playing** 框架讓 App 的播放狀態連接到**鎖定畫面等系統介面**，是現代化的 Swift 媒體整合方式。
讓 `@Observable` 的播放模型採用 **`MediaSessionRepresentable`**，提供 content、`playbackSnapshot` 與 `commands`，再以 `MediaSession` 建立連結。
透過 App extension 與 **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`** 支援遠端媒體 session，並以 `MediaDevice` 描述喇叭與音量等裝置能力。
藝術圖透過 `Artwork` 以非同步方式依尺寸提供，命令（play／pause／next／previous）可直接綁定播放器或送往伺服器。

audience: **開發音樂、Podcast、影音或任何媒體播放 App 的開發者**，想整合系統播放控制與遠端播放的人。
gloss_en: Meet the Now Playing framework
takeaway_en: Use the new Now Playing framework to connect your app's media playback to system surfaces like the Lock Screen through MediaSession, with support for remote playback and device control.

points_en.text: The new **Now Playing** framework connects your app's playback state to **system surfaces like the Lock Screen**, a modern Swift approach to media integration.
Have your `@Observable` playback model adopt **`MediaSessionRepresentable`**, providing content, `playbackSnapshot`, and `commands`, then establish the connection with `MediaSession`.
Support remote media sessions through an App extension and **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`**, using `MediaDevice` to describe device capabilities like speakers and volume.
Artwork is provided asynchronously by size through `Artwork`, and commands (play/pause/next/previous) can bind directly to your player or be sent to a server.

audience_en: **Developers building music, podcast, video, or any media playback apps** who want to integrate system playback controls and remote playback.
summary: 這場由 Media Frameworks 團隊主講，介紹全新的 **NowPlaying** Swift 框架——讓 app 的媒體播放輕鬆接上系統的 now-playing 體驗，出現在 **Lock Screen**、**Control Center**、**Dynamic Island**、**StandBy**、**CarPlay**，以及 Apple Watch、Apple Vision Pro 與 Apple TV。講者以自己開發、播放環境音幫助專注放鬆的 app 為例，貫穿三大主題：用 media sessions 把本地播放內容呈現到系統、用 remote media sessions 把在其他裝置（如智慧喇叭）上播放的內容帶進系統，以及用 **Media Sharing Extensions** 簡化把媒體從 iPhone 送到其他裝置。

本地播放的核心是 **media sessions API**。讓你的播放模型（如 `@Observable` 的 `PlayerModel`）符合 **`MediaSessionRepresentable`** 協定——這是 app 與系統間的「合約」，讓系統理解正在播什麼、以及如何處理 skip／pause 等互動。每個 session 表示需有唯一 identifier；用 `content` 描述播放內容（NowPlaying 提供 Music、Podcast、MovieContent 等專用型別，環境音用 **`GenericContent`** 即可，含 title、subtitle、media type 與 duration，連續播放設 `.continuous`），用 async closure 提供 **Artwork**，用 **`PlaybackSnapshot`** 表示播放狀態（含 isPlaying、有明確長度時加 elapsedTime），並透過 **`commands`** 定義 app 支援的所有動作（每個 command 有系統在使用者操作時呼叫的 closure）。最後用 **`MediaSession`** 以你的 model 初始化，它會開始觀察 model 並自動讓 now-playing 介面保持同步。

若內容是在其他裝置上播放（例如透過 app 控制的智慧喇叭），用 **remote media sessions API**。它靠**app extension 加推播通知**運作：喇叭狀態改變時通知伺服器，伺服器用 **APNs** 推播到 iPhone，系統以推播 payload 啟動 app extension，extension 再回傳更新後的 session 表示；反之若互動來自 iPhone 系統 UI，系統會呼叫 extension 中的 command handler、由 extension 通知伺服器再到喇叭。實作上建立符合 `RemoteMediaSessionExtension` 的 app extension（用 `RemoteMediaSessionExtensionConfiguration` 與 remote-media extension point），並讓 model 符合 **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`**，整體與本地 media session 很相似。

remote session 多了幾項專屬能力：用 **`devices`** 屬性告訴系統該 session 中播放的裝置（把伺服器裝置清單對應成 **`MediaDevice`**，含跨 session 穩定的 identifier、名稱、device type 如 `.speaker`、以及 volume 控制等 capability），於 Control Center 顯示裝置名與音量、調整時呼叫 volume change closure 送請求到伺服器；`update(_:)` 在收到帶新狀態的推播時被呼叫（`RemotePlayerState` 符合 `RemoteMediaSessionAttributes`），因 model 為 observable，NowPlaying 偵測變化後自動更新系統。最後介紹 **Media Sharing Extensions**：讓 app 用系統裝置選擇器支援多種媒體協定，協定實作改由系統管理、活在 app bundle 之外，app 只需專注於內容；隨著更多協定加入，app 不必再嵌入新 SDK 即可使用。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Media Frameworks 工程師 Leo Formaggio 開場，點出媒體無處不在——出現在 Lock Screen、Control Center、Dynamic Island，放下充電時於 **StandBy** 可一眼掌握，上車時在 **CarPlay** 居中顯示，並橫跨 Apple Watch、Vision Pro、Apple TV。預告 **NowPlaying** 框架的三大主題：media sessions、remote media sessions、Media Sharing Extensions，並以自製的環境音 app 為示範。

deepdive.title: Media sessions
deepdive.body: 介紹 **media sessions API** 為把本地播放內容呈現到系統 now-playing 體驗的方式。以播放環境音、可選音、暫停與恢復的範例 app 帶出，後續逐步說明如何用此 API 讓內容出現在系統各表面。

deepdive.title: Existing PlayerModel implementation
deepdive.body: 展示既有的 `PlayerModel`——一個 `@Observable` 類別，持有 app 音訊引擎的參照與一個追蹤目前播放哪個音效的屬性。這是後續接上系統的基礎。

deepdive.title: Adopt MediaSessionRepresentable
deepdive.body: 讓 `PlayerModel` 符合 **`MediaSessionRepresentable`**——app 與系統間的「合約」，使系統理解播什麼、如何處理 skip/pause 等互動。每個 session 表示需唯一 identifier；用 `content` 描述內容，NowPlaying 提供 Music、Podcast、MovieContent 等型別，環境音用 **`GenericContent`**（以 sound.id 識別、sound.name 為 title、description 為 subtitle，media type 為 .audio、duration 設 .continuous），並用 async closure 提供 **Artwork**。再用 **`PlaybackSnapshot`** 表示播放狀態（連續音效只需 isPlaying，有長度的內容要加 elapsedTime），用 **`commands`** 定義所有支援動作，每個 command 的 closure 在使用者於 Lock Screen 操作（pause/play/next）時被系統呼叫。

deepdive.title: MediaSession initialization
deepdive.body: 採用 `MediaSessionRepresentable` 後，還需用 **`MediaSession`** 把 session 表示接上系統。在設定音訊引擎的同處以 `PlayerModel` 初始化 `MediaSession`；完成後它會開始觀察 model，自動讓 now-playing 各表面保持最新。詳見 Apple 文件的 Publishing Media Sessions 文章。

deepdive.title: Remote media sessions
deepdive.body: 情境轉到把音訊引擎放上智慧喇叭、由 app 控制：從裝置選單選喇叭，透過 web server 連到喇叭請求播放狀態並送指令。介紹 **remote media sessions API**——用 app extension 與推播通知接收喇叭更新，把該內容呈現到系統。

deepdive.title: App extension entry point
deepdive.body: 說明 remote 的互動流程：使用者操作喇叭→喇叭通知伺服器→伺服器用 **APNs** 推播到 iPhone→系統以推播 payload 啟動 app extension→extension 回傳更新後的 session 表示。反向：互動來自 iPhone 系統 UI 時，系統呼叫 extension 的 command handler，extension 送指令給伺服器、再到喇叭。

deepdive.title: Existing RemotePlayerModel implementation
deepdive.body: 展示 `RemotePlayerModel`——一個 `@Observable` 類別，持有與伺服器溝通的 `ServerClient` 參照並追蹤伺服器狀態，作為建立 remote media session 表示的基礎。

deepdive.title: Adopt RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable in app extension
deepdive.body: 示範採用：先建立符合 **`RemoteMediaSessionExtension`** 的 app extension，用 `RemoteMediaSessionExtensionConfiguration` 與 remote-media extension point 設定；`session(:)` 方法在系統需互動時被呼叫，可用 `RemotePlayerState` 建立並回傳 model。接著讓 model 符合 **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`**，內容（GenericContent）、media type、duration、Artwork、PlaybackSnapshot 的用法與本地 media session 幾乎相同，差別在每個 command closure 會送請求到伺服器、由伺服器在喇叭上執行對應動作。

deepdive.title: Media sharing extensions
deepdive.body: 說明 remote session 的專屬屬性與方法：**`devices`** 告訴系統 session 中播放的裝置（對應成 **`MediaDevice`**，含跨 session 穩定的 identifier、名稱、device type 如 .speaker、volume capability），於 Control Center 顯示裝置名與音量、調整時呼叫 volume change closure；**`update(:)`** 在收到帶新狀態的推播時被呼叫（`RemotePlayerState` 符合 `RemoteMediaSessionAttributes`），model 為 observable 故 NowPlaying 自動更新系統。最後介紹 **Media Sharing Extensions**——用系統裝置選擇器支援所有 app 支援的媒體協定，協定實作活在 app bundle 之外由系統管理，app 專注於內容；新協定加入時不必再嵌入新 SDK。

summary_en: Presented by the Media Frameworks team, this session introduces the new **NowPlaying** Swift framework, which connects your app's media playback to the system now-playing experience—the **Lock Screen**, **Control Center**, **Dynamic Island**, **StandBy**, and **CarPlay**, plus Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple TV. Using an ambient-sound focus/relaxation app he built, the presenter covers three topics: surfacing local playback with media sessions, bringing content playing on other devices (like smart speakers) into the system with remote media sessions, and simplifying sending media from iPhone with **Media Sharing Extensions**.

Local playback centers on the **media sessions API**. Make your player model (e.g., an `@Observable` `PlayerModel`) conform to **`MediaSessionRepresentable`**—a contract between app and system so it understands what's playing and how to handle interactions like skip or pause. Each representation needs a unique identifier; describe playback with `content` (NowPlaying offers Music, Podcast, and MovieContent types; ambient sounds use **`GenericContent`** with title, subtitle, media type, and duration set to `.continuous`), provide **Artwork** via an async closure, represent state with a **`PlaybackSnapshot`** (isPlaying, plus elapsedTime for content with a defined duration), and define all supported actions via **`commands`** (each with a closure the system calls). Finally, **`MediaSession`** is initialized with your model, observing it and keeping the now-playing surfaces in sync automatically.

When content plays on another device (like a smart speaker controlled by the app), use the **remote media sessions API**. It works via an **app extension plus push notifications**: when the speaker state changes it notifies a server, which uses **APNs** to push to iPhone, the system launches the app extension with the push payload, and the extension returns an updated session representation; conversely, when interaction originates from iPhone system UI, the system calls a command handler in the extension, which notifies the server and then the speaker. In code, create an app extension conforming to `RemoteMediaSessionExtension` (with `RemoteMediaSessionExtensionConfiguration` and the remote-media extension point) and make the model conform to **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`**, which feels very similar to local media sessions.

Remote sessions add a few extras: the **`devices`** property tells the system which devices are playing (mapping the server's device list into **`MediaDevice`** values with stable identifiers, names, a device type like `.speaker`, and capabilities like volume control), shown in Control Center with name and volume, with a volume-change closure sending a request to the server; `update(_:)` is called when a push arrives with new state (`RemotePlayerState` conforms to `RemoteMediaSessionAttributes`), and since the model is observable, NowPlaying detects the change and updates the system automatically. Finally, **Media Sharing Extensions** let your app use the system device picker for all the media protocols it supports, with protocol implementations managed by the system outside your app bundle so you focus on content—and as more protocols arrive, your app uses them without adopting another SDK.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Media Frameworks engineer Leo Formaggio opens, noting media is everywhere—on the Lock Screen, Control Center, and Dynamic Island, glanceable in **StandBy** when charging, front and center in **CarPlay** in the car, and across Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV. Previews the three topics of the **NowPlaying** framework—media sessions, remote media sessions, and Media Sharing Extensions—demoed with a homemade ambient-sound app.

deepdive_en.title: Media sessions
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the **media sessions API** as the way to surface local playback in the system now-playing experience, using the ambient-sound app (select sounds, pause and resume) as the running example for the steps that follow.

deepdive_en.title: Existing PlayerModel implementation
deepdive_en.body: Shows the existing `PlayerModel`—an `@Observable` class with a reference to the app's audio engine and a property tracking which sound is playing—as the foundation for connecting to the system.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt MediaSessionRepresentable
deepdive_en.body: Conforms `PlayerModel` to **`MediaSessionRepresentable`**, a contract so the system understands what's playing and how to handle skip/pause. Each representation needs a unique identifier; describe content with `content` (Music, Podcast, MovieContent types exist; ambient sounds use **`GenericContent`** with sound.id, sound.name as title, description as subtitle, media type .audio, duration .continuous) and provide **Artwork** via an async closure. A **`PlaybackSnapshot`** represents state (just isPlaying for continuous, plus elapsedTime for content with duration), and **`commands`** defines all supported actions, each closure called by the system on Lock Screen pause/play/next.

deepdive_en.title: MediaSession initialization
deepdive_en.body: After adopting `MediaSessionRepresentable`, **`MediaSession`** connects the representation to the system. Initialize it with `PlayerModel` where the audio engine is set up; it then observes the model and keeps now-playing surfaces up to date automatically. See the Publishing Media Sessions article in Apple Developer Documentation.

deepdive_en.title: Remote media sessions
deepdive_en.body: Shifts to making the audio engine available on smart speakers controlled by the app: choose a speaker from a device picker and connect via a web server to request playback state and send commands. Introduces the **remote media sessions API**—using an app extension and push notifications to receive speaker updates and surface that content in the system.

deepdive_en.title: App extension entry point
deepdive_en.body: Explains the remote interaction flow: a user interacts with the speaker → the speaker notifies the server → the server uses **APNs** to push to iPhone → the system launches the app extension with the payload → the extension returns an updated representation. In reverse, when interaction comes from iPhone system UI, the system calls a command handler in the extension, which notifies the server and then the speaker.

deepdive_en.title: Existing RemotePlayerModel implementation
deepdive_en.body: Shows `RemotePlayerModel`—an `@Observable` class with a reference to `ServerClient` for server communication, tracking server state—as the foundation for building the remote media session representation.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable in app extension
deepdive_en.body: Shows adoption: create an app extension conforming to **`RemoteMediaSessionExtension`**, configured with `RemoteMediaSessionExtensionConfiguration` and the remote-media extension point; its `session(:)` method is called when the system needs to interact, returning a model built from `RemotePlayerState`. The model conforms to **`RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable`**, with content (GenericContent), media type, duration, Artwork, and PlaybackSnapshot nearly identical to local sessions—except each command closure sends a request to the server, which performs the action on the speaker.

deepdive_en.title: Media sharing extensions
deepdive_en.body: Covers remote-specific properties and methods: **`devices`** tells the system which devices are playing (mapped into **`MediaDevice`** values with stable identifiers, names, a device type like .speaker, and volume capabilities), shown in Control Center with name and volume and a volume-change closure; **`update(:)`** is called on a push with new state (`RemotePlayerState` conforms to `RemoteMediaSessionAttributes`), and the observable model lets NowPlaying update the system automatically. Finally introduces **Media Sharing Extensions**—using the system device picker for all supported media protocols, with implementations managed by the system outside the app bundle so the app focuses on content, and new protocols usable without adopting another SDK.

title: Learn CSS Grid Lanes
gloss: 認識 CSS Grid Lanes
takeaway: 全新的 **CSS Grid Lanes** 讓你用 `display: grid-lanes` 排列各種形狀大小的內容，打造能自適應的網頁版面。

points.text: 用 **`display: grid-lanes`** 建立容器，結合 `grid-template-columns` 與 `gap` 即可排列不同形狀的內容。
搭配 `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))` 做出能自適應的**磚塊式（brick）**版面與多種欄寬組合。
以 `grid-column: span 2` 或 `grid-column: 2 / span 2` 控制個別項目的跨欄與位置。
整合 **Subgrid**（`grid-template-columns: subgrid`）讓子項目對齊父層格線。
用新的 **`flow-tolerance`** 屬性調整項目排列的容差，並可在 Web Inspector 中檢視 Grid Lanes。

audience: **使用 Safari／WebKit 開發自適應網頁版面**的前端開發者。
gloss_en: Learn CSS Grid Lanes
takeaway_en: The new **CSS Grid Lanes** lets you arrange content of all shapes and sizes with `display: grid-lanes` to build adaptive web layouts.

points_en.text: Create a container with **`display: grid-lanes`**, then combine `grid-template-columns` and `gap` to arrange differently-shaped content.
Pair it with `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))` to build adaptive **brick** layouts and varied column-width combinations.
Control an individual item's column span and position with `grid-column: span 2` or `grid-column: 2 / span 2`.
Integrate **Subgrid** (`grid-template-columns: subgrid`) to align child items to the parent grid lines.
Adjust the tolerance of item placement with the new **`flow-tolerance`** property, and inspect Grid Lanes in Web Inspector.

audience_en: **Front-end developers building adaptive web layouts with Safari/WebKit**.
summary: 這場由 Safari 團隊工程師 Brandon 主講，主題是 CSS 的全新版面模式 **Grid Lanes**。它解決的是一個長期讓網頁開發者頭痛的需求：當內容（尤其是圖片）有著各種不同的形狀與尺寸時，如何讓它們自然地填入可用空間、緊密堆疊而不留下大片空白。這種版型過去常被稱為 **masonry layout**（瀑布流／磚牆排版），開發者往往得仰賴 JavaScript 函式庫，或勉強用 floats、Flexbox 拼湊，結果總是「差一點就能用」。Grid Lanes 從根本上把這件事變成幾行 CSS 就能完成，而且自 **Safari 26.4** 起就已可使用，其他瀏覽器則在 flag 之後支援。

理解 Grid Lanes 的關鍵，是把它放在 **Flexbox** 與 **Grid** 之間來看。每種版面模式都在回答兩個問題：項目放在哪裡、能拿到多少空間。Flexbox 給你一個軸、單一通道流動；Grid 給你欄與列兩個維度、把項目放進交叉的儲存格，但遇到不同長寬比的內容就會留下空白。Grid Lanes 折衷其間——只結構化單一方向（欄或列，二擇一），另一方向放任自由，項目逐一被放進「目前最短的那一欄」，於是形成緊湊、交錯且保留各自原始比例的版型。用法上以 `display: grid-lanes` 起手，搭配 `grid-template-columns` 與 `gap`，把欄換成 `grid-template-rows` 就從瀑布流變成磚牆。

Grid Lanes 最貼心的地方在於它幾乎完全沿用既有的 Grid 語法與心智模型。你可以用 `fr` 單位調整各欄比例、用 `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))` 讓瀏覽器自動決定欄數、用 `grid-column: span 2` 或明確的 `grid-column: 2 / span 2` 讓單一項目跨欄（但列由系統決定，無法手動指定）。卡片內部還能透過 `grid-template-columns: subgrid` 加入 **Subgrid**，讓子內容也對齊父層版面。

進階控制則靠 **flow-tolerance**。預設情況下瀏覽器永遠把下一個項目塞進最短的欄，但當兩欄高度只差幾像素時，這會造成視覺順序與 tab 順序錯位，進而傷害**無障礙**體驗。flow-tolerance（預設 `1em`）就是放寬這條規則的旋鈕：只要較高欄不超過較矮欄加上容差，就仍填入原欄，避免左右來回跳動。當結果不如預期時，**Web Inspector** 已完整支援 Grid Lanes，可疊加顯示欄列線、每個項目的排列順序編號與間距。整體而言，Grid Lanes 用幾行 CSS 取代了過去得靠 JavaScript 的版型，並讓版面去適應內容，而非反過來。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: Safari 團隊的 Brandon 開場介紹 **Grid Lanes** 這個網頁全新版面模式，目標是讓任意尺寸的項目自然流入可用空間。他點明這正是大家熟知的 **masonry layout**：縱向看是內容如瀑布般落下的瀑布流，翻轉方向則成為橫向流動的磚牆。重點訊息是「不必再等」——此功能自 **Safari 26.4** 起已可使用，其他瀏覽器則在 flag 之後支援。

deepdive.title: CSS Flexbox and Grid
deepdive.body: 講者退一步說明每種版面模式都在回答兩個問題：項目放在哪、能拿到多少空間。**Flexbox** 只有一個軸、單一通道，項目依序流動並換行；**Grid** 則提供欄與列兩個維度，把項目放進交叉儲存格。問題在於當內容長寬比不同時，Grid 會留下大片空白，而拉伸、放大裁切或縮放都會破壞圖片，凸顯出需要一個折衷方案。

deepdive.title: CSS Grid Lanes
deepdive.body: 正式定義 **Grid Lanes**：它介於 Grid 與 Flex 之間，只結構化單一方向、另一方向放任自由，但又不像 Flex 只有單一通道，而是把內容分配到多條 lane。項目逐一被放進「能讓它離頂端最近」的那一欄，因此較早的項目位置較高、後面的填補在下方，形成緊湊交錯且保留各自原始比例的版型。它不挑內容，圖片或文字皆可，文字會自動換行並由瀏覽器決定高度，需要突顯的標題還能跨欄。

deepdive.title: Build a Grid Lanes container
deepdive.body: 進入實作環節，示範如何從零建立一個 Grid Lanes 容器，作為後續逐步加上欄定義與屬性的起點。

deepdive.title: Create a Grid Lanes Container
deepdive.body: 以 `display: grid-lanes` 宣告容器，這是啟用整個版面模式的第一步。

deepdive.title: Create a Grid Lanes Container
deepdive.body: 加入 `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` 定義欄軌。講者解釋 **`fr`**（fractional unit）會把容器可用空間切成等分，此處即切成三等分形成三個等寬欄。

deepdive.title: Create a Grid Lanes Container
deepdive.body: 補上 `gap: 10px` 設定項目間距，用法與 Grid 完全相同，至此三行 CSS 就完成一個基本的 Grid Lanes 容器。

deepdive.title: Implement brick variation
deepdive.body: 示範如何把瀑布流轉成磚牆變體，關鍵只是切換主結構方向。

deepdive.title: Implement a Brick Variation
deepdive.body: 把 `grid-template-columns` 換成 `grid-template-rows`，版面立刻從垂直瀑布流翻轉成水平流動的磚牆。

deepdive.title: Implement a Brick Variation
deepdive.body: 強調唯一的限制：方向只能擇一，不能同時對欄與列都做結構化，這正是 Grid Lanes 與雙維度 Grid 的本質差異。

deepdive.title: Experiment with different layouts
deepdive.body: 展示這三行 CSS 其實能變化出意料之外的多種版型，鼓勵開發者動手嘗試。

deepdive.title: Experiment with different layouts
deepdive.body: 從三個等寬欄出發，示範各欄寬度不必相等，例如用 `1fr 2fr 1fr` 讓中間欄佔據左右兩欄兩倍的空間。

deepdive.title: Experiment with different layouts
deepdive.body: 改用 `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))` 讓瀏覽器自行決定欄數：**`auto-fill`** 盡可能塞入欄，**`minmax()`** 規定每欄至少 200px、可成長以填滿空間。

deepdive.title: Experiment with different layouts
deepdive.body: 進一步以 `minmax` 組合出窄欄與寬欄交替的重複樣式，展現只用少量 CSS 就能做到的彈性。

deepdive.title: Experiment with different layouts
deepdive.body: 講者總結最欣賞的是這套版面模式的高表達力——少量 CSS 就能做出豐富變化，鼓勵觀眾自行探索。

deepdive.title: Control individual items
deepdive.body: 從整體版面轉向單一項目的塑形，說明 Grid Lanes 也能控制個別 item 的呈現。

deepdive.title: Control Individual Items
deepdive.body: 回到三個等寬欄的容器，示範要給某個項目更多空間時，可直接沿用 Grid 既有的屬性來達成。

deepdive.title: Control Individual Items
deepdive.body: 用 `grid-column: span 2` 讓項目橫跨兩欄，其餘版面會自動環繞調整。

deepdive.title: Control Individual Items
deepdive.body: 改用 `grid-column: 2 / span 2` 精確指定項目從第 2 欄開始、橫跨第 2 與第 3 欄。重點提示：你能控制**欄**的位置，但**列**由 Grid Lanes 自行決定。

deepdive.title: Integrate Subgrid
deepdive.body: 示範把某個跨兩欄的項目做成食譜卡，卡片內含圖片與文字，但這些子內容預設並不參與父層 Grid Lanes 版面。

deepdive.title: Integrate Subgrid
deepdive.body: 在卡片上加入 `display: grid-lanes` 與 `grid-template-columns: subgrid`，讓卡片內容以各自獨立的 item 身份加入父層版面：圖片佔一欄、文字佔另一欄，各依內容自動調整大小。

deepdive.title: Integrate Subgrid
deepdive.body: 強調可任意巢狀：Grid Lanes 容器內放一般 Grid，或反過來都行。既有的工具與語法直接沿用，因此 **Subgrid** 與 Grid Lanes 能無縫整合。

deepdive.title: Flow Tolerance
deepdive.body: 引入 **flow-tolerance**。瀏覽器預設總把下一個項目放進最短欄，但當兩欄高度只差幾像素時，會讓視覺排列在第一列左到右、最後一列右到左，造成與 tab 順序錯位、傷害**無障礙**。flow-tolerance 是放寬此規則的旋鈕：對每個新項目都問「較高欄是否小於較矮欄加上容差？」，是則仍填入原欄、否則才落入較矮欄。預設值為 `1em`，建議依內容調整。

deepdive.title: Improve item positioning
deepdive.body: 延續 flow-tolerance 的概念，示範如何透過調整容差值來改善項目落點，讓視覺順序更符合預期。

deepdive.title: Improve item positioning
deepdive.body: 把 `flow-tolerance` 設成具體數值（如 `2.1em`），實際比較不同容差對排列結果的影響，找出最適合自身內容的設定。

deepdive.title: Web Inspector
deepdive.body: 說明當瀏覽器的彈性導致結果出乎意料時，可開啟 **Web Inspector** 除錯。它已完整支援 Grid Lanes，疊加 overlay 後會顯示欄列線、投影在每個項目上的排列順序編號，以及項目之間的間距。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 結語強調 Grid Lanes 用幾行 CSS 取代了過去得靠 JavaScript 的版型，並讓版面去適應內容。講者推薦 WebKit 團隊製作的 **Grid Lanes Field Guide**（含互動範例），鼓勵在專案中試用、透過 Feedback 回報，並延伸觀看「What's new in WebKit for Safari 27」。

summary_en: Presented by Safari engineer Brandon, this session introduces **Grid Lanes**, a new CSS layout mode. It solves a long-standing pain point: arranging content (especially images) of differing shapes and sizes so it flows naturally into available space, packing tightly without leaving large empty gaps. This pattern is widely known as **masonry layout** (a waterfall or brick-wall arrangement), and developers have historically reached for JavaScript libraries or improvised with floats and Flexbox that 'almost works.' Grid Lanes reduces it to a few lines of CSS, and it is available starting in **Safari 26.4** (behind a flag in other browsers).

The key to understanding Grid Lanes is positioning it between **Flexbox** and **Grid**. Every layout mode answers two questions: where do items go, and how much space do they get. Flexbox gives one axis and a single lane; Grid gives two dimensions placing items into intersecting cells, but leaves empty space when aspect ratios differ. Grid Lanes splits the difference—it structures only one direction (columns or rows, your choice) and leaves the other free, placing each item into whichever column currently leaves it closest to the top.
