Compute **camera-only motion vectors** in the shader, subtracting the sub-pixel jitter offset between consecutive frames.
**Deploy custom ML networks** with Metal 4 and integrate them into the rendering flow.
Run neural networks **inline** within shaders via **tensorOps**.

audience_en: **Metal developers building high-performance games and real-time 3D rendering** who want to bring ML into their rendering pipeline.
summary: 這場由 Apple GPU 軟體工程師 Yulia 主講，主題是如何用 **Metal 4** 把機器學習帶進即時算繪管線。核心訊息是：許多過去靠解析法（analytical methods）實作的算繪技術——降噪、neural textures、學習式 tone mapping 等——如今都能改用 ML 來提升畫質、效能或記憶體佔用。Apple 平台提供一整套由淺入深的工具：最高層是 **MetalFX** 開箱即用的神經降噪與升頻；中間是 **Metal 4 ML command encoder**，能在 command buffer 裡直接跑預訓練模型；最底層是 **TensorOps API**，讓你在 shader 內手刻小型網路，充分發揮 M5 與 A19 Pro 上的 neural accelerator。

第一層以 Maxon 的 **Redshift Live**（Cinema 4D 中的即時 path tracer viewport）為例示範 **MetalFX Denoising**。在互動式 viewport 裡每像素往往只能取一個 sample，畫面天生有雜訊，MetalFX 把它升頻並降噪成接近最終品質的影像。講者整理出 Maxon 採用的三條最佳實務：一是**保持輔助輸入乾淨**，其中 diffuse albedo 是最強的降噪訊號，並善用 transparency overlay 與 denoiser strength mask 處理天空、煙霧等無須降噪的區域；二是**儲存觀者實際看到的內容**，鏡面要存反射面的材質屬性，玻璃則用 Fresnel 項混合反射與折射的 albedo（primary surface replacement）；三是**算對 motion vectors**，MetalFX 需要去除 jitter 的 dejittered motion vectors，否則邊緣會閃爍。

第二層談如何**部署自己離線訓練的模型**。講者以 tone mapping 為例：傳統後處理管線由多個階段串接、可任意複雜，而最佳結果來自理解影像內容，正適合用神經網路學習。以 **HDRNet**（Gharbi 等人 2017）為例，網路在降採樣影像上做全域與局部分析，為 16x16 的 tile 產生色彩轉換並以 edge-aware 方式套用。流程是先在 PyTorch 等框架訓練，匯出成 **MTLPackage**，再透過 ML command encoder 在同一個 command buffer 裡執行——path tracer、MetalFX 降噪與 neural tone mapper 全在同一幀完成，一次神經評估取代整條多階段後處理鏈。

第三層是用 **TensorOps API** 在 shader 內手刻 tiny network。這類網路只有數千個參數以下、針對單一場景訓練、甚至每幾幀就**線上訓練（online training）**一次，因此不需泛化。講者以 image-based lighting 的 skybox probe 為例：在動態日夜循環下，離線預算的照明會失準，於是改用一個 3-4-4-3 的 **MLP**（fully connected multilayer perceptron），每幀做一到多次訓練迭代（取樣方向、推論、算解析解誤差、反向傳播）來持續修正。實作上把 input 批次成 2D 矩陣，逐層用 **matmul** 2D tensor operation 加上 activation function 前向傳播；在 compute stage 用 **SIMD group execution scope** 搭配 **cooperative tensors**，讓中間結果留在快速的 thread storage、避免往返主記憶體。總結是三個層級各給你不同的控制權，挑最適合你 app 的那一層採用即可。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 GPU 軟體工程師 Yulia 開場，點出機器學習正從研究走向即時算繪的量產應用：**neural denoising**、neural textures、學習式 tone mapping 等過去靠解析法的技術都能改用 ML 來改善畫質、效能或記憶體。並預告 Apple 平台的三層工具：最高層的 **MetalFX**、中層的 **Metal 4 ML command encoder**，與最底層在 shader 內運作的 **TensorOps API**，三者由淺入深、控制權遞增。

deepdive.title: MetalFX Denoising
deepdive.body: 說明 path tracer 在互動式 viewport 中每像素只能取一個 sample、畫面天生有雜訊，**MetalFX Denoising** 是結合神經升頻與降噪、為 Apple silicon 最佳化的方案。需餵入 diffuse albedo、depth 等輔助輸入。以 Maxon 的 **Redshift Live** 為例：開啟降噪後畫面從 1spp 的雜訊轉為穩定、接近最終品質的即時影像，可即時看到光影、陰影與 global illumination 的變化。並帶出三條最佳實務作為後續主軸。

deepdive.title: Compute camera-only motion vectors
deepdive.body: 聚焦第三條最佳實務：正確的 **motion vectors** 是時間穩定性的關鍵，它回答「此像素上一幀在哪」。MetalFX 需要去除 jitter 的 **dejittered motion vectors**，否則可能誤差達一像素造成邊緣閃爍。程式碼示範靜態物體的 camera-only 算法：用當前與前一幀的 view-projection 矩陣各投影一次取差，再減去兩幀的 jitter delta。會動或變形的物體須存前一幀世界座標或 skin 兩次,快速運動的粒子則改用 reactive mask。

deepdive.title: Deploy custom ML networks with Metal 4
deepdive.body: 進入第二層：用 **Metal 4 ML command encoder** 部署自己離線訓練的模型，以 **tone mapping** 為例。傳統後處理管線多階段串接、可任意複雜，而理解影像內容正是神經網路所長。介紹 **HDRNet** 架構（在降採樣影像上做全域＋局部分析、為 16x16 tile 產生 edge-aware 的色彩轉換），流程為 PyTorch 訓練、匯出 **MTLPackage**、用 function descriptor 與 ML pipeline descriptor 設定後 dispatch，讓一次神經評估取代整條後處理鏈，且與 compute、render 同在一個 command buffer 執行。

deepdive.title: Inline neural networks with tensorOps
deepdive.body: 第三層用 **TensorOps API** 在 shader 內 inline 跑 tiny network（數千參數以下、針對單一場景、可**線上訓練**）。以 skybox 的 image-based lighting probe 為例，動態日夜循環會讓離線預算的照明失準，故用 3-4-4-3 的 **MLP** 每幀做訓練迭代（取樣方向、推論、算解析解誤差、反向傳播）。實作把 input 批次成 2D 矩陣，逐層 **matmul** 加 activation 前向傳播；在 compute stage 用 **SIMD group execution scope** 與 **cooperative tensors** 把中間結果留在快速 thread storage，避免往返主記憶體。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結三個層級：**MetalFX** 提供平台整合的神經降噪（三條最佳實務：輸入乾淨、存觀者所見、算對 motion vectors）；**MTLPackage** 讓你部署離線訓練模型、以一次評估取代整條後處理；**TensorOps API** 讓你在 shader 內建構跑在 neural accelerator 上的 tiny network。建議：pro-app 與遊戲的即時 viewport 先採用 MetalFX，再嘗試 neural tone mapper，並用 tensor API 實驗小型專用網路。

summary_en: Presented by Apple GPU software engineer Yulia, this session shows how to bring machine learning into your real-time rendering pipeline with **Metal 4**. The core message is that many techniques that traditionally relied on analytical methods—denoising, neural textures, learned tone mapping and more—can now be implemented with ML to improve quality, performance, or memory footprint. Apple platforms offer a complete, layered toolset: at the top, **MetalFX** provides ready-to-use neural denoising and upscaling; in the middle, the **Metal 4 ML command encoder** runs pre-trained models directly in your command buffer; and at the most flexible level, the **TensorOps API** lets you hand-build tiny networks inside your shaders, fully leveraging the neural accelerator in M5 and A19 Pro Apple silicon GPUs.

The first layer demonstrates **MetalFX Denoising** using Maxon's **Redshift Live**, a real-time path-tracing viewport in Cinema 4D. With only one sample per pixel to stay interactive, frames are naturally noisy; MetalFX upscales and denoises them into near-final quality in real time. Yulia distills three best practices Maxon followed: first, keep your auxiliary inputs clean—diffuse albedo is the strongest denoising signal—and use the transparency overlay and denoiser strength mask for noise-free regions like sky, fog, and volumetrics; second, store what the viewer actually sees—mirrors store the reflected surface's material properties, while glass blends reflected and refracted albedo by the Fresnel term (primary surface replacement); third, get your motion vectors right—MetalFX expects dejittered motion vectors, or edges will shimmer.

The second layer covers deploying your own offline-trained models, using tone mapping as the example. A traditional post-processing chain concatenates many parameterized stages and can grow arbitrarily complex, yet the best results come from understanding image content—exactly what a neural network can learn. Using **HDRNet** (Gharbi et al., 2017) as an example, the network analyzes a downsampled image both globally and locally, producing edge-aware color transforms for 16x16 tiles. The workflow is to train in a framework like PyTorch, export to an **MTLPackage**, then run it via the ML command encoder in the same command buffer—path tracer, MetalFX denoising, and the neural tone mapper all in one frame, replacing the entire multi-stage chain with a single neural evaluation.

The third layer uses the **TensorOps API** to hand-build tiny networks inside shaders. These have a few thousand parameters or fewer, are trained on one specific scene, and can even be trained **online** every few frames, so they never need to generalize. Yulia's example is a skybox probe for image-based lighting: under a dynamic day-night cycle an offline-precomputed signal goes out of sync, so a 3-4-4-3 **MLP** (fully connected multilayer perceptron) runs one or more training iterations per frame—sample a direction, run inference, compute the error against the analytical solution, then back-propagate. Inputs are batched into a 2D matrix and evaluated layer by layer with **matmul** 2D tensor operations plus an activation function; in a compute stage, **SIMD group execution scope** with **cooperative tensors** keeps intermediate results in fast thread storage, avoiding a round trip to main memory. The takeaway: each layer grants more control—pick the one that's right for your app.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: GPU software engineer Yulia opens by noting that ML is moving from research into production for real-time rendering: **neural denoising**, neural textures, and learned tone mapping that once relied on analytical methods can now be done with ML to improve quality, performance, or memory. She previews Apple's three-layer toolset—the top-level **MetalFX**, the mid-level **Metal 4 ML command encoder**, and the lowest-level **TensorOps API** that runs inside shaders—ordered from easiest to most flexible, with increasing control at each step.

deepdive_en.title: MetalFX Denoising
deepdive_en.body: Explains that a path tracer in an interactive viewport can afford only one sample per pixel, so frames are inherently noisy; **MetalFX Denoising** is a combined neural upscaler and denoiser optimized for Apple silicon, fed auxiliary inputs like diffuse albedo and depth. Using Maxon's **Redshift Live** as the example, enabling the denoiser turns a noisy 1spp image into a stable, near-final real-time result, letting artists see ray-traced lighting, shadows, and global illumination update live. This sets up the three best practices that follow.

deepdive_en.title: Compute camera-only motion vectors
deepdive_en.body: Focuses on the third best practice: correct **motion vectors** are essential for temporal stability—each answers 'where was this pixel last frame?' MetalFX expects **dejittered motion vectors**, otherwise they can be up to a pixel off and cause edge shimmering. The code computes camera-only motion for static objects: project the vertex through the current and previous view-projection matrices and take the difference, then subtract the per-frame jitter deltas. Moving or deforming geometry must store previous-frame world positions or skin twice, while fast alpha-blended particles use the reactive mask instead.

deepdive_en.title: Deploy custom ML networks with Metal 4
deepdive_en.body: Enters the second layer: deploying your own offline-trained models via the **Metal 4 ML command encoder**, with tone mapping as the example. A traditional post-processing chain concatenates many parameterized stages and can grow arbitrarily complex, but understanding image content is exactly what a network learns. It introduces **HDRNet** (global plus local analysis on a downsampled image, producing edge-aware color transforms per 16x16 tile), with a workflow of training in PyTorch, exporting an **MTLPackage**, configuring it with a function descriptor and ML pipeline descriptor, then dispatching—so one neural evaluation replaces the entire chain, running alongside compute and render in the same command buffer.

deepdive_en.title: Inline neural networks with tensorOps
deepdive_en.body: The third layer uses the **TensorOps API** to run a tiny network inline inside a shader (a few thousand parameters or fewer, trained per-scene, even **online**). The example is a skybox probe for image-based lighting; a dynamic day-night cycle makes an offline-precomputed signal go stale, so a 3-4-4-3 **MLP** runs training iterations each frame (sample a direction, infer, compute the error against the analytical solution, back-propagate). Implementation batches inputs into a 2D matrix and evaluates layer by layer with **matmul** plus activation; in a compute stage, **SIMD group execution scope** with **cooperative tensors** keeps intermediate results in fast thread storage, avoiding a round trip to main memory.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recaps the three levels: **MetalFX** offers platform-integrated neural denoising (three best practices: keep inputs clean, store what the viewer sees, get motion vectors right); the **MTLPackage** lets you deploy offline-trained models and replace an entire post-processing chain with one evaluation; and the **TensorOps API** lets you build tiny networks in shaders running on the neural accelerator. The advice: adopt MetalFX first for real-time viewports in pro apps and games, then try a neural tone mapper, and experiment with small specialized networks using the tensor API.

title: Find your accessory with Bluetooth Channel Sounding
gloss: 用藍牙通道測距找到你的配件
takeaway: 用 Bluetooth Channel Sounding 透過 Core Bluetooth 或 Nearby Interaction，為藍牙配件帶來距離與方向感知。
chapters: Start a Core Bluetooth Channel Sounding session
Receive distance results and cancel a session
Start a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session
Run a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session

points.text: **Channel Sounding** 為藍牙配件帶來**距離與方向**感知，可用於尋找配件等情境。
在 **Core Bluetooth** 中先以 **supportsFeatures(.channelSounding)** 檢查支援，再用 **CBChannelSoundingSessionConfiguration** 啟動測距 session。
透過 delegate 接收 **CBChannelSoundingProcedureResults** 取得 **distance**，並可隨時取消 session。
用 **Nearby Interaction** 的 **NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration** 並啟用**相機輔助（camera assistance）**，可額外取得方向（水平角）。

audience: 開發**藍牙配件或尋物類 App、需要距離與方向定位**的硬體與 iOS 開發者。
gloss_en: Find your accessory with Bluetooth Channel Sounding
takeaway_en: Use Bluetooth Channel Sounding through Core Bluetooth or Nearby Interaction to bring distance and direction awareness to Bluetooth accessories.

points_en.text: **Channel Sounding** brings **distance and direction** awareness to Bluetooth accessories, useful for scenarios like finding an accessory.
In **Core Bluetooth**, first check support with **supportsFeatures(.channelSounding)**, then start a ranging session with **CBChannelSoundingSessionConfiguration**.
Receive **CBChannelSoundingProcedureResults** through the delegate to get **distance**, and cancel the session at any time.
Use **Nearby Interaction**'s **NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration** with **camera assistance** enabled to additionally obtain direction (azimuth).

audience_en: Hardware and iOS developers building **Bluetooth accessories or item-finder apps that need distance and direction positioning**.
summary: 這場由 Core Bluetooth 團隊的 Gretchen 主講，介紹如何用 **Bluetooth Channel Sounding** 為你的 Bluetooth 配件加上距離與方向感知。講者以辦派對為例：屋內烤箱與後院煙燻爐各放一支 Bluetooth 溫度探針，當某支達到設定溫度時，app 能告訴你它「在你右邊 8 公尺」，讓你不會搞混兩支探針。相較於過去用 **RSSI** 粗估距離，Channel Sounding 是真正「測量」距離。

原理上，已配對連線的 iPhone 為 **initiator**、配件為 **reflector**：iPhone 送出 tone，配件把它反射回來，iPhone 量測訊號往返過程中的變化，並在 2.4GHz 頻段的各個 channel 重複此過程，依據反射 tone 在 channel 間的變化率估算距離，這個量測過程稱為一次 **procedure**。實作上有兩條路：若只需距離，用 **Core Bluetooth**——先以 `CBCentralManager.supportsFeatures` 確認本機支援，對已連線的 `CBPeripheral` 呼叫 `startChannelSoundingSession`，iOS 會反覆執行 procedure 並透過 `didReceive results` delegate 回傳以公尺為單位的距離，結束時呼叫 `cancelChannelSoundingSession`。

若同時需要距離與方向，改用 **Nearby Interaction**：以 `supportsBluetoothChannelSounding` 確認支援後，用 peripheral 的 identifier 建立 `NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration`，方向需要啟用 **CameraAssistance**，再建立 `NISession` 並 run。可透過 `updateMotionState` 告知配件是移動或靜止以改善方向估算，delegate 回傳的 `NINearbyObjects` 與 UWB 完全相同，距離與方向皆為 optional（量測失敗時 distance 可能為 nil），iOS 會自動過濾離群值並平滑結果。需注意 iOS 27 僅在 app 前景時可用、進背景會暫停，且其他 Bluetooth／Wi-Fi 活動增加時 iOS 可能降低量測頻率；此功能需具備 **N1 chip** 的 iPhone。
硬體方面，配件必須支援 **Bluetooth 6.3** 並具備 **inline PCT** 功能；由於 iOS 採用 phase-based ranging，chipset 還須支援 spec 定義的 **mode-0** 與 **mode-2**，且 tone 之間的間隔時間 **T_FCS** 至少要 100µs。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Core Bluetooth 團隊的 Gretchen 開場，介紹用 **Channel Sounding** 尋找鄰近 Bluetooth 配件的方法。她先預告本場架構：先給出使用情境與運作原理，再說明如何用 **Core Bluetooth** 取得距離、或用 **Nearby Interaction** 同時取得距離與方向，接著是打造支援 Channel Sounding 硬體的提示，最後是 next steps。

deepdive.title: Overview
deepdive.body: 以派對情境說明價值：屋內烤箱與後院煙燻爐各有一支 Bluetooth 溫度探針，app 能指出達溫的探針「在右邊 8 公尺」，避免搞混。講者比較三種測距方式：最高精度是加上 **Ultra Wideband** chipset 搭配 Nearby Interaction；若配件只有 Bluetooth chipset，則 **Channel Sounding** 是最佳選項；它比過去用 **RSSI** 粗估更準，是真正的距離量測。

deepdive.title: Core Bluetooth API
deepdive.body: 說明若只需要距離就用 **Core Bluetooth**。前置條件是配件已透過 **AccessorySetupKit** 配對設定、並經 Core Bluetooth 連線，細節可參閱文件。這段帶出接下來測距的程式碼流程。

deepdive.title: Start a Core Bluetooth Channel Sounding session
deepdive.body: 先用 **`CBCentralManager.supportsFeatures`** 確認本機 iOS 裝置支援 Channel Sounding，再對已連線的 **`CBPeripheral`** 呼叫 **`startChannelSoundingSession`**。呼叫後 iOS 會反覆執行 Channel Sounding 的 **procedure**，持續產出量測結果。

deepdive.title: Receive distance results and cancel a session
deepdive.body: 每完成一次 procedure，delegate 方法 **`peripheral didReceive results`** 就會帶著以公尺為單位的距離被呼叫。當你準備結束時呼叫 **`cancelChannelSoundingSession`**，session 結束後會觸發 `peripheral didCompleteChannelSoundingSession` delegate 通知。

deepdive.title: Nearby Interaction API
deepdive.body: 若要同時取得距離與方向，改用 **Nearby Interaction**。同樣需先讓配件透過 **AccessorySetupKit** 配對設定、並經 Core Bluetooth 連線，作為建立 Channel Sounding session 的前置條件。

deepdive.title: Start a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session
deepdive.body: 先以 **`supportsBluetoothChannelSounding`** 確認本機支援，再建立 **`NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration`**，把 Core Bluetooth 的 `peripheral.identifier` 當作 `bluetoothChannelSoundingIdentifier` 傳入。要取得方向必須啟用 **CameraAssistance**，需要時務必開啟。

deepdive.title: Run a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session
deepdive.body: 建立 **`NISession`**、設定 delegate，並以剛才的 accessory configuration 執行 `run`。若 app 知道配件正在移動或靜止，可呼叫 **`updateMotionState`** 並帶上 `object.discoveryToken`（牆上固定的 tag 傳 `.stationary`、移動物件傳 `.moving`）以改善方向估算。delegate 回傳的 **`NINearbyObjects`** 與 UWB 完全相同，距離與方向皆為 optional，量測失敗時 distance 可能為 nil；iOS 會自動過濾離群值並平滑結果。iOS 27 中此功能僅在前景可用、進背景會暫停，且其他 Bluetooth／Wi-Fi 活動增加時可能降低量測頻率，需具備 **N1 chip** 的 iPhone。

deepdive.title: Hardware tips
deepdive.body: 配件必須支援 **Bluetooth 6.3** 且具備 **inline PCT** 功能。由於 iOS 採用 phase-based ranging，chipset 還須支援 Bluetooth spec 定義的 **mode-0** 與 **mode-2**；tone 之間的間隔時間 **T_FCS** 至少需達 100µs。

summary_en: Presented by Gretchen of the Core Bluetooth team, this session introduces **Bluetooth Channel Sounding** for adding distance and direction awareness to your Bluetooth accessories. Using a party example, two Bluetooth temperature probes sit in an indoor oven and a backyard smoker; when one hits its target temperature, the app can say it's "8 meters to my right," so you never mix up your probes. Unlike using **RSSI** to estimate distance, Channel Sounding actually measures it.

Mechanically, a paired and connected iPhone is the **initiator** and the accessory is the **reflector**: the iPhone sends a tone, the accessory reflects it back, and the iPhone measures how the signal changes in transit. Repeating this across the channels of the 2.4GHz band, it observes the rate of change in the reflected tones to estimate distance — each such measurement is called a **procedure**. There are two implementation paths: if you only need distance, use **Core Bluetooth** — check support with `CBCentralManager.supportsFeatures`, call `startChannelSoundingSession` on a connected `CBPeripheral`, and iOS repeatedly runs procedures and returns the distance in meters via the `didReceive results` delegate; call `cancelChannelSoundingSession` to finish.

If you need distance and direction, use **Nearby Interaction**: after confirming support with `supportsBluetoothChannelSounding`, build an `NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration` using the peripheral's identifier, enable **CameraAssistance** (required for direction), then create and run an `NISession`. You can call `updateMotionState` to tell it whether the accessory is moving or stationary for better direction estimates; the `NINearbyObjects` delegate callback is identical to UWB, with both distance and direction optional (distance may be nil if a measurement fails), and iOS automatically filters outliers and smooths results. Note that in iOS 27 it works only in the foreground (sessions pause in the background), iOS may reduce measurement frequency when other Bluetooth/Wi-Fi activity increases, and it requires iPhones with the **N1 chip**.

On the hardware side, the accessory must support **Bluetooth 6.3** with the **inline PCT** feature; because iOS uses phase-based ranging, the chipset must also support **mode-0** and **mode-2** as defined by the Bluetooth spec, and the inter-tone timing **T_FCS** must be at least 100µs.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Gretchen of the Core Bluetooth team opens by introducing how to find nearby Bluetooth accessories with **Channel Sounding**. She previews the agenda: use cases and how it works, how to implement it with **Core Bluetooth** for distance or **Nearby Interaction** for distance and direction, tips for building supporting hardware, and finally next steps.

deepdive_en.title: Overview
deepdive_en.body: A party scenario illustrates the value: with Bluetooth temperature probes in an indoor oven and a backyard smoker, the app can say the probe that reached temperature is "8 meters to my right," so you don't mix them up. The talk compares ranging options: highest accuracy comes from adding an **Ultra Wideband** chipset with Nearby Interaction; if the accessory only has Bluetooth, **Channel Sounding** is the best option, and unlike **RSSI** estimation it actually measures distance.

deepdive_en.title: Core Bluetooth API
deepdive_en.body: Explains that if you only need distance, use **Core Bluetooth**. The prerequisite is that the accessory is paired and set up with **AccessorySetupKit** and connected through Core Bluetooth, with details in the documentation. This sets up the code flow for measuring distance that follows.

deepdive_en.title: Start a Core Bluetooth Channel Sounding session
deepdive_en.body: First check that the local iOS device supports Channel Sounding with **`CBCentralManager.supportsFeatures`**, then call **`startChannelSoundingSession`** on a connected **`CBPeripheral`**. Once started, iOS repeatedly performs Channel Sounding **procedures**, continuously producing measurements.

deepdive_en.title: Receive distance results and cancel a session
deepdive_en.body: Each completed procedure invokes the **`peripheral didReceive results`** delegate method with the measured distance in meters. When you're ready to finish, call **`cancelChannelSoundingSession`**; when the session ends, the `peripheral didCompleteChannelSoundingSession` delegate is called.

deepdive_en.title: Nearby Interaction API
deepdive_en.body: To get both distance and direction, use **Nearby Interaction**. As before, the accessory must be paired and set up through **AccessorySetupKit** and connected via Core Bluetooth as the prerequisite for creating a Channel Sounding session.

deepdive_en.title: Start a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session
deepdive_en.body: Check support with **`supportsBluetoothChannelSounding`**, then create an **`NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration`**, passing the Core Bluetooth `peripheral.identifier` as the `bluetoothChannelSoundingIdentifier`. Getting direction requires **CameraAssistance**, so be sure to enable it if you need direction.

deepdive_en.title: Run a Nearby Interaction Channel Sounding session
deepdive_en.body: Create an **`NISession`**, set its delegate, and `run` it with the accessory configuration. If the app knows whether the accessory is moving or stationary, call **`updateMotionState`** with `object.discoveryToken` (`.stationary` for a wall-mounted tag, `.moving` for a moving object) to improve direction estimates. The **`NINearbyObjects`** callback is identical to UWB, with distance and direction both optional and distance possibly nil on a failed measurement; iOS filters outliers and smooths results. In iOS 27 it works only in the foreground (pausing in the background), iOS may reduce measurement frequency under heavier Bluetooth/Wi-Fi activity, and it requires iPhones with the **N1 chip**.

deepdive_en.title: Hardware tips
deepdive_en.body: The accessory must support **Bluetooth 6.3** and have the **inline PCT** feature. Because iOS uses phase-based ranging, the chipset must also support **mode-0** and **mode-2** as defined by the Bluetooth spec, and the inter-tone timing **T_FCS** must be at least 100µs.

title: Elevate your app’s text experience with TextKit
gloss: 用 TextKit 提升 App 的文字體驗
takeaway: 結合內建文字視圖的便利與 TextKit 的掌控力,用新 API 做出行號、可折疊段落與可重用的文字附件視圖等進階文字體驗。
chapters: Example: Code editor with line numbers
ContainerView with TextView and line number view
DidLayout: convert frames to viewport coordinates
Draw line numbers in ContainerView closure
Text attachments and view provider reuse
Text attachment view provider reuse policy

points.text: 用新 API**結合內建文字視圖的便利與 TextKit 的底層掌控力**,提升 App 的文字體驗。
新增 **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface** conformance,讓自訂 UIView 直接作為 viewport 的渲染表面(搭配 NSMapTable 快取)。
可在 SwiftUI 中以 **UIViewRepresentable / NSViewRepresentable** 包裝 UITextView/NSTextView。
範例:用 **NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate** 的三個 override + enumerateTextElements 算出起始行號,在 ContainerView 畫行號;另示範可折疊段落。
文字附件可用 **register(_:forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** 設定 view provider 的重用策略(如 .onEditingInlineParagraphs)。

audience: **需要進階文字排版(程式碼編輯器、行號、可折疊段落、自訂附件)、想善用 TextKit 的 UIKit/AppKit 開發者。**
gloss_en: Elevate your app's text experience with TextKit
takeaway_en: Combine the convenience of built-in text views with the control of TextKit, using new APIs to build advanced text experiences like line numbers, collapsible paragraphs, and reusable text attachment views.

points_en.text: Use new APIs to **combine the convenience of built-in text views with the low-level control of TextKit**, elevating your app's text experience.
Adds **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface** conformance, letting a custom UIView serve directly as the viewport's rendering surface (with NSMapTable caching).
In SwiftUI, wrap UITextView/NSTextView with **UIViewRepresentable / NSViewRepresentable**.

Example: use **NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate**'s three overrides plus enumerateTextElements to compute the starting line number and draw line numbers in a ContainerView; also demonstrates collapsible paragraphs.
For text attachments, use **register(_:forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** to set the view provider's reuse policy (such as .onEditingInlineParagraphs).

audience_en: **UIKit/AppKit developers who need advanced text layout (code editors, line numbers, collapsible paragraphs, custom attachments) and want to make the most of TextKit.**
summary: 本場由 TextKit 團隊工程師 Tarun Uday 主講,主題是如何結合「內建文字視圖的便利」與「**TextKit** 的掌控力」。**TextKit** 是 Apple 跨平台的次世代文字引擎,SwiftUI、UIKit 與 AppKit 的文字控制項皆以它進行排版與渲染。長久以來,開發者面臨「便利 vs 掌控」的兩難:一條路是使用框架文字視圖(**NSTextView**、**UITextView**、**TextEditor**),可免費獲得文字輸入、選取、無障礙、復原重做、聽寫、行內預測等大量功能,但難以客製繪製方式;另一條路是直接以 TextKit 當引擎、在自有 view 或 layer 上渲染的 custom text view,雖有完全掌控卻得放棄前述所有內建功能。本場目標就是兼得兩者之長。

講者先回顧 **TextKit 的四層架構**:最底層是 **text storage**(封裝所有文字資料,由 NSTextContentStorage 將 attributed string 拆成 NSTextParagraph)、其上是 **layout** 層(NSTextLayoutManager 量測字形並產生不可變的 NSTextLayoutFragment)、再上是 **viewport** 層(追蹤哪些 chunk 可見)、最頂是 **view** 層。storage、layout、viewport 三層跨所有 UI 框架共用。關鍵在於 TextKit 圍繞 **viewport** 組織工作、只渲染使用者看得見的文字,並由 **NSTextViewportLayoutController** 協調 layout manager 與 text view,在每次捲動、編輯或選取時重複此 viewport layout process。

在新 API 方面,2027 版前 TextKit 雖能追蹤 layout fragment,卻無法追蹤它們被繪製到哪些 view。新增的 **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface** 協定代表 viewport 內可繪製的視覺元素(可讓 UIView、NSView 或 CALayer 遵循),搭配 **NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey** 作為跨 viewport layout cycle 唯一識別 surface 的 key(如 NSTextLayoutFragment),可用於在 map table 或 dictionary 中快取 rendering surface。此外,**UITextView 與 NSTextView 現在遵循 NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate**,讓你可以 subclass 並 override delegate 方法來加入自訂行為。

講者以三個範例展示在 UITextView 中擴充的威力:第一個是為 iPad 程式編輯器加上 **行號**,透過 override willLayout、configureRenderingSurfaceFor 與 didLayout 三個 delegate 方法收集每段落 bounds 並換算到 viewport 座標,再用 enumerateTextElements 算出起始行號;第二個是 **可摺疊的食譜段落**,額外遵循 **NSTextContentStorageDelegate** 並以 shouldEnumerate 跳過已摺疊段落的排版;第三個是 **text attachment 的重用**,針對行內動畫在編輯時重啟的問題,以 **register(forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** 搭配 **onEditingInlineParagraphs** 與 onScrollingOutOfViewport 兩種重用政策,在編輯與捲動時保留 view provider 與其狀態。最後建議:想要便利又強大就以 UITextView/NSTextView 起步(SwiftUI 用 ViewRepresentable),想要更多掌控則用新的 Rendering Surface API 自建 custom text view。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 TextKit 團隊工程師 **Tarun Uday** 開場,點出 **TextKit** 是 Apple 跨所有平台的次世代文字引擎,也是 SwiftUI、UIKit、AppKit 文字控制項排版與渲染的基礎。講者直指開發者長期反映的「便利 vs 掌控」張力:一條路是用框架文字視圖(**NSTextView**、**UITextView**、**TextEditor**),免費獲得輸入、選取、無障礙、復原重做、聽寫、行內預測等,但客製繪製能力有限;另一條是用 TextKit 當引擎、自行渲染的 custom text view,有完全掌控卻得從零打造量產品質的編輯體驗。本場目標是兼得兩者之長。

deepdive.title: TextKit architecture
deepdive.body: 回顧理解 custom text 體驗的關鍵——**TextKit 四層架構**。最底是 **text storage** 層(封裝待渲染的所有文字資料)、其上是 **layout** 層(將文字拆成 chunk)、再上是 **viewport** 層(追蹤哪些 chunk 可見)、最頂是 **view** 層(文字在 app 中出現之處)。storage、layout、viewport 三層跨所有 UI 框架共用,可在任何 view 或類 view 的可繪製元素上渲染文字。講者以渲染長 NSAttributedString 為例逐層說明。

deepdive.title: What's new in TextKit
deepdive.body: 在回顧架構後,轉入 2027 版 TextKit 引入的新 API。重點是補足過去的缺口:先前 TextKit 雖能追蹤 layout fragment,卻沒有跨 TextKit 指涉「文字被渲染到的目標 view」的方式,接下來介紹的 rendering surface 系列 API 正是為此而生。

deepdive.title: NSTextViewportRenderingSurface conformance
deepdive.body: 介紹新協定 **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface**,代表 viewport 內一個你可繪製的視覺元素,亦即實際渲染 layout fragment 文字的 view,提供共通抽象。你可讓自己的 **UIView、NSView 或 CALayer** 遵循此協定,並在 viewport controller 的 delegate 方法中用它來追蹤 viewport 內有哪些 view 可見。

deepdive.title: NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey and NSMapTable
deepdive.body: 說明 rendering surface 的搭檔協定 **NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey**:任何能跨 viewport layout process 週期唯一識別 rendering surface 的 class(如 **NSTextLayoutFragment**)皆可作為 key,因此可用 layout fragment 當 key 在 **NSMapTable** 或 dictionary 中快取 rendering surface。viewport layout process 內部大量使用此 key 對 surface 的映射;可在 layout 過程以 renderingSurfaceFor delegate 方法指派 surface(每次 process 開始時會清除),並在 didLayout 階段以 viewport controller 的 renderingSurfaceFor 方法查詢。

deepdive.title: Extending framework text views
deepdive.body: 轉向說明驅動 Apple 預設文字體驗的框架文字視圖如何運作。**UITextView** 與 **NSTextView** 撐起平台上數千個長文體驗,包括 Messages、TextEdit、Notes 與 Journal。接下來將示範如何透過它們的 TextKit hooks 來擴充這些視圖。

deepdive.title: UITextView/NSTextView in SwiftUI via ViewRepresentable
deepdive.body: 說明在 SwiftUI app 中,實作長文體驗最方便的是 **TextEditor**,但也可透過 **ViewRepresentable** 納入 UITextView 或 NSTextView。講者建立名為 MyTextView 的 view,以 TextViewRepresentable 填入 body,並依平台條件編譯:macOS 為 **NSViewRepresentable**(於 makeNSView 回傳 NSTextView)、其他平台為 **UIViewRepresentable**(於 makeUIView 回傳 UITextView)。

deepdive.title: Example: Code editor with line numbers
deepdive.body: 第一個範例:為 iPad 打造可隨手寫程式的程式編輯器。講者先以 **UITextView** subclass 起步,初始化並把字型設為 **monospacedSystemFont**。但缺少行號就稱不上好的程式編輯體驗,因此下一步要開始建構行號功能。

deepdive.title: ContainerView with TextView and line number view
deepdive.body: 建立名為 **ContainerView** 的 view 來同時容納 TextView 與 lineNumberView——前者是 UITextView subclass、後者是顯示行號的 UIView。目標是在 viewport 變動時,重新計算並顯示 viewport 內 layout fragment 對應的 NSTextParagraph 索引,而這需要 text view 在其 viewport controller 完成一次 viewport layout process 時被通知。

deepdive.title: Three NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate overrides
deepdive.body: 重點宣布:自 2027 版起,**UITextView 與 NSTextView 現在遵循 NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate**,因此可 subclass 並 override delegate 方法加入自訂行為。講者將 override 三個方法:**willLayout** 做前置設定(清空 lines、計算起始行號)、**configureRenderingSurfaceFor** 擷取待渲染段落的 bounds(以 layoutFragmentFrame),以及 **didLayout** 把累積資訊回傳給 ContainerView 以繪製行號。每個方法都務必先呼叫 super。subclass 並加入 lines 陣列、startingLineNumber 整數與一個 closure 等狀態。

deepdive.title: startingLineNumber(for:) using enumerateTextElements
deepdive.body: 示範以獨立函式計算起始行號——即 viewport 開始前所有段落的數量。先做 nil 檢查,取得 textContentManager 並轉型為 **NSTextContentStorage**,再從 documentRange 的起點以 **enumerateTextElements** 列舉元素並遞增 count,直到元素範圍不再小於 viewportRange 的位置為止。講者提到 sample code 會以快取改良,避免每次 layout pass 都重付此成本。

deepdive.title: DidLayout: convert frames to viewport coordinates
deepdive.body: 在 **didLayout** 中,此時已握有 viewport 內每個段落的 bounds,要傳給 ContainerView。觸發 closure 前,需把 fragment frame 從 text container 座標換算為 viewport 座標——做法是減去 **viewportBounds.origin**(以 offsetBy 在 y 軸位移 -origin.y)。接著把起始行號與調整後的 frames 一併傳給 ContainerView。

deepdive.title: Draw line numbers in ContainerView closure
deepdive.body: 回到 **ContainerView** 設定該 closure:對每個 frame,以起始行號加上索引算出實際行號,並用設定好的屬性(monospacedSystemFont、secondaryLabel 顏色)以 NSString 的 draw(at:withAttributes:) 在正確位置繪製行號。執行後即成功為 UITextView 加上行號,只用了寥寥數行程式碼,是打造程式編輯器的良好起點。

deepdive.title: Example: Collapsible recipe sections
deepdive.body: 第二個範例涉及修改多段落的排版:把顯示多份食譜的 UITextView 改成可逐份摺疊、只剩標題。講者沿用上一例的三個 viewport delegate 方法,但在摺疊段落時要避免對其排版。為此讓 TextView 額外遵循 **NSTextContentStorageDelegate**,以取得 **textContentManager:shouldEnumerate** 方法來標記 textElement 是否摺疊。

deepdive.title: Collapsible sections: full TextView class
deepdive.body: 展示完整 TextView class:除三個 viewport delegate override 外,以一個 **Set<Int>**(collapsedSections)記錄段落 offset 來唯一識別各段落,並加入處理使用者點按切換的 **toggleSection** 方法。摺疊時於 **shouldEnumerate** 跳過排版,切換後則透過 viewport controller 的 delegate 呼叫 **textViewportLayoutControllerReceivedSetNeedsLayout** 觸發重新排版。NSTextContentManager 是 NSTextContentStorage 的抽象版、NSTextElement 是 NSTextParagraph 的抽象版。最終可在 UITextView 中點三角形圖示把食譜摺疊成單一標題。

deepdive.title: Text attachments and view provider reuse
deepdive.body: 退一步說明文字視圖顯示的不只是文字——還有 Messages 的行內照片與貼圖、Notes 的塗鴉與掃描,這些非文字內容稱為 **text attachment**,遵循與一般文字相同的架構。attachment 如同一般字元般存於 text storage(以 **NSTextAttachment** 物件),layout manager 遇到它時會索取對應的 **NSTextAttachmentViewProvider** 來渲染。問題在於這些物件不可變:編輯段落時所有實例都得丟棄重建,導致行內動畫在每次編輯時重啟。

deepdive.title: Text attachment view provider reuse policy
deepdive.body: 為解決動畫重啟問題,在 UITextView 新增 API:初始化後以 **register(forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** 為特定 NSTextAttachmentViewProvider 子類別註冊重用政策。第一個引數傳入 **onEditingInlineParagraphs** 政策,可在段落編輯時保留 view provider,讓按鍵不致拆除 provider;第二個引數提供 view provider 子類別型別。sample code 另展示 **onScrollingOutOfViewport** 政策(attachment 捲出畫面時快取其 rendering surface、回到畫面時還原),兩種政策可視情境組合。如此編輯時 UITextView 會重用 view provider、維持狀態、避免動畫閃爍。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結三個 UITextView 中使用 TextKit 的範例:程式編輯器的行號、食譜 app 的可摺疊段落,以及簡單文字視圖的行內 attachment 重用。建議想要便利又強大的富文字編輯體驗者,在 UIKit 以 **UITextView**、AppKit 以 **NSTextView** 起步,SwiftUI 則用 **ViewRepresentable** 納入;想要更多渲染掌控者,則以 TextKit 自建 custom text view 並善用新的 **Rendering Surface** API。並可下載 sample app 參考細節。

summary_en: Presented by Tarun Uday, an engineer on the TextKit team, this session is about combining the convenience of built-in text views with the control of **TextKit**. **TextKit** is Apple's next-generation text engine, the foundation of text layout and rendering across all platforms, used internally by SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit text controls. Developers have long faced a tension between convenience and control: one path is using a framework text view (**NSTextView**, **UITextView**, **TextEditor**), which gives text input, selection, accessibility, undo/redo, dictation, inline predictions, and more for free but limits how text is drawn; the other path is a custom text view using TextKit as the engine and rendering into your own view or layer, which gives total control but gives up all those built-in features. This session aims to get the best of both worlds.

The presenter first recaps **TextKit's four-layer architecture**: at the base is **text storage** (encapsulating all text data, with NSTextContentStorage breaking an attributed string into NSTextParagraph objects), above it the **layout** layer (NSTextLayoutManager measuring glyphs and producing immutable NSTextLayoutFragment objects), then the **viewport** layer (tracking which chunks are visible), and at the top the **view** layer. The storage, layout, and viewport layers are shared across all UI frameworks. Crucially, TextKit organizes its work around the **viewport**, rendering only the text the user can see, with the **NSTextViewportLayoutController** coordinating the layout manager and text view through a viewport layout process that repeats on every scroll, edit, or selection.

On new APIs, before the 2027 releases TextKit could track layout fragments but not the views they were drawn into. The new **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface** protocol represents a drawable visual element inside the viewport (which UIView, NSView, or CALayer can conform to), paired with **NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey** as a key that uniquely identifies a surface across viewport layout cycles (like NSTextLayoutFragment), enabling rendering surfaces to be cached in a map table or dictionary. Additionally, **UITextView and NSTextView now conform to NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate**, so you can subclass them and override delegate methods to add custom behavior.

The presenter shows three examples of extending UITextView: first, adding **line numbers** to an iPad code editor by overriding the willLayout, configureRenderingSurfaceFor, and didLayout delegate methods to collect each paragraph's bounds and convert them to viewport coordinates, using enumerateTextElements to compute the starting line number; second, **collapsible recipe sections** by additionally conforming to **NSTextContentStorageDelegate** and using shouldEnumerate to skip layout on collapsed paragraphs; third, **text attachment reuse**, solving inline animations restarting on edit by using **register(forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** with the **onEditingInlineParagraphs** and onScrollingOutOfViewport reuse policies to preserve view providers and their state across edits and scrolling. The closing advice: for a convenient yet powerful experience start with UITextView/NSTextView (or a ViewRepresentable in SwiftUI), and for more control build a custom text view with the new Rendering Surface APIs.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Engineer **Tarun Uday** from the TextKit team opens by noting **TextKit** is Apple's next-generation text engine across all platforms and the foundation of layout and rendering for SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit text controls. He names the long-standing tension between convenience and control: one path uses a framework text view (**NSTextView**, **UITextView**, **TextEditor**) for free input, selection, accessibility, undo/redo, dictation, and inline predictions but with limited drawing customization; the other builds a custom text view with TextKit as the engine for total control but must build a production-quality editing experience from scratch. The session aims to get the best of both.

deepdive_en.title: TextKit architecture
deepdive_en.body: Recaps the key to a great custom text experience — **TextKit's four-layer architecture**. At the base is the **text storage** layer (encapsulating all text data to render), above it the **layout** layer (breaking text into chunks), then the **viewport** layer (tracking which chunks are visible), and at the top the **view** layer (where text appears in your app). The storage, layout, and viewport layers are shared across all UI frameworks, letting you render text on any view or view-like drawable element. The presenter walks through each layer using the example of rendering a long NSAttributedString.

deepdive_en.title: What's new in TextKit
deepdive_en.body: After recapping the architecture, the talk turns to the new APIs introduced in the 2027 TextKit. The key gap being filled: previously TextKit could track layout fragments but had no way to refer to the destination views where text is rendered across TextKit. The rendering surface APIs introduced next exist precisely to address this.

deepdive_en.title: NSTextViewportRenderingSurface conformance
deepdive_en.body: Introduces the new **NSTextViewportRenderingSurface** protocol, representing a visual element inside the viewport you can draw into — the view that actually renders a layout fragment's text — providing a common abstraction. You can conform your **UIView, NSView, or CALayer** to it and use it in the viewport controller's delegate methods to track which views are visible in the viewport.

deepdive_en.title: NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey and NSMapTable
deepdive_en.body: Explains the companion **NSTextViewportRenderingSurfaceKey** protocol: any class that can uniquely identify a rendering surface across viewport layout process cycles (like **NSTextLayoutFragment**) can serve as a key, so you can use a layout fragment as a key to cache rendering surfaces in an **NSMapTable** or dictionary. The viewport layout process uses this key-to-surface mapping extensively internally; you can assign a surface during layout via the renderingSurfaceFor delegate method (cleared at the start of each process) and query it during didLayout via the viewport controller's renderingSurfaceFor method.

deepdive_en.title: Extending framework text views
deepdive_en.body: Turns to how the framework text views powering Apple's default text experiences work. **UITextView** and **NSTextView** power thousands of long-form text experiences on Apple's platforms, including Messages, TextEdit, Notes, and Journal. The talk will next demonstrate how to extend these views through their TextKit hooks.

deepdive_en.title: UITextView/NSTextView in SwiftUI via ViewRepresentable
deepdive_en.body: Explains that in a SwiftUI app the most convenient long-form text experience is **TextEditor**, but you can also include a UITextView or NSTextView via a **ViewRepresentable**. The presenter creates a view called MyTextView, populating its body with a TextViewRepresentable that conditionally compiles as an **NSViewRepresentable** on macOS (returning NSTextView in makeNSView) and a **UIViewRepresentable** otherwise (returning UITextView in makeUIView).

deepdive_en.title: Example: Code editor with line numbers
deepdive_en.body: First example: building an iPad code editor for quick coding away from the Mac. The presenter starts with a **UITextView** subclass, initializing it and setting its font to the **monospacedSystemFont**. But without line numbers it isn't a great code editor experience, so the next step is to start building line number support.

deepdive_en.title: ContainerView with TextView and line number view
deepdive_en.body: Creates a view called **ContainerView** to hold both the TextView and a lineNumberView — the former a UITextView subclass, the latter a UIView for displaying line numbers. The goal is to recompute and show the NSTextParagraph index for the layout fragments in the viewport whenever the viewport changes, which requires the text view to be notified whenever its viewport controller completes a viewport layout process.

deepdive_en.title: Three NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate overrides
deepdive_en.body: Announces the key change: starting with the 2027 releases, **UITextView and NSTextView now conform to NSTextViewportLayoutControllerDelegate**, so you can subclass them and override the delegate methods to add custom behavior. The presenter overrides three methods: **willLayout** for setup (clearing lines and computing the starting line number), **configureRenderingSurfaceFor** to capture the bounds of paragraphs to be rendered (via layoutFragmentFrame), and **didLayout** to share accumulated info back to the ContainerView for drawing line numbers. Each must call super first. The subclass adds state: a lines array, a startingLineNumber integer, and a closure.

deepdive_en.title: startingLineNumber(for:) using enumerateTextElements
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates computing the starting line number in its own function — essentially a count of all paragraphs before the viewport starts. After nil checks, it gets the textContentManager cast to **NSTextContentStorage**, then enumerates elements from the documentRange location via **enumerateTextElements**, incrementing the count until an element's range is no longer ordered before the viewportRange location. The presenter notes the sample code improves this with caching so you don't pay this cost on every layout pass.

deepdive_en.title: DidLayout: convert frames to viewport coordinates
deepdive_en.body: In **didLayout**, with the bounds of every paragraph in the viewport now in hand, the info is passed to the ContainerView. Before firing the closure, the fragment frames must be converted from text container coordinates to viewport coordinates — done by subtracting the **viewportBounds.origin** (offsetting by -origin.y). Then the starting line number and adjusted frames are passed to the ContainerView.

deepdive_en.title: Draw line numbers in ContainerView closure
deepdive_en.body: Back in the **ContainerView**, the closure is set: for each frame, the actual line number is computed by adding the index to the starting line number, then drawn at the right position using configured attributes (monospacedSystemFont, secondaryLabel color) via NSString's draw(at:withAttributes:). Running the app successfully adds line numbers to a UITextView with just a few lines of code — a great first step toward building a code editor.

deepdive_en.title: Example: Collapsible recipe sections
deepdive_en.body: The second example involves modifying layout across multiple paragraphs: turning a UITextView showing several recipes into one that collapses each into just its heading. The presenter reuses the three viewport delegate methods from the last example but adds the goal of avoiding layout on collapsed paragraphs. To do this, the TextView additionally conforms to **NSTextContentStorageDelegate** to gain the **textContentManager:shouldEnumerate** method for marking text elements as collapsed or not.

deepdive_en.title: Collapsible sections: full TextView class
deepdive_en.body: Shows the full TextView class: beyond the three viewport delegate overrides, it uses a **Set<Int>** (collapsedSections) of paragraph offsets to uniquely identify each paragraph and adds a **toggleSection** method to handle user taps. Layout is skipped in **shouldEnumerate** for collapsed paragraphs, and after toggling, relayout is triggered via the viewport controller's delegate calling **textViewportLayoutControllerReceivedSetNeedsLayout**. NSTextContentManager is the abstract version of NSTextContentStorage, and NSTextElement of NSTextParagraph. The result lets you tap a triangle to collapse any recipe into just its heading, right in UITextView.

deepdive_en.title: Text attachments and view provider reuse
deepdive_en.body: Steps back to note text views display much more than text — Messages' inline photos and stickers, Notes' drawings and scans — non-text content called **text attachments** that follow the same architecture as regular text. An attachment is stored in text storage like any character (as an **NSTextAttachment** object), and when the layout manager encounters it, it asks for the corresponding **NSTextAttachmentViewProvider** to render it. The challenge: because these objects are immutable, editing a paragraph discards and recreates all instances, causing inline animations to restart on every edit.

deepdive_en.title: Text attachment view provider reuse policy
deepdive_en.body: To solve the animation restart, a new API is added on UITextView: after initialization, **register(forTextAttachmentViewProviderType:)** registers a reuse policy for a particular NSTextAttachmentViewProvider subclass. The first argument takes the **onEditingInlineParagraphs** policy, preserving the view provider across paragraph edits so keystrokes don't tear it down; the second provides the view provider subclass type. The sample code shows a second policy, **onScrollingOutOfViewport** (caching the attachment's rendering surface when it scrolls off screen and restoring it on return), and the two can be combined. Now on editing, UITextView reuses the view provider, maintaining state and avoiding animation glitches.

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Recaps the three examples of using TextKit in UITextView: line numbers for a code editor, collapsible sections in a recipe app, and inline text attachment reuse in a simple text view. The advice: for a convenient but powerful rich text editor experience, start with **UITextView** on UIKit and **NSTextView** on AppKit, and use a **ViewRepresentable** to include these in a SwiftUI app; for those wanting much more control over rendering, build custom text views with TextKit and the new **Rendering Surface** APIs. A sample app is available to explore the details.

title: Unwrap PaperKit
gloss: 深入了解 PaperKit
takeaway: 用 PaperKit 全新的資料模型 API 以程式存取、建立與修改畫布上的 markup 元素，並結合 adornments 與 Image Playground 打造互動式畫布應用。

points.text: **PaperKit** 推出全新的**資料模型 API**，可用程式存取、建立與修改畫布上的 markup 元素（`PaperMarkup`、`MarkupOrderedSet`）。
可建立 `ShapeMarkup` 等 subelement，並用 `allowedInteractions = .readOnly` 把模板元素設為唯讀。
用 **adornments**（`MarkupAdornment`）在畫布上加入可點擊的浮動按鈕，並透過 delegate 處理點擊事件。
結合 **Image Playground**（`ImagePlaygroundViewController`）產生圖片，再以 `ImageMarkup` 放置到對應面板中。

audience: **開發畫布、繪圖、筆記或標註類 App，想以程式控制 PaperKit 內容的開發者**。
gloss_en: Unwrap PaperKit
takeaway_en: Use PaperKit's new data model APIs to programmatically access, create, and modify markup elements on the canvas, combining adornments and Image Playground to build interactive canvas apps.

points_en.text: **PaperKit** introduces new **data model APIs** to programmatically access, create, and modify markup elements on the canvas (`PaperMarkup`, `MarkupOrderedSet`).
You can create subelements like `ShapeMarkup` and use `allowedInteractions = .readOnly` to make template elements read-only.
Use **adornments** (`MarkupAdornment`) to add tappable floating buttons on the canvas, handling tap events through a delegate.
Combine with **Image Playground** (`ImagePlaygroundViewController`) to generate images, then place them into the corresponding panel with `ImageMarkup`.

audience_en: **Developers building canvas, drawing, note-taking, or markup apps who want to control PaperKit content programmatically**.
summary: 這場由 Pencil and Paper 團隊的工程師 Matt 主講，主題是「解開（unwrap）」**PaperKit**——也就是驅動 Apple 自家眾多畫布體驗的框架：Notes 的塗鴉與標記、Preview 中替 PDF 加簽名與螢光標記、macOS Freeform 的構思畫布，背後都是 PaperKit，整合了 pencil、shapes、text 與 images。在 iOS、macOS 與 visionOS 27，PaperKit 進一步開放，讓開發者能完全掌控自己的畫布體驗。講者以自製的漫畫編輯器為貫穿範例，依序帶過三大主題：資料模型、元素（elements），以及 adornments。

第一是**資料模型**。`PaperMarkup` 新增了 **`subelements`** 屬性，以 **`MarkupOrderedSet`**（可讀可寫的有序集合）暴露畫布上的每個元素。範例為每個漫畫格建立一個 **`ShapeMarkup`** 並寫回 markup。但預設畫布完全可互動——使用者能選取、拖曳甚至刪除範本格子，這並非所求。每個元素都遵循 **Markup** protocol，提供 frame、rotation 等共通屬性，並新增 **`allowedInteractions`**（一個 **`MarkupInteractions`** option set），可細緻控制移動／縮放／旋轉、刪除、styling、選取等行為；要一次鎖死全部就用 **`.readOnly`**，正好讓漫畫範本固定不動。

第二是**元素**。PaperMarkup 中每個元素都有具體型別——shapes、images、links、loupes、pencil strokes——同屬一個 ordered set 並遵循 Markup protocol，但各自有自訂屬性，例如 rounded rectangle 的 corner radius、curved line 的 control points。範例用 rectangle 當漫畫格，藉由迭代 subelements 設定 `strokeColor` 與 `fillColor`（並把同色套到 markup 背景）來實作色彩 styling。由於 PaperKit 建構在 **PencilKit** 之上，可用 Apple Pencil 繪製，每一筆都是 markup 元素，並可使用 PencilKit 的 model API（現支援字元辨識與 Bézier path 轉換）。

第三是 **adornments**。講者想替每格加上「建立圖稿」的按鈕，但不希望這些控制項成為文件的一部分、被儲存或匯出。**`MarkupAdornment`** 正是錨定在畫布座標的視覺覆蓋層，會自動隨 zoom 與 scroll 追蹤，且與持久化的 markup 完全分離,非常適合按鈕、註解與協作 UI。範例為每格建立錨定中心的 adornment、用 SF Symbol 當圖示，實作 delegate 的 **`didTapAdornmentWithID`**，點擊時呈現 **`ImagePlaygroundViewController`**；當 Image Playground 回傳影像時建立 **`ImageMarkup`** 插入 subelements 並更新畫布。最終以資料模型程式化讀寫畫布內容、用 adornments 加上量身打造的互動覆蓋層，就能在 app 中打造完整互動的畫布體驗。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 由 Pencil and Paper 團隊工程師 Matt 開場，說明 **PaperKit** 驅動了 Apple 自家眾多畫布體驗：Notes 的塗鴉與標記、Preview 替 PDF 加簽名與螢光標記、macOS Freeform 的構思，整合了 pencil、shapes、text、images。在 **iOS、macOS 與 visionOS 27** PaperKit 進一步開放，本場將依序示範資料模型、elements 與 adornments 三大主題。

deepdive.title: Data model
deepdive.body: 進入資料模型主題：`PaperMarkup` 新增 **`subelements`** 屬性，以 **`MarkupOrderedSet`**（可讀寫的有序集合）暴露畫布上的每個元素。講者以自製漫畫編輯器為例，已備好基本範本，接下來要把這些範本轉成 PaperMarkup。

deepdive.title: Creating markup subelements
deepdive.body: 示範如何為每個漫畫格建立元素：程式碼為每個 panel frame 建立一個 **`ShapeMarkup`**、append 進 `subelements`，再寫回 markup。在 iPad 上加入三頁版面後，畫格如預期顯示，且畫布完全可互動——這也埋下下一節要解決的問題。

deepdive.title: Making template elements read-only
deepdive.body: 點出問題：預設畫布可互動，使用者能選取、拖曳甚至刪除範本格子。每個元素遵循 **Markup** protocol（提供 frame、rotation 等），並新增 **`allowedInteractions`**（一個 **`MarkupInteractions`** option set）細緻控制移動／縮放／旋轉、刪除、styling、選取；用 **`.readOnly`** 可一次鎖死全部，讓範本格子固定，但仍能新增、移動與美化 speech bubble。

deepdive.title: Elements
deepdive.body: 說明 PaperMarkup 中每個元素都有具體型別——shapes、images、links、loupes、pencil strokes——同屬一個 ordered set 並遵循 Markup protocol，但各自有自訂屬性。以 shapes 為例，不同 shape 型別有各自屬性，例如 rounded rectangle 的 corner radius 或 curved line 的 control points;漫畫格用的 rectangle 具有 stroke color，正是 styling 要操作的對象。

deepdive.title: Apply style to template elements
deepdive.body: 示範色彩 styling 的實作：迭代 `subelements`、把每個元素的 `strokeColor` 與 `fillColor` 設為選取的顏色（fill 用 0.15 alpha），並把同色套到 markup 的 `backgroundColor` 讓畫面更有整體感，最後更新 `paperMarkupViewController.markup`。並補充 PaperKit 建構在 **PencilKit** 之上，可用 Apple Pencil 繪製、每筆皆為 markup 元素,且支援 PencilKit 的字元辨識與 Bézier path 轉換。

deepdive.title: Adornments
deepdive.body: 進入 adornments 主題：講者想替每格加上建立圖稿的按鈕，但不希望這些控制項成為文件、被儲存或匯出。**`MarkupAdornment`** 是錨定在畫布座標的視覺覆蓋層，會自動隨 zoom 與 scroll 追蹤、與持久化 markup 完全分離,非常適合按鈕、註解與協作 UI。

deepdive.title: Add adornments to each panel
deepdive.body: 示範如何為每格建立 **`MarkupAdornment`**：錨定到 panel 中心、透過 `imageConfiguration` 給一個 SF Symbol 圖示（`photo.badge.plus`），並設定 `dragRegion` 與 `scalesWithZoom`,再把陣列指派給 controller 的 `adornments` 屬性。同時用字典記錄 adornment id 與 panel index 的對應。

deepdive.title: Handle adornment taps
deepdive.body: 示範點擊處理：實作 delegate 方法 **`didTapAdornmentWithID`**，從對應字典取得被點的 panel index，建立並呈現 **`ImagePlaygroundViewController`**（設定 delegate 為自己），讓使用者為該格產生圖稿。

deepdive.title: Place the generated image
deepdive.body: 當 Image Playground 回傳影像時，於 `didCreateImageAt` 取得影像、以該格的 frame 建立 **`ImageMarkup`**，append 進 `markup.subelements` 並更新 view controller 的 markup，讓生成的圖填滿畫格。講者藉此完成漫畫第一頁（超級英雄狗狗的故事）。

deepdive.title: Next steps
deepdive.body: 總結：現在可用 PaperKit 在 app 中打造完整互動的畫布體驗——用**資料模型**程式化讀寫畫布內容、用 **adornments** 建立量身打造的互動覆蓋層。鼓勵開發者動手 unwrap PaperKit。

summary_en: Presented by Matt, an engineer on the Pencil and Paper team, this session shows how to 'unwrap' **PaperKit**—the framework powering many of Apple's own canvas experiences: sketching and markup in Notes, signing and highlighting PDFs in Preview, and ideating on the Freeform canvas on macOS, all combining pencil, shapes, text, and images. In iOS, macOS, and visionOS 27, PaperKit opens up so developers can take full control of their own canvas experience. Using a homemade comic book editor as the running example, Matt walks through three topics in turn: the data model, elements, and adornments.

First is the **data model**. `PaperMarkup` gains a new **`subelements`** property that exposes every element on the canvas as a **`MarkupOrderedSet`**, an ordered collection you can read from and write to. The example creates a **`ShapeMarkup`** for each comic panel and writes the markup back. But by default the canvas is fully interactive—users can select, drag, and even delete the template panels, which isn't desired. Every element conforms to the **Markup** protocol, which provides common properties like frame and rotation, plus a new **`allowedInteractions`** property (a **`MarkupInteractions`** option set) for fine-grained control over moving/resizing/rotating, deleting, styling, and selecting; to lock everything at once you use **`.readOnly`**, which keeps the comic template fixed.

Second are **elements**. Every element in PaperMarkup has a concrete type—shapes, images, links, loupes, and pencil strokes—all part of the same ordered set and conforming to the Markup protocol, yet each with its own custom properties such as corner radius for rounded rectangles or control points for curved lines. The example uses rectangles for the panels and implements color styling by iterating over subelements to set `strokeColor` and `fillColor` (and applying the same color to the markup background). Because PaperKit is built on **PencilKit**, you can draw with Apple Pencil, where each stroke becomes a markup element and you can use the PencilKit model APIs—which now support character recognition and Bézier path conversion.

Third are **adornments**. Matt wants a button on each panel for creating artwork, but doesn't want those controls to become part of the document, saved or exported. A **`MarkupAdornment`** is a visual overlay anchored to canvas coordinates that automatically tracks zoom and scroll and is completely separate from the persisted markup—ideal for buttons, annotations, and collaboration UI. The example creates an adornment anchored to each panel's center with an SF Symbol icon, implements the delegate's **`didTapAdornmentWithID`** to present an **`ImagePlaygroundViewController`** on tap, and when Image Playground returns an image, creates an **`ImageMarkup`**, inserts it into subelements, and updates the canvas. The result: read and modify the canvas programmatically via the data model and add tailored interactive overlays with adornments to build a fully interactive canvas experience.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Matt, an engineer on the Pencil and Paper team, opens by explaining that **PaperKit** powers many of Apple's own canvas experiences: sketching and markup in Notes, signing and highlighting PDFs in Preview, and ideating in Freeform on macOS, combining pencil, shapes, text, and images. In **iOS, macOS, and visionOS 27** PaperKit opens up, and this session will walk through three topics in order: the data model, elements, and adornments.

deepdive_en.title: Data model
deepdive_en.body: Enters the data model: `PaperMarkup` gains a new **`subelements`** property that exposes every element on the canvas as a **`MarkupOrderedSet`**, a read/write ordered collection. Matt uses a homemade comic book editor with basic templates already set up, and now needs to turn those templates into PaperMarkup.

deepdive_en.title: Creating markup subelements
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates creating an element per panel: the code makes a **`ShapeMarkup`** for each panel frame, appends it to `subelements`, and writes the markup back. After adding a three-page layout on iPad, the panels show up as intended and the canvas is fully interactive—which sets up the problem solved in the next chapter.

deepdive_en.title: Making template elements read-only
deepdive_en.body: Identifies the problem: by default the canvas is interactive, so users can select, drag, and even delete the template panels. Every element conforms to the **Markup** protocol (frame, rotation, etc.) and gains a new **`allowedInteractions`** property (a **`MarkupInteractions`** option set) for fine control over moving/resizing/rotating, deleting, styling, and selecting; **`.readOnly`** locks everything at once, keeping panels fixed while still allowing a speech bubble to be added, moved, and stylized.

deepdive_en.title: Elements
deepdive_en.body: Explains that every element in PaperMarkup has a concrete type—shapes, images, links, loupes, and pencil strokes—all part of the same ordered set and conforming to the Markup protocol, yet each with its own custom properties. Taking shapes as an example, different shape types have their own properties such as corner radius for rounded rectangles or control points for curved lines; the rectangles used for the comic panels have a stroke color, which is exactly what styling will target.

deepdive_en.title: Apply style to template elements
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates color styling: iterate over `subelements`, set each element's `strokeColor` and `fillColor` to the chosen color (fill at 0.15 alpha), apply the same color to the markup's `backgroundColor` for a cohesive look, then update `paperMarkupViewController.markup`. Also notes that PaperKit is built on **PencilKit**, so Apple Pencil drawing works—each stroke is a markup element—and the PencilKit model APIs now support character recognition and Bézier path conversion.

deepdive_en.title: Adornments
deepdive_en.body: Enters adornments: Matt wants a button on each panel to create artwork, but doesn't want those controls to become part of the document, saved or exported. A **`MarkupAdornment`** is a visual overlay anchored to canvas coordinates that automatically tracks zoom and scroll and is completely separate from the persisted markup—ideal for buttons, annotations, and collaboration UI.

deepdive_en.title: Add adornments to each panel
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates creating a **`MarkupAdornment`** per panel: anchor it to the panel center, give it an SF Symbol icon via `imageConfiguration` (`photo.badge.plus`), set `dragRegion` and `scalesWithZoom`, then assign the array to the controller's `adornments` property. A dictionary also records the mapping from adornment id to panel index.

deepdive_en.title: Handle adornment taps
deepdive_en.body: Demonstrates tap handling: implement the delegate method **`didTapAdornmentWithID`**, look up the tapped panel index from the mapping dictionary, then create and present an **`ImagePlaygroundViewController`** (with self as delegate) so the user can generate artwork for that panel.

deepdive_en.title: Place the generated image
deepdive_en.body: When Image Playground returns an image, the `didCreateImageAt` callback grabs the image, creates an **`ImageMarkup`** with that panel's frame, appends it to `markup.subelements`, and updates the view controller's markup so the generated image fills the panel. Matt uses this to complete the first page of his comic (a super hero dog story).

deepdive_en.title: Next steps
deepdive_en.body: Wraps up: you can now build a fully interactive, canvas-based experience in your app with PaperKit—use the **data model** to read and modify the canvas programmatically, and add **adornments** to create interactive overlays tailored to your app. Matt encourages developers to go unwrap PaperKit.

title: Create high-quality images using Image Playground
gloss: 用 Image Playground 產生高品質影像
takeaway: 用 **Image Playground** 在 App 中產生高品質影像，新模型運行於 Private Cloud Compute，並可透過 concepts、參考相片與樣式客製化。
chapters: Add Image Playground sheet with binding to @State
Seeding the sheet with context from your card
Providing a visual suggestion using a drawing
Adopt Image Playground in UIKit or AppKit
Generating an expressive icon for the card thumbnail
Disabling personalization when it doesn't fit your context

points.text: 新的生成式模型運行於 **Private Cloud Compute**，可產出更高品質的影像。
在 SwiftUI 用 **`imagePlaygroundSheet`** 綁定 `@State` 呈現；UIKit／AppKit 則用 `ImagePlaygroundViewController`。
用 `ImagePlaygroundConcept`（`.text`、`.extracted`、`.drawing`）與 `sourceImage` 以情境、參考相片或塗鴉引導生成。
以 `ImagePlaygroundOptions` 設定尺寸（`sizeSpecification`）與樣式（`imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle`，含 `.emoji`、`.externalProvider`），並可關閉個人化。
用 `@Environment(\.supportsImageGeneration)` 檢查裝置是否支援影像生成，再決定提供哪種 UI。

audience: **想在 App 中加入生成式影像建立功能**的 SwiftUI 或 UIKit 開發者。
gloss_en: Create high-quality images using Image Playground
takeaway_en: Use **Image Playground** to create high-quality images in your app, with a new model running on Private Cloud Compute and customization via concepts, reference photos, and styles.

points_en.text: A new generative model runs on **Private Cloud Compute** to produce higher-quality images.
In SwiftUI, present it with **`imagePlaygroundSheet`** bound to `@State`; in UIKit/AppKit, use `ImagePlaygroundViewController`.
Guide generation by context, reference photo, or sketch using `ImagePlaygroundConcept` (`.text`, `.extracted`, `.drawing`) and `sourceImage`.
Set size (`sizeSpecification`) and style (`imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle`, including `.emoji` and `.externalProvider`) with `ImagePlaygroundOptions`, and optionally disable personalization.
Check whether the device supports image generation with `@Environment(\.supportsImageGeneration)` before deciding which UI to offer.

audience_en: SwiftUI or UIKit developers who want to **add generative image creation to their app**.
summary: 本場由 Image Playground 團隊的工程師 Antonio 主講，介紹如何把 **Image Playground** 的完整體驗帶進你自己的 app。今年 Apple 以更強大的影像模型重新打造了體驗，能在幾乎任何風格下生成高品質影像，甚至包含逼真的 **photorealistic** 照片級結果。所有運算都跑在 **Private Cloud Compute** 上，Apple 隱私保護的雲端基礎設施，使用者資料不會被儲存或分享，連 Apple 也看不到。由於改用伺服器模型，原本的非 UI API **ImageCreator** 已被 deprecated，取而代之的是一套品質更高、內建隱私且提供完整使用者體驗的新 API。

採用方式極為簡單：在 SwiftUI 中只需對按鈕加上 **.imagePlaygroundSheet** 修飾器，並綁定一個 @State 布林值即可叫出 sheet，完成後 completion closure 會回傳一個指向 app 容器內暫存檔的 **URL**(需自行另存)。你可以用 **ImagePlaygroundConcept** 的 .text 與 .extracted 工廠方法把 app 情境(如卡片主題與訊息)注入 sheet,也能傳入 **sourceImage** 作為視覺靈感,或透過 PencilKit 的 **PKDrawing** 以 .drawing 概念提供構圖建議。UIKit/AppKit 則使用對應的 **ImagePlaygroundViewController** 取得相同體驗。

在設定方面,**ImagePlaygroundOptions** 與 **ImagePlaygroundStyle** 可管理尺寸、長寬比、可選與預設風格,以及個人化。尺寸用 .closest(to:) 讓系統對應到最接近的支援解析度;風格透過 **imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle** 指定預設值與允許清單(如 illustration、sketch、animation、emoji),其中 **externalProvider** 是選擇加入的第三方供應商風格(例如 ChatGPT)。emoji 風格會改觸發 onAdaptiveImageGlyphCreation 並回傳可內嵌於文字的 **NSAdaptiveImageGlyph**。

Image Playground 由於依賴強大的伺服器模型而有用量限制,但這完全不需開發者操心:沒有伺服器要架設、沒有用量 UI 要做,系統會代為管理,部分 iCloud+ 方案還能提升額度。最後在可用性處理上,只要讀取 **supportsImageGeneration** 這個環境值,即可在裝置支援 Apple Intelligence、語言地區受支援且使用者已啟用時顯示完整體驗,否則優雅地退回到一般的 Photos 選擇器,無需任何 entitlement 或額外檢查。

deepdive.title: Introduction
deepdive.body: 工程師 **Antonio** 開場說明人們已在 Messages、Freeform 與各類 app 中使用 **Image Playground** 創作影像。今年以更強大的影像模型重新打造,能在幾乎任何風格下生成高品質、甚至 **photorealistic** 的影像。**ImagePlayground.framework** 把同樣的模型、風格與品質直接帶進你的 app,支援 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 上具備 **Apple Intelligence** 的裝置。

deepdive.title: Capabilities
deepdive.body: 模型可依文字描述生成對應影像,描述可具體可開放(如「生日派對有狗、氣球與彩帶」或單純「慶祝」)。啟用 **personalization** 後,使用者可從 Photos 帶入人物或以文字描述外貌,讓結果更具個人感。風格涵蓋 animation、illustration、sketch 與 **Genmoji**,並支援橫向、直向、方形等多種尺寸與長寬比;所有運算皆跑在 **Private Cloud Compute**,資料不被儲存或分享。

deepdive.title: Adopt Image Playground
deepdive.body: 講者以自製的 **Postcards** 賀卡 app 為示範情境,卡片正面的客製藝術圖正是 Image Playground 的切入點。採用無需 SDK 初始化、API key 或伺服器端點,一切從單一 view modifier 開始。由於模型移至伺服器,非 UI 的 **ImageCreator** 已被 deprecated,改用提供完整體驗的新 API。

deepdive.title: Adopt Image Playground in SwiftUI
deepdive.body: 在 SwiftUI 中對按鈕加上 **.imagePlaygroundSheet** 修飾器即可採用,sheet 會處理 UI、模型互動與風格選擇器。當使用者接受影像,completion closure 會收到一個指向檔案的 **URL**。

deepdive.title: Add Image Playground sheet with binding to @State
deepdive.body: 以綁定到 **@State** 布林值的方式呈現 sheet:當綁定翻為 true 時 sheet 出現。回傳的 URL 指向 app 容器內的暫存位置,務必在 session 結束前另存到別處,之後即可顯示這張生成影像。

deepdive.title: Seeding the sheet with context from your card
deepdive.body: sheet 可空白開啟,也能用 app 情境預先填入以獲得更豐富的起點。**ImagePlaygroundConcept** 提供 .text(包裝直接描述,如卡片主題 cherry blossoms)與 .extracted(從較長文字如卡片訊息中萃取最相關概念)兩個工廠方法,讓 sheet 一開啟就針對該卡片做好準備。

deepdive.title: Starting from a reference photo
deepdive.body: 可透過 **sourceImage** 參數傳入任一 SwiftUI Image(使用者選的照片或卡片既有影像),Image Playground 會將其與 concepts 一起作為視覺靈感。使用者仍能在 sheet 內替換或調整,它是起點而非限制。

deepdive.title: Providing a visual suggestion using a drawing
deepdive.body: 在 iPad 上 Postcards 於卡片正面下方顯示小畫布。**ImagePlaygroundConcept.drawing** 接受 PencilKit 的 **PKDrawing** 並作為 concept 加入,模型把筆畫視為視覺建議來引導構圖而不鎖死。

deepdive.title: Adopt Image Playground in UIKit or AppKit
deepdive.body: UIKit 或 AppKit app 可用 **ImagePlaygroundViewController** 取得相同體驗:呈現前先設定 concepts 與 options 屬性,再於 delegate 實作 imagePlaygroundViewController(_:didCreateImageAt:) 接收結果。整體 API 與 SwiftUI 版本對應一致。

deepdive.title: Options
deepdive.body: **ImagePlaygroundOptions** 與 **ImagePlaygroundStyle** 用來管理設定:尺寸與長寬比、可用與預選的風格,以及個人化。無論是生成卡片藝術圖、鎖定畫面桌布、橫幅或 Genmoji 圖示,同一套 API 都能適配。

deepdive.title: Size Specification
deepdive.body: Postcards 支援橫向、直向、方形三種卡片格式,各自儲存一個 CGSize,直接傳給 **.closest(to:)**,系統便會對應到最接近的支援長寬比與解析度。由於格式是卡片的屬性,尺寸請求會自動隨之調整,透過 **.imagePlaygroundOptions** 傳入 sheet。

deepdive.title: Styles
deepdive.body: **imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle** 接受兩個參數:選擇器開啟時的預設風格,以及限制可見風格的允許清單(如 illustration、sketch、animation、emoji)。若允許清單只給單一風格,選擇器會鎖定在該風格。Postcards 中每張卡片帶有 **StylePreset** 對應這些值,選擇器會自動反映當前開啟的卡片。

deepdive.title: External Provider Style
deepdive.body: **externalProvider** 是選擇加入的風格,會帶出使用者在設定中配置的第三方供應商(例如 **ChatGPT**)。只要把它附加到 .allowedStyles 清單即可提供;若使用者已配置供應商,該分頁就會出現,若未配置則由系統處理設定,開發者無需自行檢查,也可將其設為預設風格。

deepdive.title: Generating an expressive icon for the card thumbnail
deepdive.body: **ImagePlaygroundStyle.emoji** 專為 emoji 尺度的表情角色調校。啟用時 sheet 會改觸發 **onAdaptiveImageGlyphCreation**,交給你一個 **NSAdaptiveImageGlyph** 而非 URL。這種自適應影像字符可像 emoji 一樣內嵌於文字中,正適合顯示在收件人名稱旁的卡片縮圖。

deepdive.title: Disabling personalization when it doesn't fit your context
deepdive.body: 個人化預設為啟用,可讓人從 Photos 帶入人物,使賀卡更具個人感。若你的情境不需要(如產品圖生成器),可將 **options.personalization** 設為 .disabled,人物選擇器與名稱偵測就會從 sheet 中完全消失。

deepdive.title: Availability
deepdive.body: Image Playground 在支援 **Apple Intelligence** 的裝置、受支援的語言與地區,且使用者已於設定中啟用影像生成時可用。透過 **supportsImageGeneration** 環境值即可判斷:為 true 時導向完整的 CardEditorView,為 false 時導向 CardPickerView 的 Photos 選擇器後備方案,無需 entitlement 或額外能力檢查。

deepdive.title: Supports image generation
deepdive.body: 以 **@Environment(\.supportsImageGeneration)** 讀取單一環境值即可乾淨地支援兩條路徑。講者最後鼓勵開發者思考影像在自家設計中的位置,以及只有你的 app 才知道的關係、回憶與情境,把這些帶入畫面,讓結果真正為特定的人而生成。Image Playground 提供模型,你提供故事。

summary_en: Presented by Antonio, an engineer on the Image Playground team, this session shows how to bring the full **Image Playground** experience into your own app. This year Apple rebuilt the experience around powerful image models that can generate high-quality images in virtually any style, including genuinely true-to-life **photorealistic** results. Everything runs on **Private Cloud Compute**, Apple's privacy-preserving cloud infrastructure, where user data is never stored or shared, even with Apple. Because it moved to server models, the old non-UI **ImageCreator** API is deprecated in favor of a new API with greater image quality, built-in privacy, and a complete user experience.

Adoption is remarkably simple: in SwiftUI you just add the **.imagePlaygroundSheet** modifier to a button with a binding to a @State boolean to present the sheet, and the completion closure returns a **URL** to a temporary file inside your app container (save it elsewhere yourself). You can seed the sheet with app context using **ImagePlaygroundConcept**'s .text and .extracted factory methods (e.g. a card's theme and message), pass a **sourceImage** for visual inspiration, or supply composition hints via PencilKit's **PKDrawing** as a .drawing concept. UIKit/AppKit uses the matching **ImagePlaygroundViewController** for the same experience.

For configuration, **ImagePlaygroundOptions** and **ImagePlaygroundStyle** manage size, aspect ratio, available and default styles, and personalization. Size uses .closest(to:) so the system maps to the nearest supported resolution; styles are set via **imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle** with a default and an allowed list (illustration, sketch, animation, emoji), where **externalProvider** is an opt-in third-party provider style (e.g. ChatGPT). The emoji style instead fires onAdaptiveImageGlyphCreation and returns an **NSAdaptiveImageGlyph** you can embed inline with text.

Because it relies on powerful server models, Image Playground has a usage limit, but none of this is the developer's problem: there's no server to provision and no usage UI to build, the system manages it, and most iCloud+ plans raise the limit. Finally, for availability you only need to read the **supportsImageGeneration** environment value, which is true when the device supports Apple Intelligence, the language and region are supported, and the user has it enabled; otherwise you fall back gracefully to a Photos picker, with no entitlement or extra check required.

deepdive_en.title: Introduction
deepdive_en.body: Engineer **Antonio** opens by noting people already create images with **Image Playground** in Messages, Freeform, and apps. This year it was rebuilt around more powerful image models that produce high-quality, even **photorealistic** images in virtually any style. **ImagePlayground.framework** brings the same models, styles, and quality directly into your app across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS on devices with **Apple Intelligence**.

deepdive_en.title: Capabilities
deepdive_en.body: The model creates an image from a text description, which can be specific or open-ended (e.g. "a birthday celebration with dogs, balloons and confetti" or just "celebration"). With **personalization** enabled, users can bring in someone from Photos or describe an appearance in text for a personal result. Styles include animation, illustration, sketch, and **Genmoji**, with multiple sizes and aspect ratios; all of it runs on **Private Cloud Compute** with no data stored or shared.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt Image Playground
deepdive_en.body: The presenter uses a self-built greeting-card app, **Postcards**, as the demo context, where custom front artwork is where Image Playground fits in. Adoption needs no SDK initialization, API keys, or server endpoints and starts with a single view modifier. Because the models moved to the server, the non-UI **ImageCreator** is deprecated in favor of the new full-experience API.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt Image Playground in SwiftUI
deepdive_en.body: In SwiftUI you adopt it by adding the **.imagePlaygroundSheet** modifier to a button, and the sheet handles the UI, model interaction, and style picker. When someone accepts an image, the completion closure receives a **URL** to the generated file.

deepdive_en.title: Add Image Playground sheet with binding to @State
deepdive_en.body: The sheet is presented via a binding to a **@State** boolean: when the binding flips to true, the sheet appears. The returned URL points to a temporary location inside the app container, so save it elsewhere before the session ends, then display the generated image.

deepdive_en.title: Seeding the sheet with context from your card
deepdive_en.body: The sheet can open empty or be seeded with app context for a richer start. **ImagePlaygroundConcept** offers .text (wrapping a direct description like the card theme "cherry blossoms") and .extracted (pulling the most relevant ideas from longer text like the card message), so the sheet opens already primed for that specific card.

deepdive_en.title: Starting from a reference photo
deepdive_en.body: You can pass any SwiftUI Image via the **sourceImage** parameter (a photo the person picked or an image the card already has), and Image Playground uses it as visual inspiration alongside the concepts. The user can still replace or refine it inside the sheet, so it's a starting point, not a constraint.

deepdive_en.title: Providing a visual suggestion using a drawing
deepdive_en.body: On iPad, Postcards shows a small canvas below the card front. **ImagePlaygroundConcept.drawing** takes a PencilKit **PKDrawing** and adds it as a concept, and the model treats the strokes as a visual suggestion that guides composition without locking it in.

deepdive_en.title: Adopt Image Playground in UIKit or AppKit
deepdive_en.body: A UIKit or AppKit app uses **ImagePlaygroundViewController** for the same experience: set concepts and options as properties before presentation, then implement imagePlaygroundViewController(_:didCreateImageAt:) on the delegate to receive the result. The API mirrors the SwiftUI version.

deepdive_en.title: Options
deepdive_en.body: **ImagePlaygroundOptions** and **ImagePlaygroundStyle** manage configuration: size and aspect ratio, available and preselected styles, and personalization. Whether generating card artwork, a lock screen wallpaper, a banner, or a Genmoji icon, the same API adapts to fit.

deepdive_en.title: Size Specification
deepdive_en.body: Postcards supports landscape, portrait, and square formats, each storing a CGSize passed directly to **.closest(to:)**, which the system maps to the closest supported aspect ratio and resolution. Since format is a property of the card, the size request adapts automatically and is passed to the sheet via **.imagePlaygroundOptions**.

deepdive_en.title: Styles
deepdive_en.body: **imagePlaygroundGenerationStyle** takes two arguments: the default style the picker opens on and an allowed list limiting which styles appear (illustration, sketch, animation, emoji). Passing a single style in the allowed list locks the picker to it. In Postcards each card carries a **StylePreset** mapping to these values, and the picker automatically reflects whichever card is open.

deepdive_en.title: External Provider Style
deepdive_en.body: **externalProvider** is an opt-in style that surfaces whatever third-party provider the person configured in Settings (for example **ChatGPT**). To offer it, append it to your .allowedStyles list; if a provider is configured the tab appears, and if not the system handles setup, requiring no check on your side. It can also be passed as the default style.

deepdive_en.title: Generating an expressive icon for the card thumbnail
deepdive_en.body: **ImagePlaygroundStyle.emoji** is tuned for expressive, emoji-scale characters. When active, the sheet fires a separate **onAdaptiveImageGlyphCreation** completion and hands you an **NSAdaptiveImageGlyph** instead of a URL. This adaptive image glyph can be embedded inline with text like an emoji, ideal for a card thumbnail next to the recipient's name.

deepdive_en.title: Disabling personalization when it doesn't fit your context
deepdive_en.body: Personalization is enabled by default and lets people include someone from Photos to make a card feel personal. If your context doesn't call for it (say, a product image generator), set **options.personalization** to .disabled and the people picker and name detection disappear from the sheet entirely.

deepdive_en.title: Availability
deepdive_en.body: Image Playground is available on devices that support **Apple Intelligence**, across supported languages and regions, and when the user has image generation enabled in Settings. The **supportsImageGeneration** environment value is all you need: when true, navigate to the full CardEditorView, and when false, navigate to a CardPickerView Photos fallback, with no entitlement or extra capability check.

deepdive_en.title: Supports image generation
deepdive_en.body: Reading the single **@Environment(\.supportsImageGeneration)** value cleanly supports both paths. The presenter closes by encouraging developers to consider where images live in their design and what only their app knows, the relationships, memories, and context to bring into the picture so the result feels made for that specific person. Image Playground brings the models, you bring the story.

title: Unlock in-game content with StoreKit and Background Assets
gloss: 用 StoreKit 與 Background Assets 解鎖遊戲內容
takeaway: 透過新的 Unity StoreKit 與 Background Assets 外掛，在遊戲中接上原生 IAP 並以隨選資產包縮減下載量。
chapters: Asset pack manifest for a localized asset pack
Convert Steam depots to asset packs
Convert a Steam depot to an asset pack manifest
Convert an asset pack manifest to an asset pack archive
StoreKit and Background Assets sample code
Fetch and purchase products with the StoreKit plug-in
Listen for Transaction updates with the StoreKit plug-in
Download asset packs with the Background Assets plug-in

points.text: 新的 **Unity StoreKit 外掛** 讓 Unity 遊戲直接使用原生 Apple 內購（IAP）。
用 **Background Assets** 與本地化資產包縮減初始下載量，依語言隨選下載內容。
透過 **xcrun ba-package** 把 Steam depot 轉成 asset pack manifest 與封存檔。
以 **Product.FetchProducts／Purchase** 取得並購買商品，並驗證交易後解鎖內容。
監聽 **Transaction.Updates** 處理消耗型與非消耗型商品，並以 CurrentEntitlements 為權益來源。

audience: 用 **Unity 開發遊戲** 並想整合 Apple 原生 IAP 與資產隨選下載的開發者。
gloss_en: Unlock in-game content with StoreKit and Background Assets
takeaway_en: Use the new Unity StoreKit and Background Assets plug-ins to wire up native IAP in your game and reduce download size with on-demand asset packs.

points_en.text: The new **Unity StoreKit plug-in** lets Unity games use native Apple In-App Purchases (IAP) directly.
Use **Background Assets** and localized asset packs to reduce the initial download size, downloading content on demand by language.
Use **xcrun ba-package** to turn a Steam depot into an asset pack manifest and archive.
Use **Product.FetchProducts / Purchase** to fetch and buy products, and unlock content after verifying the transaction.
Listen to **Transaction.Updates** to handle consumable and non-consumable products, using CurrentEntitlements as the source of truth for entitlements.

audience_en: Developers **building games with Unity** who want to integrate native Apple IAP and on-demand asset downloads.
